1password.name: 1Password
1password.note: Candidate sources describe a conversational, security-aware loop of about 3-6 weeks (TechPrep: 3-4 weeks; Glassdoor average about 21 days for engineers and 25 company-wide; one 2026 senior developer report took 6 weeks and ended in an accepted offer):
1password.roles: 1Password (password manager and identity security; Toronto, Vancouver, remote). Software Engineer / Software Developer, Senior Software Engineer / Senior Developer, Junior Developer, Frontend Engineer, Security-focused developers, Engineering Manager, plus Solutions Engineer, Account Executive, SDR / BDR, Customer Success and IT Ops Analyst roles in Glassdoor reports. Levels are not published beyond Junior / Senior titles.
steps: Recruiter screen (explains what to expect; mission alignment, remote-first communication)
Hiring-manager conversation, then a deep-dive chat with a senior engineer on your technical background and projects

A practical technical task: a take-home or live exercise (a Vancouver senior report: build an events API with POST and GET for account events; another: design an API with two endpoints); junior developers report a take-home assessment; some interviews are largely behavioral with no LeetCode

Final conversations with another hiring manager and two team engineers, then decision. TechPrep notes a security-first angle (threat modeling) and that behavioral stories should map to the company's core behaviors.

abnormal-ai.name: Abnormal AI
abnormal-ai.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports, Interview Query (candidates describe seven stages and a very AI-friendly process) and Taro:
abnormal-ai.roles: Abnormal AI (email security; San Francisco, New York, Toronto, Singapore, Bengaluru, Berlin). Glassdoor volume: Software Engineer (52), Software Engineer II (5), Senior Software Engineer (4), Full Stack Engineer, SDE in Bengaluru, plus account executive, security analyst, sales engineer and recruiter roles. Titles used in reports; no official numeric ladder seen.
steps: Application online, recruiter or referral; recruiter call, then a hiring-manager screen

Take-home assignment (React.js and Django in one Bengaluru report; a file-storage app: search by filename, dedupe, then explain your design and add search by file content in a follow-up review) and technical round; candidates are expected to use and show AI coding tools (a 2026 round called 'Build a file storage vault with AI tools'; one reviewer disliked an AI coding round, another says the process wants to see how you prompt AI)

Virtual onsite / full loop: hiring manager, system design with incident handling, past-project review, and code-review / feedback rounds ('imagine this code was written by a junior; what feedback would you give?'); older (2024) SWE II reports describe two LeetCode easy / medium questions

Decision. Timeline: Glassdoor shows about 60 days average hiring time (5 reports), with individual reports from 3-4 weeks to 2 months; Taro shows a 21% pass rate across 28 reports with 39% negative experiences; Glassdoor rates it about 2.8/5 with 25% positive for software engineers and 12 Senior SWE ratings very negative. Many recent candidates mention template rejections.

abnormal-security.name: Abnormal Security
abnormal-security.roles: Software Engineer (SWE I, II, Senior, Staff Back End), Machine Learning Engineer, Backend Engineer, Data Engineer, plus Account Executive, Customer Success Engineer, Security Analyst and Solutions Engineer roles. Engineering hiring spans the US and Bangalore. Titles with numbers such as Software Engineer 1 and 2 appear in job listings. Software Engineer is the largest report group (69 of 168 reports on one aggregator).
steps: Application online or via recruiter
Recruiter / HR screen
Online assessment (reported in one guide's four-round summary)
Technical screen, with AI-assisted coding in a large codebase appearing in a 2026 report; onsite discussions reported to include code review, debugging and system design
Hiring manager round and, in the company's own wording, a transparent process where candidates are given examples of values in action and can sit in on the weekly town hall
Decision. Guides say several weeks, with some reports up to two months; difficulty is rated medium (reports vary).

abridge.name: Abridge
abridge.roles: Software Engineer (Gen AI Platform, early career, full stack, AI evaluation platform, AI infrastructure), Senior / Staff Software Engineer (Agentic Engineering), Software Engineering Intern, Machine Learning Engineer, Lead ML Engineer, Product Manager. Abridge is a clinical-AI company (ambient clinical documentation), HQ in Pittsburgh with New York and San Francisco hubs and remote roles.
steps: Application online
Recruiter screen of about 30 min (mission alignment, interest in clinical AI, level calibration; one report says it was fairly light)
Technical rounds: coding (object-oriented programming problems, straightforward coding task in one report)

Onsite of about three technical sessions: data structures and algorithms, a frontend or infra round, and system design, plus one behavioral interview (an older ML-engineer report describes two intro calls then basic technical, culture and infrastructure interviews that are reviewed together afterwards)

Decision. Reports vary: a 2026 Taro report says the process took about 1 day, other guides describe 4-6 rounds. Candidates describe the process as clear, structured and supportive, with a practical rather than puzzle-style focus on judgment and ownership.

accenture-in-india.name: Accenture in India
accenture-in-india.note: Associate Software Engineer path per GeeksforGeeks and candidate reports (four rounds in a typical campus/off-campus drive): Timeline: Glassdoor shows about 21 days on average for software engineers across 1,791 reports (26 days company-wide); reports vary from 1 day (on-campus) to 2 months and, for some experienced hires, up to 6 months. Taro shows high pass rates for junior India reports. Glassdoor rates the process 2.7/5 difficulty with 72% positive.
accenture-in-india.roles: Associate Software Engineer (largest early-career entry route; also 'Packaged App Development' profile per GeeksforGeeks), Software Engineer / Software Developer Engineer, Custom Software Engineer (about 15K India job listings on Glassdoor), Application Development Analyst / Applications Development Analyst, Analyst, Consultant, Management Consultant, Senior and Lead roles. Glassdoor volume: Software Engineer (about 8,600 reports), Analyst (about 6,500), Associate Software Engineer (about 5,600). India sites include Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Chennai, Dehradun. Accenture India uses levels like Analyst / Senior Analyst / Consultant / Manager in general; no engineering ladder seen.
steps: Application through the careers site, university/campus drive or off-campus hiring
Online assessment: cognitive and technical assessment with aptitude (quantitative, logical, verbal), pseudo-code and coding questions; communication assessment (listening, reading) in some drives

Technical interview: self introduction, projects and resume skills, core CS and the programming language you know; scenario questions on cloud (for example high-level solution on Azure) for some roles

Communication / HR interview (about 30 min: introduction, strengths and weaknesses, willingness to relocate), then offer; Interview Query says take-home application-design assignments and a presentation round can appear for experienced software engineers

addepar.name: Addepar
addepar.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Staff Backend / Frontend Software Engineer (platform integration, portfolio data workflows, AI platform), Software Engineer Intern, plus Client Support Analyst, Solutions Consultant and Business Development roles in Glassdoor counts. Addepar is a wealth-management data platform with offices in New York, Mountain View, Edinburgh and Pune. No official level codes seen beyond title tiers.
steps: Application online, university / career fair or recruiter
Recruiter screen
Timed online coding exercise (HackerRank in some reports, Python allowed) and/or a technical phone screen

Onsite or virtual onsite with several interviews: product walkthrough or domain discussion, coding, system design, debug session and behavioral; one onsite report counts 5 interviews of which 2 were coding and 1 system design

Decision. Guides say 4-7 rounds; Glassdoor shows about 16 days on average for software engineers, but some reports mention 7 stages over about 2 months, and several candidates describe a weak recruiting process and silence after interviews (reports vary).

adia.name: Adia
adia.note: Not enough evidence to describe a software-engineer interview process. The only usable fragments: for the Adia project manager role, Dataford describes a screening call, a project-management examination and an interview with leadership over about 3-5 weeks; the one Glassdoor report for Adia (Austin) says candidates were asked to do a very lengthy project that felt like free work. Please tell me which Adia the sheet means if you want me to dig deeper.
adia.roles: Name is ambiguous and no software-engineer interview reports for it were found. Candidates: (a) Adia, a staffing / workforce app company (Glassdoor 'Adia', Austin TX and elsewhere) whose only report found is for a Delivery Operations Manager; (b) ADIA, the Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, which hires through technology and ADIA Lab (data science, AI, computational scientists, quantitative researchers) and runs scholarship and residency programs; (c) a Dataford guide for 'ADIA' that is based on 17 reports but mainly lists a Marketing Analytics Specialist and a Project Manager.

adobe.name: Adobe
adobe.note: Timeline: guides say about 3-6 weeks, Glassdoor-style stats suggest about a month overall; campus hiring can finish in a day. Rounds vary by team and level.
adobe.roles: Software Engineer ladder per candidate guides (unofficial): Software Engineer 1 (P10 / entry), SE 2, SE 3 (P30), SE 4 (P40), SE 5 (P50), then Principal (about SE 5.5) and Fellow; engineering manager roles also appear. Other families seen in reports: design, product management, data science, and a lot of India campus/off-campus SDE reports.
steps: Application (portal, referral or campus), resume screen
Recruiter screening call
Online assessment for some teams/campus hiring (coding and problem solving)
One or two technical phone/video screens: DSA coding, core CS and OOP questions, project discussion

Virtual or on-site loop of roughly 3-5 rounds: DSA, low-level design, and for senior levels high-level system design (one engineer said system design outweighs DSA at senior levels); some loops add a presentation
Hiring manager and/or HR conversation, then decision

adyen.name: Adyen
adyen.note: Engineering path per candidate reports: Timeline: guides say about 3-6 weeks over 5-6 stages; Glassdoor shows about 26 days company-wide; some candidates describe the process as very long. Taro pass rates are low (about 10% for Amsterdam software engineers, 50% in Singapore).
adyen.roles: Software Engineer (52 Glassdoor reports), Java Software Engineer, Software Engineer II, Senior Software Engineer / Senior Software Developer, Lead Software Engineer, Staff Engineer (e.g. Financial Products), AI engineer, plus account manager, product manager and technical support engineer. Locations: Amsterdam (main), Singapore, Chicago, San Francisco, Auckland. A SE II evaluation in a December 2025 report shows engineers can be levelled up or down during the process; no official ladder seen.
steps: Application online, via LinkedIn or a staffing agency
Recruiter / HR call (about 30 min: career history, motivation, understanding of Adyen)

Technical test: online assessment or HackerRank-style task (live coding or take-home), followed by a call to discuss your solution; topics include backtracking, concurrency, designing a globally unique identifier, Java/Spring Boot and architecture
Technical + system design round and team round (one report lists 6-7 rounds with 3-5 business days between them)

Adyen Formula interview: a 45-60 minute behavioral round against Adyen's eight core principles, often described as the most important stage, plus a leadership interview (for one candidate invited to the Amsterdam office)
Offer

affirm.name: Affirm
affirm.roles: Software Engineer (SWE I / II / Senior / Staff / Senior Staff / Principal; one candidate-guide site labels these L4 through L9, unofficial), New Grad / Early Career software engineer, engineering manager and director, product manager, analyst. Glassdoor report volume is dominated by Software Engineer, then Senior Software Engineer, with smaller counts for Analyst and Product Manager.
steps: Application online (or recruiter outreach)
Recruiter call (about 30 min)

Technical phone / live coding screen with a senior engineer (about 1 hour); some reports describe a practical, Python-friendly task such as a small card-game style exercise, and reports say it is not always a classic LeetCode problem
Hiring manager conversation (behavioral plus project discussion)

Final loop of several rounds: coding, live codebase navigation or debugging, fintech-flavored system design for experienced levels, behavioral; senior and staff candidates may be asked to present a project they led (architecture, tradeoffs, business case)
Decision. Reports vary: about 2 to 5 weeks overall, with some new-grad reports of an offer within about 48 hours of the final round.

agoda.name: Agoda
agoda.note: Agoda's own tech hiring guide says the exact structure varies by role and seniority but typically includes 4 rounds, starting with a coding round; the recruiter conversation can cover salary expectations, availability and relocation (e.g. to Bangkok). From candidate reports:
agoda.roles: Software Engineer (associate, software engineer, senior, staff, lead, principal per a candidate guide, unofficial; Agoda's own tech guide mentions IC levels such as IC5 Backend Lead), Full Stack and Backend Engineers, Software Engineer Interns, plus Project Manager, Analyst and Customer Support roles in Glassdoor. Offices include Bangkok, Gurgaon and others.
steps: Recruiter screen
Coding round (HackerRank-style, two medium DSA questions, explain your approach and pass all test cases)
Further technical rounds: platform engineering and code review, system design, distributed systems questions, project discussion
Culture and impact / hiring manager round, then offer. Glassdoor average for senior engineers is about 33 days; guides say 4-8 weeks in some cases.

ai2.name: Ai2
ai2.roles: Software Engineer (AI for the Planet, Earth Ranger, platform), Senior Software Engineer, Lead Software Engineer, Senior Platform Engineer, Senior Data Engineer, Research Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, AI Research Scientist. Ai2 (Allen Institute for AI) is a Seattle non-profit research institute; the sheet links allenai.org. No official level codes beyond Senior / Lead titles.
steps: Application online (Ai2 job postings are hosted on its Greenhouse board)
Short, warm recruiter or video screen (reports say no online assessment in some 2025 cases)
Hiring manager interview (about 30 minutes) or a 1-hour technical interview split about 20 minutes behavioral and 40 minutes technical

Further rounds reported: HR business partner round, an assignment, and an onsite with multiple team members for ML roles; one 2025 candidate criticizes the process as less open than Ai2's culture suggests
Decision. Reports say about 3-4 weeks, with one 2025 report of 2 months; a third-party guide says 3-6 weeks for research scientists (reports vary).

aim-intelligent-machine.name: Aim Intelligent Machine
aim-intelligent-machine.note: Very few candidate reports. Per Glassdoor reports (2022-2023, 3 ratings, mostly negative and difficult): application online, a brief orientation meeting about AIM's goals, then a technical assignment; or recruiter chat, technical screen and onsite (one candidate withdrew before the onsite for another role); a take-home coding challenge described as hard for the 2-hour limit with a vague problem; a LeetCode-style question plus questions about past experience; one ML engineer interview began with a general orientation without direct questions. A September 2026 Senior+ software-engineer report on PracHub describes a technical screen with a merge-intervals problem and a curveball follow-up, outcome rejected, difficulty medium. Process length reported as 3 days to 1 week. Treat this row as thin and low-confidence.
aim-intelligent-machine.roles: AIM Intelligent Machines (autonomous earth-moving / heavy-equipment robotics, Seattle and Bellevue WA). Roles seen: Senior Software Engineer (AI and Robotics), Embodied AI Engineer, Perception & SLAM ML Engineer, Robotics Software Engineer, Full Stack Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Senior Engineer Firmware, Senior Engineer Robotic Simulation, C++ Engineer (Firmware & Simulation), Infrastructure Engineer, Product Engineer (Infrastructure, UI & DevTools), ML Engineer, hardware engineers. A September 2026 report is tagged Senior+. I did not use pages about AIM Consulting Group or Applied Intuition, which are different companies.

airbnb.name: Airbnb
airbnb.roles: Software Engineer (new grad, Software Engineer, Senior, Staff, Senior Staff, Principal; candidate guides label these G8-G14, unofficial), interns, Product Manager, Customer Experience Specialist, Safety Specialist, Recruiter per Glassdoor.
steps: Recruiter screen / call (~30 min)
Timed online coding test (HackerRank-style) and/or ~1 hr technical phone screen
Onsite loop: coding (hard DP-type problems reported), system design, and a Core Values interview that carries real weight; one account mentions a code-review round
Decision. Roughly 3-5 weeks typically (Glassdoor data), up to 8+ weeks in some cases.

airtable.name: Airtable
airtable.roles: Software Engineer (full stack, frontend, backend, new grad), Senior Software Engineer, Data Engineer, Solutions Engineer. A third-party guide labels engineering levels IC4-IC6 (unofficial).
steps: Recruiter call
Online assessment (new grad / early career) or a technical screen; product engineers may get a coding assignment or feature/API design exercise

Multi-round virtual loop (often described as ~5 rounds of one hour each): coding (data-structure work like serializing nested data with circular references, table / CSV processing), system design, a distinctive pull-request review round, product judgment, AI-fluency discussion in 2026 reports, a hiring-manager round and behavioral
Decision. About 5-8 weeks per one guide (candidate reports of ~4 weeks to first stages). Taro reports a very low pass rate for US software engineers and many candidates describe it as hard.

airwallex.name: Airwallex
airwallex.note: Airwallex Engineering's own 2022 Medium post says every interview path starts with a call with a recruiter who explains the company, the role and the hiring process, and that the process is designed to mirror day-to-day work and connect you with people who can talk openly about life there. From that and candidate reports:
airwallex.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (Singapore, Amsterdam, Australia), Backend Engineer (Java/Kotlin, distributed systems), Frontend Engineer, AI Engineer, Product Manager (guides describe consulting-style case interviews and heavy executive involvement). Levels are not publicly structured.
steps: Recruiter / HR screening call

Technical screen(s): first conversation about your projects and tech stack, then a technical interview with a principal or senior engineer (LeetCode-style plus OOP simulation or database-modeling questions); frontend candidates report a small build task and a ~1.5 hr project-and-behavior interview with an engineering manager and a lead engineer
Later rounds with a bar raiser (reported for the Senior SWE path), possibly a senior leader
Offer. About 4-6 weeks per Glassdoor reports; some candidates report delays and slow communication, and the process appears to vary by team and office.

akuna-capital.name: Akuna Capital
akuna-capital.roles: Software Engineer (junior / mid-level / senior tiers per candidate guides, unofficial), split by language track (C++ developer vs Python developer), plus quantitative developer and quant trading intern roles seen in reports. Reports in the sheet are most likely for software engineering.
steps: Online application (some via career fair or Glassdoor)
Online assessment on HackerRank: coding, sometimes with C++ / OS multiple choice; reports describe simulation-style or LeetCode-style problems
Technical phone or video screen (C++ and data structures / algorithms focus; some reports mention a one-way video round)
Further technical rounds, with deeper C++, low-latency / systems and order-book style questions, then an HR / culture conversation
Decision. Reports range from about 2-3 weeks to several slow weeks (reports vary); candidate data suggests the process is very selective.

altruist.name: Altruist
altruist.note: Dataford summarises the engineering loop as about 3-5 weeks and 3 rounds (mobile engineers: about 2-4 weeks and 2 rounds): A Solutions Architect guide counts 7 interview rounds, so the process length depends heavily on the role. Dataford rates difficulty about 4.7 out of 10 with positive culture comments from employees. No detailed individual candidate reports were available in these results.
altruist.roles: Altruist (fintech and AI platform for financial advisors / RIAs; Los Angeles / Culver City, San Francisco). Software Engineer, Backend Engineer, Staff Back End Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack, Internal Tools; 5+ yrs), Mobile Engineer, Data Engineer, Senior Engineering Manager (Credit and Lending), Software Engineering Intern (Summer 2026, hybrid LA), Solutions Architect, Customer Success Engineer, Product Manager. Dataford has guides for 19 roles from 36 reports. Levels are not published beyond Intern / Senior / Staff.
steps: Initial screen (recruiter) with mission and fit discussion

Technical interview(s): practical coding and system design (high-availability, high-throughput services; database isolation levels in a financial context), discussions that pivot to product scenarios for mobile and frontend roles
Final team / cross-functional and behavioral round (collaboration, receptiveness to feedback, mission alignment)

amazon.name: Amazon
amazon.roles: Software Development Engineer (SDE): SDE I (L4, entry), SDE II (L5), SDE III / Senior (L6), Principal (L7) - levels come from candidate guides, not Amazon. Data Scientist also appears (recruiter + phone screen, then a 4-6 interview loop, 45-60 min each). Glassdoor also lists Program Manager, Operations Manager and similar.
steps: Online application
Online assessment (commonly HackerRank-style coding plus work-style questions) for SDE I/II
Technical phone screen, 1-2 rounds (~60 min), coding plus Leadership Principles (system design at SDE III)
Loop of 4-6 interviews, 45-60 min each, mixing coding, system design and Leadership Principles
Bar Raiser: a trained interviewer from outside the team, with a strong say in the final decision
Debrief, outcome usually within about 5 business days

ambience.name: Ambience
ambience.note: Few first-hand reports. A Taro report (July 2024, San Francisco, via recruiter, about 2 months, negative): a take-home that tests scaling an operation and a system design of a game, then a virtual onsite of three parts: reviewing the project with a panel of the current team, a behavioral interview, and a 75-minute interview with the hiring manager. techinterview.org (updated September 2026) reports a topgrading interview with a senior leader (a chronological walk through every job: scope, results, what references would say), rounds on eval rubrics, EHR latency, rate-limited upstream APIs and tenant isolation under compliance constraints, and one onsite with a case interview (flights and hotel covered, shape directional). Process length is not clearly reported. Treat details as indicative; confirm with the recruiter.
ambience.roles: Ambience Healthcare (AI for clinical documentation and medical coding, San Francisco, in-office or hybrid). Roles seen: Senior Software Engineer (Platform, Product, AI Platform), Senior Backend Software Engineer, Staff Software Engineer (Product; Distributed Systems), Staff Full-Stack Engineer, Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Staff ML Engineer (Frontier AI), Senior Data Engineer, Engineering Manager (Product), Clinical AI Researcher. Posted bands include $250k-$300k base for staff roles (per techinterview.org, 2026). I did not use pages about Abridge, a competitor, that came up in results. No numeric ladder seen.

ambience-healthcare.name: Ambience Healthcare
ambience-healthcare.note: Few first-hand reports. A Taro report (July 2024, San Francisco, via recruiter, about 2 months, negative): a take-home that tests scaling an operation and a system design of a game, then a virtual onsite of three parts: reviewing the project with a panel of the current team, a behavioral interview, and a 75-minute interview with the hiring manager. techinterview.org (updated September 2026) reports a topgrading interview with a senior leader (a chronological walk through every job: scope, results, what references would say), rounds on eval rubrics, EHR latency, rate-limited upstream APIs and tenant isolation under compliance constraints, and one onsite with a case interview (flights and hotel covered, shape directional). Process length is not clearly reported. Treat details as indicative; confirm with the recruiter.
ambience-healthcare.roles: Ambience Healthcare (AI for clinical documentation and medical coding, San Francisco, in-office or hybrid). Roles seen: Senior Software Engineer (Platform, Product, AI Platform), Senior Backend Software Engineer, Staff Software Engineer (Product; Distributed Systems), Staff Full-Stack Engineer, Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Staff ML Engineer (Frontier AI), Senior Data Engineer, Engineering Manager (Product), Clinical AI Researcher. Posted bands include $250k-$300k base for staff roles (per techinterview.org, 2026). I did not use pages about Abridge, a competitor, that came up in results. No numeric ladder seen.

amd.name: AMD
amd.roles: Software Engineer (incl. Senior Software Engineer, Software Developer, intern / co-op), Member of Technical Staff (MTS, Senior MTS, up to Fellow / Corporate Fellow per candidate guides, with L-numbers that are unofficial), plus a large hardware-side volume: Silicon Design Engineer, Design Verification Engineer, Physical Design Engineer, Product Development Engineer. Glassdoor volume is mostly Software Engineer, Intern and MTS, with offices in Santa Clara, Austin, Markham, Bengaluru and Hyderabad.
steps: Application online
Recruiter / HR call (some reports mention 2-3 initial phone screens covering background and the job description)
Online assessment or skills test in some regions (OA only, no follow-up, in one report)
Hiring-manager round (about 45 min) and technical screens: OOP fundamentals, systems concepts, GPU / hardware-software interaction, parallel computing, practical coding

Technical loop / onsite of several rounds, including debugging and explaining code, project deep-dive, and a system design prompt for experienced candidates (e.g. collecting and analysing GPU performance data)
Decision. Reports vary: roughly 3-5 weeks per one guide, though Glassdoor shows short average hiring times (about 8-12 days). Pass rates differ a lot by site and team in small Taro samples.

amperity.name: Amperity
amperity.roles: Software Engineer / Senior Software Engineer (Senior+ also reported), Software Development Engineer Intern (Summer 2026 posting), Machine Learning Engineer, data-focused engineering roles. Offices mentioned in reports: Seattle and Buenos Aires. One 2026 report says the company is moving toward forward-deployed-engineer style work.
steps: Application online or employee referral
Take-home / online DSA assessment of about 90 minutes (per Interview Query), or one to two technical phone screens
System design round of about 60 min
Final coding loop / virtual onsite, in some cycles up to five virtual onsites, covering coding, system design, behavioral and AI-integration discussion; a behavioral screen with the hiring manager

Decision. Reports vary: described as very fast (about 2 weeks from first interview to final loop) in some reports, but one 2026 candidate describes a long loop followed by silence and a senior reviewer notes about 2 months. ML engineer guides suggest 3-5 weeks.

amplitude.name: Amplitude
amplitude.note: Candidate sources describe about 3-5 rounds over 3-4 weeks (Glassdoor reports as quick as 1 week):
amplitude.roles: Software Engineer I, Software Engineer II, Senior Software Engineer, Staff Software Engineer (levels from Levels.fyi data quoted by a third-party page, unofficial), Data Engineer, AI Engineer, Engineering Manager, Solutions Engineer, Technical Writer, Data Scientist. Based in San Francisco and other offices.
steps: Resume screen and initial recruiter phone screen
Technical screen with an engineer: hands-on coding in Python (small data-oriented tasks), pair programming (e.g. build an events table)

More technical rounds: LeetCode medium to medium-hard style questions, system design and operations questions (such as what you would monitor to know a release is going wrong), then a hiring-manager round with a technical deep dive and behavioral questions
Final conversations with executives in some cases, then team matching and offer negotiation. Values like a growth mindset, humility and ownership are emphasised.

ancestry.name: Ancestry
ancestry.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (largest group), Principal Software Engineer, Frontend Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, Software Engineer Co-op / Intern, plus Product Manager, Customer Solutions Associate and customer service roles in Glassdoor counts. Reports come from Lehi, Provo, San Francisco and other sites. No official level codes seen beyond title tiers.
steps: Application online, employee referral, recruiter or Hired.com style platforms
Recruiter phone call (some older reports describe it as unstructured and the recruiter as unprepared)

Technical phone interview with an engineer: easy-to-medium coding, JSON and parsing, Java or JavaScript questions, CS concepts such as databases and runtime; AWS, Python and Terraform for platform roles
Onsite or series of Zoom calls with the team (about 90 minutes in an intern format: 45 minutes with a senior engineer and 45 with a manager), covering problem solving depth and collaboration
Decision. Reports range from 2 weeks to 3 months; some candidates describe recruiter coordination as unorganized, while 2026 reports call it quick and straightforward (reports vary).

anchorage-digital.name: Anchorage Digital
anchorage-digital.note: Candidate sources describe about 4 weeks to roughly 2 months, with up to 7 interviews in one report:
anchorage-digital.roles: Anchorage Digital (federally chartered crypto custody bank, New York and remote). Member of Technical Staff (MTS; level decided during the process), Software Engineer / SDE, Senior Engineer, Software Engineering Intern (Summer 2026), PlatSec / IT and Security MTS, Product Manager, Business Development Representative, Account Executive.
steps: Recruiter screen (background, experience, motivation); the first outreach can be via LinkedIn

First technical round with an engineer: initial tech + behavioral conversation and a coding round (e.g. design an in-memory database that supports multiple pending transactions that can be committed or rolled back)
System design interview, another coding interview, and technical design discussion

Behavioral interview with an engineering manager, then a final interview with executives on cultural fit, values and long-term vision. Some candidates found the process disorganized or ending before the full loop; others call it well-structured and respectful.

anduril.name: Anduril
anduril.note: Timeline: guides say about 3-4 weeks; reports vary from 2 weeks to about 3-4 months for some robotics or new-grad cases.
anduril.roles: Software Engineer (including robotics software engineer, new grad), plus embedded/autonomy, hardware and defense-systems engineering roles. A new-grad report on Exponent tags entry level / L3 (unofficial). Anduril builds defense and autonomous-systems products.
steps: Recruiter call (about 30 min; 'why Anduril' and logistics)
Technical phone screen and/or hiring manager call (about 1 hour); new-grad report: no online assessment, 60-minute engineer phone screen

Onsite/final loop: about 3-5 separate interviews of about 60 min (about 4 hours total in one guide): coding (graphs, heaps, tries, API-style problems), system design, in-depth project review, and a behavioral/values round that some candidates say carries the most weight
Team matching may happen at the end (hybrid process), then decision

anrok.name: Anrok
anrok.note: Candidate sources describe about 3-6 weeks (Interview Query: 3-5 weeks; Glassdoor reports include a 6-week recruiter-led process):
anrok.roles: Anrok (sales tax compliance automation for internet businesses, San Francisco / remote). Software Engineer (backend and frontend, Typescript stack; early career postings exist), RPA Software Engineer, Agentic AI Engineer, Engineering Manager, Solutions Engineer, Product Manager, Account Executive, Operations Manager. Levels are not published.
steps: Application and resume review, then a recruiter screen

Technical phone screen: about 1 hour of practical coding, with one October 2026 report describing a one-hour concurrency round on batching HTTP requests that ended in rejection; a 1Point3Acres post mentions a full-time tech phone screen with a coding challenge
Practical coding and algorithms, system design and data modeling discussions across backend and frontend, then a behavioral / cultural-fit interview (communication, conflict resolution, ambiguity)
Final decision. Glassdoor engineers describe both easy and negative experiences.

ansys.name: Ansys
ansys.roles: Software Engineer (C++ / C#, R&D Engineer II), Software Engineer Intern and Co-op, plus simulation-side roles: Application Engineer, Senior Application Engineer (structural, RF, thermal, fluids). Note: Ansys is now part of Synopsys, and Glassdoor says to see Synopsys's profile for current data. Offices: Canonsburg PA, Vancouver, Toronto, Bengaluru, Munich, Irvine, Austin, Tokyo.
steps: Application online, referral, campus fair or recruiter
Recruiter / HR phone screen (15-30 min on resume, co-op timing, location, salary expectations)
Online technical assessment in some cycles: an adaptive C++11/C++14 multiple-choice exam of about 1.5 hours; some candidates are skipped straight to the interview

Technical interview with a manager and/or engineers: C++ (pointers, references, upcasting, constructors), OOP, LeetCode-medium / tree and string problems, solid mechanics and finite-element knowledge for simulation-focused teams; a codepair for intern roles

Longer onsite / panel for some teams: about 4.5 hours of coding and background with team members, three back-to-back interviews with senior engineers, or a 30-min technical presentation plus discussion for senior roles

Decision. Reports vary: about 1-4 weeks for most, 2+ months in a few. Glassdoor puts SWE hiring at about 7 days and company-wide at 13 days; some candidates mention a template rejection with no feedback.

anthropic.name: Anthropic
anthropic.roles: Software Engineer (incl. infrastructure, safeguards, product), research engineer, machine learning engineer, research scientist, forward deployed engineer. Few product manager roles per a university career blog. Levels in candidate guides run roughly junior-mid to senior to staff (unofficial).
steps: Recruiter screen (15-30 min on background and interest)
Online assessment, often a ~90 min CodeSignal-style task where you build a small working system in levels
1-2 technical interviews: practical live coding, system design for experienced engineers
Virtual onsite: more technical rounds, project deep dive, and a values / culture interview, plus hiring manager conversation
Offer. Reports range from 2 weeks to 1-4 months, usually 3-6 weeks. No ML research background needed for SWE roles per one guide.

antra.name: Antra
antra.note: Reports describe a short, fundamentals-focused process (Glassdoor average is about 1-5 days, with some candidates reporting 2-4 weeks):
antra.roles: Antra Inc (IT services / consulting and training-to-placement firm, Sterling VA; offices across the US and India). Software Engineer, Software Engineer - Java Developer, Full Stack Developer (including MEAN stack), .NET Developer, React Developer, Data Engineer, Java Developer, Junior Java Developer, Principal Software Engineer. Many roles are entry-level with client placement.
steps: Recruiter / HR phone call (~20 min on resume, career goals, and an explanation of Antra's program and company; basic questions about visa status and start dates also appear)

Video interview with recorded answers, or a live technical session (20-30 min): coding question (e.g. linked list, arrays, easy LeetCode), Java basics (OOP, HashMap vs HashTable, abstract class vs interface, collections, Spring annotations), JavaScript / HTML / CSS fundamentals, MVC pattern, event loop
A second round on building a program and explaining your thinking; some candidates describe a two-week intensive training period before a final ending round interview
Offer. Glassdoor ratings are mixed (50% positive for software engineers), and several candidates declined offers.

anyscale.name: Anyscale
anyscale.roles: Software Engineer (Ray Data, Platform Infrastructure Foundations and other specialized teams), Senior Software Engineer, Staff Software Engineer, Member of Technical Staff, Research Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer (L4 LLM role mentioned on a forum), Lead Security Engineer. Anyscale is the company behind Ray, based in San Francisco with a Bengaluru presence. Only an L4 code appears in forum titles; no official level codes confirmed.
steps: Application online (the careers board is on Ashby) or via recruiter
Recruiter screen

Technical phone screen of about 1.5 hours with a software engineer and the hiring manager (distributed systems questions, a debugging interview, coding such as designing a ThreadPool class, and behavioral questions)

Onsite of two back-to-back interviews in one 2025 report; guides say a multi-session loop with peers, hiring manager and cross-functional people, with deep distributed-systems and AI infrastructure emphasis
Reference checks for some roles, then decision. Guides say about 3-5 weeks; one report heard back in 3 days after the onsite and another process took 4 weeks (reports vary).

apple.name: Apple
apple.roles: Software Engineer with internal ICT levels (ICT2, ICT3 ... up to principal; older guides use Software Engineer I-V, unofficial). Hiring is team-owned across areas like wireless, devices, services and retail engineering. Glassdoor also shows Senior Software Engineer and Sales reports.
steps: Resume screen / recruiter or hiring manager contact
Pre-screen HR call (casual)
1-2 technical phone screens (~45 min each, coding and algorithms, team-specific)
Onsite or virtual panel, often 5 rounds and sometimes up to ~10 interviews over a day, mixing coding, design, team-specific domain questions and behavioral (behavioral weighs heavily)
Team-owned decision, then offer. Least standardized of big tech: about 4 weeks to 3 months.

applied.name: Applied
applied.roles: Assumed to be Applied Intuition (autonomous-vehicle simulation software, Mountain View and Sunnyvale CA); 'Applied' alone could also mean Applied Materials, Applied Systems or others, which were not checked. At Applied Intuition: Software Engineer (largest group, about 71 Glassdoor reports; Senior, Staff, Principal levels), Software Development Engineer, ML Engineer, Engineering Manager, Technical Program Manager, plus recruiter and business-development roles.
steps: Application online, referral or recruiter; a recruiter call (sometimes two) covering your background, the work culture and project options
Technical screen of 45-60 min on a CoderPad-style platform: one LeetCode-style problem or a practical data problem with follow-ups (maximum velocity and maximum range from returned data)

Virtual onsite of several rounds: LeetCode-style coding, system design for experienced levels, a deep dive into your most impactful project, and a behavioral interview (one candidate says there is more behavioral than expected)
Decision. Reports vary: about 2-4 weeks for most. Taro stats (25 Mountain View SWE reports) show a pass rate of roughly 8%, and many candidates report no offer despite a positive experience.

applied-intuition.name: Applied Intuition
applied-intuition.roles: Software Engineer, Senior, Lead, Staff and Principal Software Engineer (levels from candidate guides, unofficial), Machine Learning Engineer, Systems Engineer, Application Engineer, Engineering Manager, Technical Program Manager, Technical Recruiter, Business Development, and Vehicle Operator - Data Collection. Builds software for autonomous vehicles and ADAS.
steps: Recruiter screen (behavioral: background, interest, fit); sometimes a second recruiter call explaining the process and culture
Technical screen: ~45 min CoderPad-style live coding (e.g. 1 LeetCode-style problem with follow-up requirements)
Onsite / virtual onsite: multiple rounds of algorithm-heavy coding with real-world twists, design, a project deep dive and a sizeable behavioral round
Decision. Fast and selective: about 2-4 weeks; ML engineer loops can be as short as 2 rounds in about a week.

applovin.name: Applovin
applovin.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports and guides:
applovin.roles: Software Engineer (largest share, 57 Dataford reports; Palo Alto CA, San Francisco), Software Engineer I (entry level), Software Engineer (Games, Unity), full-stack and mobile engineers, software engineering interns, business analysts, account executives and UX/UI designers. Levels seen only as titles (SE I, SE, Senior); no official ladder.
steps: Application online, LinkedIn, referral, recruiter or university recruiter
Recruiter phone screen (about 30 min: past experience, visa status, future plans; the recruiter explains the process)

Technical phone interview with an engineering manager or senior engineer: standard data structures and design; entry-level reports mention two easy LeetCode questions (cycle detection / Floyd's algorithm appeared); a Games role leads with a behavioral HR round then a technical interview on Unity and game design coding

Onsite loop: coding on trees, graphs, BFS/DFS and dynamic programming, plus system-design discussions; one July 2024 candidate was asked to build an application from scratch; culture-fit questions ('why AppLovin', 'how do you align with the company's culture')

Offer. Timeline: Dataford says about 3-6 weeks across 3 rounds, with offers sometimes within days of the final round; Taro pass rate is about 32-38% across 13-22 reports. Candidate sentiment is mostly positive.

arista.name: Arista
arista.note: Systems-software focused; guides count 3-5 rounds over about 3-5 weeks (Glassdoor average about 12-14 days):
arista.roles: Arista Networks. Software Engineer (EOS, platform, C/C++ systems; levels labelled 2, 3L, 3H, 4H, 5H, 6 in a candidate guide, unofficial), Senior Software Engineer, Software Developer (Vancouver, Dublin, Santa Clara), plus networking and test roles.
steps: Recruiter screen that walks through the interview steps, or an online assessment on HackerRank

Coding challenge / technical phone round (about 45 min): short intro, then problems that may include analysing buggy code, live coding on CoderPad or over SSH, C/C++ fundamentals, linked lists and BSTs

Onsite / virtual rounds: more coding, a networking and OS deep dive (processes, threads, scheduling, virtual memory, mutexes, networking protocols), distributed-systems or design discussion for experienced roles, and a ~30 min managerial / behavioral interview
Decision. Taro shows a pass rate of about 20% across 332 reports; some candidates note the interview content can differ from the job description.

arize.name: Arize
arize.note: Reports describe a multi-stage but fairly practical process, about 2-4 weeks (one report: 2 months via a recruiter):
arize.roles: Arize AI (ML / LLM observability and evaluation platform; Berkeley CA, New York, Denver, Raleigh, remote). Software Engineer, platform engineer, DevOps engineer, AI Application Engineer (2-5 yrs, remote), Machine Learning Solutions Engineer (incl. Junior), developer advocate, plus sales and marketing roles. Levels are not published.
steps: Screening call with the hiring manager (technical plus behavioral), or a phone screen then a light technical interview
Take-home project (emailed after the early calls), followed by a review of the take-home with an engineer

Technical interview with an engineer: a coding round in a real editor in a language of your choice and a system design interview around Arize's domain (observability, tracing); an August 2026 PracHub report mentions a concurrency problem (three threads printing 0 to n in order)

Final conversations, including a meeting with a founder or CEO and, for solutions roles, a mock software demo; some candidates count six interviews in total. The process is described as extensive; Glassdoor reports range from positive to negative.

arm.name: Arm
arm.roles: Software Engineer (largest group), Senior Software Engineer, Staff Engineer, Graduate Engineer and Graduate Software Engineer, Software Engineer Intern, plus a large hardware side: Hardware Engineer, Verification Engineer, Design Engineer, Senior Design Engineer. Glassdoor volume also includes Project Manager and Director. Offices: Cambridge, Manchester, Durham (UK), Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Austin, Galway.
steps: Application online, referral, university or recruiter
HireVue video screen or HackerRank-style online test for some cycles; resume-focused first conversation

Technical rounds: C pointers and short C functions with compiler-optimization questions, Arm assembly (e.g. if-then-else with predication), computer architecture and memory systems, operating systems, OOP design, binary trees and linked lists, plus behavioral and cultural-fit questions; some reports mention programming on paper
Final / panel interviews; Arm uses a consensus-based decision, so interviewers coordinate feedback before an offer
Decision. Reports vary: about 1 week to 5 weeks for most, around 33 days on Glassdoor for SWE (39 days company-wide), and a few reports of 3 months with a chaotic process.

armada.name: Armada
armada.note: Public interview detail is very thin; nothing is published by the company. From the few candidate reports I found:
armada.roles: Armada (edge computing / sovereign AI infrastructure; Bellevue WA, Bengaluru, Thiruvananthapuram, Washington DC). Roles seen on its Greenhouse board and job sites: Software Engineer (about $118-130k), Senior Software Engineer (Edge Infrastructure, AI Infrastructure about $158-197k, GPUaaS, networking, open-source ecosystem), Lead / Staff Software Engineer (12+ years), Software Engineer Azure Stack / Azure Arc, AI Engineer (3+ years), Front End Developer, Engineering Manager, and an unpaid Software Engineer Intern. Levels are in job titles and years of experience; no numeric ladder. I did not use pages for other companies called Armada (for example Armada Hoffler or Armada in France).
steps: Application online or via recruiter; a recruiter / HR screen

A Glassdoor AI Engineer report (Washington DC, January 2026): an initial HR screen, then three interviews with the manager and colleagues, the last a three-person panel asking ML, deep-learning and research-paper questions

A 1point3acres full-time onsite report describes unexpected issues in coding and system design rounds and the candidate's final decision (details behind a login); a Front End Developer report (March 2025, via recruiter, 5 days) describes a good HR interaction and a technical interview on your past experience, CSS, JavaScript, ReactJS and Redux Saga

Decision. Glassdoor has about 4-5 reports with ratings of about 3/5 difficulty and mostly positive experiences; timelines range from 5 days upward. Treat everything here as indicative only and ask the recruiter for the loop for your role (infrastructure, networking, GPUaaS and AI roles will differ).

asana.name: Asana
asana.note: Asana publishes its own engineering interview guide (see official sources) and a technical interview skills guide called Asana 101. From it and candidate sources the stages are:
asana.roles: Software Engineer (product, APIs, communications integrations, web app performance, AI chat), Senior and Staff Software Engineer (e.g. AI Developer Experience); candidate guides label levels L3-L7 (unofficial). Glassdoor also shows Business Development Representative and Corporate Account Executive reports.
steps: Recruiter screen
Technical phone screen (~1 hr with an engineer; often an object-oriented design problem, which Asana emphasizes more than most companies)
Onsite loop of about four rounds, including a full two-hour coding exercise, design questions that break real-world problems into components, and behavioral conversation
Reference checks, then decision. About 3-4 weeks per one guide; Glassdoor and candidate posts range from ~2 to ~6 weeks.

assort-health.name: Assort Health
assort-health.note: There is no published loop; per Glassdoor and techinterview.org (September 2026), two tracks differ: Software Engineer track: 1) recruiter round or screening interview, 2) take-home assessment with about a week to complete (candidates built a voice AI agent you can actually call), 3) technical discussion on the take-home or open-ended Python code refactoring, 4) onsite at the San Francisco office, 5) reference checks Agent Software Engineer track: one report counts about nine calls over six weeks (recruiter, technical discussion, system design interview, coding interview, onsite of four 30-minute conversations, offer call); another says 3 rounds (HR screen, technical, 4-hour in-person onsite) over 2-3 weeks, very timely and professional Timeline: plan on about 2-6 weeks depending on track; recruiters are described as responsive with next-day updates. Glassdoor has accepted-offer reports (April 2026, February 2026) and several no-offer reports; ask the recruiter which track applies before committing the take-home week.
assort-health.roles: Assort Health (patient-facing voice AI agents for healthcare; San Francisco, in-office). Roles seen: Software Engineer (backend, entry to mid level), Agent Software Engineer, Senior Agent Software Engineer, Staff Agent Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (4-8+ years, $190-240k as of September 2026), Staff Software Engineer (7+ years, $240-295k), Forward Deployed Engineer and Senior Forward Deployed Engineer. Levels are as stated in the postings and techinterview.org's guide. I did not confuse it with Infinitus.

assorted-health.name: Assorted Health
assorted-health.roles: Software Engineer, Agent Software Engineer (also Senior and Staff Agent Software Engineer), Senior Software Engineer, Staff Software Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer. The sheet note says this row is a duplicate / alias of Assort Health (assorthealth.com, the voice AI agents for healthcare company in San Francisco); engineering postings are on-site. No official level codes beyond Senior / Staff titles.
steps: Application online or via recruiter / staffing agency
Recruiter / HR screen (about 30 min)

Software Engineer track: take-home assignment with about a week to complete (one report: build a voice AI agent you can actually call); Agent Software Engineer track: technical discussion, system design and live coding interviews instead
Onsite at the San Francisco office (reported as about 4 hours in person, or four 30-minute conversations), with some Python refactoring work and conflict-style behavioral questions

Reference checks, offer call and decision. Reports say about 2-3 weeks for one agent engineer and 4-6 weeks for others (one counted nine calls over six weeks); candidates describe recruiters as responsive (reports vary).

atlassian.name: Atlassian
atlassian.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Principal (Backend) Engineer, Engineering Manager, interns, Support Engineer / Senior Support Engineer, Product Manager, Program Manager, Product Designer, Data Scientist, ML engineers.
steps: Recruiter call (~30 min)
Technical phone screen (~1 hr), or an online assessment / Karat-style screen with timed coding
Onsite / virtual loop (4-5 hrs, fully virtual-first): coding, system design (e.g. rate limiter, tagging system), a leadership craft round, and a values interview that carries real weight
Centralized hiring: you go through the full process first and are matched to a team afterwards; final hiring committee style decision. About 3-6 weeks, though one guide shows 6-17 weeks in reports.

attentive.name: Attentive
attentive.note: Attentive's own engineering blog has a post on how to communicate well in its engineering interviews (only a snippet was visible, so step details come from candidate sources).
attentive.roles: Software Engineer (SWE I / II / Senior / Staff / Senior Staff per candidate guides, unofficial), engineering manager, machine learning engineer, data engineer (SQL-heavy), and solutions engineer; the company is an AI-powered SMS/email marketing platform. Candidate reports from 2026 mention applying for SWE II and being assessed against a senior bar.
steps: Recruiter / HR screen (about 30 min)
Technical phone screen with an engineer (coding)

Onsite / virtual loop: guides describe up to about 6 rounds covering coding, system design (one 2026 report had a catalog-style design question) and behavioral rounds; some reports combine coding and design in one round; a final presentation round is mentioned in one guide
Decision. Engineering manager guide says about 3-4 weeks overall; reports vary and one candidate saw the role close after the phone screen.

aurora.name: Aurora
aurora.roles: Software Engineer (largest group, about 43 Glassdoor reports), Senior Software Engineer, Software Engineer II, Staff Software Engineer, Systems Engineer, Software Engineering Intern, Hardware Engineer, Global Supply Manager and operations roles. Sources are for Aurora Innovation (self-driving trucks); C++ and robotics / perception topics are common. Offices: Mountain View, San Francisco, Pittsburgh and others.
steps: Application online, recruiter or referral
Recruiter call (background and role fit, e.g. computer vision, sensors, C++)
First technical screen of about 60 min: C++ fundamentals (pointers, stack vs heap, STL, implementing a smart pointer) or LeetCode-medium style questions

Onsite of about 4-5 interviews: two coding rounds, a domain-experience round, a domain-specific or classic system design round (e.g. design Spotify, a library management system), and a behavioral interview with the hiring manager

Decision. Reports vary: about 3-4 weeks in most recent reports; older or senior reports say 2 months or more. Several candidates note quick feedback within 1-2 days between steps and some disorganization.

autodesk.name: Autodesk
autodesk.roles: Software Engineer (largest group), Senior Software Engineer, Principal Software Engineer, Software Developer / Software Development Engineer (campus), C++ engineers (Maya and other product teams), Intern. A third-party guide maps titles to grades (Grade 8 SE1 through Grade 17 Fellow), which is unofficial. Glassdoor counts also include Product Manager, Project Manager and Customer Success Manager.
steps: Application online, campus, recruiter or employee referral
Recruiter / HR screen (telephone resume screening)
Online assessment: campus drives use a scored test (one report mentions an assessment scored out of 600), and many experienced candidates also get coding or skills tests

Hiring manager conversation, then technical interviews with content varying by team (C++ and polymorphism for some teams, front-end JavaScript coding for others, system design for senior roles); reports range from four stages to six interviews, some with a panel or presentation
Decision. Glassdoor shows about 12 days for software engineers and 30 days for the company overall; guides say 3-5 weeks, and Interview Query says 4-10 weeks (reports vary).

axon.name: Axon
axon.roles: Software Engineer (Associate Software Engineer, Software Engineer II, senior levels), Backend Engineer, Frontend Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, Solutions Engineer, engineering manager. One candidate-guide site uses its own L-number ladder for Axon, which looks unreliable and is left out here. Sources are for Axon Enterprise (public safety / body cameras); a similarly named healthcare comms firm (AXON Communications) also showed up in results and was ignored.
steps: Application online, via recruiter, or employee referral
Recruiter screen
Live coding round, LeetCode-style data structures and algorithms (about 45-60 min)
Further technical rounds: more coding, and for some teams system design or a take-home; panel / onsite-style interviews with the team
Behavioral / hiring-manager conversation
Decision. Reports vary: about 1 week to a month, with Glassdoor putting Axon overall at around 25 days. Interview Query notes most reports in its sample ended without an offer.

axq-capital.name: Axq Capital
axq-capital.note: I found no real candidate interview reports. Scoutify's generic software-engineering loop (not company-specific) suggests an initial call (30 min), a technical interview (45-60 min, coding and/or system design), and a behavioral interview (45 min); applications run through Greenhouse. A recruiting job posting says AXQ is investing in firm-wide interview quality, but the actual rounds are not described. Treat the process, timeline and round counts as unverified; ask the recruiter for the loop for your track.
axq-capital.roles: AXQ Capital is a global quantitative investment firm (offices in New York, Beijing, Shanghai, Hong Kong). Roles seen on its Greenhouse job board: Quantitative Researcher (including execution research), Senior Quantitative Researcher, Quantitative Developer and Senior Quantitative Developer (including 0-3 years experience entry roles), Production Engineer, Portfolio Manager (Global Futures), Quantitative Research Intern (undergraduate/graduate and PhD, Summer 2027), and talent acquisition. Seniority is shown by 'Senior' in titles; no numeric ladder seen.

balyasny.name: Balyasny
balyasny.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Software Engineer Intern, Quant Developer, Applied-AI engineer, Frontend Engineer. Balyasny (BAM) is a multi-strategy hedge fund; engineering reports dominate the sources. Offices: New York, London, Chicago and others.
steps: Application online or external recruiter
HR call: motivations, past experience, what you know about BAM (no technical questions in one report)
Camera-on HackerRank assessment of about 90 minutes (timed Python and SQL problem solving) or a recorded HackerRank video interview
Online technical interview: LeetCode medium (e.g. a buy-and-sell-stock variant), Linux / Unix command questions, Applied-AI roles get live ML / feature engineering instead
Virtual super day: about three back-to-back 45-minute interviews (two technical, one behavioral and fit / team questions)
Decision. Reports vary: about 2-3 weeks. Candidates note inconsistent difficulty between rounds and some abrasive questioning; intern and senior reports are mostly positive offers in small samples.

bank-of-america.name: Bank of America
bank-of-america.roles: Technology roles dominate the reports seen: Global Technology Analyst (graduate program), Technology Analyst, Technology Developer and Analyst Program (older name), Technology Business Analyst. Bank of America also hires across banking, markets, operations and corporate functions, but the search results here only covered the technology analyst track, so non-tech roles are not described.
steps: Online application (campus / university route, employee referral or recruiter also reported)
HireVue video interview: about 3 basic behavioral video questions, and for the technology analyst track 2 LeetCode-style coding questions
Phone screening or phone interviews (older reports: 1-2 phone rounds, behavioral, sometimes a developer asking technical basics)
Technical rounds (often 2): CS trivia such as processes vs threads and hash tables, LeetCode-style coding, spotting what is wrong in a code snippet
Final round or Super Day style interviews (in-person in New York / Charlotte in older reports): behavioral, why Bank of America, why finance, teamwork, agile vs traditional work
Decision. Reports vary: about 1 week to 2 months, commonly 2-6 weeks. Newer reports describe the process as fair and fairly easy.

barclays.name: Barclays
barclays.note: Software engineer / Technology Analyst path per candidate reports: Timeline: Glassdoor shows about 21 days for Technology Analyst (42 reports) and about 28 days company-wide; reports range from 1 day (campus) to 2 weeks and 5 days for some campus drives. Glassdoor rates difficulty about 3/5 with about 59% positive for Technology Analyst. Other divisions (investment banking, retail) were not researched here.
barclays.roles: Very broad bank. Glassdoor volume across Barclays: Analyst (975), Vice President (828), Assistant Vice President (757), Business Analyst (538), Software Engineer (about 390), Director (329), Software Developer (308), AVP-IT (296), Personal Banker, Project Manager, Graduate Analyst, Senior Analyst, Investment Banking Analyst. Technology-side reports cover Software Engineer (Java, React, full stack; Glasgow, Knutsford, London, Pune, Prague, Whippany NJ), Technology Analyst (graduate and early-career track; about 42 reports), Software Engineer - AVP and AVP Software Engineer Full Stack, Application Support Analyst. Barclays uses banking grades (Analyst, Assistant Vice President, Vice President, Director); no engineering-specific ladder.
steps: Application online, via campus or recruiter; for graduate / analyst tracks an automated online assessment with behavioural and personality questions (Glassdoor stage stats for software engineers: skills test 22%, phone interview 21%, one-on-one 21%; Technology Analyst: one-on-one 17%, phone 14%, IQ test 14%)

Technical interview(s): easy LeetCode-style questions in Java or Python (your choice), core Java, graph or dynamic-programming problems with time/space complexity, data structures, DBMS, resume and project questions, Java and React basic usage, architecture questions such as microservices vs monolith for senior roles

Further interview with higher management on past experience and behavioural questions (a Whippany NJ Technology Analyst described three interviews, the third with senior management), then offer; one report says the offer came a week later

baseten.name: Baseten
baseten.roles: Software Engineer (including infrastructure / inference and an AI Enablement Engineer seat), new grad engineer, forward deployed engineer, AI solutions engineer, applied AI inference engineer, account executive and technical writer. A new grad engineer's company blog post describes the early-stage engineer path. No official level ladder seen.
steps: Application online, recruiter outreach, career-fair contact or agency; one new grad emailed the CTO and got a product demo first
Recruiter screen (about 30 min)

Practical coding / technical screen (about 60 min): practical engineering scenarios rather than LeetCode, such as a rate limiter, top-K from a stream, scheduling bursty inference work, data modeling plus a coding question, or an ML-related coding problem

Virtual onsite of about 4 rounds (August 2026 report): coding, system/ML-system design on inference scheduling or long-running task APIs, handling a production incident, and team/behavioral conversations; the new-grad blog says the candidate eventually spoke to all six employees at that time
Decision. A design-guide site says about three main steps over a month; candidate reports vary and one describes the process as poorly organised, with unclear feedback and a mistaken rejection email.

basis-ai.name: Basis Ai
basis-ai.note: Very few first-hand reports. A PracHub report (September 2026, Machine Learning Engineer, rejected, medium): a headhunter reached out, then a recruiter call, then two remote interview rounds and a cut before the onsite; round 1 was behavioral with a resume deep dive plus product sense and DFS/BFS; an agent-debug round followed. PracHub lists 6 Basis experiences in total. Per Basis's own job postings, every engineer gets an unlimited token budget for coding agents and the team works in person in Flatiron. Scoutify's 'standard software engineering loop' (30-minute intro call, 45-60 minute technical interview) is generic and not company-specific. Timeline not reported. Treat this row as thin.
basis-ai.roles: Basis (getbasis.ai; AI agents for accounting, tax and audit; New York Flatiron, in-person 5 days a week; about 25 employees per one posting; raised $34m per another). Roles seen: Member of Technical Staff (Product Engineering; ML / Agent Design; Applied ML), Internal Agent Engineer (Atlas internal agents), Machine Learning Engineer, GTM Systems Engineer, Member of Accounting Staff, Accounting Solutions Consultant, Deployed Intelligence Strategist, Product Manager (Atlas), design and demand-generation roles. The title 'Member of Technical Staff' is used rather than levels. I did not use pages about Basis Research Institute or other organizations named Basis.

bcg.name: BCG
bcg.roles: Software Engineer (BCG X, the tech build and digital arm; X Delivery teams), Developer, Mobile App Developer, AI Software Engineer, Data Scientist, Senior and Staff Engineer tracks per guides. The sheet note says this row is a duplicate / alias of Boston Consulting Group. Reports come from New Delhi, Bengaluru, Casablanca and Copenhagen. No official level codes seen.
steps: Application online, recruiter outreach or BCG X careers page; HR / hiring team screening call (background, projects)
Online assessment: CodeSignal or DSA-focused tests (one report: easy, medium, medium, hard problems); internship roles may use a one-way video interview
Technical interview on your stack (one DSA problem and one SQL problem reported), online machine-coding round, and basic API / REST fundamentals

Technical case interview (develop a full-stack solution), coding and software design cases, and a discussion with the tech lead; successful candidates may then face additional case or behavioral / fit interviews
Decision. Reports range from 1 week to 2 months, including long gaps between rounds in Casablanca; Glassdoor shows about 41 days for the company overall (reports vary).

belvederetrading.name: Belvederetrading
belvederetrading.note: Belvedere's own new-graduate and intern recruiting pages (see official sources) list the steps: 1) submit your application; 2) an at-home, timed assessment (developers: a coding challenge on fundamental tech concepts; quantitative traders: a probability and logic test); 3) a virtual first-round interview with a current developer, quantitative trader or researcher, with technical and behavioral questions; 4) a final round, in person or virtual depending on the team. Candidate reports add: C++ technical interviews of about 2.5 hours with three difficult questions (multithreading, template metaprogramming, concurrency, system design), a Super Day, and a 45-min virtual interview with a trader and an HR business partner for the first stage. Glassdoor timelines run from 1 week to about 4 weeks, with mixed experiences.
belvederetrading.roles: Belvedere Trading (Chicago options market maker). Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (Algorithmic Trading Applications), Senior C++ Software Engineer (market data systems), Quantitative Developer, Systems Engineer, QA Engineer, software engineering interns (BTU training program, 'Intern Olympics'), plus Junior Trader, Quantitative Trader and Risk Analyst. Levels progress by performance and tenure; no published ladder.

betterhelp.name: BetterHelp
betterhelp.note: Reports from candidates (small sample, Dataford shows 8 software engineer reports):
betterhelp.roles: BetterHelp (online therapy platform, Teladoc / Mountain View, Chicago, remote). Software Developer / Software Engineer, Frontend Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, QA Engineer, Data Scientist, Product Manager, Product Designer; Glassdoor volume is dominated by Therapist and Counselor reports. Levels are not published.
steps: Application online or via recruiter, short initial call
Tech screen / frontend coding test (a 2024 report lists CSS styling, HTML classes and a React onClick function)

Interviews with the engineering manager and team members (a 2020 Software Developer report: a tech screen and three interviews, with a final one with several directors and founders); a 2022 frontend candidate describes a multi-step process ending with a final panel where you suggest improvements to the BetterHelp app and says an offer came the morning after, about 5 weeks in total

Decision. Timelines range from about 1 day (May 2026 Chicago report) to 5 weeks; Indeed puts it at about two weeks with easy difficulty. The company explains each interview in advance in some reports.

bilt-rewards.name: Bilt Rewards
bilt-rewards.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Backend Engineer, Lead Software Engineer, Back End Engineer (all levels), product manager, account executive, plus customer experience / solutions roles. New York in-office. Bilt's own job posting (mirrored on a venture-capital job board) says leveling is based on experience and performance in the interview process; no numeric ladder seen.
steps: Application online, referral, staffing agency or recruiter contact on LinkedIn
Recruiter screen (general phone-screen questions; resume background)

Technical screen / online assignment: a codespace-based coding task with unit tests, no LeetCode, plus an AI-assisted design task in a July 2026 report; one September 2025 candidate passed every unit test but was still rejected, and others report being ghosted after the online assignment

Hiring-manager conversation and a multi-person final: reports mention 4 rounds with 1 on-site, or a third round with a director, a staff engineer and the hiring manager; project deep dives with trade-off questions
Offer. Glassdoor reports range from about 3 weeks to 2 months; Dataford cites about 17% of interviewees getting an offer across 47 reports.

bitgo.name: BitGo
bitgo.roles: Software Engineer (largest group), Senior Software Engineer, Staff Software Engineer, Backend Engineer, Software Engineering Intern, Engineering Manager, plus Technical Support Engineer, Data Scientist, Product Manager and compliance / sales roles in Glassdoor counts. Reports come from San Francisco, New York, Singapore and Bengaluru. No official level codes seen beyond title tiers.
steps: Application online, referral, recruiter or university
Initial screening, often with an online test or coding challenge (examples reported: simple blockchain challenge, shortest path in a graph, find all anagrams)

Technical rounds: two DSA rounds and a low-level design / machine-coding round (for example an in-memory DB with indexes), then high-level design for senior and staff roles; project and BitGo product discussion
Hiring manager round and, in some cases, a final round with leadership

Decision. Glassdoor shows about 7 days for software engineers on average, but individual reports range from 2 days to 4 weeks and some staff-level processes spread across weeks; several candidates describe it as somewhat disorganized (reports vary).

bitkernel.name: Bitkernel
bitkernel.roles: Software Engineer / Software Developer (the roles seen in reports), plus admin / finance and marketing-type postings on the company's job pages. Company looks like Bitkernel Technology Inc, which describes itself as working on OTT video streaming apps and content distribution. Report volume is small.
steps: Application online

Online assessment for software engineering roles: reported as about 20 multiple-choice questions covering algorithms, data structures, networking and databases (per a 1point3acres post whose details were behind a login)
About three rounds with different team members, including the HR head and a director (one Glassdoor report)
Decision. One report says about 4 weeks overall and another candidate had a negative experience; too few reports to say more, so treat all steps as indicative only.

blackedge.name: BlackEdge
blackedge.note: Per Glassdoor, TraderMath and EverythingQuant (few detailed reports; TraderMath says where a detail rests on one report it says so): Timeline: one intern had 3 weeks via referral; a 2023 trader says the firm took longer than usual to reply. Glassdoor reports are mixed: several no-offer reports, an accepted offer in October 2025, and complaints about uninterested interviewers and careless template rejections.
blackedge.roles: BlackEdge Capital (Chicago proprietary options market maker, about 11-50 employees per Simplify; a major market maker in CME interest rate options). Roles seen: Quantitative Trader / Quantitative Trading Intern (most Glassdoor reports), Quantitative Developer Intern (Chicago, multiple teams), Trading Strategy Software Engineer (high-frequency, ML-driven, FPGA integration, nanosecond latency), Graduate Quantitative Researcher. No numeric ladder; entry routes are internships and graduate roles.
steps: Application online or employee referral
Online assessment: for traders a timed mental maths and probability test; for developer interns a HackerRank-style OA or an open-ended assessment (a forum asks which is harder)

First round on Zoom with a trader or engineer: basic probability and mental maths (two-digit multiplication, binomial distribution, conditional probability, decimals like 2/7 to 5 places), some behavioral and a resume review

Second technical round (Green Book-style probability and brainteasers), then a Chicago superday in the office with travel and hotel covered; for software roles the final conversation is with senior team members about your potential contribution; the Trading Strategy Software Engineer posting values low-latency C++-style thinking and FPGA co-design

blackrock.name: BlackRock
blackrock.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports: Timeline: reports vary a lot, from 1-3 days (campus/Bengaluru) to about 3-4 weeks; Glassdoor shows about 20 days for software engineer roles and about 30-37 days company-wide. Senior levels (VP, Director) reportedly have 4-5 rounds. Non-engineering divisions (investment, portfolio, client roles) were not researched here.
blackrock.roles: Glassdoor report volume is led by Analyst, Associate, Vice President, Director, Summer Analyst, Software Engineer (about 155 reports), intern, financial analyst, portfolio manager, managing director and business analyst roles. Engineering roles follow the bank-style ladder of Analyst, Associate, Vice President, Director and Managing Director (as shown by a third-party prep site, unofficial), with Summer Analyst Software Engineer internships and groups such as Aladdin, portfolio management technology and AI Labs appearing in postings.
steps: Application online, via campus or recruiter; early-career candidates often do a HireVue recorded video interview
Recruiter / phone screen, sometimes with a senior engineer: resume, projects and behavioral questions such as why BlackRock
Technical interviews: data structures and algorithms (hash maps, arrays, dynamic programming), OOP, OS, SQL, Java/C++ or Python fundamentals, and a coding problem
Final round or Super Day (one analyst report: about 4 hours with three 45-minute calls), with behavioral and analytical questions plus team fit
Offer, background check

block-square.name: Block (Square)
block-square.roles: Software Engineer (new grad, SWE, Senior; one guide labels senior as L6, unofficial), Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Software Engineering Intern. Glassdoor report volume for Block is dominated by Software Engineer (about 257) and Senior Software Engineer (about 93). Block is the parent of Square, Cash App and others; offices: San Francisco, New York, Seattle, Atlanta, Melbourne.
steps: Application online, referral or campus recruiting
Recruiter screen (about 30 min)
Technical phone screen of about 1 hour, with a hiring-manager conversation for some levels (practical coding rather than pure LeetCode in several reports)

Virtual onsite of 4-5 rounds (about 4-5 hours): coding, design (e.g. hotel booking system, end-to-end banking system), a practical build-something task, past-experience and values conversations; committee review follows

Team matching, then decision. Reports vary: about 3-4 weeks in many cases, up to 2-4 months for some new-grad and referral cycles; Glassdoor puts Block overall at about 25 days. Taro stats show a roughly 42% pass rate for SWE in San Francisco (12 reports).

bloomberg.name: Bloomberg
bloomberg.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Financial Software Developer, Senior Software Developer (build Bloomberg Terminal, financial data, trading and enterprise products), interns, plus Account Manager, Analyst, Financial Analyst and Sales roles per Glassdoor.
steps: Application (an online assessment appears depending on how you apply)
Recruiter interview and/or a 1:1 online intro interview
Technical phone screen: LeetCode-style coding with deep follow-up questions

Final loop, usually 4-5 rounds in total: two coding interviews, 1-2 system design rounds in some loops, resume / 'why Bloomberg' conversation, and a hiring manager interview (the most technical round, with system design and language tradeoff questions)
Decision. Roughly 4-7 weeks per one guide; Glassdoor average about 4 weeks, some reports up to 4 months. Finance knowledge is not required for SWE.

bnp.name: Bnp
bnp.note: Technology / engineering path per candidate reports: Timeline: reports vary, about 2 weeks to 4 weeks for many roles, under 3 months for quant analysts; one Mumbai campus case took 1 day. Teams vary a lot by country and business line; non-technology divisions were not researched.
bnp.roles: Sources are for BNP Paribas. Very broad bank: Glassdoor volume is led by Analyst, Business Analyst, Associate, Financial Analyst, Compliance Officer and (in France) Conseiller Patrimonial and seasonal staff roles. Technology-side reports cover Software Engineer / Developer, Technology Analyst, Summer Analyst - Technology, Graduate Programme Technology Consulting, Quantitative Analyst, Data Analyst and Business Analyst in Global Markets IT. Generic bank titles (Analyst, Associate, VP, Director) are used; no engineering ladder seen.
steps: Online application and CV review (a CS background is checked for graduate technology roles)
Online assessment: aptitude / logical reasoning, and for technology analysts a coding test
HR / recruiter screen or phone/Skype interview: motivation (why technology at BNP, why this role), behavioral questions
