Technical interview: coding, data structures, maths/Python questions, project discussion; quant roles add stochastic maths and a panel; business-analyst roles are case-heavy (finance and credit-risk cases)
Final interview with a manager / head of division, or an assessment centre / in-person panel for graduate and quant routes
Offer

bnsf.name: Bnsf
bnsf.roles: Software Engineer I / II (backend, full-stack, new grad and mid-level), Senior Software Engineer, Staff and Senior Staff Software Engineer, Sr / Staff Infrastructure Software Engineer, Software Development Engineer. Reports in the sheet are most likely for software engineering at BNSF Railway.
steps: Application online or via recruiter (recruiters reported as unsure about the process in some cases)
Online assessment, often timed (one report: 60 minutes, two DSA problems, Java only); other reports describe Spring API coding tasks and sliding-window style problems
Phone interview with a software engineer (about 1 hour)

Onsite / virtual loop of about 4-5 hours: hands-on tasks (Angular rating app, Spring Boot aspect code on undocumented classes, UI component task on an older framework), project architecture questions and a system design question, behavioral
Decision. Reports range from 1 day to about 2 months; most candidates in sources got no offer and several mention silence or no feedback (reports vary).

bobyard.name: Bobyard
bobyard.note: Reports for the full-stack engineer track (five rounds in total):
bobyard.roles: Bobyard (AI takeoff / estimating software for construction, San Francisco). Software Engineer (full-stack), Senior Fullstack Engineer (React architecture), Computer Vision Research Engineer (incl. internship), plus Account Executive, Customer Success Engineer, Product Manager, Sales Engineer and marketing roles. Levels are not published.
steps: Recruiter screen (motivation, role fit, logistics)
Technical phone screen (three-part coding / technical discussion)
Take-home project, followed by a presentation of it
System design round
Onsite with a four-person panel. One non-engineering Glassdoor report describes recruiter, take-home, presentation and panel steps and calls it a waste of time. Timeline not clearly reported.

boeing.name: Boeing
boeing.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports and guides: Timeline: Glassdoor shows about 76 days on average for software engineers (46 days company-wide); reports vary from 2 weeks to 2 months, and a Dataford guide says about 3-5 weeks over 4 rounds. Taro shows a 44% pass rate over 117 U.S. reports; some candidates complain about slow recruiting.
boeing.roles: Software Engineer (Glassdoor's most searched role, about 630 reports), Senior Software Engineer (about 135), Associate and Experienced Software Engineer - Java (Bengaluru), Software Engineer internships (about 27 plus about 185 general intern), Systems Engineer, design and industrial engineers, programme analysts and managers. Locations: Seattle, Chicago, Berkeley MO, Herndon VA, Huntsville, Brisbane, Bengaluru. No official level ladder seen beyond titles.
steps: Application online or via university / career fair (a Boeing-dedicated career fair interview was described as relaxed and only slightly technical); Boeing asks candidates not to disclose details of its structured process
Prescreen: automated video-recording interview and/or cognitive tasks / online assessment, then a recruiter or phone screen (one September 2023 candidate had no face-to-face contact at first)

Hiring-manager or structured panel interview: heavy on behavioral STAR questions ('tell me about a time...'), situational and project questions; supervisor-written technical questions, easy-to-medium DSA, domain-specific questions and sometimes dynamic-programming explanations; a group panel and a presentation appear in Glassdoor stage stats
Final technical/behavioral discussion, background check, offer

booking-com.name: Booking.com
booking-com.roles: Software Engineer (SWE I, II, Senior), Graduate Software Developer, Software Developer. Glassdoor report volume also includes Team Leader, Product Manager, Customer Service Agent and customer-support roles. Offices: Amsterdam, London, Singapore, Washington DC and others.
steps: Application online, recruiter, referral or staffing agency

HR call explaining the process (a short prep call in some cycles); online assessment on HackerRank with a couple of LeetCode-medium problems (an 'award top K hotels' style question is widely reported)

Technical interview(s): object-oriented coding in a language of your choice, phone coding with two medium questions, pair programming with two engineers (explain, debug, refactor, add tests), sometimes a live coding session on practical travel-style problems
System design on booking-style problems (hotel search and availability, 'users looking at the same property'), plus idempotency, retries, observability and reliability discussions
'Ownership' interview and team-fit / cultural interview; one report describes about 5 stages in total
Decision. Reports vary: about 2-6 weeks in most, up to about 3 months in older Amsterdam reports. Taro stats (9 Amsterdam graduate reports) show a pass rate of roughly 22%.

boston.name: Boston
boston.note: Boston Dynamics software engineer path per candidate reports and guides (applies only if 'Boston' means Boston Dynamics): Timeline: TechPrep says about 3 weeks over 4 stages (DesignGurus: 3 main stages); Glassdoor reports range from 2 to 4 weeks. Dataford rates difficulty 5.3/10 on 53 reports with about 21% of candidates receiving an offer.
boston.roles: AMBIGUOUS COMPANY: the sheet's 'Boston' has no website or other identifier, so I could not tell which company it means (Boston Dynamics, Boston Consulting Group, Boston Scientific and others are all plausible). As a best guess I researched Boston Dynamics (robotics, Waltham MA); please confirm or tell me the real company. Boston Dynamics roles seen: Software Engineer (about 15 Glassdoor reports), Robotics Engineer (about 9), Senior and Staff Software Engineer, UI Engineer, Product Manager, QA Engineer, Technical Program Manager, manufacturing and mechanical engineers. No numeric ladder seen.
steps: Application online, via recruiter or campus
Recruiter screen (about 30 min), sometimes a behavioral interview first

Technical video interview (about 60 min): straightforward coding exercises and a few domain-knowledge questions; one 2021 report had a presentation first; object-oriented design such as designing a filesystem appeared
Onsite / final technical interviews in Waltham or Boston: coding, system design, robotics/hardware-software debugging angle, a whiteboard-style session, and behavioral questions

boston-consulting-group.name: Boston Consulting Group
boston-consulting-group.note: BCG's own careers page lists the process as: application (with a note on using AI in the application) -> Step 2 skill interview (a traditional interview on your experience, skills and motivation) -> Step 3 case interview. From candidate guides:
boston-consulting-group.roles: Consulting ladder per managementconsulted (third-party): Associate, Consultant, Project Leader, Principal, Managing Director and Partner. Also BCG X (tech / digital build teams), student and early-career programs such as the Vantage program, and internships (same screening and case process as full-time hires), plus non-consulting roles. Glassdoor reports center on Consultant and Business Analyst.
steps: Online application (resume, cover letter, transcripts, office preferences)
Online aptitude / problem-solving test in many offices, sometimes a video cover letter or an online case
Screening / skill interview with a recruiter or junior consultant (fit and resume walk-through)

Case interviews: first round of about two live cases with consultants/principals, final round of about two back-to-back cases with partner-level interviewers, with behavioral and fit questions mixed in
Decision. Often about 3-8 weeks; one guide says BCG sets up a mock case before the first round. Exact steps vary by office and entry level.

box.name: Box
box.note: Candidate guides give about 3-5 weeks overall (Glassdoor average is about 14 days for engineers, 22 days company-wide):
box.roles: Software Engineer (backend, frontend with React / JavaScript, full stack), Senior Software Engineer, Staff, Senior Staff, Principal and Fellow tracks (a candidate guide labels engineering levels L4-L12, unofficial), Demo Engineering, interns. Offices include Redwood City, Chicago and Warsaw.
steps: Recruiter screen (~30 min), sometimes with a culture-fit phone call
Technical phone screen (~60 min): coding with hash maps, object-oriented JavaScript, or a React / JavaScript exercise; some reports mention a HackerRank challenge

Onsite / virtual loop: algorithm rounds, system design, an older-format simulated code review of a junior engineer's code, a design question such as an object-oriented elevator system, and a hiring-manager and values conversation. Demo Engineering candidates report a one-week take-home assignment
Decision. Taro shows a moderate pass rate for senior roles (about 32% in one sample of 34), and reports describe the process as organized and well communicated though not uniform.

bp.name: Bp
bp.roles: Software Engineer (32 Glassdoor reports), Senior Software Engineer, Data Engineer, Digital Technology Intern, Graduate Program, plus a very large non-software mix (Customer Service Representative, Analyst, Process Engineer, Petroleum Engineer, Cashier). A third-party guide shows lettered levels (D through J) for software engineers, which is unofficial. Reports come from Pune, Kuala Lumpur, Houston, Singapore and Europe.
steps: Application online, campus or recruiter
Initial screen: recruiter call or a HireVue one-way video interview with behavioral questions (reported by a software engineer candidate)

Online assessment (campus hiring starts with an OA) and technical rounds: scenario-based puzzles, DSA coding on a shared screen (for example validating parentheses), a design exercise such as a to-do list application, and about one hour of medium-difficulty questions that follow the job description closely
Team-fit conversations including a panel or superday, a behavioral and managerial interview and a final HR round (campus: OA, technical rounds, HR)
Decision. Glassdoor shows about 30 days for software engineers; guides say about 14 days to several weeks, and one aggregator shows an offer rate of about 39 percent (reports vary).

brex.name: Brex
brex.roles: Software Engineer (SWE I / II, Senior, Staff per reports), with separate front-end, back-end and mobile tracks; Embedded Engineer. Offices mentioned: San Francisco, Seattle, New York, Vancouver, Toronto.
steps: Apply online, then a recruiter call (about 30 min on background and role)

One-hour technical coding phone screen; practical, API-style problems rather than pure algorithms (some reports mention a LeetCode hard DP problem); mobile / front-end tracks may use a take-home of roughly 4 hours (e.g. a React Native app)
Hiring-manager call in some cycles

Virtual onsite of about 3-4 sessions: coding with API calls, system design (e.g. simplified card authorization), debugging, AI-assisted coding in newer cycles, and a values interview (45-60 min, ownership and simplicity)
Decision. Reports vary: about 3 weeks in guides, up to about 4 weeks in some reports. Taro stats (25 US SWE reports) show a pass rate of roughly 24%, and some candidates mention slow communication.

bridgewater.name: Bridgewater
bridgewater.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Software Developer, Senior Software Developer, plus AIA Lab (ML generalist) and investment tracks. A third-party guide maps engineering levels L3 through L7 (unofficial). Reports come from the Westport, Wilton, Bridgeport and Hartford, Connecticut area.
steps: Application online, recruiter or staffing agency
Recruiter / culture screen (about 30-45 min; candidates are asked whether they fit the unusual work culture)
Online assessment or take-home: Codility / HackerRank set, a simple take-home coding challenge, or a topological-sort style investment compute graph problem

Technical phone interview about resume and technologies (for example how to debug a race condition in multithreading), then discussion of the take-home solution, language choice, testing and trade-offs

In-person interviews, reported as about 4 interviews over an 8-hour day, including a whiteboard deep dive into the architecture of your most recent project and probing questions about decision-making, followed by values / team-lead rounds
Decision. Reports range from 1 day to 4 weeks; many candidates describe the process as intense, with reviews from both tough and neutral experiences (reports vary).

bytedance.name: ByteDance
bytedance.roles: Software Engineer (backend, frontend, fullstack, iOS, ML such as recommendation for CapCut), content moderator, product manager, quality analyst, subject matter expert and interns. Internal levels like 1-2, 2-1 ... 4-2 appear in candidate guides (unofficial). Engineers build systems behind TikTok, CapCut, Lemon8 and PICO.
steps: Application or recruiter contact
Online assessment (HackerRank / LeetCode-type) for many roles
About 3 technical rounds (live coding, algorithms, system design, deep dive on past projects), strictly sequential - you pass one to reach the next
HR / behavioral or managerial round
Decision. Fast, often 1-4 weeks; a few reports say around a month. Varies by office and team.

c3-ai.name: C3 AI
c3-ai.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (platform, generative / agentic AI teams), Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Data Scientist, plus new-grad and intern roles. Glassdoor report volume is led by Software Engineer, Data Scientist, Senior Software Engineer and Forward Deployed Engineer. No formal level codes seen in sources.
steps: Application online or manager / recruiter outreach on LinkedIn
Recruiter or manager screen (conversational)
Online coding assessment (HackerRank style) for many candidates
Technical rounds: LeetCode-style coding (strings, arrays, graphs / matrix traversal), sometimes system or application design; about 3-5 rounds in total per candidate guides
Hiring manager behavioral conversation, then decision. Reports vary a lot, from about 3 weeks to 3 months; many reports mention slow communication.

capital-one.name: Capital One
capital-one.roles: Software Engineer track: Associate Software Engineer (entry), Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Lead Software Engineer, Senior Lead, Distinguished Engineer tiers (levels from candidate guides, not the company). Glassdoor also shows Business Analyst and Customer Service Representative reports.
steps: Application and resume screen
Recruiter or hiring-manager call
Online coding assessment
Power Day: a same-day block of about 4 back-to-back interviews (coding, system design or case study, behavioral)
Offer. Roughly 4-8 weeks overall depending on team matching and reference checks.

cargurus.name: Cargurus
cargurus.roles: Software Engineer / Software Development Engineer (II and above), Senior Software Engineer (largest engineering report group), JavaScript / Frontend Engineer II, Principal SDE, Software Engineer Co-Op, Engineering Manager. Glassdoor report counts mix in many sales roles (Account Executive, Account Manager, SDR). No official level codes seen beyond title tiers.
steps: Application online or via recruiter / LinkedIn sourcer
Recruiter phone screen (about 30 min)
Technical screen with an engineer: about 1 hour of live coding (React live coding for frontend roles; for others array manipulation or an easy LeetCode-style debugging problem plus SQL queries)
Final round, sometimes in person and split over two days: about one hour with the team manager (behavioral) and one hour with a senior engineer (system design or a real-world problem walk-through)
Decision. Glassdoor shows about 12 days on average for software engineers; individual reports range from 2 to 4 weeks, and one report praises the detailed feedback received (reports vary).

carvana.name: Carvana
carvana.roles: Software Engineer (SWE I, mid-level, Senior), Senior Front End Software Engineer, Data Engineer, Systems Engineer, Frontend Engineer, Product Analyst. Mostly Tempe / Phoenix AZ, plus Indianapolis / Carmel IN, Los Angeles, New York, San Francisco.
steps: Application online, recruiter or LinkedIn outreach
Recruiter screen (30-45 min) and a 30-min hiring-manager conversation

Technical screen of about 60 min: basic data transformations, C# questions (e.g. using statements and IDisposable), Python concurrency limits, front-end tasks such as calling a sample API and rendering the list

Virtual onsite of about 3-4 rounds (one Interview Query report describes 6 rounds: hiring manager, coding, data science, leadership, system design and product): application design, coding exercise based on system design, behavioral questions such as a disagreement with a coworker

Decision. Reports vary: about 2-4 weeks per Glassdoor, with one guide noting it can take months. A 2026 candidate describes being matched to different teams and a four-round onsite, with the final outcome being a rejection.

censys.name: Censys
censys.note: Censys's own Greenhouse postings contain hiring-process notes: candidates must keep their cameras on during video interviews to protect the integrity of the process, and you may be required to meet a Censys employee in person at some point; hired remote employees are invited to Ann Arbor for in-person onboarding. A Dataford manager guide says the full process may take 4-6 weeks with feedback within 1-2 weeks after each stage, and describes the engineer loop as thorough, collaborative and balanced between technical and cultural fit. I did not find candidate-written round-by-round accounts, so exact rounds are unknown.
censys.roles: Censys (internet intelligence / attack-surface security platform; Ann Arbor MI HQ, remote US and Canada). Software Engineer II (Backend, Core Services, Go), Senior Backend Software Engineer (Censys Platform, Exposure Management, SaaS Platform), Senior Integrations Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer AI/LLM (7+ yrs), Staff Scanning Engineer / Staff Software Developer (10+ yrs), Systems Engineer (ARC research team), Backend Engineer (Threat Hunting), Machine Learning Engineer, Engineering Manager. Levels in postings: II / Senior / Staff.

cerebras.name: Cerebras
cerebras.note: Cerebras has its own interviewing guide on Coda (careers site) and a blog post on how it adapted technical interviews for AI-native work. Its guide says the software engineering interview process is three steps, the first being a 45-minute exploratory conversation about your background and interests; I only saw that first step, so the rest comes from candidate sources:
cerebras.roles: Cerebras Systems (wafer-scale AI chips, Sunnyvale). Software Engineer (including new grad), Senior AI Engineer, Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET), Embedded Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, Product Manager, plus hardware and ASIC roles. Levels are not published.
steps: Recruiter screen, then exploratory conversation (~45 min)

Online assessment or technical phone screen, one or two coding interviews (new-grad reports describe three whiteboard-style coding rounds on HackerRank), plus a team-specific technical round on low-level systems, distributed AI or hardware-software topics
Hiring manager and cross-team conversations; one SDET candidate describes 4 rounds (2 coding, 2 behavioral) over about a month. Guides give 3-6 weeks overall.

cfm.name: Cfm
cfm.note: CFM publishes little about its process and candidate reports are sparse (Dataford has 28 reports: 8 quantitative researcher, 6 software engineer). Per Dataford and Quantt's CFM guide (generic, partly reconstructed): Timeline: Dataford says the process can span two to four months for quantitative analysts; Dataford rates difficulty 5.0/10. Confirm the loop for your track with the recruiter.
cfm.roles: Sources are for Capital Fund Management (CFM; Paris-headquartered systematic investment manager founded in 1991; offices in Paris, London, New York and Sydney). Roles seen: Quantitative Researcher (over 100 researchers; PhD in physics / maths / stats / CS common), Quantitative Developer (Python alpha signals, portfolio construction, real-time C++ for execution research; some senior roles ask 4+ years), Software Engineer, Data Scientist / Data Engineer, Research Analyst, research internships (four to six months in Paris). No numeric ladder; Senior is shown in titles.
steps: Application and CV screen (academic record and research experience carry weight)
Initial coding / technical assessment and a recruiter or HR call

Technical interviews with researchers and engineers: mathematical problem-solving (probability, statistics, time series, optimisation, machine learning on noisy data), coding (Python or C++; developer roles on pipelines, back-testing and production code), and a research presentation for researchers
Further rounds on fit and culture, then offer

chainlink-labs.name: Chainlink Labs
chainlink-labs.note: Chainlink Labs publishes role-specific candidate prep guides, so this process is partly company-described: all interviews are conducted via Zoom, the process is described as clear, efficient and mutually exploratory, and the SRE guide allows AI tools during the Docker interview within stated limits (only snippets of the guides were visible). Software engineer path per candidate reports: Timeline: Glassdoor reports range from 2 to 3 weeks, with some describing a prolonged process and communication gaps; PracHub lists 10 first-hand reports.
chainlink-labs.roles: Software Engineer (about 10 Glassdoor reports), Senior Software Engineer (about 8-9), Software Engineer II, Software Engineer Frontend, Senior Software Engineer CCIP, Staff Software Engineer Data Products, Site Reliability Engineer, Senior IT Systems Engineer, QA Engineer, Solutions Architect, Research Intern. Remote-first with reports from Sydney and other regions. Titles used; no numeric ladder seen.
steps: Application online, referral or recruiter; recruiter call that guides you through the process (a talent acquisition contact schedules catch-ups before each round in one report)
HackerRank / coding round (about 90 minutes in one report) or a technical screen: algorithms and data structures

Technical rounds: coding sessions, an algorithms meeting, system design (for example designing a web3 solution's architecture), software architecture review, and for frontend roles questions on working with designers
Discussions with executives / the C-suite team and a values-alignment conversation, then offer (a January 2026 candidate accepted)

chalk.name: Chalk
chalk.note: Few candidate reports. A November 2023 Glassdoor ML engineer report says the first interview is a medium-difficulty take-home coding test that requires writing your own test cases and unit tests (the process took 1 day in that report). Chalk's postings say engineers help interview and grow the team but do not publish steps. A generic Scoutify page lists a 30 min intro call and a 45-60 min technical interview, which is not company-specific. Older reports for Chalk.com (a different company) are not relevant.
chalk.roles: Chalk (chalk.ai, data platform and feature engine for ML / inference; San Francisco, New York). Software Engineer (systems: query planning, compilers, distributed data processing; Rust / Python), Full-stack Software Engineer, Frontend Software Engineer, Infrastructure / Platform Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer (also Singapore), Support Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer. Levels are not published (postings ask for 2+ or 4+ years depending on role). Other 'Chalk' companies (a communication app, Chalk.com in Canada) also appear in results and were separated out.

character-ai.name: Character.AI
character-ai.roles: Software Engineer (front-end / full-stack React, backend, safety engineering), Staff Software Engineer (AI Platform), Machine Learning Engineer, DevOps Engineer. Offices: Redwood City (San Francisco Bay Area), plus a Bergen op Zoom (Netherlands) report.
steps: Application online, referral or recruiter
Recruiter screen

Technical rounds: React interview (straightforward in one report), two algorithms interviews (LeetCode-style, planning the data structure up front), and for infra / ML roles an ML coding or ML infrastructure and inference round (described as the most distinctive round)

System design (e.g. messaging app, relevant to chat products, LLM serving and safety systems) and a culture-fit round; one reviewer describes four rounds in total (LeetCode-style coding, system design, ML coding, culture fit) and calls it relaxed and collaborative
Decision. Reports vary: about 2 weeks in one referral case, 3-5 weeks in guides. One aggregator mentions 14-28 weeks and a 33% offer rate, which is unverified and based on a small sample.

chariot.name: Chariot
chariot.note: Per Chariot's own posting on YC's Work at a Startup board:
chariot.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Backend Engineer, Senior Frontend Engineer, Founding Frontend Engineer, Product Engineer. The sheet had only search links for this name, and the name is crowded (Chariot Solutions, Chariot Robotics and others exist). The match assumed here is Chariot, the New York nonprofit payments company (donor-advised fund payments, YC S22), which has a Software Engineer interview report matching the sheet's role. No official level codes beyond Senior / Founding titles.
steps: Application online or via founders
Two technical interviews with team members (45-60 minutes each); a 2026 candidate report describes a technical screen built around an interactive HTTP maze API coding challenge
Meet the team in the New York office (about 90 minutes)

Offer decision. The company says the process typically takes 2-4 weeks from start to finish; a later founding frontend posting says about a month, depending on engineering team availability (reports vary).

charta-health.name: Charta Health
charta-health.note: Software engineer path per a September 2026 candidate report and Dataford: Dataford topics list software engineering general, senior, staff, technical design and implementation and system design. One Blind post from August 2025 says the rounds are very different from other companies; another candidate was lined up for an onsite in 2026. Process length was not reported; Dataford sentiment is based on only 2 reports (0% positive, 50% neutral, 50% negative).
charta-health.roles: Software Engineer (NYC, mid level, in office), Senior and Staff Software Engineer, Software Engineer (FDE / Platform) intern, Senior / Staff Forward Deployed AI Engineer, founding site reliability engineer, plus recruiting, marketing and SDR roles. Charta Health is a generative-AI healthcare billing/chart-review startup (San Francisco and New York). I did not use pages about Carta (equity management), which is a different company. No level ladder seen.
steps: Recruiter outreach (LinkedIn) or online application
Technical phone screen: a rate-limiter style coding problem
Virtual / onsite loop of four rounds: coding, technical design and implementation, system design, and behavioral (project and motivation for Charta Health)
Decision

chicago-trading-company.name: Chicago Trading Company
chicago-trading-company.roles: Software Developer / Software Engineer (Java and C++ reported), Associate Engineer, Software Engineering Intern (Summer 2027 posting), Quantitative Trader / Quantitative Trading Analyst, Quantitative Analyst, Quant Researcher (PhD-level). CTC describes itself as an options market-making firm based in Chicago with a New York presence.
steps: Application online, or campus recruiting

Online assessment: for trader / quant tracks, probability and mental maths (a CCAT-style aptitude test is mentioned); for software developers, one or two algorithmic coding problems on a testing platform such as Codility
Phone interview of about 30-45 min with a trader, quant analyst or engineer (reports describe SWE phone screens as roughly 75% coding and 25% non-technical)

Onsite or virtual assessment day / Super Day: for engineers, coding in Java or C++ (e.g. writing a unique_ptr-style template), algorithms and system design; for trader tracks, probability and options concept interview, mental math, and a trading / market-making game
Decision. Reports vary: about 3 days to about 4 weeks in Glassdoor reports; guides describe 4-6 stages depending on track.

chime.name: Chime
chime.note: Guides describe about 4 stages and a fintech-flavoured loop; timeline reports vary, roughly 3-6 weeks (a mobile guide says 3-5 weeks).
chime.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (including mobile and backend engineers), and Software Engineering Manager appear in reports. One third-party prep site lists an L1 to L8 engineer ladder (for example L2 = SE I, L3 = SE II, L6 = Staff, L7 = Principal, L8 = Senior Principal); treat these levels as unofficial and unconfirmed. Sources identify the company as the fintech/neobank Chime.
steps: Recruiter screen (call with a technical recruiter)
Technical screen / coding assessment (live coding, often 45-60 min)
Hiring manager conversation

Final onsite or virtual loop: about two technical rounds (coding and system design), a team/manager round and a product- or behavioral-style round; mobile roles may include a mobile-specific design topic
Decision

cibc.name: CIBC
cibc.note: Interview Query summarises 11 candidate reports as 2-3 rounds mixing resume discussion, behavioral questions and a technical conversation, with coding difficulty varying widely by team. Candidate reports (Glassdoor, 2024-2026) describe:
cibc.roles: CIBC (Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce, Toronto and US capital markets in Chicago and New York). Software Developer, Software Engineer, Intermediate Applications Developer, Senior Software Engineer (mobile), Sr. Consultant / Back End and Full Stack Developer (Java, Spring Boot, microservices), Executive Director, FICC eTrading Development, Software Developer Intern / Co-op. Glassdoor volume is dominated by non-engineering bank roles (Associate, Analyst, banking, customer service). Levels follow Intermediate / Senior / Sr. Consultant titles, not a numeric ladder.
steps: Recruiter or HR screening (yes/no and behavioral questions, sometimes via a one-way video)
Online coding assessment (skills test) for many developer applicants

Technical and behavioral interview with the hiring manager or team (resume verification, agile vs waterfall style questions, Java / .NET fundamentals; one candidate expected live .NET coding but got definition-style questions); a final-round team interview or panel / presentation for some roles

Background check and offer. Glassdoor averages about 14 days for developers and 33 days company-wide; internships report anywhere from 1 day to 2 months. Experiences are mixed: a February 2026 Chicago report calls the hiring communication poorly managed, while a June 2026 Toronto software engineer report ended in an accepted offer.

circle.name: Circle
circle.note: Timeline: guides say about 3-6 rounds and roughly 5 weeks, but reports vary from 1-2 weeks to a six-week wait after the assessment; several candidates describe slow follow-up, cancelled calls or no reply.
circle.roles: Software Engineer (including new grad), Senior Software Engineer, frontend engineer, senior site reliability engineer (Tech Ops), and AI engineer openings appear in candidate reports. Sources are for Circle Internet Financial (the USDC issuer). No official or unofficial level ladder seen.
steps: Application online, via agency, or through campus
Recruiter / hiring manager call

CodeSignal online assessment, commonly reported as 90 minutes and proctored, with about four coding questions (one candidate described building an in-memory database in four levels); some candidates report the process ending after this stage

Technical rounds reported by candidates: a general system design round, a pair-programming task building a web API with CRUD operations, a behavioral interview, and for some candidates a 5-7 hour take-home project
Further interviews with engineering managers and a senior engineer, and for one 2023 report a VP interview, then decision

cisco.name: Cisco
cisco.roles: Software Engineer ladder per third-party guides (unofficial): Software Engineer 1, 2, III, IV, Technical Leader, Principal Engineer, Distinguished Engineer, Fellow; also graduate / intern engineers, Network Engineer, Customer Support Engineer, Program / Project Manager, Business Analyst. Glassdoor report volume is led by Software Engineer (by far), Senior Software Engineer, Program and Project Manager.
steps: Application online, referral or campus
Recruiter screen (about 30 min; resume walkthrough, domain fit)
Online coding assessment for many candidates
Technical interviews (usually 1-3): coding problems, project / resume deep dive, core CS and networking topics depending on team; some teams use a panel
Hiring manager or managerial round, then HR round
Decision. Guides give 3-4 rounds and roughly 1-8 weeks depending on team and source (reports vary widely).

citadel.name: Citadel
citadel.roles: Software Engineer: university graduate / campus (NXT early-career program), Software Engineer (experienced, 6+ yrs), Senior; Citadel Securities has C++, full stack, UI and options engineer roles. Other reported roles: Quantitative Researcher, Quantitative Analyst, Trader, Analyst, Associate. One guide says Citadel and Citadel Securities run a single engineering interview process.
steps: Resume screen
One or two online assessments (coding and problem-solving) and/or 1-2 phone screens with coding exercises

Interviews of about 4-6 rounds (Citadel's own guide describes experienced-hire interviews as one problem worked through in four stages with the same engineer, in a shared coding environment such as CoderPad). Reports mention LeetCode medium-hard questions, concurrency and distributed systems for C++ roles
Decision. Roughly 2-4+ weeks; blog guides say 5-7 stages.

citadel-securities.name: Citadel Securities
citadel-securities.note: Citadel Securities publishes its own engineering interview process pages (experienced and campus versions). From them and candidate sources:
citadel-securities.roles: Software Engineer: University Graduate (US), C++ Software Engineer, Full Stack Software Engineer (3+ yrs), UI Engineer (Global Trading Applications), Senior Options Software Engineer, Senior Python Software Engineer, Research Engineer (Data), Software Engineer Interns (US, Australia, Asia), UI engineer contractors. A third-party guide says Citadel and Citadel Securities run one shared engineering interview process.
steps: Application, online assessment (HackerRank-style: easy and medium problems, e.g. stock / order-book themed coding; interns report this first)
Phone screen with coding in a shared environment such as CoderPad

Experienced-professional interviews: one problem worked through in four stages with the same engineer, testing how you communicate as the requirements change; campus / university-graduate route has its own process; C++ debugging, TCP/UDP and threads, OOP and project discussion are reported
Super Day or onsite of several sessions, then a senior-engineer team match and decision. Roughly 2-4+ weeks in most reports; guides count 4-8 stages.

citi.name: Citi
citi.note: Technology analyst / graduate path per candidate reports: Timeline: Glassdoor shows about 15 days for Technology Analyst and about 24 days company-wide; reports vary from 1 day to about a month for many, and one Singapore case took 9-10 months. Non-technology divisions (branch, investment banking) were not researched.
citi.roles: Very broad bank. Glassdoor volume is led by Financial Analyst, Software Engineer (about 370), Project Manager, Intern, Technology Analyst (about 100), Investment Banking Summer Analyst, bank teller, personal banker and other branch/operations roles. Technology reports cover Technology Analyst / ICG Technology Analyst Program, Apps Dev (programmer analyst) roles and senior titles (Vice President, Technology Lead Analyst). Standard bank titles (Analyst, Associate, AVP, VP, Director) are used; no engineering-specific ladder seen.
steps: Online application or campus career fair / webinar
Recruiter or HR screen (background, why Citi vs competitors)

Assessment: online or written technical test (core Java, SQL, OS, web services, brain teasers, immutable objects, prime-number function) or aptitude/IQ-style tests; some reports have a case sent the night before and presented next day

Interview day or half-day: group interviews and one-on-one technical / manager interviews (one older campus report was four managers for 30 minutes each; Singapore report lists HR, case interview, HR with manager, hiring-department interview)
Offer

citibank.name: Citibank
citibank.note: Technology analyst / graduate path per candidate reports: Timeline: Glassdoor shows about 15 days for Technology Analyst and about 24 days company-wide; reports vary from 1 day to about a month for many, and one Singapore case took 9-10 months. Non-technology divisions (branch, investment banking) were not researched.
citibank.roles: Citibank is the Citi / Citigroup banking unit; same sources as the Citi row. Very broad bank. Glassdoor volume is led by Financial Analyst, Software Engineer (about 370), Project Manager, Intern, Technology Analyst (about 100), Investment Banking Summer Analyst, bank teller, personal banker and other branch/operations roles. Technology reports cover Technology Analyst / ICG Technology Analyst Program, Apps Dev (programmer analyst) roles and senior titles (Vice President, Technology Lead Analyst). Standard bank titles (Analyst, Associate, AVP, VP, Director) are used; no engineering-specific ladder seen.
steps: Online application or campus career fair / webinar
Recruiter or HR screen (background, why Citi vs competitors)

Assessment: online or written technical test (core Java, SQL, OS, web services, brain teasers, immutable objects, prime-number function) or aptitude/IQ-style tests; some reports have a case sent the night before and presented next day

Interview day or half-day: group interviews and one-on-one technical / manager interviews (one older campus report was four managers for 30 minutes each; Singapore report lists HR, case interview, HR with manager, hiring-department interview)
Offer

clickhouse.name: Clickhouse
clickhouse.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports, Taro, Interview Query (only two reports) and guides (partly generic):
clickhouse.roles: ClickHouse (open-source analytical database and ClickHouse Cloud; remote-first with offices and hires in San Francisco, Austin, New York, Philadelphia, Europe, Japan). Roles seen: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (Postgres, ClickPipes CDC/streaming, Cloud Partner Integrations, Backend AI/ML, Data Integration, JVM Language Clients; posted US bands about $140-208k), Full Stack Software Engineer, Principal Software Engineer, Core Engine (C++) and Cloud / Platform tracks, AI Engineer, Analytics Engineer, Technical Support Engineer, Customer Success Engineer, Solutions Account Executive. No numeric ladder beyond Senior / Principal.
steps: Application online; initial screening by the recruiter (about 30 min: background, a recent project, role fit, logistics)

One-hour video call that opens with a resume walkthrough and technical questions (a Kubernetes question in one report); a Full Stack Developer report describes a recruiter conversation followed by a live coding interview

Take-home assignment and live coding pairings for some tracks (Dataford lists a loop with a take-home, live coding pairings and a final management-alignment round); techinterview.org says Core Engine interviews are C++-heavy (cache lines, SIMD, microsecond-level performance); TechPrep says the process differs between Core Engine and Cloud / Platform roles

Final management / team conversation, then decision. Timeline: Taro (3 senior SWE reports) shows 4 weeks, a 0% pass rate and mostly negative experiences; Dataford suggests about 2-6 weeks depending on role; one December 2025 Glassdoor candidate had a good experience but an offer was rescinded based on country of birth. Public reports are very few, so treat as indicative.

clickup.name: Clickup
clickup.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (about 17 Glassdoor reports), Staff Software Engineer, Senior Frontend Engineer, AI Engineer, Backend Engineer, QA Engineer, DevOps Engineer, Solutions Engineer. Glassdoor volume also includes Customer Support Specialist (largest, about 18), Account Executive, Product Manager and Product Marketing Manager. Offices: San Diego, Denver, Toronto, Warsaw, Bengaluru and remote.
steps: Application online, referral or recruiter
HR screening, then a manager screen

Live coding interview (e.g. a document-event processing problem in a shared code pad with follow-ups, or implement a chat application API); some reports mention an aptitude test and technical puzzles / fundamentals
System design / architecture interview, including component design from an image with product managers and engineering partners as interviewers
Culture interview, and for some roles a final interview or practical assessments

Decision. Reports vary: about 1-4 weeks in most Glassdoor reports, while a guide gives 4-6 weeks. Reviews range from positive (accepted offers, straightforward guided process) to negative (staff-level no offers in 2022 and 2025).

cloudflare.name: Cloudflare
cloudflare.roles: Software Engineer (L1 through L6 per third-party guides, unofficial; also Principal Software Engineer), systems / content delivery engineers, full-stack and frontend engineers, Software Engineering Managers. Reports in the sheet are most likely for software engineering.
steps: Application online; hiring manager or recruiter reaches out
Recruiter screen (role, logistics, how the rounds work)
Technical phone interviews (coding, data structures and algorithms; some teams use pairing)

Later stages reported by candidates: system design (distributed systems emphasis), practical coding / debugging, behavioral / values round, hiring manager or team round, sometimes a final deep dive or presentation; at least 5-6 hours spread across meetings
Decision. Guides say roughly 3-8 weeks, 2-8 rounds depending on team, and some candidates call it slow (reports vary).

cloudkitchens.name: CloudKitchens
cloudkitchens.roles: Software Engineer (backend, full-stack, frontend, mobile; Java and other backend languages), Staff and Senior/Staff Backend Software Engineer, Customer Success Engineer; a third-party guide labels engineering levels L4-L6 (unofficial). Glassdoor reports are dominated by Account Executive, SDR and Sales roles.
steps: Recruiter call and hiring-manager conversation
Technical phone screen (practical coding, e.g. an in-memory file storage or classic menu coding task)
Take-home assignment in any backend language (e.g. a Java take-home with tests) or a ~3-hour coding project

Onsite / virtual rounds: four 'modules' of about an hour each in some reports - project deep dives, system design (order-management / kitchen order courier style problems), concurrency model and trade-off defence, a director conversation
Decision. Slow in some reports: about 4 weeks to roughly 8 weeks, with one candidate describing nearly three months and an abrupt stop after assignments.

cloudtrucks.name: CloudTrucks
cloudtrucks.roles: Software Engineer (backend, marketplace, financial products, business platform), Mid-level to Senior Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (including AI Products), Analytics Engineer. Job listings ask for about 4+ years of production experience for mid-level and above roles. CloudTrucks is a San Francisco virtual trucking carrier and fleet management platform. No official level codes seen.
steps: Application online
Recruiter interview
Technical screening and first technical interview (examples: load location coordinate mapping in Python)

Onsite of about 6 hours: another coding interview, a project-storytelling interview (walk through a challenging project end to end), a practical case study, and conversations with the hiring manager and the CEO
Decision. Reports describe about three semi-easy rounds plus the onsite, a lean team and, in some cases, no feedback after the loop; Glassdoor data is too small to give a timeline (reports vary).

cloverhealth.name: Cloverhealth
cloverhealth.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports and Interview Query's guide:
cloverhealth.roles: Clover Health (Medicare Advantage insurer and Counterpart Health / Clover Assistant tooling; remote US plus older Hong Kong, San Francisco and New Jersey sites). Roles seen: Senior Software Engineer (full-stack, remote US, about $195-220k in a posting), Associate Software Engineer (Hong Kong, 2019), Software Engineer. Glassdoor volume is mostly Senior Software Engineer reports from 2019-2026. Levels shown only as Associate / Senior; no numeric ladder seen. Posting text says you will learn the specific team and interview process as you move through it.
steps: Application online or via recruiter; a 30-minute recruiter call about the company, role and process
Phone screen with an easy coding question or a coding assessment (a 2019 Hong Kong report: turn an integer into a string with commas, via video with staff in Hong Kong, San Francisco and New Jersey)
Technical interview of about an hour; a 2019 senior report adds a take-home exercise (coding plus system design) before a roughly four-hour onsite with one hour with the CTO including live coding

Recent senior reports (2025-2026): a system design interview with data architecture and API design for a theoretical feature, with some interviewers described as interrupting; multiple stages with a helpful recruiter who gave feedback on request; candidates who did not progress past the third round
Offer. Timeline: reports range from 4 weeks (2019) to a few weeks in 2026; most recent senior-engineer reports are no offer with neutral experiences.

codeium.name: Codeium
codeium.note: Software engineer path per Glassdoor and Taro reports (2024-early 2025, pre-acquisition):
codeium.roles: Software Engineer (Mountain View CA and San Francisco), Software Engineer New Grad, and a few account executive / strategic account executive reports. Codeium rebranded as Windsurf; per a techinterview.org guide (updated September 2026), the Windsurf product and brand belong to Cognition after a mid-2025 deal, and no post-acquisition candidate interview reports had surfaced, so the process below is pre-acquisition. Sheet website is windsurf.com; Glassdoor and Taro file the company as Windsurf. No level ladder seen.
steps: Application online, via university or recruiter; an introductory recruiter call about motivation and interest in Codeium
Online assessment for new grads: 1 hour, one LeetCode-hard problem (one May 2025 candidate passed all test cases)
Virtual coding interview(s): 1 hour, LeetCode-medium to hard in graph/string topics, with a second coding round that candidates describe as a high bar (one solved the problem but did not pass)

Onsite: for new grads about 2 coding problems (1 hard, 1 medium) plus a Python project implementation such as a mini data pipeline using pandas; the company covered flight and hotel costs; one onsite coding miss led to rejection; a November 2025 candidate describes a 45-minute interview on building a search engine

Decision. Timeline: about 3-4 weeks on average (techinterview.org says a little over three weeks); one university applicant took 2 months. Candidates call it difficult but the interviewers helpful. The loop after the acquisition is unknown; confirm with the recruiter.

cognitiv.name: Cognitiv
cognitiv.note: Cognitiv publishes its own candidate-experience post, 'No Ghosting, No Guessing: Here's Exactly What to Expect When You Interview at Cognitiv' (see official sources); only its intro was visible, so the step list comes from candidate reports:
cognitiv.roles: Cognitiv (deep-learning ad-tech, Bellevue WA, also New York and a new Canada office). Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (C# deep learning platform, Spark), Senior Software Engineer C++ Real-time Systems (programmatic bidding), Machine Learning Engineer, DevOps Engineer, Engineering Manager. Levels are not published beyond Senior / Manager titles. Search results for Cognitio, Cognitev and Kognitiv were different companies and were ignored.
steps: Recruiter / initial call

Technical screen: a PracHub report (Jul 2026, Software Engineer) describes a hard technical screen focused on Spark and C#, ending in rejection; the company is described there as a small ads-data startup hiring for a new Canada office

Later rounds and a hiring-manager conversation; Glassdoor reports range from about 2 weeks (Senior SWE, Apr 2024) to a smooth, well-communicated process (Seattle, Apr 2026) and a neutral New York report that ended after the first round (Apr 2026).

cohere.name: Cohere
cohere.roles: Software Engineer (API platform, agent platform, customer tooling), Senior Software Engineer (L5 per one candidate report, unofficial), Senior Staff Software Developer, Research Engineer, Research Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, Platform Engineer, Product Manager, Sales Engineer. Search results also surfaced Cohere Health, a different healthcare company, so only sources about the AI company at cohere.com were kept here.
steps: Application online
Recruiter / HR screen (about 30 min)
Online assessment or take-home project for some roles (described as demanding)
Technical rounds: coding, plus an ML or system design round (for example ML system design for an agent platform role)
Behavioral round and team-match conversation, then final round
Decision. Guides say about 4-6 weeks, with long waits between rounds reported by some candidates (reports vary).

coinbase.name: Coinbase
coinbase.roles: Software Engineer (frontend or backend / algorithmic loop), Senior and Staff Software Engineer, trading engineers, interns, plus Support Analyst, Analyst, Product Manager and Customer Service roles per Glassdoor. Levels are not clearly published.
steps: Recruiter screen (why Coinbase, interest in crypto/web3)
Work-style assessment (CCAT-type plus values questions) or online assessment in some cases
Technical screen on HackerRank over video, lighter in depth
Onsite of about 4 rounds: two ~90 min coding rounds (practical, real-world rather than pure puzzles), system design, and behavioral; some reports add a hiring manager round and a culture round
Decision. Glassdoor average about 30 days; blog guides say 3-5 stages over 6-8 weeks.

collegevine.name: Collegevine
collegevine.note: Very thin data. Sources only give: a Forward Deployed Engineer who applied through a recruiter in Nov 2025 (process about 4 weeks, accepted offer, average difficulty), and the CTO saying in a podcast write-up that the hiring process is designed to find engineers who thrive in a fast-moving environment (shipping in about two days, owning work from idea to production). A third-party guide counts 28 interview reports across consultant and forward-deployed engineer tracks. No software engineer round-by-round process was found.
collegevine.roles: Software Engineer (2-4 years of experience per a listing), Senior Fullstack Engineer (Postgres, NoSQL, Ruby on Rails), Forward Deployed Engineer, Consultant, Success Engineer. CollegeVine is a remote-first college guidance company. No official level codes seen. Only the Forward Deployed Engineer role has a Glassdoor interview report with a stated duration.

color-health.name: Color Health
color-health.note: Color's own company profile on Elpha lists the process: Stage 1, a 30-minute recruiter screen; Stage 2, a 60-minute phone or video interview; Stage 3, a 3-4 hour virtual onsite with different team members including live coding and design (varies by role). Color's Lever postings add that it may use AI tools to support parts of hiring (reviewing applications, analyzing resumes) without replacing human judgment. Candidate reports (PracHub, Aug 2026, new grad) describe an AI-assisted online assessment, an HR screen, then a technical screen with pair programming on a staged, AI-assisted full-stack exercise (an expense reimbursement app with persistent add, delete, list and toggle flows, a server-side rule and an end-to-end review). TechPrep puts the whole process at about 3-5 weeks. Dataford shows 4 rounds over 3-5 weeks for other roles.
color-health.roles: Color Health (cancer care and healthcare platform, Burlingame CA, South San Francisco, remote-friendly; formerly Color). New Grad Software Engineer, Software Engineer II (Core Services, Onboarding Experience, 4+ yrs, Python / Django / React / TypeScript), Senior Software Engineer (AI Platform), full stack engineers, Product Designer, plus clinical and operations roles. Levels in postings: New Grad / II / Senior.

commure.name: Commure
commure.roles: Software Engineer (RCM Billing, Biller Workflows, AI Integrations, Backend, Frontend / Ambient AI platform), Staff Software Engineer (Accounts & Ledgering, Data Integrations), Software Engineer Intern (Applied AI). Glassdoor report volume also includes Medical Documentation Specialist (about 30), Medical Scribe, Account Executive, Operations Manager and Sales. Healthcare-AI company; offices: Mountain View, Los Angeles, San Francisco.
steps: Application online
Recruiter / phone screen (smooth, conversational, background and interest)
Online assessment for interns: 5 questions with 3 multiple choice, plus a build task such as a URL shortener API
Two technical rounds that are implementation-focused rather than LeetCode (fetch data from an API and transform it, implement a working rate limiter), plus a system design round
Hiring-manager / executive screens (reports mention up to 3 of these in one cycle)
Decision. Reports vary: about 2 weeks in several reports; Glassdoor shows 7 days from a single sample. Several 2025-2026 candidates ended with no offer, some describe interviewers as disengaged.

composio.name: Composio
composio.note: Public detail is very thin (Dataford has one interview report; PracHub has one new-grad report). From those:
composio.roles: Composio (AI agent tooling and integrations platform; San Francisco and Bengaluru, Series A). Roles seen on its Ashby board (via Scoutify and Fast AI Jobs): Software Engineer (7 open roles as of June 2026, including an unusual '$1 engineer' posting), Fullstack Engineer (including new grad), forward-deployed and enterprise engineering roles, and enterprise account executive. Dataford shows a median total compensation of about $193k with a wide $105-282k range for the Software Engineer guide, based on only 1 report. No level ladder seen.
steps: Application via Ashby (resume), then a recruiter or founder intro

Take-home project: an August 2026 new-grad Fullstack Engineer report describes an AI-assisted take-home plus a one-take code walkthrough video (in progress when posted, medium difficulty); Dataford's topic signals (not interview reports) emphasise take-home projects, forward-deployed and enterprise engineering, problem solving and explaining your work
Technical and team conversations (not described in the sources I found)

Decision. Timeline and round counts were not reported. Scoutify's generic loop (a 30-minute intro call and a 45-60 minute technical interview) is not company-specific. Treat everything here as indicative and ask the recruiter for the loop for your role.

concentric-ai.name: Concentric Ai
concentric-ai.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports:
concentric-ai.roles: Software Engineer / Software Developer (SDE-1, including on-campus drives in India), and engineers in Bengaluru, Pune, New Delhi and California. Concentric AI is a data-security (DSPM) company. I did not use pages about ConcertAI, Concentrix or Concentric Advisors, which are different companies. No official level ladder seen.
steps: Application online, via recruiter, staffing agency, or campus drive
Online assessment (the September 2026 SDE-1 on-campus report starts with an online assessment round; a DSA round with dynamic-programming questions appears in another report)
Technical interviews: DSA, resume questions, and tech-stack proficiency in different technologies; one candidate called it easy and insightful

Further rounds and offer. Round details beyond the first were not visible in the snippets I saw. Timeline not clearly reported. Dataford lists a difficulty of 5.0/10 based on 6-12 reports; several candidates declined offers or received no offer, and an April 2026 Bengaluru report is negative and difficult.

confluent.name: Confluent
confluent.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (I / II), Staff, Principal and Senior Principal ladder (L2 through L7 per candidate guides, unofficial), frontend, infrastructure and streaming / cloud engineering teams. Other families in Glassdoor reports: Account Executive, Sales, SDR, Solutions Engineer, Customer Success Technical Architect. Engineering reports dominate the SWE counts.
steps: Application online or via recruiter
Recruiter / phone screen, and for many candidates a coding challenge or online skills test
Technical phone / video screen (coding, medium difficulty with harder follow-ups)

Onsite or virtual loop of several interviews: coding, system design (design a product style question; distributed systems and concurrency emphasis in guides), frontend roles may include a UI / React round, plus a hiring manager behavioral round
Decision. Average of about 35-40 days per Glassdoor stats, though individual reports run from 3 weeks to 2 months (reports vary).

coreweave.name: Coreweave
coreweave.roles: Software Engineer (for example Kubernetes core interfaces), Senior Software Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, Operations Engineer, AI Engineer, plus Data Center Technician, Finance and SDR roles. Glassdoor report counts are small and led by Data Center Technician, then Software Engineer. No official level codes seen.
steps: Application online, via recruiter or referral (recruiters tend to contact quickly)
Recruiter screen (about 30 min; motivation, background, expectations)
Technical screen / assessment: timed CoderPad-style coding (about 60 min), concurrency topics reported; operations roles get a Linux / Kubernetes knowledge assessment
Culture-fit or hiring manager interview (one report says about 90 min with a director), system design, and domain-specific cloud / infrastructure interview
Behavioral round and final decision. Guides say 5-6 rounds over several weeks; individual reports range from about 2 weeks to 8 weeks (reports vary).

cortex.name: Cortex
cortex.note: Per Cortex's own 'Interview Process and Compensation' page (cortex.io/work-for-us), usually four steps, varying by role: 1) recruiter phone screen with the Talent team about the company, team and role, 2) technical screen, 3) virtual onsite interview, 4) a final step (cut off in the visible snippet); results are typically shared within 2-5 business days of each interview. Candidate reports: a 1point3acres SDE thread describes a technical phone screen and virtual onsite with coding and system design rounds; Glassdoor (Cortex CA) reports a standard HR intro followed by a coding and system design interview (a Staff Software Engineer in May 2026 was a difficult no-offer, and a December 2023 candidate called the design review a gotcha question). Timeline not clearly reported beyond the 2-5 business-day result promise. If 'Cortex' means a different company, ignore this row.
cortex.roles: AMBIGUOUS COMPANY: the sheet's 'Cortex' has no website or other identifier. Many unrelated companies use the name (Cortex.io internal developer portal; Cortex in Brazil; Cortex Robotics; Cortex Business Solutions; PCS Software's Cortex platform). As a best guess I researched Cortex.io (San Francisco, engineering-productivity platform), because it publishes its own interview process and Glassdoor lists it as 'Cortex (CA)'; please confirm or tell me the real company. Roles seen for Cortex (CA): Software Engineer, Staff Software Engineer, SDE, plus other roles; no numeric ladder seen.

coupang.name: Coupang
coupang.roles: Software Engineer / SDE on an L-level ladder (L4 SDE, L5 Senior, L6-I / L6-II Staff, L7 Senior Staff, L8 Principal per third-party guides, unofficial), plus engineering roles in Seoul, Seattle, Mountain View and Singapore hubs. Reports in the sheet are most likely for software engineering.
steps: Application online or recruiter outreach
HR chat or hiring manager call (about 30-45 min on background and fit)
Possible online assessment, then live coding rounds (data structures and algorithms)
System design round (examples: ticketing system, catalog / recommendation system, e-commerce platform)
Behavioral / culture-fit or bar-raiser style round; guides say the process is modeled on Amazon with leadership-principles style questions woven in; four to five rounds reported
Decision. Guides say about 2-5 weeks; some candidates report chaotic scheduling or unclear follow-up (reports vary).

coursera.name: Coursera
coursera.roles: Software Engineer I, II, Senior, Staff, Senior Staff and Principal Engineer per a third-party guide (unofficial), Senior Frontend Engineer (Pune), Senior Software Developer (Toronto), Software Engineer Intern. Glassdoor report counts also include many sales roles (SDR, Account Executive).
steps: Application online or recruiter outreach (including LinkedIn for the Pune office)
Recruiter / phone screening; for some candidates an online assessment, HackerRank challenge or a take-home project (older reports mention a week-long project)

Technical interviews: timed coding or machine coding (examples reported: build a progress bar in vanilla HTML / CSS / JavaScript, LRU cache, async problems), then system design for senior roles and code review

Hiring manager meeting and behavioral conversation (why online learning); one report counts 5 stages, a Pune frontend report counts 5 rounds, and one report notes a design question in the 4th interview
Final debrief with the recruiter, then decision. Glassdoor shows about 27 days on average for software engineers; several candidate reports ended without an offer (reports vary).

credit-genie.name: Credit Genie
credit-genie.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer Backend, Mobile Engineer / Engineering Manager Android, Machine Learning Engineer, Data Engineer, QA Engineer, Product Manager. Credit Genie is a mobile-first financial wellness company with a Pittsburgh area base. No official level codes seen.
steps: Application online, campus or other source
Recruiter call
Technical screen: fairly quick custom pair programming, for example a FastAPI CRUD exercise with strong questioning, plus a behavioral / mission-alignment introduction

Further rounds: guides mention data structures and algorithms, backend architecture and distributed systems design; one 2025 report describes 7 rounds in total from recruiter to a final round with the CEO
Decision. One report says about 4 weeks; some candidates describe the process as rigorous or ended in rejection after small communication slips (reports vary).

creditkarma.name: Creditkarma
creditkarma.note: Candidate sources describe a fairly compact process, about 2 weeks to 2 months (Glassdoor shows 1 day to 4 weeks for different cycles):
creditkarma.roles: Credit Karma (personal finance platform, now part of Intuit). Software Engineer, Software Engineer - Full Stack, Senior Software Engineer (a Glassdoor report mentions a SWE 4 interviewer, unofficial levels), Machine Learning Engineer, Software Engineer Intern (including Charlotte).
steps: Form / survey screening for some intern and early roles, or a recruiter phone screen (some candidates are approached by email)
Technical screen: coding with an engineer (about 1 hr; a robot-style modelling problem is reported, plus some behavioral questions)

Onsite / virtual rounds: software design with LeetCode-style questioning and design principles, a technical interview with a team, and behavioral interviews (older reports include whiteboard problems, lunch with engineers, HR and hiring manager interviews)
Decision. Taro shows a low pass rate (about 11% across 18 SF reports) and several candidates describe inconsistent communication.

cresta.name: Cresta
cresta.roles: Software Engineer (mid-level, Senior Backend, Senior Frontend), Forward Deployed Engineer (AI Agent side), Junior Software Engineer internship (Cluj and Bucharest, Romania), Customer Success Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer. Company builds generative-AI tools for contact centers. Offices: San Francisco, New York, Cluj, Bucharest.
steps: Application online or recruiter
Online assessment on CoderPad (company-confirmed vendor): about 3 coding questions in 45 minutes; FDE cycles report up to five timed OA parts
Recruiter / 15-min background chat
One-hour technical interview with an engineer (LeetCode easy-medium plus OOP / practical coding, e.g. a feature-flag evaluation engine)
Onsite / virtual loop: AI-assisted coding (e.g. build a chat agent in Python), system design (e.g. eval platform for AI agents, streaming pipeline), project presentation, hiring-manager conversation
Decision. Reports vary: about 3 weeks for FDE cycles, guides suggest 3-5 weeks. Some 2026 candidates report rejection after a good final chat.

cribl.name: Cribl
cribl.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (largest group, 14 Glassdoor reports), Staff Software Engineer (Core Platform, Cribl AI), Principal Software Engineer, Director of Engineering, plus Regional Sales Manager, SDR, Solutions and Sales Engineer roles in report counts. Reports come from San Francisco, New York, Toronto and Ireland. No official level codes seen beyond title tiers.
steps: Application online or employee referral
Recruiter screen, then a hiring manager screen
Take-home assessment (estimated 60-90 minutes; reviewed afterward with two engineers), which the company says it introduced in a changed engineer process; some candidates get no feedback after it

Panel interview with a straightforward coding question, system design (for example a highly available, scalable real-time data ingestion system, with a principal and senior principal engineer) and domain expertise questions; a behavioral question such as describing a bad day at work was reported
Decision. Reports range from 2 weeks to 2 months; several candidates describe slow or no communication, while an April 2026 candidate calls it smooth but long (reports vary).

crowdstrike.name: Crowdstrike
crowdstrike.roles: Software Engineer (Engineer I, II, III, Senior Engineer II, Principal, Senior Principal, Distinguished per a candidate-guide ladder, unofficial), Backend Engineer, UI Engineer, AI Engineer, Sensor / cloud-security engineers. Glassdoor report volume is dominated by sales: Sales Development Representative (about 69), Software Engineer (about 42), Sales, Account Manager, Corporate Account Executive and Regional Sales Manager.
steps: Application online or via recruiter
Recruiter call, then hiring-manager conversation
Technical screen: coding and algorithms round of about 45 min; some cycles use a take-home
Onsite / panel: three back-to-back one-hour parts in one report (coding, design, domain / project deep dive), with an HR and manager meeting; senior roles add system design

Decision. Reports vary: about 2-3 weeks per Glassdoor reports and about 4-6 weeks per one guide; Glassdoor puts CrowdStrike overall at about 24 days. Slow follow-up and silence after the loop are common complaints.

crusoe.name: Crusoe
crusoe.roles: Software Engineer (cloud, managed AI services, control planes, storage, telemetry, networking for GPU clusters), Senior Software Engineer, Staff Software Engineer, Security Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Product Manager. No official level codes seen. Reports in the sheet are most likely for software engineering; the sheet links crusoe.ai (Crusoe, the AI infrastructure company).
steps: Application online
Recruiter screen

One or more technical or skills-based interviews (a senior engineering report describes a phone coding screen such as printing a binary tree, then a conversation with the head of engineering about projects)
System design round (backend roles reportedly got some networking questions) and, in one report, an in-person onsite with a slide-deck deep dive of past work
Final round meeting team members and the hiring manager
Decision. Crusoe says most processes wrap up within two to six weeks; Glassdoor shows about 21 days on average for software engineers (reports vary).

current.name: Current
current.roles: Software Engineer (Java / JVM backend, 2+ years, New York in-office), Senior Software Engineer (infrastructure, backend), Software Engineer Backend, Senior Analytics Engineer, Lead Data Scientist. Sources are for Current (NY), a New York neobank (Glassdoor name 'Current (NY)'); other companies named Current or Fintech showed up in results and were ignored.
steps: Application online, recruiter or staffing agency
Initial HR / recruiter call

Coding assessment sent first in recent cycles, with about a week to complete (e.g. design, build, test and document a Java REST API end to end); LeetCode-style live questions also reported (valid parentheses with a wildcard follow-up)
Technical and team interviews; analytics roles are asked about dbt and building dimensional models; one report asks whether you are fine with 5 days a week in the office and late hours
Decision. Reports vary: about 3-4 weeks. Most Glassdoor reports (2020-2025) are negative with no offer, citing disorganization, short-notice scheduling and no follow-up.

cursor.name: Cursor
cursor.roles: Software Engineer (Product), Software Engineer (Infrastructure), Software Engineer (ML & Inference), security engineer, design engineer, product quality / DX engineer, research scientist, engineering manager, data platform engineer, plus solutions, sales, operations and IT systems roles, per a third-party prep site that reads Cursor's postings. The company is legally Anysphere, so Glassdoor and Taro list it as Anysphere. One Exponent report tags a new-grad engineer as entry level / L3 (unofficial). No official level ladder seen.
steps: Application (online) or referral
Recruiter call (about 30 min)
One to three technical screens of about 60 min; one candidate report describes a HackerRank-style practical task with an engineer on the line

Decision round: an onsite project on part of Cursor's real codebase, where you pick a feature to design and ship; guides describe it as a paid, about eight-hour or up to two-day in-person project alongside the team, plus informal time with teammates for culture fit

Decision. Guides give about 3-5 rounds and roughly 3-5 weeks (one new-grad report: 5 weeks). A third-party prep site notes that Cursor publishes no company-wide interview loop; only the Software Engineer (Product) posting mentions the onsite small-project step. Details vary by role.

cvs-health.name: CVS Health
cvs-health.note: Typical corporate / call-centre path per candidate reports: Technical roles per reports: HR screen with basic SQL/Python questions, then 2-3 rounds with live coding or technical discussion, sometimes a take-home assignment. Timeline: reports vary, about 1-4 weeks; Glassdoor shows about 20 days on average. Frontline roles can be a single short interview with an on-the-spot offer.
cvs-health.roles: Interview-report volume is dominated by non-engineering and frontline/corporate roles: customer service representative (hundreds of Glassdoor reports), pharmacy technician, pharmacist and retail roles, plus nurse/clinical, analyst, and corporate roles. Technology roles (software engineer, developer, data analyst) also appear. No official or unofficial level ladder seen in the sources.
steps: Online application through the careers portal (ATS keyword screen)
Recruiter/HR phone screen
HireVue one-way video interview with timed behavioral (STAR-style) questions; some roles add an online assessment (an SHL-style test is mentioned in one guide)
Live virtual interview with the hiring manager, sometimes a panel of manager plus 2-3 leaders; behavioral questions dominate
Background check (and drug test for pharmacy/store roles), then offer

da-vinci-trading.name: Da Vinci Trading
da-vinci-trading.note: Da Vinci's own job postings (Greenhouse and a university careers board) include a Process section that starts with an HR interview (a conversation with a recruiter about Da Vinci and your soft skills and motivators) and continues through technical interviews and final conversations. Third-party guides add (tradermath, Jan 2026; tradinginterview.com): a numerical quiz, an HR interview on motivation and volatility trading knowledge (with some mental maths and brainteasers), a technical interview held by video with a trader, then final conversations often at the Amsterdam HQ including an in-depth HR interview with the founders; developer candidates get C++ assessments and discussions of past projects. For the separate DV Trading in Chicago, one Glassdoor engineer reports a 2-week process and an offer within 24 hours of the final interview, with C++ tech assessment and project questions.
da-vinci-trading.roles: Da Vinci Derivatives (Da Vinci Trading), Amsterdam-based proprietary trading firm founded by former Optiver people. Software Engineer / Experienced C++ Software Engineer (low-latency trading systems and algos, in-house trading system 'Melzi'), C++ Software Engineer, graduate roles, plus Trader and Quantitative Researcher tracks. IMPORTANT: Glassdoor and some reports labelled 'DV Trading' (Chicago, Seattle, London; Graduate Software Developer) are a different firm, DV Trading, and I kept those out of this row's process except where noted.

dandy.name: Dandy
dandy.note: Dandy's careers technology page says the process digs into real situations you have faced and hypothetical ones you might face. Candidate and third-party sources describe 5-6 rounds, quick decisions and cross-functional panels: Dandy's AI guidance for candidates says AI use is welcome for prep but not during live interviews. A May 2026 Glassdoor report praises the speed of the process, but the candidate says Dandy rescinded a signed offer two days before the start date.
dandy.roles: Dandy (digital dental lab / dental technology, New York and remote). Software Engineer II, Senior Software Engineer I and II (Practice Engagement, ML Platform, Billing, Supply Chain, Web and 3D Integrations), Staff Software Engineer, Senior Full-Stack Engineer; levels appear as I / II in the postings themselves (Senior II asks for 8+ years of experience). Also sales and manufacturing roles.
steps: Recruiter call

Online assessment for some software engineers, then a tech screen that opens with soft-skills questions about a recent project and moves to coding (a hashmap defaults / duplicate-attributes problem is reported)
System design centred on APIs and data modeling that is close to real work (a senior frontend candidate reports a data-modeling round with little feedback)
Hiring manager and cross-functional panel (stakeholders from adjacent teams), behavioral rounds on cross-functional collaboration

dark-alpha-capital.name: Dark Alpha Capital
dark-alpha-capital.note: Only two Glassdoor reports exist (100% positive, difficulty 3/5): a Boston candidate (April 2026) describes two rounds, the first kind of technical and introductory and the second more character-oriented ('character interview felt more important since you are likely working under your interviewer'); a New York candidate gives no detail. A Handshake posting hosts applications. No stages, durations or timeline were published; ask the recruiter. I did not use pages for Alpha Capital (a different company) or generic quant-fund guides.
dark-alpha-capital.roles: Dark Alpha Capital (emerging proprietary trading and independent-sponsor investment firm; Boston and New York, with remote roles; descriptions vary by posting: systematic, quantitative and event-driven strategies, and lower-middle-market private equity in Industrials, Business Services, Healthcare, Aerospace & Defense and IT). Roles seen on Handshake: Quant Researcher (remote, performance-based pay, reports to the CIO / PM), Quant Developer (designs, tests and implements systematic trading strategies), Private Equity Intern, Sales Operations Analyst, Analyst. No level ladder seen. The postings read like a very small and early-stage firm; check its legitimacy and compensation terms before relying on this.

databricks.name: Databricks
databricks.roles: Software Engineer (backend, fullstack, distributed data systems, AI product), Staff and Senior Staff engineers, Data Engineer, Solutions Architect, Technical Solutions Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Data Scientist, Account Executive. Candidate guides use P1-P4+ style levels (unofficial); postings themselves state no level numbers.
steps: Recruiter screen (~30 min)
Technical phone screen (~1 hr live coding with follow-ups; some teams add a take-home or non-trivial coding assignment)
Hiring manager call (~1 hr)
Virtual onsite (4-5 hrs, roughly 4 interviews): coding, system design around data infrastructure and distributed systems, CS fundamentals (OS, networking, database internals), behavioral
Reference checks (a formal step), then offer. Candidate guides cite 4-8 weeks; one guide says Databricks itself puts it at 2-3 months.

datadog.name: Datadog
datadog.roles: Software Engineer (SWE I, II), Senior, Staff, Senior Staff and Principal Software Engineer per candidate guides (unofficial), plus internships, Data Engineer, Site Reliability / infrastructure roles. Other families in Glassdoor reports: Account Executive, Enterprise Account Executive, Customer Success Manager, Technical Support Engineer, Solutions Engineer, SDR, Recruiter. Software Engineer and Senior Software Engineer lead the report counts.
steps: Application online or via recruiter
Recruiter call (about 30 min); some candidates say the recruiter helps them prepare for later rounds
Technical phone screen (about 1 hour; coding, data structures and debugging style problems)

Onsite / virtual loop of roughly 4 hours or several interviews: live coding (some reports mention AI-assisted coding), backend system design, project deep dive, hiring manager conversation, values / experience round; team matching calls reported by some candidates
Decision. Guides say roughly 3-8 weeks; one senior report describes seven interviews over about six months, and Glassdoor shows a 90-day average for a small sample (reports vary).

datology.name: Datology
datology.note: Per DatologyAI's own blog post and careers page (company-described, only snippets visible): The company says the whole process can be expedited into a week and that it has given offers before candidates left the office; interviews are meant to feel like a conversation. Candidate reports: PracHub (6 reports) describes software engineer technical screens (January 2026 and September 2026) built around a three-part text editor, then a mock Spark RDD (one candidate blanked on intersect), rated easy to medium; one noted the company raised a Series A and has not raised a Series B.
