Timeline: up to about a week if expedited; otherwise not reported.
datology.roles: Sources are for DatologyAI (data curation for AI training; Redwood City CA, on-site 4-5 days a week, 20-50 people). Roles seen: Research Engineer ($180-300k, senior), Research Scientist and Research Scientist Post-Training, Machine Learning Engineer, Software Engineer (Cloud Infrastructure, Data Infrastructure, Full-Stack, Infrastructure, Training & Inference Infrastructure), Forward Deployed AI Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Product Manager, Customer Success Manager, recruiters. The company says it does not pigeonhole its technical staff; no numeric ladder seen.
steps: Initial conversation
A 60-minute screening interview that reflects the actual work and is explicitly not LeetCode

A set of several technical interviews, a behavioral interview, and (for the Research Scientist role) a research presentation; also lunch with the team and time for your questions, on-site in Redwood City

datologyai.name: DatologyAI
datologyai.roles: Software Engineer (Infrastructure, Data Infrastructure, Cloud Infrastructure, Full-Stack, Frontend, Training and Inference Infrastructure), Machine Learning Engineer, Forward Deployed AI Engineer, Solutions Engineer, plus operations and recruiting roles. Offices are in Redwood City and San Mateo, California, and the company says it works in office most days. No official level codes seen beyond senior-style titles in listings.
steps: Application online or referral
Initial conversation / recruiter step
60-minute screening interview, described by the company as hands-on and reflective of the actual work, not LeetCode (a 2026 candidate report describes a three-part text editor coding task)

Further interviews and a decision; the company says it can expedite the whole process into a week and has made offers before candidates left the office, though it does not publish the later rounds in the snippet seen
Timeline: company says it can be as fast as a week (reports vary; public candidate data is thin).

dave.name: Dave
dave.note: I did not find a candidate-written description of Dave's engineering loop. The only interview report seen is on PracHub (one candidate): a Machine Learning Engineer interview described as a long Python online assessment followed by a live data exercise. A PracHub guide adds general advice for Dave SWE interviews (avoid over-engineering the coding problem, agree on requirements before sketching class hierarchies). Treat the exact stages and timeline as unknown.
dave.roles: Dave Inc. (neobank, Nasdaq: DAVE, Los Angeles, remote). Software Engineer II (Fullstack / Backend), Senior Software Engineer (Backend, Fullstack), Staff Software Engineer (Backend - Risk and Underwriting), Lead Software Engineer (Fullstack, mobile), Engineering Manager (e.g. EC Card), Machine Learning Engineer. Dave's own postings use SWE II / Senior / Staff / Lead titles and ask for roughly 2+ years (SWE II), 4+ years (Senior) or 6+ years with management experience (EM); stack is TypeScript / Node.js.

deca-technologies.name: Deca Technologies
deca-technologies.note: No usable first-hand interview process was found for software engineers at Deca Technologies: only a PracHub page with two sample questions (behavioral / leadership and software-engineering fundamentals). A typical loop for a company this size would be a recruiter screen, a technical interview and a team / hiring-manager conversation, but that is an assumption, not evidence from candidates.
deca-technologies.roles: Software Engineer is the only role seen (a PracHub page lists 2 questions covering behavioral and software-engineering fundamentals). Deca Technologies is a semiconductor advanced-packaging company (Tempe, AZ); other 'Deca' companies (DECA Analytics, DE&S DECA in the UK, Deka Research & Development) appeared in results and were ignored.

decagon.name: Decagon
decagon.roles: Software Engineer (AI-agent / conversational AI platform), AI Engineer / Agentic AI Engineer, Backend Engineer, Research Scientist, Engineering Manager, Agent Software Engineer intern and new grad pipeline. One compensation site labels a mid-level SWE as L5 (unofficial). Sources are mostly software-engineering reports from San Francisco; one older Glassdoor report is from a different company with a similar name (Lagos, 2021) and is ignored.
steps: Recruiter screen (motivation, high-impact work, fit)
Coding phone screen, about 45-60 min, often one practical implementation problem (e.g. shopping cart versioning, CSAT tracker, tic-tac-toe style problems, skyline variation)

Onsite loop of about 4 rounds: AI-assisted / practical coding, system design (one report says it felt more like data modeling), deep dive into a past project, behavioral / culture / values (customer focus, momentum)

Decision. Reports vary: about 3 to 4 weeks, some within about 2 weeks; one Glassdoor reviewer describes 8 interviews in total including two after the onsite and a disorganized process. Reddit-style commentary says it is a hard company to get an interview at.

deshaw.name: Deshaw
deshaw.note: Timeline: guides say often 2-3 months, though other sources say a few weeks or 1-2 weeks for quant analyst; the firm itself says it may take several weeks. Reported pass rate is very low. The firm publishes an interviewing guide PDF (only a snippet was visible, so step details come from candidate sources).
deshaw.roles: Sources are for the D. E. Shaw group. Quantitative Analyst / Quantitative Researcher, Software Developer (one guide says the firm posts no 'Quantitative Developer' title; Software Developer in Quantitative Strategies is the match), Quant Systems / Systems Developer, Developer Experience, Technology Lead, Fundamental Research, Portfolio Manager / systematic trader, and internships (including a PhD intern track). No official level ladder seen.
steps: Application online (rolling review); recruiters route you to a sub-organization
Recruiter screen (about 30 min: background, why D. E. Shaw, target role)
Online assessment for software roles (CodeSignal, 90 min, 4 problems per one guide) or take-home assessment for some quant tracks
Technical phone screen (about 60 min): probability/statistics/maths reasoning for quant roles, coding fundamentals for software roles

Final rounds with multiple interviewers: more technical depth and a deep dive into your resume/background (projects, papers), plus a behavioral/fit round; guides count 4-6 interviews (quant 5, developer 6)
Closing steps: code/writing sample, references and background check, then offer

deutsche-bank.name: Deutsche Bank
deutsche-bank.roles: Software Engineer (Analyst, Associate, AVP, VP, Director per a candidate-guide ladder, unofficial), IT Analyst, Technology Analyst, Technology Data and Innovation (TDI) Analyst, Software Developer, Quantitative Trading Engineer. Glassdoor report volume is dominated by non-engineering banking roles: Analyst (about 249), Intern, Summer Analyst, Associate, Investment Banking Analyst, Vice President, Financial Analyst, KYC Analyst. Software Engineer has about 76-217 reports. Offices: Pune, Bengaluru, Cary / Chapel Hill NC, London, Frankfurt, Paris, others.
steps: Application online, university, recruiter or referral
Online coding test or HackerRank-style assessment (Java-heavy tests in India cycles)
Recruiter / HR screen, sometimes with a short technical conversation

Technical rounds (often 2): Java and Spring Boot, core Java keywords (final, finally, finalize), exceptions, project deep-dive, good coding practices; data-structure and algorithm assessment of about 45 min in some guides
Hiring-manager / fitment / HR round: motivation for joining the bank and the specific tech division, banking-technology awareness; presentations appear in some cycles
Decision. Reports vary: 1 day (campus, Pune) to about 2 months; Glassdoor puts software engineer hiring at about 28 days and the bank overall at 36 days.

digitalocean.name: Digitalocean
digitalocean.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports: Timeline: Glassdoor shows about 23 days company-wide and about 30 days for software engineers; reports vary from 1 day (Hyderabad) to 6 weeks. A TechPrep guide says the process has shifted toward practical, production-oriented evaluation.
digitalocean.roles: Software Engineer (37 Glassdoor reports), Senior Software Engineer (27), Software Engineer II, Senior Software Engineer I and II, Staff Software Engineer (AI/ML, AI Inference Data Plane, Applied Research), identity and access management, billing, key-management, security-products and network/cloud engineers, developer support engineer, cloud support engineer, customer success manager, director. Locations: New York, Seattle/Bellevue, San Francisco, Boston, remote US, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Lahore, Guadalajara. Levels such as SE I, SE II, Senior I/II and Staff are visible in job titles.
steps: Application online, referral or recruiter (one August 2025 report calls the recruiter call unprofessional)
Recruiter / initial discussion

Technical assessment or CoderPad screen: algorithm problems such as a Cheapest-Flights-style graph variant, plus practical questions on SSL, Kubernetes, VM migration between hypervisors with zero downtime, Docker repository fetching

Further technical interviews and system-design / design discussion, a cultural-fit round and a final discussion; engineers report many video interviews because the company is remote friendly; Developer Support roles reported 45-minute rounds over about a month
Offer

discord.name: Discord
discord.note: Timeline: guides say about 3-5 weeks. Reports vary by role and level; Taro pass-rate stats for US/SF software engineer are very low. Discord's own blog post describes its hiring process and how to prepare (only a snippet was visible, so step details come from candidate sources).
discord.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Staff Software Engineer (including systems / applied ML), frontend and front-end infrastructure engineers, mobile and backend engineers, and engineering managers. Level names above are as used in candidate reports; no numeric level ladder was seen.
steps: Resume review
Recruiter or hiring-manager phone screen (background, interests, team fit; some behavioral questions such as a trade-off story)
Technical phone screen / coding assessment; candidates repeatedly mention a practical task such as building a chat server (websocket or multi-client TCP) rather than puzzle questions

Virtual onsite: one senior engineer reported a technical phone screen plus seven interviews, mixing coding, web-service/system design, project deep dive and collaboration/behavioral rounds; interviews are run within Discord itself
Offer: one candidate got the offer about one week after the final round

disney.name: Disney
disney.roles: Software Engineer across Disney Entertainment & ESPN, Disney Streaming, Disney Experiences technology and other units (SWE I, SWE II, Senior, Lead, Principal, Senior Principal per candidate guides, unofficial). The sheet's reports may also cover non-engineering roles across a very broad company (media, parks, corporate); the sources seen here are mostly software engineering.
steps: Application (some units start with a short HireVue video screen with a handful of questions and unlimited redos)
Recruiter call (about 15-30 min)
Technical interview: data structures and algorithms coding, often about 45-60 min; hiring-manager conversation covering background and role in some units
Final panel of roughly 3-4 one-hour interviews: coding, system design for experienced levels, behavioral
Decision. Reports vary a lot by team: about 2-6 weeks per one guide, though another summary mentions anywhere from 6 to 26 weeks. Some candidates report scheduling delays and recruiters going quiet.

distyl.name: Distyl
distyl.note: Per Distyl's own engineering blog, the technical interviews were redesigned for how engineers work today and now integrate AI use; candidate reports and guides describe:
distyl.roles: AI Engineer (including Senior+ and new grad), Software / Backend Engineer on the platform team (a May 2026 report says AI Engineer vs Backend Engineer is decided at the end of the same process), Forward-Deployed Engineer, Frontend Engineer, Research Scientist, AI Strategist, SRE/DevOps, product marketing. Distyl AI is an enterprise-AI company whose founders ran forward-deployed teams at Palantir (per a techinterview.org summary). Seniority is shown only as Senior+ and new grad in reports.
steps: Recruiter conversation / HR screen
Technical introductory call and technical screening (live coding with a systematic debugging process)
Take-home project: a May 2026 Senior+ report describes a Whisper-based streaming take-home

Onsite / virtual loop: system design, a deploy deep dive, and client-facing / FDE-style scenarios that decompose vague business problems; a 1point3acres report calls it a 5-round video interview for a full-time AI engineer; Dataford says 5 rounds over about 4-6 weeks (3-5 weeks for frontend), while Glassdoor shows about 14 days on 4 reports
Decision. Glassdoor ratings are few (4), mixed and average difficulty. Distyl's own posts say what they test and how to prepare (only snippets were visible).

docusign.name: Docusign
docusign.roles: Software Engineer (P1 through P7 per third-party guides: P4 Senior, P5 Lead, P6 Principal; unofficial), Senior and Lead Software Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, Manager Software Engineering, Solutions Engineer. Glassdoor report volume is led by sales-development roles (SDR) with Software Engineer and Senior Software Engineer next.
steps: Application online, referral or recruiter
Recruiter screen (experience and role fit)
Technical screen (coding)

Virtual loop of about four to five interviews: DSA-heavy coding (dynamic programming and graph questions reported), system design (often two design rounds for senior roles), project deep dive, hiring manager / behavioral round

Decision. Guides say about 3-4 weeks, while others report 1-2 months; one Bengaluru senior report describes 4 rounds in about 2 weeks, and some India candidates report poor recruiter communication (reports vary).

doordash.name: DoorDash
doordash.note: About 2-6 weeks overall. Loop emphasizes practical, production-style coding over abstract puzzles.
doordash.roles: Software Engineer ladder E3 (entry), E4, E5 (Senior), E6 (Staff), E7, E8 per candidate guides (unofficial). Also Data Scientist and Product Manager tracks have their own guides.
steps: Recruiter call (~30 min, light on tech)
Technical phone screen (~1 hr, practical applied coding, HackerRank-style at times)
Onsite loop: coding rounds, system design (level dependent), and a ~60 min behavioral round built around mission and values
Team match and leveling discussion, then offer

dropbox.name: Dropbox
dropbox.roles: Software Engineer on an IC ladder (IC1 through IC7 per candidate guides: IC3 mid, IC4 senior, IC5 Staff, IC6 Principal, IC7 Senior Principal; unofficial), Backend Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, Data Engineer, Engineering Manager (M-levels). Reports in the sheet are most likely for software engineering.
steps: Application online or via recruiter
Recruiter call (about 30 min)
Online assessment on CodeSignal (about 1 hour); some data engineer reports mention CodeSignal then deep-dive rounds

Virtual loop, often split into two sets: coding (including a code-review style round), system design, project / deep dive, behavioral with hiring manager; technical questions reported around LeetCode medium difficulty. One report says the onsite was split over two days.
Decision. Guides give about 3-5 weeks; one data engineer report calls the process disorganized with communication gaps (reports vary).

drw.name: DRW
drw.note: Timeline: Glassdoor shows about 4 weeks on average, but reports vary from 1 day (campus) to 2 months.
drw.roles: Trader / quantitative trader (largest share of Glassdoor reports, including junior trader and trader assistant), Software Engineer / developer (often C++ or Python, market data, trading tools, DeFi, Clojure finance roles), Quantitative Researcher, FPGA engineer, trading operations, plus software engineering internships. No official level ladder seen; one third-party site lists L2/L3/L5 engineer levels, which I treat as unofficial and unconfirmed.
steps: Application via careers page or university recruiting

Online assessment: for traders about 60-75 min of mental maths, probability and market-sense questions; for software engineers a coding assessment (HackerRank-style; one guide says around 150 min with 3 coding problems)
Recruiter / phone screen

Technical or trading interviews: probability, statistics, market-making/trading intuition for trader and research tracks; data structures, algorithms, C++ and systems or design questions (e.g. market data feed design) for engineers
Final rounds with multiple interviewers (guides say 5-6 stages in total depending on track; one candidate reported HackerRank plus 7 interviews over about 2 months)
Decision

duolingo.name: Duolingo
duolingo.roles: Software Engineer I, II, Senior, Staff, Senior Staff and Principal ladder per third-party guides (unofficial), plus Android (Kotlin), iOS (Swift), backend and frontend engineers, mobile engineers, interns. Duolingo's own engineering post lists accepted languages by role (Python or Java for general roles, Swift for iOS, Kotlin for Android).
steps: Application online or via recruiter; recruiter screen (about 30 min)
Online coding assessment (CodeSignal) for many candidates
Technical video interview: about 60 minutes of algorithmic coding with a Duolingo engineer on CodeSignal

Virtual onsite of several interviews, as described by Duolingo: pair programming in a codebase similar to production, a whiteboard algorithm interview, a code review (pull request) interview and, in newer loops, an AI-assisted engineering interview; senior roles add system design and a team-member situational interview
Hiring manager / behavioral conversation, then decision. Guides say 6-8 rounds in total; reports describe a fast, feedback-rich process, with pass rates in candidate data being low (reports vary).

dydx.name: dYdX
dydx.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (largest report group), Staff Software Engineer (including Kotlin Multiplatform), Senior Trading Infrastructure Engineer, Senior Software Engineer Developer Infrastructure, Backend Engineer. Reports mostly come from New York with some from Warsaw. dYdX is a crypto derivatives exchange. No official level codes seen beyond title tiers.
steps: Application online, referral or recruiter outreach on LinkedIn
Recruiter phone call

Tech screens: two back-to-back one-hour sessions in one report, LeetCode-style problems or small design problems such as a tic-tac-toe game simulation; a coding interview and a system design interview come before the onsite

Onsite of about one day: system design, a full-day mini project (for example building a microservice) with a presentation at the end, and a leadership interview; one report says candidates were compensated for the onsite
Decision. Reports range from 2 weeks to 2 months; several 2022-2024 candidates ended without an offer, and a Warsaw report criticizes the final interview (reports vary).

earnin.name: Earnin
earnin.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports:
earnin.roles: Software Engineer (28 Glassdoor reports), Senior Software Engineer (14), Staff Software Engineer (including a QAE variant), Full Stack Software Engineer, backend engineer, Senior Mobile Engineer (Android), platform/data engineers, engineering manager and product roles. Locations: Mountain View / Palo Alto CA, Vancouver, Bengaluru, Mexico City, Bangkok, Singapore. Titles shown are SE, Senior and Staff; no numeric ladder seen.
steps: Application online, via LinkedIn or a recruiter
Recruiter phone screen (about 30 min: company walk-through and process explanation)

Hiring manager / engineer conversation mixing behavioral questions, light coding and architecture; technical topics include data structures and algorithms (arrays, strings, hash maps, recursion, grid problems like Number of Islands) and debugging snippets under time pressure
Onsite round: one senior candidate describes a phone screen followed by four one-hour interviews on the same day; other reports describe a short process

Decision. Glassdoor shows about 24 days company-wide and about 30 days for staff roles; reports vary from 1 week to 4 weeks. All four Interview Query reports ended in rejection, and several 2026 reviewers criticise generic rejection messages; EarnIn replies on Glassdoor that it is working on candidate communication. Dataford shows a 20% offer rate for backend engineers.

ease.name: Ease
ease.note: Very thin. Ease's own profile on the Hired marketplace describes its engineering process: step 2 is a choice between a tech project taken at home in any language, or a technical phone screen with an Ease engineer using CoderPad (the other steps were not visible in the snippet). Glassdoor has only a few reports: a 2022 Onboarding Manager candidate had four brief to intermediate Zoom interviews over 5 weeks with different people in the department and no offer; a 2017 Senior Development Engineer applied through a recruiter, no offer, negative experience, easy interview. No timeline for engineering roles was found. Treat this row as very low-confidence and verify the company and process with the recruiter.
ease.roles: AMBIGUOUS COMPANY: the sheet's 'Ease' has no website or identifier. I researched Ease (also seen as Ease.io / EnrollEase; benefits administration and insurance-tech platform, San Francisco and San Diego, described as a 'Stripe for health insurance'), the only software-engineering match in results; please confirm or tell me the real company. Roles seen: Senior Development Engineer (2017), software engineers, an Onboarding Manager (2023). Very little public data; no level ladder.

ebay.name: eBay
ebay.roles: Software Engineer / Software Engineer II / III, Senior Software Engineer, Member of Technical Staff (MTS 1, MTS 2, Senior, Principal and Distinguished MTS in the India/other tracks; candidate guides label SE1-SE3, unofficial), Software Engineer - Observability and backend roles, interns, engineering managers; also Product Manager, Business Analyst, Data Scientist and Customer Service Representative reports.
steps: Application (online or via LinkedIn / recruiter)
Recruiter screening call (~30 min: background, experience, interest)
Technical screen: ~45 min with a senior engineer (LeetCode-medium style data structures, trees / graphs / strings with follow-ups)

Onsite / virtual loop of ~3-4 rounds: coding, system or product-flavored design (e.g. multi-label purchase system with payments), behavioral and product sense; principal-level adds mentorship and roadmap influence
Decision. About 2-4 weeks per one guide; Glassdoor average about 16 days to 4 weeks, with some reports of up to 6 weeks.

eightfoldai.name: Eightfoldai
eightfoldai.note: Candidate sources describe a short, fairly standard loop (Dataford: 4 stages based on 122 reports; Glassdoor average about 30-33 days):
eightfoldai.roles: Eightfold AI (talent intelligence platform, Santa Clara, Bengaluru). Software Engineer (AI Agentic Product Dev team, Data Platform), Senior Software Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer (Senior, Staff), Engineering Manager (ML), Agentic AI Engineer, QA / QA Automation Engineer, Data Engineer, Agentic AI Intern. Levels are not published.
steps: Initial alignment / screening with a recruiter, sometimes an AI-integrated screening tool for basic coding; campus recruiting starts with a CGPA check and resume shortlisting
Phone interview or skills test (Glassdoor: two graph-traversal questions and merging documents by ranking in recent software engineer reports)

Technical deep-dive: Dataford describes 2 rounds, a behavioral screen then a technical deep dive including system design (e.g. scalable notification delivery); a Jul 2026 PracHub report mentions an AI-assisted coding round and a take-home; an Engineering Manager ML candidate reports a Director meeting, an agentic coding round and an ML system design round
Decision. Glassdoor reports range from easy to average difficulty; one 2022 candidate says it took 4 weeks.

elastic.name: Elastic
elastic.roles: Software Engineer (I, II, Platform, Senior, Principal), Senior JavaScript / Software Engineer (React, TypeScript, Node), AI Engineer, Cloud Engineer, Support Engineer, Solutions Architect. Glassdoor report volume is led by sales: Account Executive (about 64) and Sales Development Representative (about 46), then Senior Software Engineer (about 37), Software Engineer (about 36) and Support Engineer (about 36). Elastic is a distributed (remote-first) company with engineers in Amsterdam, Warsaw, Toronto, Atlanta, Seattle and elsewhere.
steps: Application online or employee referral
Recruiter / technical recruiter call on background and technologies used
Hiring-manager call

Practical coding: a take-home or live coding in JavaScript / Java, or a live pull-request review where you find functional issues in a small codebase; fixing or refactoring React components and Express endpoints is reported; interviews lean on practical coding over algorithm puzzles

Technical interviews, often with principal engineers: system design of a project you worked on, TypeScript questions (e.g. generics), platform topics (e.g. ArgoCD workflows), followed by a behavioral / values round and sometimes a final interview
Decision. Reports vary: about 1-6 weeks, with Glassdoor putting SWE hiring at about 28-30 days; process is fully remote. Taro stats (39 SWE reports) show a pass rate of roughly 41%.

electronic-arts.name: Electronic Arts
electronic-arts.roles: Software Engineer (Associate SE, SE 1, SE 2, SE 3, Senior SE 1 and 2, Principal SE per a third-party guide; the SE-number style also shows in Glassdoor titles like Software Engineer II, unofficial for exact mapping), Software Developer, game engine / C++ engineers. Reports come from Redwood City, Vancouver, Kitchener, Madrid and other studios; process varies by team.
steps: Application online or recruiter outreach
HR / recruiter screening call (background and a structured explanation of the stages)
Hiring manager interview (reported as a conversation about experience and projects)
Technical rounds: C++ fundamentals, project deep dives, data structures and algorithms (one report: two DSA rounds ending in rejection), design questions for senior levels
Panel with team members, team manager and a senior engineer; behavioral questions (challenging project, disagreement with a colleague)
Decision. Guides say about 3-5 weeks over 4-6 stages; Glassdoor samples range from about 4 weeks to 60-90 days (reports vary).

elevenlabs.name: Elevenlabs
elevenlabs.note: A PracHub guide says ElevenLabs states that its process varies by role; from candidate and guide sources, the software engineer path is fast and product-focused, about 2-5 weeks:
elevenlabs.roles: ElevenLabs (AI voice and audio). Software Engineer (product engineering, real-time audio streaming, distributed systems; London, Warsaw, Germany and remote), Senior Software Engineer, Full-Stack and Frontend Engineer, Mobile Engineer, Software Engineer (SEO), Solutions Engineer and Solutions Architect. Levels are not published.
steps: Recruiter conversation (salary expectations and notice period come up in some reports)

Online screening / online assessment (practical coding on CoderPad or similar: 2D matrix and state-simulation problems; a senior candidate in Germany was asked to build a small React app calling a voice API)
Live technical rounds on practical coding based on real product features, and a 'product decomposition' round that mixes system design with product/UI thinking (Exponent highlights it as unusual)

Final conversations focused on autonomy, shipping end-to-end and results, then decision. Glassdoor and Taro reports range from 2 weeks to about 2 months, with several negative and 'disorganized' experiences and very low pass-rate samples.

eliseai.name: EliseAI
eliseai.note: Candidate sources describe about 3-5 rounds over roughly 3-5 weeks (2-3 weeks for fast tracks; Glassdoor reports range from 3 days to 2 months):
eliseai.roles: EliseAI (conversational AI for housing and healthcare, New York). Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Data Engineer, Solutions Engineer; Glassdoor volume also includes Account Executive, SDR, Sales, Customer Success, AI Ops Specialist, Recruiter and Strategy & Operations roles. Levels are not published.
steps: Recruiter call (some candidates are approached on LinkedIn), then a 30 min intro interview with technical and behavioral questions or a conversation with the head of engineering
Live technical assessment of about 2 hours (coding challenge, reading and explaining what a JavaScript function does)
System design (e.g. designing a set of voice agents), then final team and behavioral interviews
Decision. Taro shows a very low pass rate for senior engineers (about 9% of 11 reports) and mostly negative experiences, though Glassdoor SE ratings are positive.

enigma.name: Enigma
enigma.note: Per Interview Query / Dataford guides and Glassdoor (reports mostly from 2017-2020, with a few 2023-2025):
enigma.roles: AMBIGUOUS COMPANY: the sheet's 'Enigma' has no website. Several companies use the name (Enigma Technologies, the New York business-data company; Enigma Aerospace; Enzigma; others). As a best guess I researched Enigma Technologies (data on businesses for financial services, New York) because most software engineer and ML interview reports match it; please confirm or tell me the real company. Roles seen: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (Data Product), Staff Software Engineer, Senior and Staff ML Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, Data Engineer, Data Scientist, Product Analyst. No numeric ladder seen beyond Senior/Staff.
steps: Initial HR / recruiter screening call (about 30 min)
Technical phone interview (Dataford lists 4 rounds over about 3-5 weeks for ML engineers): algorithms, data structures, data processing
Technical on-site or virtual interviews with engineers and a team/culture conversation

Decision. Glassdoor shows software engineer roles averaging about 35 days (data engineer about 5 days); several candidates describe a slow, frustrating process or going radio silent after hours of interviews, with a 2017 candidate saying the company admitted the process was not good.

envoy.name: Envoy
envoy.roles: Software Engineer (largest group), Full-Stack Web Developer, Mobile Software Engineer, Engineering Manager, Member of Technical Staff, Solutions Engineer. The sheet links envoy.com (Envoy, the workplace and visitor management company in San Francisco); search results also mixed in Envoy Global (immigration software) and older Envoy mobile app agency reports, which were not treated as the same company. No official level codes seen.
steps: Application online or recruiter outreach on LinkedIn
Recruiter screening call (about 30 min)
SQL assessment on CoderPad and/or a technical phone screen (LeetCode-easy style questions reported by an employee)
Several interview rounds / onsite: straightforward technical interviews, a presentation requiring prep work and consulting ability for some roles, and behavioral questions
Decision. Reports range from 1 week to 4 weeks, with some candidates reporting no word for months after the onsite (reports vary).

epic.name: Epic
epic.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports (2018-2026) and guides:
epic.roles: Sources are for Epic Games (per your sheet's epicgames.com). Software Engineer (Cary NC, Raleigh, Vancouver BC, New York, Philadelphia, Montréal), Senior Software Engineer (Raleigh, Philadelphia; AWS-flavoured roles), Software Engineer / Software Developer internships, mobile engineer and build/release engineer. No official level ladder seen beyond titles.
steps: Application online, LinkedIn or recruiter; some candidates start with a screening test advertised as about 4 hours (a 2020 Canada report) that includes algorithm questions
Recruiter / HR-style screening (30 min): your background, relevant technical experience, 'Why Epic?', 'describe an initiative you led'; a screen call on Google Meet in Vancouver (2025)

Hiring-manager or team call with two engineers (mix of technical and behavioral) and technical rounds: palindrome-style questions, array navigation, data structures, APIs/AWS experience for senior roles; TechPrep says the loop is heavily C++ focused for engine-side roles
Onsite or final loop; one Raleigh candidate got the offer 3 days after the onsite

Decision. Timeline: TechPrep says about 2-4 weeks across four stages; reports vary from 1 day to 2 months; Taro shows 0% pass rate on 8 U.S. software-engineer reports and 5 Canada reports. Several 2024-2026 candidates describe the process as unprofessional or very slow, and some interns report an NDA on questions.

epic-systems.name: Epic Systems
epic-systems.roles: Software Developer (the main engineering role; Epic does not use the title Software Engineer much), Junior Software Developer, Software Developer Intern, plus Technical Solutions Engineer, Technical Services, Quality Assurance, Project Manager and implementation roles that dominate Glassdoor counts. Most developer reports are for the Verona and Madison, Wisconsin campuses.
steps: Application online with transcript, via university job board or recruiter outreach
Phone / HR screen with a software developer (behavioral questions, describe a project, why Epic)

Online assessment: demanding, multi-hour (about 3 hours or longer in several reports), screen-recorded with coding problems where optimal running time matters; some candidates describe oral assessments with 4-5 questions

Virtual or onsite interviews: a developer talk and casual conversation, a one-on-one case study to walk through a problem, a project discussion with another developer (older onsite reports include dinner the day before and a campus tour), plus coding interviews in newer reports

Decision. Glassdoor shows about 14 days on average for software developers, while reports range from 1 week to 4 weeks and some describe a very long process; Taro shows low pass rates in a large US sample (reports vary).

equinix.name: Equinix
equinix.note: Interview Query summarises 7 candidate reports as conversational and experience-driven rather than an algorithm gauntlet (4-5 rounds); TechPrep puts it at 3-5 rounds over about 4 weeks (Glassdoor average about 33 days company-wide, 14 days for one Senior Associate report):
equinix.roles: Equinix (data centers and interconnection). Software Engineer (also Associate / Senior Associate Software Engineer, Senior and Staff Software Engineer), Java Developer, AI Platform Engineer, Agentic AI Engineer, Network Engineer, Software Engineer Intern; Glassdoor volume also includes IBX Technician, Project Manager and Senior Account Executive roles. Levels are not published beyond these titles.
steps: Recruiter conversation, then a hiring-manager conversation (domain questions on networking, routers and the OSI model appear for some teams)
Project-focused technical discussions: architecture of a project you built, Java concurrency, OOP, system design for mid-level and senior roles; a few reports mention Go or a presentation round

Further rounds with team members (a 2022 San Diego candidate reports no coding), then salary discussion and decision. Older reports describe 5 technical rounds plus a phone interview over about 5 days to 4 weeks.

ericsson.name: Ericsson
ericsson.note: Interview Query (35 reports) says candidates describe a conversational process more than an algorithm-heavy one, with resume depth the most repeated theme: an HR screen, a technical round on fundamentals and projects, and a manager conversation, sometimes with an online assessment; about 3-4 rounds over 1-4 weeks. TechPrep gives 4-5 stages over 3-4 weeks. Candidate reports add:
ericsson.roles: Ericsson (telecom networks; Stockholm, Gothenburg, Karlskrona, Budapest, Galway, Athlone, Bengaluru, Plano / Lewisville TX, Montreal, Ottawa). Software Engineer / Software Developer, Senior Software Engineer, Junior and New Graduate Software Engineer / Software Developer 1, Software Development Engineer (SDE, campus), Baseband Software Developer, Principal Modem Engineer, Integration Engineer, Network Engineer, Solutions Architect, Customer Project Manager and interns. Glassdoor volume is huge across many role families. Levels are not a single public ladder.
steps: HR / recruiter screen (location preferences, 'why Ericsson')

Online test or skills / IQ / personality test for some tracks (17% of Glassdoor software engineer reports each); campus SDE: three interviews (hiring manager, senior software engineer, HR) with a LeetCode-medium style technical round, DSA and OOP questions
Technical interview on programming languages, databases, Docker and VMs, Angular and OOP for web teams, and a group panel or presentation for graduates
Manager / final conversation, then offer. Glassdoor average about 14 days for software engineers (22 days company-wide); some European reports run 4 weeks to 4 months.

etsy.name: Etsy
etsy.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports: Timeline: guides say about 3-6 weeks (3-5 weeks in one guide); reports vary from about 2 days / 1 week to 2-3 months. Fellowship and some intern processes were done in a single day. Taro pass-rate stats range from about 10% to 36% depending on role and city.
etsy.roles: Software Engineer (largest share of Glassdoor reports), Senior Software Engineer, Staff Software Engineer, Software Engineer II, software engineering interns and fellowship, plus product manager, data scientist, product designer, engineering manager, machine learning engineer and program manager. Locations in reports: Brooklyn NY, Dublin, Mexico City / Guadalajara. No official level ladder seen.
steps: Application online, via recruiter or referral
Recruiter / HR screen or online assessment (15-30 min)

Phone / initial technical interview with a collaborative or practical coding exercise (an open-book style; tasks like building a priority queue, debugging a Flask app, editing a React app, or prefix search in a word list), sometimes in a special IDE on a shared project

Onsite / virtual onsite of about 3-7 rounds depending on level: practical coding or debugging in the team's stack, system design (senior and above, e.g. a marketplace search ranker), behavioral conversations, and for some processes a separate team-matching stage
Offer

evenup.name: EvenUp
evenup.note: Candidate reports differ a lot between candidates and teams (Glassdoor average is about 18 days for developers; some call it long and inconsistent):
evenup.roles: EvenUp (AI for personal-injury legal claims). Software Engineer (AI document generation, builders, backend for cases product, frontend), Senior Software Engineer, Senior AI / Machine Learning Engineer, New Grad Software Engineer, Solutions Architect; Glassdoor volume is dominated by Legal Operations Associate and sales roles. Levels are not published.
steps: Recruiter conversation, then a hiring-manager call

Technical stage varies: LeetCode-medium style round on CoderPad (45 min, e.g. graph traversal), a React build, system design (e.g. stream processing, 45 min), or a take-home; new-grad candidates report an online assessment on Canditech
A 'superday' of about 2 hours (a 30 min talk followed by LeetCode-style interviews) in some reports, plus cross-functional and PM behavioral conversations (~30 min each)
Decision. A Senior AI Engineer candidate reports six rounds with a request for a seventh; one report says compensation is not discussed until after five rounds. Taro shows 0 of 3 senior SWE passes.

exa.name: Exa
exa.roles: Software Engineer (Full Stack, Backend), Full Stack Engineer (Agentic Search team), Web Crawler Engineer, Research Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer. Exa (exa.ai, formerly Metaphor Systems) builds a search engine / API for AI agents; San Francisco and Singapore. Note: 'EXA AG' (a different company) also showed up and was ignored.
steps: Application online or via recruiter
Short technical screen (a 15-minute rapid-fire call on basic math, probability and scalable system design in one report; two phone screens for a research engineer, including a 40-minute derivation)
Take-home project or practical building task; per techinterview.org, practical building counts for more than interview theater
Paid working trial / onsite day in San Francisco instead of a whiteboard-only final (per techinterview.org)

Decision. Process is short: about 1-2 weeks from first contact to a decision per techinterview.org; Glassdoor shows about 11 days on average across a handful of reports. Reports are very few and mostly negative or no offer (Taro: Web Crawler Engineer 2026 negative with no offer).

exoduspoint.name: Exoduspoint
exoduspoint.note: ExodusPoint does not publish its hiring process, and because hiring often runs through headhunters at team (pod) level the experience varies (Quantt's guide, from candidate reports). Developer and quant path per Glassdoor reports:
exoduspoint.roles: ExodusPoint Capital Management (multi-strategy hedge fund founded 2017 by Michael Gelband; pod model; New York, London, Hong Kong, Singapore). Roles seen on its Greenhouse board and job sites: Software Developer / Software Engineer (Cloud Data Platform), Risk Developer, Data Engineer, Quantitative Researcher / Junior Quantitative Researcher, Junior Quantitative Modeler (C++/Python quant analytics library), Software Developer Intern (AI team), Quantitative Modeling intern, Portfolio Manager and analyst roles. Glassdoor volume: Analyst (12), Quant Researcher (4), Software Developer (4), Data Engineer (3), interns. No numeric ladder; entry routes are internships and junior roles.
steps: Application online, recruiter or headhunter; a quantitative researcher (2023) reports HackerRank at LeetCode-medium level

Online assessment or algorithms screen (Risk Developer reports: initial online assessment, then an interview with the tech lead; basic DSU-style algorithm questions with simulations; merge sort and insertion sort; two algorithms rounds for a New York 2025 developer via recruiter)
Two to four technical rounds, then a final round with the portfolio manager and a business-development / HR round (Quantitative Researcher report; the process 'concludes within 4-8 weeks')

Decision. Timeline: Glassdoor shows one report with about 120 days, while others say 4-8 weeks; several developer reports are no-offer with poor interviewer conduct noted (a late, multitasking tech lead). Treat as indicative; confirm with the recruiter.

expedia.name: Expedia
expedia.roles: Software Engineer / Software Development Engineer (SDE I, II, Senior), Software Engineer intern, Data Scientist, Product Manager, Manager / Senior Manager / Director. Glassdoor report volume is large for non-engineering roles too: Market Associate / Associate Market Manager, Lodging Partner Associate and Account Manager appear near the top alongside Software Engineer. Sources are for Expedia Group.
steps: Application online, referral, campus recruiting or staffing agency
Online coding assessment (some reports mention a coding challenge first)
Recruiter screen / phone interview: resume basics, why Expedia, SDE fundamentals
Technical phone screen: live coding with an engineer on CoderPad or similar, 1-2 problems (LeetCode-style: intervals, missing positive integer, trapping rain water)
Virtual onsite of several boards / rounds: more coding, system design (a URL shortener is commonly reported), project deep-dive and values-based behavioral questions
Decision. Reports vary: about 3-4 weeks per one guide, 4-8 weeks per another, and Glassdoor shows overall hiring at roughly 33-47 days.

experian.name: Experian
experian.note: Varies by team and country; Glassdoor average is about 21 days for engineers (25 company-wide):
experian.roles: Software Engineer, Senior and Staff Software Engineer (React/TypeScript, .NET, Java), Graduate Software Engineer / Developer (UK, Nottingham, London), Associate Software Engineer (India, San Jose), Lead Software Engineer, Data Platform Engineer, plus Project Manager, Product Manager, Account Manager, Customer Service Representative and Analyst reports.
steps: Application, then a timed online assessment (Codility, or SHL / situational judgement tests for graduates)
One-way video interview (HireVue style) with timed questions

Phone / recruiter screen, then a technical conversation with a manager or lead developer on past projects, Java or JavaScript fundamentals and design; some teams give a take-home coding test with a time limit or a live full-stack coding session

Graduate route: online assessment centre (about 9am-3pm) with a group task, technical interview and competency interview, then decision. About 3-4 weeks for experienced roles, 2+ months for graduates.

ey.name: EY
ey.note: Graduate / technology consulting path per candidate reports: Experienced hires: screening call, then service-line and partner-led interviews. Timeline: reports vary a lot, from 3 days to about 5 weeks for individual cases, and Glassdoor shows about 47 days company-wide and about 97 days for Graduate Technology Consultant. Audit, tax and other service lines were not researched here.
ey.roles: Big Four professional-services firm. Glassdoor interview volume is led by auditor, senior associate, associate consultant and staff accountant roles; the technology-side reports I saw are Graduate Technology Consultant, Technology Consultant Intern, Technology Risk Graduate, Graduate Consultant and 'Tech Consultant' roles, with country-specific graduate programmes (UK, Ireland, Australia, Singapore, US). Typical career titles in reports: Staff/Associate, Senior Associate/Senior Consultant, and above; no engineering-style level ladder seen.
steps: Online application (CV and questions) through the careers site
Online assessments / personality or aptitude test, depending on country and service line
One-way video interview
Assessment centre or virtual assessment day: group exercise, case study (one candidate warned of a sudden change in the case), presentation, and one-on-one interviews
Final interview with a senior leader or partner, mostly behavioral/motivation questions ('why EY', 'why this service line') and not very technical
Offer

f5networks.name: F5Networks
f5networks.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports and Interview Query's guide: Timeline: Glassdoor shows about 52 days for software engineer roles (15 reports) versus 27 days company-wide; reports range from 1 day (campus) to 4 weeks, and Interview Query notes some processes stretching over several months. Glassdoor rates difficulty 3.2/5 with 40% positive for software engineers; several candidates describe the process as disorganized or say they got no response after all rounds. Taro pass rate in Hyderabad is about 14% on 7 reports.
f5networks.roles: Software Engineer (about 148 Glassdoor reports), Senior Software Engineer (about 103), Principal Software Engineer (about 39), Software Engineer I / II / III (about 6 / 39 / 33), Software Engineer internships, Network Support Engineer (about 34), Enterprise Network Engineer, Test Engineer, Manager and Director, plus sales and account roles. Sites: Seattle, San Jose, Hyderabad, Chennai, Bristol, Bengaluru, Spokane. F5 uses numbered software engineer levels (SE I, II, III, Senior, Principal) visible in job titles.
steps: Application online, referral, recruiter (LinkedIn outreach), or university; campus drives in India use a coding test of two LeetCode-style questions plus a few multiple-choice questions
Phone screen with a hiring manager or recruiter about current work, sometimes with one algorithmic question

Technical rounds: C/C++, data structures and algorithms (medium), operating systems (processes, threads), networking fundamentals (DNS, load balancing, how a server responds to a load balancer), REST, Docker/containerization, and for some roles SIEM tools; whiteboard or paper-based coding on site in older reports
Multiple back-to-back interviews (older Seattle reports describe up to 8 one-on-one interviews; an Hyderabad report lists 5 rounds: 2 technical, 1 managerial, 1 cultural fitment, 1 HR), then offer

faire.name: Faire
faire.roles: Software Engineer (E2 through E7 levels per a candidate-guide site, unofficial), Backend Engineer, Fullstack Software Engineer, Mobile Engineer, Software Developer, Senior Software Engineering Manager. Wholesale-marketplace company; offices in San Francisco, Toronto, Kitchener-Waterloo, with remote roles.
steps: Application online or recruiter
30-min HR call on the company, your experience and the position you want
CodeSignal assessment (first step in some 2024 cycles)
Technical rounds: two coding rounds (LeetCode-style such as longest substring with unique characters, practical pair-programming flavor), about 1-hour technical interviews plus a 30-min behavioral
Onsite for some candidates: coding, system design and behavioral (a 1point3acres onsite report exists, details behind a login)

Decision. Reports vary: about 1-2 weeks; Glassdoor says Faire's overall process takes about 16 days. Taro shows mixed pass rates in small samples (0% in several Canadian samples, 100% in a few single reports), and a Sept 2026 senior candidate reports a negative experience.

falconx.name: FalconX
falconx.roles: Software Engineer (Software Engineer 1 level appears in a NYC listing), Senior Software Engineer (including Transfer Networks), Senior Front End Engineer, Python Engineer, Trading Systems Engineer (5+ years), Senior DevOps Engineer, Security Engineer. FalconX is a crypto prime brokerage with New York, San Mateo and Bengaluru engineering. No official level codes beyond the SE 1 mention.
steps: Application online or via recruiter
Recruiter screen

Online assessment or DSA round on the company's coding platform (examples: Daily Temperatures from LeetCode, a trade-log window problem), then technical phone interviews (scripting and AWS for DevOps, React on-screen round for frontend)
Panels and a take-home project (a front-end take-home that took real time in a 2025 report), plus 4-5 behavioral rounds in one report

Decision. Glassdoor shows about 8 days on average across a few reports; individual reports range from 1 day to about 4 weeks, with a 2021 Bengaluru candidate saying it took a month, and some candidates describing chaotic priorities and ghosting (reports vary).

fanatics.name: Fanatics
fanatics.roles: Software Engineer (largest group, about 65 Glassdoor reports), Senior Software Engineer (about 35), Senior SDET, Data Engineer. Glassdoor volume is dominated by non-engineering roles: Warehouse Associate, Sales Associate, Customer Service Representative, Retail Sales Associate, Buyer, Graphic Designer. Offices: New York, San Mateo, Dublin, Hyderabad.
steps: Application online or employee referral
Recruiter screen (some candidates report casual outreach emails that omit the role name; salary expectations are often asked early)

Technical screen / live coding round: LeetCode-style trees, graphs, strings and hashmaps (a BFS question similar to Word Ladder reported in Dublin; plot points on a graph in another); SDET roles get Selenium and Java testing questions

Additional rounds depending on site: two back-to-back behavioral interviews, a culture interview, a manager interview, and an in-person system design interview (Dublin); a Hyderabad senior cycle had 5 rounds (two DSA rounds, then domain and design)

Decision. Reports vary: about 3-4 weeks in most, up to 2 months in one SDET report, and 5-6 days in an older onsite. Dublin 2026 candidates describe negative experiences with no offers, while a July 2026 New York senior candidate describes a well-organized process and an accepted offer.

fannie-mae.name: Fannie Mae
fannie-mae.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports: Timeline: reports vary, about 1-4 weeks, with one campus case taking 2 months. Some candidates received canned rejection emails after a scheduling step; newer Dataford reports describe a fairly light, professional process.
fannie-mae.roles: Software Engineer, Software Engineer II, Software Engineer Associate / Associate Software Engineer (early career), Full Stack Developer, Python developers, plus many non-engineering and finance roles. Locations in reports: Reston VA, Washington DC, Plano TX, College Park MD. Title ladder (Associate, SE, SE II, Senior) seen only in report titles, not an official ladder.
steps: Application online, via recruiter, staffing agency or campus career fair
Recruiter intro call (describes the role, asks for resume, schedules screen)

Initial technical interview: video or phone, concept questions (OOP's four concepts, Java and Angular, compiled vs interpreted languages), a Python technical interview for associate roles, and a simple coding exercise such as palindrome or string reversal typed into chat

Final interviews: often several back-to-back 30-minute interviews with engineering managers and engineers on the same day, heavily technical or grounded in your resume; behavioral questions about group experience and a challenge; campus hires also get a meet-and-greet
Offer

fetch-rewards.name: Fetch Rewards
fetch-rewards.roles: Software Engineer, Backend Engineer (largest group, about 26 reports), Frontend Engineer, Android / iOS Engineer, Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, ML Engineer, Data Scientist, Backend Apprentice, SDET, Product Manager. Glassdoor volume also includes Fraud Analyst, Support Specialist and Sales roles. Sources are for Fetch (Fetch Rewards); offices: Madison WI, Birmingham AL, Chicago and remote.
steps: Application online or recruiter outreach

Take-home project, often sent first with no recruiter call (build an API or small app in a language of your choice; commercial-quality code with separated logic and unit tests is advised; sizes range from about a day to 30-40 hours for analytics roles)
Engineer interview or Zoom on the take-home: design decisions and tradeoffs; data roles add a SQL challenge and architecture review
Short HR conversation
Final onsite / superday about the product (redesigning parts of the Fetch app on a smaller scale; reverse-engineering the app is advised)
Decision. Reports vary: about 1-6 weeks in most, though a 2025 candidate reports 11 months; reviews call it fair but a heavy time investment with inconsistent communication.

fidelity.name: Fidelity
fidelity.note: Timeline: reports vary, from about 3 days (referral, Bengaluru) to 2 months; Glassdoor shows about 34 days on average. Several candidates report silence or ghosting after screens.
fidelity.roles: Sources are for Fidelity Investments. Engineering reports cover Software Engineer / Software Developer, Associate Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Lead Software Engineer / Lead Engineering, Principal Software Engineer, internships, with sites in Boston, Westlake and Dallas TX, Durham/Raleigh NC, Galway, Bengaluru and Chennai. Titles are as used in candidate reports; no official numeric levels seen. Non-engineering roles (advisors, operations, investments) were not researched.
steps: Application online, referral, staffing agency or campus; campus hiring may include online aptitude and coding assessments
Recruiter / HR screen (15-30 min; background, role fit, expectations)
Technical or hiring-manager round: resume and project deep dive, Java/OOP fundamentals, SQL, SDLC, and an approachable DSA problem; some candidates report a short video call with an engineer

Further technical rounds, often two back-to-back 1-hour sessions with senior/principal engineers for senior roles: live coding, sometimes system design (for example a video streaming platform); Lead roles reported four rounds (two tech, manager, HR); a final leadership round appears for some
Offer

figma.name: Figma
figma.note: One guide says Figma shares a written guide to its hiring process with candidates. Timeline: reports vary, roughly 2-6 weeks (about 3-4 weeks is common). Candidate pass-rate stats on Taro are low (around 16% for US SWE).
figma.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (including infrastructure and frontend tracks), and Software Engineering Manager appear in reports. Levels not given in the sources seen. Glassdoor interview volume also covers account executives/account managers, product support, product designers, data scientists and recruiters.
steps: Recruiter screen (about 30 min)
Hiring manager call (about 45 min) in some reports
Technical/coding screen (about 1 hour), practical and product-flavoured rather than puzzle-like; one candidate found it long and harder than expected
Onsite loop of about 5 rounds: 2 coding, 1 system design, a project/technical deep-dive, and a culture/behavioral round (values are emphasized)
Reference check, then decision

figure.name: Figure
figure.note: A techinterview.org summary says Figure has not published its interview process, and the loop depends on which of the three role families you apply to. Candidate sources describe (DesignGurus: four to five steps, decision in about two weeks; TechPrep: 3-5 weeks): Figure acts fast (a Taro candidate got a reply within a week); Taro reports 'extremely selective' outcomes for perception roles. Glassdoor puts the average process at about 14 days.
figure.roles: Figure AI (humanoid robotics, San Jose CA; not the fintech Figure). Software Engineer families per a techinterview.org guide: Robotics and controls (Reinforcement Learning Engineer, Whole Body Control, State Estimation, Systems Integration), Platform and integration software (Senior Software Engineer Middleware Productivity, Software Engineer Service and Operations, Software Integration Engineer: C++, real-time systems, fleet tooling), and Applied ML / Helix (Helix AI Engineer: Perception, Backend, Localization and Mapping, Training Performance, iOS, Staff AI Inference and Acceleration). Also robot technicians (Spartanburg SC) and Perception Engineers. Levels are not published.
steps: Recruiter screen (~30 min on background, motivation, logistics); some candidates talk directly to an engineer first
Technical phone screen (queues and sliding-window style coding problems; one Glassdoor report was a purely conversational engineer chat with no technical questions)
System design with a robotics-infrastructure focus (real-time behavior, failure diagnosis, hardware-software integration constraints) rather than generic web services
Hiring-manager conversation, a case-study presentation in some loops, and a final conversation with leadership

figureai.name: Figureai
figureai.roles: Software Engineer, Software Integration Engineer (C++, real-time, hardware-software integration), Senior Software Engineer (middleware productivity), Software Engineer (service and operations), perception engineer, robotics engineer, AI engineer (Helix robot-learning track), data engineer, plus hardware roles. Offices: San Jose and Sunnyvale CA. No official level ladder seen.
steps: Application online or via employee referral (some candidates get no recruiter call and go straight to an engineer)

Phone / technical screen with an engineer, often conversational: past work and project deep dive, data-pipeline design ideas, why Figure AI; some reports mention a LeetCode-style question dressed up as non-LeetCode
Technical rounds and a system-design / architectural case: hardware-software integration, real-time constraints and failure diagnosis, ETL/data pipeline design for AI workloads
Final round or case-study presentation; guides describe 4-5 steps with cross-functional and culture-fit focus

Decision. Guides say about 2 weeks (designgurus) to 3-5 weeks (TechPrep); Glassdoor and Taro reports vary from 1 week to 2 weeks, with several describing the process as disorganized or fast-moving; Taro shows a 0% pass rate on two software engineer reports.

fireworks.name: Fireworks
fireworks.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports and DesignGurus: Timeline: DesignGurus says about 3 weeks from application to decision and about 5 weeks for software engineers; Glassdoor reports range from 3 days to 4 weeks. Taro shows a 0% pass rate across 5 U.S. software engineer reports, and some solutions-architect candidates received only a take-home.
fireworks.roles: Fireworks AI (inference platform for open models; Redwood City / San Mateo CA, San Francisco, New York; about 180 people). Roles seen: Software Engineer, Software Engineer AI Infrastructure, Machine Learning Engineer, Solutions Architect, AI Field Engineer, People Operations. I did not use pages about Firework (a different short-video company). No numeric ladder seen.
steps: Application online, via recruiter or staffing agency (one CTO interview reported on Taro)

Recruiter call, then a technical phone screen: about 45 minutes (about 30 minutes coding, 10 minutes technical questions, 5 minutes for yours), C++ pointers / pass-by-reference for some roles, and in an October 2026 report an AI-allowed screen on detecting attacks in logs
Take-home project for some candidates: build a simple AI chat playground (a ChatGPT-style interface) using Fireworks models

Onsite of four to seven interviews depending on role: LeetCode-style panel questions, one or two system design rounds based on the company's own product, and AI-assisted coding for ML engineers (September 2026)

fireworks-ai.name: Fireworks Ai
fireworks-ai.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports and DesignGurus: Timeline: DesignGurus says about 3 weeks from application to decision and about 5 weeks for software engineers; Glassdoor reports range from 3 days to 4 weeks. Taro shows a 0% pass rate across 5 U.S. software engineer reports, and some solutions-architect candidates received only a take-home.
fireworks-ai.roles: Fireworks AI (inference platform for open models; Redwood City / San Mateo CA, San Francisco, New York; about 180 people). Roles seen: Software Engineer, Software Engineer AI Infrastructure, Machine Learning Engineer, Solutions Architect, AI Field Engineer, People Operations. I did not use pages about Firework (a different short-video company). No numeric ladder seen.
steps: Application online, via recruiter or staffing agency (one CTO interview reported on Taro)

Recruiter call, then a technical phone screen: about 45 minutes (about 30 minutes coding, 10 minutes technical questions, 5 minutes for yours), C++ pointers / pass-by-reference for some roles, and in an October 2026 report an AI-allowed screen on detecting attacks in logs
Take-home project for some candidates: build a simple AI chat playground (a ChatGPT-style interface) using Fireworks models

Onsite of four to seven interviews depending on role: LeetCode-style panel questions, one or two system design rounds based on the company's own product, and AI-assisted coding for ML engineers (September 2026)

first-american.name: First American
first-american.note: Per guides (CleverPrep, Dataford, Interview Query, Scoutify; mostly generic, not many first-hand reports): Timeline: guides say about 2-5 weeks across 2-4 rounds; one Glassdoor candidate in March 2026 reports 4 weeks. CleverPrep rates the process relatively easy (2.57/5) for senior engineers. Candidate reports are few, so treat details as indicative.
first-american.roles: Sources are for First American Financial Corporation (title and settlement insurance, Santa Ana CA). Engineering roles seen on its careers site and in guides: Senior Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer II, Full Stack Senior Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer - AI Platform, Senior ServiceNow and SailPoint Software Engineers, Sr Software Engineer Security Enablement, Sr Data Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, Cloud DevOps Engineer, Software Engineering Manager, plus data scientists and product roles. Postings ask for 5+ years for senior roles; no numeric ladder seen.
steps: Application on First American's careers site (careers.firstam.com)
Recruiter phone screen (about 20-30 min: background, role, logistics)
Technical assessment or aptitude/coding test (for ML engineers: data structures and ML concepts), or technical interview of about 45-60 min

Hiring-manager technical interview (system design such as processing and storing title documents at scale, behavioral questions on collaboration and 'People First' culture), then HR final interview (about 30 min: career goals, team fit, compensation)

five-rings.name: Five Rings
five-rings.roles: Software Developer (C++ on Linux; campus full-time and intern tracks), Software Engineer, Software Developer Intern, plus Quantitative Trader, Quantitative Researcher and Trading Intern tracks. Five Rings Capital is a proprietary trading firm with offices in New York, Boca Raton, London and Amsterdam (older reports also cite Nashville). No official level codes seen; new hires work closely with senior engineers, traders and quants.
steps: Application online, via university or recruiter

HR / recruiter screen and an online assessment for software developers (candidates report a short process: HR screen, an OA, then a 1-hour technical final round where the OA is debugged and theory questions are asked while solving one problem)

Technical phone interview: C++ questions involving data structures, implementing a given data structure and discussing design decisions and trade-offs, with some math / probability questions in other tracks (a trader-oriented guide says a timed mental-math screen filters heavily for trading roles)

Final rounds with senior engineers, traders or quants; older reports describe no onsite at all, while newer trading-track guides describe a head-of-trading round and a final round; references may be requested
Decision. Glassdoor shows about 19 days for the company and 10 days for interns; reports range from 2 weeks to 2 months (reports vary).

fivetran.name: Fivetran
fivetran.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports and Fivetran's own blog: Timeline: guides say about 2-3 weeks (TechPrep) and a few weeks (Interview Query); reports vary from 1 week to 4 weeks. Taro pass rates vary by city (13% for U.S. software engineers across 8 reports, 40% in Bengaluru). Fivetran also published a blog post describing its software engineering interview and tips (from 2020, so details may have changed).
fivetran.roles: Software Engineer, Software Engineer II, Senior Software Engineer, Staff Software Engineer, SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test); offices and sites in Oakland CA, Toronto, Bengaluru, Kaluga (Russia, older reports), and remote US. Titles used in reports; no official numeric ladder seen.
steps: Application online, referral, or recruiter outreach by email (recruiters are praised for being responsive)
Recruiter screen (background, behavioral, interest in the company)

Online assessment for some regions (a 1-hour HackerRank test in Bengaluru) and a live coding conversation with an engineer: string decoding, a SQL connector implementation, LeetCode-easy string problems, designing a concurrent hash map
Further interviews, typically four parts for SE II: two coding rounds, an architectural/design round (low-level design for India senior roles) and a behavioral round; manager conversation
Offer

flatiron-health.name: Flatiron Health
flatiron-health.roles: Software Engineer (including Core Software Engineer), Senior Software Engineer, Data Engineer, oncology data and analytics engineering teams. No official level codes seen. Reports in the sheet are most likely for software engineering.
steps: Application online or via recruiter
HR / recruiter phone screen (company, teams, process)
Online timed coding test or take-home (Codility mentioned in an older report), then technical phone / Zoom screen (data structures and algorithms; SQL and data manipulation emphasized in a guide)

Onsite or virtual loop of several one-on-one interviews: coding (concurrency topics noted), practical pairing, behavioral; some reports mention a non-graded break with an engineer, a short teach-me-something exercise and a final short HR chat
Decision. Reports range from about 2 weeks to 2 months; some recent candidates mention weak communication after the coding test (reports vary).

flexport.name: Flexport
flexport.roles: Software Engineer I, Software Engineer II, Senior Software Engineer, Staff, Senior Staff and Principal Engineer, Software Engineering Manager (M3) per third-party guides (unofficial). Reports come from San Francisco, Seattle and Shanghai, and the role is described as building software for global trade and freight forwarding.
steps: Application online or via recruiter
HR / recruiter screen (about 45 min)

Technical phone interview with a Flexport engineer: usually one multi-step coding question where each step builds on the previous one (examples reported: checkers game in 3 parts, bidding / matching algorithm, backtracking), with practical modeling rather than pure puzzles
Further rounds: coding, system design for senior levels, behavioral; guides say 3-5 rounds, and one candidate describes a non-standard timeline with team match after coding
Decision. Reports range from about 1 week to 4 weeks (reports vary).

flipster.name: Flipster
flipster.note: Per Flipster's own job postings (process varies by role and may change):
flipster.roles: Software Engineer (Backend, Payment Gateway, Data), iOS / Android Software Engineer (Senior iOS), Frontend / Web Engineer (including Senior), DevOps Engineer, Security Engineer. Flipster is a crypto perpetuals trading platform with remote roles in APAC and South Korea; listings often ask for 4+ years for senior mobile roles. Titles on the company's own postings, no level codes.
steps: Resume / CV submission and screening

Role-dependent first step: a homework assignment (mobile and DevOps roles), a 30-minute first-round interview with live coding (frontend), or a first technical interview with live coding / system design / architecture (backend)
Second-round interview: 60 minutes for frontend, a second live-coding or system design technical interview for backend, or a 1:1 technical interview for iOS
Third round and sometimes a tech lead interview or optional fourth round for mobile and security roles

Final offer. A 2026 candidate report describes two back-to-back technical phone rounds on class design, system design and easy coding, with quick HR feedback within a day; no total timeline is published.

fluidstack.name: Fluidstack
fluidstack.note: Fluidstack's own job postings include an 'Interview Process' section; for a Senior DevRel Engineer role it says that if you clear an initial phone interview, the main process is three 45-minute interviews: a technical deep dive, customer communications, and a culture-fit interview. Fluidstack also hosts an interview FAQ (see official sources; only the first question was visible). Candidate reports add:
fluidstack.roles: Fluidstack (GPU cloud / AI infrastructure; San Francisco, Austin, London, remote). Software Engineer / Senior Software Engineer (backend services, data pipelines, distributed systems), AI Software Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer (junior to mid-level postings), Senior DevRel Engineer, Network Engineer, Data Center Controls Engineer, plus finance and legal roles. Levels are not published beyond Junior / Mid / Senior / Staff in posting tags.
steps: Screener / recruiter call (30 min), then a technical interview (45 min with a fellow engineer, casual and scenario-based), then a culture-fit / behavioral interview with a senior manager (30 min)
For some roles a hiring manager round and a final interview with a VP / CEO / COO (a data center controls engineer reports the full process taking about 4 weeks)

Decision. Glassdoor shows an average of about 22 days, with reports from 4 to 6 weeks, and one April 2026 Austin candidate calling the process unnecessarily long with too many rounds. Interviewers reportedly warn that the work pace is intense.

fora-travel.name: Fora Travel
fora-travel.note: Small-company process, reported as quick (around 1 week to a few weeks):
fora-travel.roles: Fora (travel-advisor platform, New York based). Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (frontend, backend, full-stack across JavaScript/CSS web apps, REST APIs and location-aware services), Senior AI Engineer; non-engineering roles such as Tour Operations Associate also appear in Glassdoor reports. Levels are not publicly structured.
steps: Recruiter screening (background, current role, compensation expectations, fit; sometimes a short Zoom 1:1 introducing the company and role)

Technical screen: coding (array fundamentals / LeetCode-style, e.g. merge two arrays) and in some reports coding, system design and API design in one session; a debugging exercise where you fix CSS layout errors and JavaScript runtime bugs in a broken frontend

Behavioral / values conversation (a technical decision you explained to someone, how you use AI tools and check their output, why you want to build for travel advisors), then decision. Candidates report mixed interviewer engagement.

ford.name: Ford
ford.note: Interview Query counts 2-5 rounds (assessment, phone screen, coding challenge, behavioral, technical and team rounds); TechPrep says 3-5 rounds conducted entirely remotely, leaning toward practical engineering over abstract puzzles; CleverPrep counts about 5 rounds. Candidate reports describe:
ford.roles: Ford Motor Company (Dearborn MI, Palo Alto, Allen Park, Detroit, Oakville ON, Chennai and other global engineering centers). Software Engineer (largest group on Glassdoor with about 600 reports), Senior Software Engineer, Entry Level Software Engineer / Developer, Full Stack Software Engineer - AI Applications, Software Developer, Systems Engineer, interns and co-ops, plus a very wide set of non-software roles (Product Development Engineer, Assembly Line Worker, Financial Analyst, Data Scientist, Project Manager). Levels are not a published ladder; guides mention paths to Technical Leader and Distinguished Engineer.
steps: Online application and sometimes an assessment (algorithm-focused, LeetCode medium level)
Recruiter / HR screening phone call on background and resume

Technical phone interview or first technical round with a Ford engineer (a 2025 Dearborn report: three rounds starting with HR, then a technical round within a week; drawing and explaining a design on a cloud whiteboard; embedded roles ask CAN communications questions)

Behavioral conversation and a multi-manager panel with team members, then decision. Taro: about 33% pass rate in Dearborn (15 reports), 17% in Detroit (6 reports). Glassdoor timelines range from a few days to 2 weeks for some, up to 5 months for one 2025 candidate, with a few reports of disorganized or drawn-out processes.

freddie-mac.name: Freddie Mac
freddie-mac.roles: Software Engineer (including internships), Senior Software Engineer, GenAI Engineer, QA Engineer, Data Engineer, Product Manager, Product Analyst, Systems Analyst. No official level codes seen. Reports in the sheet are most likely for engineering and technology roles.
steps: Application online (some via staffing agencies)
Recorded video screen or recruiter phone screen
Conversational interviews built around resume deep dives, why Freddie Mac, and light coding / CS fundamentals (OOP, relational joins, concurrency basics, simple array and string problems)
Final interview with team members and/or hiring manager, behavioral emphasis; 2-4 rounds per guides
Decision. Guides say it can take about 2 months and may involve delays; one report mentions a hiring freeze at the finish line (reports vary).

furtherai.name: Furtherai
furtherai.note: Small-startup loop, about 3-4 rounds over roughly 4 weeks:
furtherai.roles: FurtherAI (YC W24, AI workspace for insurance underwriting, San Francisco). Software Engineer - Backend / Full-stack (including India remote), Software / AI Engineer (New Grad), Senior Software Engineer, Frontend Engineer, Staff Applied AI Engineer; also GTM roles (Enterprise Sales Director, Marketing). Levels are not published.
steps: Short intro chat with the hiring manager (~30 min) or a standard screen with a technical team member
Technical interview: about 1 hr of LeetCode-style coding with a senior engineer
About 1 hr of AI-assisted coding with the hiring manager (reported in 2026)

Virtual onsite of about four 30-min sessions: hiring manager, Head of Insurance, CTO and two senior engineers; staff-level reports mention a four-session onsite and advice to learn the insurance underwriting process first. Some candidates describe uneven coordination between the interviewers.

fuse-energy.name: Fuse Energy
fuse-energy.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (reported as an L5-style level on one site, unofficial), Senior Android Developer, Backend Engineer, Mobile Engineer, Data Engineer. Fuse Energy is a vertically integrated energy utility with London and New York hiring. The sheet had only search placeholder links for this name; sources about unrelated companies called Fuse or Fuse Engineering were excluded.
steps: Application online or via recruiter
Recruiter / HR screen
Technical phone screen: reports describe a 2025-2026 screen on Excel function design and database concepts, with some candidates rejected afterward

Deep technical rounds: system design and coding in great depth (one Exponent report rates it very difficult and tells candidates to practice both), plus a pick-a-project-you-are-proud-of discussion and culture / behavioral conversation

Decision. Reports range from about 1 week to 2 weeks for the process and most guides say a few weeks; Indeed shows too little data for a timeline, and the visible Glassdoor reports for senior roles ended without an offer (reports vary).

garmin.name: Garmin
garmin.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports and guides: Timeline: Glassdoor shows about 21 days for software engineers and 28 days company-wide; TechPrep says 3-4 stages completed within a couple of weeks; reports range from 1 week to 6 weeks (an April 2025 embedded report took 6 weeks, a referral 4 weeks). Glassdoor rates difficulty 3/5 with 75% positive for software engineers; a few candidates say they never heard back from the recruiter after the interview.
garmin.roles: Glassdoor volume: Software Engineer (about 245), Product Support Specialist (101), Senior Software Engineer (82), Software Engineer II (64), Software Engineer Internship (53) and Intern (42), Embedded Software Engineer (21), plus mechanical engineers, project managers and design engineers. Sites: Olathe KS (HQ), Chandler AZ, Boulder CO, Raleigh NC, Cochrane (Canada), Brea CA, Cary NC. Garmin job titles use Software Engineer 1 / 2 / Senior / Technical Lead / Staff / Principal; a prep site lists these levels with experience bands (0-2, 2-5, 5-10, 8-15 yrs; unofficial).
steps: Application online, referral or university; HR phone screen (about 20 min: resume, project walkthrough, behavioral questions such as a time you showed integrity, why Garmin)

Technical interview(s): coding in Python or C/C++ (pointers questions for embedded roles), data structures and algorithms (about 45 min), monolith vs microservices for senior roles, design discussion; interviewers are described as friendly and focused on how you think through code
