Onsite or final round (reports: 3 rounds with the final on site in Olathe), then offer; internship processes often run about 1-2 months from university application

garner-health.name: Garner Health
garner-health.roles: Software Engineer (backend-leaning, TypeScript), Senior Software Engineer, Data Engineer. The sheet had only search links for this name; search results point to Garner Health (Garner Health Technology), the healthcare quality and cost company, which is the match assumed here. No official level codes seen.
steps: Application online, recruiter or employee referral
Intro / screening call with a recruiter (background, and in some reports compensation expectations are asked early)
Live coding interview of about 1 hour, described as not LeetCode style and healthcare-focused (for example a TypeScript task combining 3 data sources, or a doctor rating exercise)
Virtual onsite of 3 behavioral / technical rounds (about 2 hours in total), including project deep dives and a backend system design question such as scaling an appointment booking system

Final technical plus behavioral conversation with leadership (30-45 min), then decision. Reports give 4-5 rounds over about 2-3 weeks; an older 2022 report describes a very large take-home early in the process (reports vary).

gatik.name: Gatik
gatik.note: Few reports. Software engineer path per candidate reports: Two October 2025 Glassdoor candidates were accepted, while another had a disappointing process where interviewers did not attend two scheduled calls. PracHub lists 6 first-hand reports. Treat the stage count as indicative.
gatik.roles: Gatik (autonomous middle-mile trucking; Mountain View CA, Phoenix AZ, Texas, Toronto). Roles seen: Software Engineer, Senior/Staff Software Engineer (Prediction; Localization and Mapping), Staff Software Engineer, Senior/Staff Data Engineer (AV infrastructure and DataOps), Machine Learning Engineer, plus safety-driver / operations roles. Levels used: Senior/Staff in titles; no numeric ladder seen. Glassdoor lists the company as Gatik AI.
steps: Application online or via recruiter (a recruiter-led intro; a Phoenix driver-role report describes a same-day phone interview under 15 minutes, not an engineering loop)

Technical screen: for autonomy engineers, topics like pose graph optimization and loop closure (an accepted August 2025 offer called it difficult); an August 2026 ML engineer screen was a point-cloud config design question, explicitly not LeetCode; a recruiter chat about your background comes first

Further technical rounds on the autonomy stack (perception, prediction, mapping), coding, and a behavioral conversation; Interview Query says the ML engineer process runs about 3-5 weeks from application to offer

ge.name: Ge
ge.roles: Software Engineer (about 124-389 Glassdoor reports depending on the page), Senior Software Engineer (about 143), Lead Engineer, Intern, Edison Engineering Development Program, Information Technology Leadership Program (ITLP) and other rotational programs, plus many non-software roles (Project Manager, Mechanical Engineer, Financial Analyst). Note: GE has split into separate companies (GE Aerospace, GE Vernova, GE HealthCare), and the Glassdoor 'GE' pages mix them and many reports are old (2010-2017), so process details may be dated.
steps: Application online, university / campus or employee referral
Online assessment and recorded interview in some cycles; recruiter / HR phone screening

Technical phone screen with an engineer from the team (about 90 min in one report): systems fundamentals such as Linux drivers, stack vs heap, real-time computing, schedulers, deadlock resolution; coding such as converting roman numerals to integers; database and agile questions; Indian cycles report two technical rounds with basic coding and project discussion
Behavioral interview (in person or video) on past challenges and stakeholders, then manager and HR rounds; onsite for some teams

Decision. Reports vary: about 3 days to 5 weeks, with a typical 15-20 days reported in India and Glassdoor putting GE overall at about 21 days. Recent (2025-2026) reports are mostly positive offers, plus one negative no-offer report from Chicago.

geico.name: Geico
geico.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports and guides: Timeline: Glassdoor shows about 27 days for software engineers (17 days company-wide); Interview Query says about 4 weeks with 2-5 rounds; reports range from 2 weeks to 8 weeks for senior roles, and several senior candidates complain about long delays. Taro pass rate is about 27% over 33 U.S. reports.
geico.roles: Software Engineer (about 105 Glassdoor reports; Taro 33 U.S. reports), Software Engineer I and II, Senior Software Engineer (including San Jose CA), TDP Software Engineer (Technology Development Program, an early-career track; TDP Software Engineer I), Principal Software Engineer and Distinguished Engineer. A third-party prep site (hw.glich.co) lists Software Engineer I (0-2 yrs), II (2-5), Senior (5-10), Principal I/II and Distinguished Engineer I/II levels (unofficial, from a candidate-prep site). Insurance (claims, agents, CSR) roles dominate Glassdoor otherwise and were not researched.
steps: Application online or via referral; TDP applicants complete a questionnaire first
HR / recruiter interview and/or an online or live coding screen (Glassdoor stats list phone interview, one-on-one interview and skills test as the common stages)

Technical interviews: LeetCode-medium (greedy, dynamic programming, knapsack) in 60 minutes, a second technical, and for SE II and above a 60-minute system design interview (an SE II report: two technical interviews, a system design interview and a behavioral one)
Behavioral / managerial round (about 45 min), TDP interviews are more behavioral (a Sep 2025 TDP report: medium LeetCode round then behavioral with resume questions)
Offer, background check

gemini.name: Gemini
gemini.note: Candidate sources describe about 5-6 stages over 4-8 weeks (some say 3-4 weeks):
gemini.roles: Gemini (Winklevoss crypto exchange, custodian and wallet; not Google's Gemini). Software Engineer (backend, trading systems, funding / payments, product engagement, risk engineering; TypeScript, Scala, C++), Senior and Staff Software Engineer, mobile engineer (React Native), Web3 Software Engineer, Software Engineering Intern, Engineering Manager. Postings are in New York and San Francisco, with some remote roles.
steps: Recruiter screen (role, comp)
First round of 30-45 min with an engineering manager (behavioral plus a technical discussion of tools)
About 75 min live coding on CoderPad with a senior engineer (arrays, hash maps, graphs); the mobile team reports a four-hour React Native / TypeScript take-home that builds a crypto watchlist

Virtual onsite: a block of four back-to-back interviews (2.5-3 hrs): pair programming on a real skeleton codebase (currency conversion and exchange-rate precision problems recur), system design, product sense, compliance / security awareness
Hiring decision. Reports describe the process as long and inconsistent for some, smooth for others.

generalmotors.name: Generalmotors
generalmotors.roles: Software Engineer (SE 1 through SE 4 / L5-L8 style levels per one candidate-guide site, unofficial), Senior Software Engineer / Software Developer, Software Engineering Manager and Director, new-grad and university hires. Offices: Warren / Detroit area, Austin, Toronto and Markham (GM Canada), Dublin, Mexico, Bengaluru.
steps: Application online, referral or university route
Online assessment, often HireVue (LeetCode-style and STAR behavioral questions), or a HackerRank-style OA
HR / recruiter phone screening (simple, background and fit)
Technical rounds: about 2 interviews of 45 min to 2 hours with coding (two medium questions), debugging a file, and verbal code-approach questions; some teams give a home assignment
Hiring-manager final interview, behavioral questions on teamwork, conflict resolution and problem-solving
Decision. Reports vary: about 2-6 weeks, with some Canada reports of a few weeks to a couple of months. Taro stats (125 US SWE reports) show a pass rate of roughly 31%.

giga.name: Giga
giga.note: Per the company's own job listings (as reposted on job boards): 1. Screening call with the recruiting lead (about 20 min) A third-party guide describes a dual-phase coding exercise (build a small game with AI-assisted tools, then extend it without AI), and a 2026 Glassdoor report describes a hiring manager screen, a peer interview with an assignment, then a panel with the hiring manager, CEO and a peer. Guides say about 3-5 weeks over 4 rounds; the candidate describes it as quick and thorough (reports vary).
giga.roles: Software Engineer I / II, Senior Software Engineer, Founding Senior Software Engineer, Junior Software Engineer, Software Engineer Intern, Solutions Engineer. The sheet had only search links for this name; search results point to Giga (Giga ML, gigaml.com), the AI customer support agent company with San Francisco and Bangalore offices, which is the match assumed here. No official level codes beyond I / II and senior titles in listings.
steps: In India listings an intro call with a founding engineer (about 15 min), then a live coding round (1 to 1.5 hours)
Technical intro call with the hiring manager (about 15 min) in the US listing
Full-day in-office interview

gimlet-labs.name: Gimlet Labs
gimlet-labs.note: Public reports are scarce: designgurus says Gimlet Labs does not publish its interview steps, and techinterview.org states that its loop is reconstructed from comparable inference-infra companies, not reported. The one candidate report I saw (PracHub, Apr 2026, Member of Technical Staff, ML Systems) describes: HR screen, technical screen, then an onsite with two system-design rounds, ending in a rejection. A generic Scoutify page mentions a ~30 min intro call and a 45-60 min technical interview, but it is not company-specific. Expect system design about serving models, scheduling across heterogeneous hardware and failure recovery for infra roles.
gimlet-labs.roles: Gimlet Labs (multi-silicon AI inference 'neocloud', San Francisco; not Gimlet Media or gimlet.io). Software Engineer, Member of Technical Staff (ML Systems, Compilers, Kernels & GPU Performance, AI Research), MTS Intern, Network Engineer, Chief of Staff and recruiting roles. Levels are not published.

glean.name: Glean
glean.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Backend Engineer (enterprise search, Work AI platform, data pipelines, developer platform tools and APIs), plus other engineering and GTM roles. Levels are not publicly structured.
steps: Recruiter conversation (process overview)
Technical screen: ~1 hr live coding, often described as 'in-house' rather than classic LeetCode (e.g. implement a small game or a couple of methods) or a medium-to-hard LeetCode-style problem

Final round: a 2-hour practical build-from-scratch assignment (e.g. a Table module with join support or a stream processor, starting from an empty file) plus 2 live technical interviews; hard DSA and search-flavored system design appear; one report counts six rounds in total (hiring manager, two technical, three cultural)
Hiring manager wrap-up; senior and above may meet an executive or founder; then decision. About 3-5 weeks. Communication speed varies.

gofundme.name: Gofundme
gofundme.roles: Software Engineer (SWE, SWE II, Senior, Staff), Software Engineer Intern, Staff Software Engineer (Pro Donate), Staff ML Engineer (Pricing), Senior Agentic AI Developer, Product Manager, Senior Product Designer. Glassdoor report volume is led by Customer Happiness Agent (about 22), then Senior Software Engineer (about 18), Software Engineer (about 11), Product Manager and Staff Software Engineer. Offices: Redwood City, San Diego, Los Angeles, New York, remote.
steps: Application online, recruiter or referral
Recruiter call (a talent acquisition lead in recent reports; supportive and clear)

Phone screen with the hiring manager or an engineer, about 30-45 min (practical algorithm-ish questions, SQL joins and aggregations, Redux / front-end experience for UI roles, older reports mention PHP, SQL and jQuery exercises)

Onsite or virtual onsite: older reports say 5+ hours or 6 rounds with backend and frontend engineers, a project manager, the CTO and CEO; newer ones describe a few technical rounds with design questions such as migrating large databases
Decision. Reports vary: about 2-6 weeks. Experiences are mixed, from a very supportive 2026 process to older reports of unprofessional scheduling.

goldman-sachs.name: Goldman Sachs
goldman-sachs.roles: Software Engineer ladder per candidate guides (unofficial): Analyst, Associate, Vice President, Managing Director, Partner; also campus New Analyst program, internships, Java / C++ developer roles and engineering teams across divisions. Reports in the sheet are most likely for engineering Analyst-level roles, though Goldman also hires heavily in banking, markets and other divisions.
steps: Online application or recruiter outreach (often via LinkedIn or referral)
Online assessment; for campus hires, guides describe a recorded video interview first, then timed coding / software fundamentals challenges
Technical interview rounds: data structures and algorithms, plus core Java, databases, threads or system fundamentals depending on team
Superday style final loop of several back-to-back interviews mixing coding, technical discussion and behavioral questions
Hiring decision. Reports vary widely, roughly 2 weeks to about 6 weeks, and some candidates mention slow scheduling or hiring freezes.

google.name: Google
google.note: One guide says Google puts the process at roughly 6-8 weeks once interviews start; other guides say 1-2 months or more.
google.roles: Software Engineer: L3 (entry), L4 (SWE III), L5 (Senior), L6 (Staff), L7 (Senior Staff). Other role families (PM, TPM, EM, data science, ML engineer) have separate guides in candidate sources.
steps: Online assessment and/or 1-2 recruiter calls
Technical phone screen: ~45 min, about 40 min of coding
Panel of about 4-6 interviews (coding at every level, system design weighted more at senior+, plus behavioral)
Interviewers write independent feedback on a standard scale; a hiring committee reviews the packet and decides
Team matching, then offer

gopuff.name: Gopuff
gopuff.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (Search and Discovery and other teams), Principal Software Engineer, Engineering Manager. Reports come from Seattle, Boston, New York and remote US. No official level codes seen. Most reports are from 2021-2023.
steps: Application online, referral or recruiter outreach on LinkedIn
Recruiter screen (about 30 minutes; role, company and process)
Hiring manager interview on past experience and behavioral questions (one report: interview put on hold the day of and moved a week later)

Technical rounds: a LeetCode-style coding question with an engineer (examples: root-to-leaf paths in a binary tree, a prime-number check), a system design interview with another engineer, including API and database design for a product list for senior roles

Final loop and decision. Reports say about 3-4 weeks (one 2022 report says 3 months); Taro shows a low pass rate for US software engineers (about 11 percent among 9 reports), and several candidates mention a disorganized recruiting team or being ghosted (reports vary).

graham-capital.name: Graham Capital
graham-capital.note: Few public reports for developer roles, so the picture mixes quant-research and technology reports:
graham-capital.roles: Graham Capital Management (alternative investment manager, Rowayton / Norwalk CT, London, New York). Technology roles: Electronic Execution Technology Senior Software Developer (C#, FIX protocol, 5-10 years), Trading Services Application Developer (.NET, Angular/Vue), Middle Office Software Developer (5+ years in finance), Machine Learning Engineer, End User Services Analyst. Most Glassdoor reports are for quantitative research roles (Quantitative Researcher, Quantitative Analyst, Portfolio Analyst). Levels are not published beyond Senior in titles.
steps: Application via careers page or recruiter; a 30-min intro call (quant roles: with a researcher about projects and CV)

Quant track: at least three further 30-minute calls with team members (probability puzzles, brainteasers and a time-series question about detecting reversed ordering are reported); technology track: hiring-manager interview about your projects, plus an interview with the CIO and an HR manager
Final onsite visit to meet the team, discuss culture and tour the office
Decision. One candidate says the process lasted a little less than a month and was very smooth; another (3-week process) calls it needlessly long, so experiences are mixed.

grammarly.name: Grammarly
grammarly.note: A 2023 Built In interview with a Grammarly engineer says the process was fully virtual and let him get to know the team. Timeline: guides say roughly 4-8 weeks across 5-6 stages; reports vary (one 3-5 week range for solutions engineers).
grammarly.roles: Software Engineer (frontend, backend, full-stack, infrastructure), machine learning engineer, software engineering manager and solutions engineer. One third-party prep site lists an L1 to L7 engineer ladder and L1-L6 manager ladder (unofficial, from a candidate-prep site and not confirmed).
steps: Recruiter screen (about 30 min: background and motivation)
Technical phone screen (about 60 min live coding with an engineer, LeetCode-style, string parsing / data structures)

Virtual onsite loop of roughly 3-5 interviews: coding, system design (high-throughput, low-latency, privacy-aware services), a deep dive on past projects, and values/behavioral rounds with the hiring manager
Reference/background steps, then offer

greptile.name: Greptile
greptile.note: Greptile's own listing on the Work at a Startup (YC) job board states the interview process for engineers: 1) they review your materials (GitHub, projects, past work); 2) an intro call over Zoom; 3) a take-home technical interview; 4) an on-site interview in San Francisco (Greptile covers flights, stay and other expenses). Dataford adds a lean, high-signal process that favors execution speed, real-time reasoning and clear trade-off communication, aiming to finish in weeks rather than months. For the Founding Account Executive role the posting lists a 15-min intro call, a one-hour on-site with the CEO and team lunch, a 30-min Zoom with a sales advisor and two reference calls. Candidate reports are very sparse: one Glassdoor software engineer report (Oct 2024) was negative with no offer.
greptile.roles: Greptile (AI code review / codebase understanding API; San Francisco, small YC W24 team, on-site). Software Engineer (Generalist, 0-2 yrs), Senior Software Engineer (1+ yrs per YC listing; Node, TypeScript, AWS ECS / Lambda, Postgres, DynamoDB, Next.js), Design Engineer, Founding Account Executive (Enterprise). Levels are not published beyond Senior.

grindr.name: Grindr
grindr.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports and guides:
grindr.roles: Glassdoor report volume: Software Engineer (about 22), Senior Software Engineer (9), Engineer (8), Staff Software Engineer (3), iOS Engineer (3), Senior iOS Engineer (3), Backend Engineer (2), plus product manager, designer, data scientist, SDET and communications roles. Sites: Chicago, Jacksonville FL, Los Angeles / West Hollywood, San Francisco. Open postings include Staff Software Engineer (Android, Full Stack Mobile) and Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer (GenAI Model Quality). No numeric ladder seen.
steps: Application online, referral, recruiter or staffing agency; recruiter phone screen about background and culture

Technical screen / coding challenge: one report describes a series of progressive challenges on JSON data processing; others mention Python/algorithms questions and typical behavioral questions; older (2016) SDET reports ask you to submit code you wrote before an onsite

Interviews with the team: first round then second panel rounds (a March 2026 Chicago senior report, semi enjoyable); a senior report (2022) says a standard career walk-through covering previous work, provisioning architecture and services built, finished in 1 day

Decision. Timeline: reports range from 1 day to 4 weeks (3 weeks in 2021, 2 weeks via referral, 4 weeks via recruiter in 2026); Dataford says about 3-5 weeks over 3 rounds for data scientists. Recent senior reports are no offer with negative or neutral experiences; some candidates mention company layoffs and an unsettled period.

gsa.name: Gsa
gsa.roles: Assumed to be GSA Capital, a London quant hedge fund (the name could also mean the US General Services Administration or another GSA, which was not checked). Roles: Software Engineer / Software Developer, Software Engineering Intern, Quant Developer, Quant Researcher, Quantitative Analyst, Infrastructure and business-operations roles. Offices: London, Kyiv.
steps: Application online, recruiter or staffing agency (many recruiters pitch roles for this firm)
Online assessment, and for quant researcher tracks a take-home data project

Technical interviews: coding (implementing APIs for a game analogue, design a music player, best time to buy and sell stocks), combinatorics and probability-style problems, and a parallel-computing question (Fibonacci on an infinitely parallel computer)

Further interviews / final round; per a third-party summary, GSA published its own process in 2026, says software candidates do not need a finance background, and internship candidates need a strong computer-science foundation and evidence of high-quality code; quant researcher paths are described as about 5 stages
Decision. Reports vary: about 1-2 weeks in a few Glassdoor reports, though one intern describes a lengthy but quick-moving process. Most reports seen ended with no offer. Evidence is thin.

gusto.name: Gusto
gusto.note: Candidate guides describe about 4 stages (5-7 touchpoints) over roughly 3-5 weeks:
gusto.roles: Software Engineer (full-stack, frontend, core products, developer productivity; Ruby/JS era reports), Senior and Staff Software Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer; levels L1-L7 appear in a candidate guide (unofficial).
steps: Recruiter call / phone screen

Technical assessment: online coding assessment or live coding (CoderPad with JavaScript/Ruby in older reports), standard data structures and algorithms plus a pair-programming exercise; many reports stress small realistic domain problems (e.g. splitting a pool of money among parties owed set amounts) over classic LeetCode
Final interview stage: more technical (including system or architecture discussion for senior roles) and a manager conversation
Values and motivations round, then offer. Glassdoor average is about 23-24 days; some 2025-26 reports mention 6-7 weeks and mixed experiences.

hackerrank.name: HackerRank
hackerrank.roles: Software Engineer (about 21 Glassdoor reports), Senior Software Engineer (about 15, including Senior Software Engineer I), Software Development Engineer (SDE) and SDE I / SDE II in test, SDE interns, frontend engineer, machine learning engineer, technical content engineer, solutions engineer, plus account executive, sales and customer success roles. Offices: Mountain View / Santa Clara / San Jose CA, New York, Bengaluru, and remote.
steps: Application online or via recruiter (some candidates get no human contact; HR may reach out and send a test after about 20 days)
Online assessment, often on HackerRank itself: 2 coding questions (medium to medium-hard) or a debugging and small-feature build; some reports say the first stage was purely automated
Hiring manager screen and one or two technical phone/video rounds (data structures, system design, such as how to build a CodePair-style platform)

Final rounds: project deep dive questions out of your own past projects, a presentation for some candidates (Glassdoor shows presentation as a common stage), and team/behavioral round; the company dogfoods its own platform

Decision. Glassdoor shows about 21 days on average; reports vary from 1 day to 2 weeks or more; a May 2026 candidate calls the process thoughtfully planned, while others report silence and abrupt schedule changes. Taro shows a 0% pass rate on 9 reports (mostly older).

hadrian.name: Hadrian
hadrian.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports (2024-2026) and a techinterview.org guide:
hadrian.roles: Hadrian (hadrian.co, an automated precision-manufacturing company; offices and factories in Los Angeles / Torrance CA, San Francisco, Mesa AZ). Roles seen: Software Engineer (full-stack, backend, 'All Levels: Frontend / Fullstack Software Engineer'), Backend Tech Lead for Factory Automation, Robotics Software Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, Computer Vision Engineer, product and project managers. Per a techinterview.org guide (updated October 2026), most roles are gated by an ITAR rule, so citizenship/status matters; posted comp bands run roughly $160-260k for robotics engineers (as of October 2026). I treated pages about Hadrian Automation as the same company; no unrelated company was mixed in. No numeric level ladder seen.
steps: Application online, then recruiter call

Technical screen: one-hour live coding on the phone (examples: a knight-to-king minimum-moves problem on an N-by-N board, a DAG critical-path problem, 3D mathematics); or a take-home problem that should take about 4 hours (one Glassdoor report)

Onsite in Los Angeles (candidates say the company can fly you out): a systems-design round (backend, databases, data structures and algorithms; nothing frontend-specific per one report), a 45-minute leadership/behavioral interview with an engineering director, and a factory tour; the September 2026 report counts three rounds ending in the factory tour

Decision. Timeline: Dataford says 4-6 weeks over 6 rounds for some roles; one Glassdoor candidate called the process simple; Glassdoor and Dataford rate it difficult (Dataford 5.5/10 on 23 reports). Sample sizes are small and role-dependent; this is not a company-published process.

harvey.name: Harvey
harvey.roles: Software Engineer (SWE II, Senior; legal-AI product and infrastructure, RAG and agentic systems), Machine Learning / MLOps Engineer, Data Scientist, Product Manager, plus GTM roles. Levels like L3-L5 appear in third-party sources only (unofficial).
steps: Recruiter screen (~30 min: background, target level, location, comp) - often via cold outreach on LinkedIn
Hiring manager screen (~45 min: motivation for legal AI, role fit, past work)
Coding tech screen: multi-part problem, at least LeetCode-medium (e.g. spreadsheet-style cell/formula storage, interval and string matching)
Virtual onsite: data-structure-heavy coding (graphs), systems / agentic design, RAG-style coding, project deep dive, behavioral
Decision. About 3-5 weeks (reports range 2-6 weeks). Reports say interviews are tough but fair.

hbo.name: HBO
hbo.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports: Timeline: reports vary, about 1 week to 3 weeks in the Glassdoor reports; guides say 4-5 stages. Some reports call the process quick and conversational; one dataford report describes an openly rude interviewer.
hbo.roles: Sources are for HBO Max / Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD), the parent company that now runs HBO's streaming engineering. Software Engineer, Software Engineer I, data engineer, interns, plus a smaller number of business analyst, content manager and manager reports. Locations in reports include Seattle, Los Angeles, New York and Atlanta. No official or unofficial level ladder seen.
steps: Online application and resume screen, or recruiter outreach
Recruiter / HR screen

Technical phone interview or initial coding screen (language of your choice): cache building, a 2048-style game problem, practical media-related design (such as arranging thumbnail tiles without repeats)

Virtual onsite of roughly 3-5 rounds: coding, system design for high-concurrency streaming and video delivery, and behavioral; one prep site says WBD adds a distinctive operational-excellence round that is a discussion of how you own software in production, not a coding round
Offer

headlands.name: Headlands
headlands.roles: C++ Software Developer (including new grad), Java Software Developer, Research Developer / Quantitative Researcher, FPGA Engineer, Systems Engineer. Headlands Technologies is a Chicago-based trading firm; the sheet links headlandstech.com. No official level codes seen. Reports in the sheet are most likely for software developer roles.
steps: Application online or via recruiter (the firm asks you to apply to one job only)

Online assessment on HackerRank: for software developers a C++ task of about 100-120 minutes (substantial input parsing / implementation); research roles get a statistics-heavy timed test (a 70-minute, 17-question format has been reported)
Technical phone / video screen with a developer or researcher (coding, C++ vs Python discussion, projects)

Onsite in person at the office, all on one day: reported as about 6 rounds for developers (8 for experienced quants after 2 phone screens): LeetCode-style problems, C++ trivia, algorithms, operating systems, concurrency and open-ended systems questions such as how to find and remove unused code from a codebase
Decision. Guides say 3-5 rounds over about 3-6 weeks, and 1-3 weeks for some researcher processes; summer can be slower (reports vary).

headway.name: Headway
headway.roles: Software Engineer (backend, full-stack provider / patient side, security), Senior Software Engineer, Staff Fullstack Software Engineer, Director of Engineering, plus non-engineering roles such as project manager. Headway is the mental healthcare network company at headway.co. No official level codes seen beyond title tiers.
steps: Application online or recruiter outreach
Recruiter / HR screen (company overview, why you are looking)
Live code screen or technical screen (standard algorithms / data structures, for example finding a free appointment slot among booked times; some reports mention a take-home or role homework)

Virtual onsite of about three to four parts: coding with two engineers, system design / backend API, behavioral and values; some senior security roles start with an architecture interview with the lead security engineer
Decision. Reports range from quick three-round loops to about 4-5 weeks with up to six interviews (reports vary).

hebbia.name: Hebbia
hebbia.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (backend, full-stack / frontend React), Integrations Engineer, Engineering Manager, plus non-engineering roles such as Solutions Engineer and AI Strategist. No official level codes seen. Reports in the sheet are most likely for software engineering at this AI company (also listed on Glassdoor as Hebbia AI).
steps: Application online or via recruiter
Recruiter / HR call (about 30 min)

Technical screen on CoderPad or an online technical assessment (candidates describe some coding prompts as confusing; one backend report describes a short background chat then a 30-minute coding portion)
API design and data modeling round; guides also list a system design discussion and interactive problem solving
Onsite at the New York office, described as a full day (about 8 hours) where you build and deploy something and meet teammates and engineering leaders
Decision. Reports range from 1 day to about 4 weeks; most candidate reports in sources ended without an offer (reports vary).

hex.name: Hex
hex.roles: Software Engineer (Backend Platform, Backend Product, Foundations, Compute, Curator, Growth, Fullstack), mostly Senior or Staff level per the company's listings, plus Design Engineer, Product Designer and Product Engineer Intern. Hex Technologies is the data analytics company at hex.tech. No official level codes beyond Senior / Staff in titles.
steps: Application online (the company says AI-assisted tools help with resume screening and fraud detection)
Recruiter / intro call
Technical screen (one Glassdoor report: about 2 weeks total for the early stage)
Onsite of about five rounds, reported as web development, system design, product taste, behavioral and a CTO round, with feedback in one 2026 report about leaning too much on AI during coding

Decision. Candidate reports are few and several ended without an offer; the company publishes interview process pages for design roles on Notion (case-study walkthroughs) but none was seen for software engineers (reports vary).

hive-ai.name: Hive.Ai
hive-ai.note: Guides describe a fast, structured, pass/fail pipeline of about 4-5 rounds with coding as the main gate:
hive-ai.roles: Hive (hive.ai, cloud-based AI for content understanding and moderation; Glassdoor lists it as Hive (CA) and Hive (NY)). Software Engineer (backend, frontend, AI software engineer), Senior Software Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer (senior and staff), Forward-Deployed Engineer, Security Engineer, Data Scientist, Product Manager. A candidate guide labels engineer levels L3-L7 (unofficial). Several search results were for unrelated companies called Hive or Hived, which I ignored.
steps: Initial recruiter / initial screening
Technical coding assessment (algorithms: tree and graph traversals, BFS/DFS, cycle detection, serialization problems)
Virtual onsite loop of coding and design rounds, then an executive interview
Decision. One Glassdoor report for an AI Software Engineer (New York) says the process took about 3 weeks and was easy; guides call the pace fast.

home-depot.name: Home Depot
home-depot.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports: Timeline: guides say 4-6 rounds and about 2-4 weeks; reports vary from 1 day (campus) to 8 weeks; Taro shows a 39% pass rate over 59 U.S. software-engineer reports and mostly positive experiences.
home-depot.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Staff Software Engineer (including remote roles in Atlanta, Austin, Detroit, Toronto), Software Engineer internship, early-career programs, plus many retail and corporate roles not researched here. Staff-level engineers report a 3-level minimum process; no official level ladder beyond titles.
steps: Application online, via recruiter, referral or campus; a text-bot automated step appears in one 2025 report
Recruiter screen

Online coding assessment (a Codility round in one report) or a collaborative technical pairing: peers use a Miro code-scramble where you organize code pieces into a working app and explain data flow, plus a design case study; guides add a 45-60 minute live coding session with a peer engineer

Behavioral / 'SIG' interview with two leads and a final round with the manager (Staff roles: technical pairing, behavioral with two leads, manager round, sometimes a principal engineer round); API design, order-management or inventory-system design discussions; Java and RESTful services topics
Offer

hopper.name: Hopper
hopper.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports, Glassdoor stage stats and guides (most reports are 2021-2024, a few newer): Timeline: Glassdoor shows about 15 days for software engineers (13 reports) and 20 days company-wide; TechPrep says about 3-4 weeks; reports range from 1 week to 5 weeks. Glassdoor rates difficulty 3.1/5 with only 31% positive for software engineers; several candidates complain about a presentation or case round being used to get free ideas, an inattentive interviewer, or negative experiences.
hopper.roles: Hopper (mobile-first travel booking platform; Montréal, Cambridge MA, Bogotá, Singapore, remote). Glassdoor volume: Senior Software Engineer (about 27-29), Software Engineer (about 37), Travel Agent / Travel Experience Agent, Market Manager, Product Manager, Software Developer, Senior Data Analyst, Customer Service roles. Engineering tracks per Dataford: Backend (Scala, Python), Frontend, Mobile, Machine Learning and Engineering Manager. No numeric ladder seen beyond Senior.
steps: Application online, referral, university or recruiter; recruiter screen then a conversation with a hiring manager about alignment with the team

Online coding or HackerRank-style test and a phone interview (Glassdoor stage stats: phone interview 29%, presentation 24%, one-on-one 18%, IQ test 12%, skills test 12%); coding questions such as stacks and matching-parentheses variations, grouping passengers by class to board a plane, reconstruct itinerary (LeetCode 332), design a web crawler in 20 minutes, and a conventional low-level design problem; frontend questions on travel-deals path cost
Technical rounds with engineers (system design and low-level design for senior roles, product-sense and travel-marketplace questions) and cultural-alignment rounds, then offer

houzz.name: Houzz
houzz.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports (2017-2025): Timeline: reports range from 1 day to 4 weeks (3 weeks in 2019 and 2021; 4 weeks for Taipei 2025; 2 weeks for Tel Aviv 2025). Recent reviews call the process professional and structured though extensive.
houzz.roles: Houzz (home renovation and design marketplace). Glassdoor volume is dominated by sales (Account Executive about 263, SDR, Account Manager); engineering reports (about 60) cover Software Engineer, Entry-Level Software Engineer, Full Stack / Fullstack Developer, Machine Learning Engineer, Software Developer. Sites: Palo Alto CA, Detroit, Tel Aviv, Taipei. No official level ladder seen.
steps: Application online, via recruiter, referral or university; HR/recruiter intro (introduce yourself, salary expectations)
Online take-home coding challenge (older reports: HackerRank, 105 minutes) or a technical phone interview with an engineer over CoderPad (older reports)

Technical interviews: a 2025 report lists a phone screen, three separate technical interviews and a final system design interview (extensive); another lists a class system design interview, a frontend task, an interview with a senior colleague and an HR interview; questions include building an auto-complete input component, fetching data from an API and displaying it in a table, greedy algorithms, finding an insertion position in a sorted array, sessions vs cookies, and objective-C detail questions in older mobile reports
Final video interviews (older: two back-to-back with a software engineer and an engineering manager), then offer

hubspot.name: HubSpot
hubspot.roles: Software Engineer (SWE I / entry, Senior Software Engineer I and II, Staff, Principal, Distinguished per third-party guides, unofficial). Glassdoor report volume is dominated by non-engineering roles: Account Executive (largest), Customer Support Specialist, Customer Success Manager, Growth Specialist, BDR, Recruiter; Software Engineer and Senior Software Engineer are the top tech groups.
steps: Application online or via recruiter
Recruiter call (about 30 min)
Asynchronous coding challenge: commonly a timed take-home of about 3 hours (API-style, multi-level tasks) or a CodeSignal-style assessment; guides say this stage matters a lot
Virtual onsite of about 4 hours: live coding / DSA, system design (for example a streaming-style design prompt), behavioral round (ownership, failure stories), sometimes technical deep dive
Decision. Guides say 4-6 rounds and roughly 1-4 weeks; some Glassdoor samples show up to 60 days (reports vary).

hudson-river-trading.name: Hudson River Trading
hudson-river-trading.note: HRT's own tech-blog post says each stage has a particular focus and a standardized question set for the season, tailored slightly by role and team. From it and candidate reports:
hudson-river-trading.roles: Software Engineer, Algo Engineer (C++ and Python for live trading infrastructure and research), Systems / Core Engineer, FPGA Engineer, Quantitative Researcher, Quantitative Trader, interns. HRT's own post covers the campus process for Software Engineering and Algo Engineering.
steps: Online assessment (HackerRank / CodeSignal style, e.g. 2-3 hard problems in ~90 min, or 4 medium problems for some roles)
Phone screens (~1 hr technical, dense with rapid follow-ups; OS principles, hash maps, C++ and Python internals appear)
Final / onsite interviews (~1 hr 15 min each): coding, CS fundamentals, systems design (one guide estimates ~50% coding, 25% design, 15% C++ specifics, 10% behavioral for core engineers)
Offers usually within about 2 weeks of the onsite. Pass rates reported as very low.

hulu.name: Hulu
hulu.note: Reports describe a fairly traditional loop:
hulu.roles: Hulu (streaming service, now operated within Disney; Santa Monica, San Francisco / San Jose, Seattle). Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Principal Software Engineer, Software Developer, Technical Program Manager, intern roles; Glassdoor volume also includes Viewer Experience Advocate and Customer Service Representative. A third-party site labels engineer levels IC2-IC5 and managers M4-M6 (unofficial). Most Glassdoor reports are old (2009-2022), and Hulu's engineering hiring has largely moved under Disney's streaming tech organization.
steps: Application on LinkedIn or via recruiter, then a recruiter call
One or two technical phone interviews (basic algorithms: LRU cache, sorting; DS&A plus a coding round of about 45 min)

Onsite or virtual onsite, often a full day: more technical interviews (DS&A, system design for senior levels), culture-fit questions (Hulu historically emphasised culture fit) and a hiring-manager conversation

Decision. Older reports: about 1-4 weeks; a 2021 San Jose candidate reports about 4 weeks and a lukewarm offer. A recent Dataford report describes an HR conversation followed by strict technical rounds.

ibm.name: IBM
ibm.note: IBM's process varies a lot by role, team, seniority and country; guides count about 3-5 stages.
ibm.roles: Glassdoor's most-reported roles: Software Engineer, Applications Developer, Software Developer, Project Manager, Senior Software Engineer, Senior Consultant, Consultant, IT Specialist, Associate Systems Engineer, Data Scientist, Offering Manager, interns. Engineering titles include Associate Software Engineer and Senior Software Engineer; consulting and sales roles are a large share. Levels are not clearly published.
steps: Application (online, recruiter or campus)
Online screening assessment, role dependent (e.g. in India: coding with string manipulation, FizzBuzz-style and tree-traversal problems; other roles get skills or personality tests)
Technical interview(s): phone or video with a senior engineer or team lead, resume-driven, covering coding, DS&A, OOP / design patterns, and for DevOps roles Kubernetes and Docker
Managerial / behavioral round (sometimes onsite) and final HR discussion; some regions add a 'Guide' interview and an assessment-centre visit
Background check, then offer. About 6 weeks per one guide; Glassdoor shows an average of about 44-46 days, with reports from 2 weeks to 6 months.

illumio.name: Illumio
illumio.roles: Software Engineer (Member of Technical Staff II / MTS-2, Staff Software Engineer, Senior Front-End Software Engineer), Backend Engineer, Frontend Engineer, DevOps Engineer, Security Engineer, ML Engineer, Solutions Engineer, UX/UI Designer, Technical Writer. Offices: Sunnyvale, San Francisco and others.
steps: Application online or recruiter outreach
Recruiter screen (straightforward and well-organized in reports)
Take-home coding assignment (reported in several recent cycles) or a coding conversation with a technical team member

Hiring-manager conversation, then technical interviews (distributed systems, Kafka deep dives, CS fundamentals, live coding such as a radix tree or matrix traversal) and system design for senior levels; older reports describe a 4-round loop with a coding round with an engineer and a QA engineer
Executive / VP leadership round for staff-level candidates
Decision. Reports vary: about 2-4 weeks for most; Staff-level reports cite about 4 weeks. Several 2024-2025 candidates describe the process as mixed or negative, including no offer after a VP round.

imc.name: Imc
imc.roles: Software Engineer (including New Grad / Early Career, Internship, Software Development Engineer, C++ and risk-technology teams), Quant Performance Engineer, Quant Trader and Quant Researcher (graduate / junior trader tracks). Offices seen in reports: Amsterdam, Chicago, Sydney, Melbourne, Mumbai. Sources are for IMC Trading.
steps: Application online or recruiter contact
Online assessment: aptitude / numerical and logical reasoning test in some regions, then a coding test (Codility in older reports; 2 medium questions in newer ones)
Recorded one-way video interview (HireVue-style, behavioral questions plus short algorithm questions), reported as part of the assessment stage
Live technical interviews: data structures and algorithms, project deep-dive, OS / concurrency basics (e.g. process vs thread), questions related to the trading space
Final round(s), sometimes with a presentation of past work for internship tracks; Quant Trader tracks add mental-math and probability rounds
Decision. Reports vary: about 1 week to 2 months, and one summary says 5-6 stages over 4-8 weeks. Selectivity is high per the Taro statistics (US SWE pass rate reported around 7%, small sample).

indeed.name: Indeed
indeed.note: Indeed's own blog post on interviewing for a software engineering role says engineering interviews cover both technical and behavioral aspects, and that the hiring process includes whiteboard coding interviews and data structures and algorithms. From it and candidate sources:
indeed.roles: Software Engineer I, II, III, IV (postings use these titles), Senior and Principal Software Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer III, engineering managers; a candidate guide labels levels L0-L5 (unofficial). Glassdoor volume is dominated by Account Executive, Senior Account Executive, Client Success, Sales Director and National Account Manager roles.
steps: Recruiter screen; for campus hires an on-campus coding interview first
Technical phone or HackerRank-style coding screen (standard DSA, LeetCode-style problems like summary ranges)

Onsite / virtual loop, often reported as 3 whiteboard-style interviews plus a code-review exercise, system design (e.g. a resume storage and search system) and a resume / manager interview; a guide says 6-7 rounds can occur for some candidates
Decision. Glassdoor average for engineers is about 9 days (21 days company-wide); some candidates report 2-8 weeks, and a candidate reports an intensive 3-week gauntlet.

instacart.name: Instacart
instacart.roles: Software Engineer (Ruby on Rails, Python, Go stacks; infra and product), Senior, Senior Staff / Staff, Principal; engineering managers. Candidate guides label levels L3-L9 (unofficial).
steps: Recruiter call
Online assessment (a 90 min CodeSignal-style test is reported) or ~60 min supervised coding screen with an engineer (multi-part problem, each part builds on the last)
Virtual onsite (~5 hrs): two coding rounds, one system design round, one behavioral / past-experience round with a manager, plus a short chat with an engineer
Decision. Loops are fairly standardized across teams; no separate culture interview. About 4-6 weeks.

interactive-brokers.name: Interactive Brokers
interactive-brokers.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports and Interview Query (8 reports): Timeline: Glassdoor shows about 20 days company-wide; reports range from 1 day (campus) to 4 weeks, with Interview Query noting one process of about two months. Glassdoor rates software engineer difficulty about 2/5, while Dataford averages 5.1/10 over 403 reports; several candidates call the process slow or poorly managed.
interactive-brokers.roles: Glassdoor report volume: Software Engineer (about 53), Compliance Analyst (33), Client Service Representative (29), Junior Software Engineer (10), Senior Software Engineer (9), Trader (7), Quantitative Developer, Java Developer, Software Developer Intern, plus professional services roles. Sites: Greenwich CT, New York, Mumbai, Pune, Budapest. Levels used: Junior, Mid-level, Senior; no numeric ladder seen.
steps: Application online, via staffing agency, recruiter or campus; some candidates get a recruiter phone screen

Online assessment: a timed 1-hour test mixing math (about 5 questions, probability), a personality / predictive-index component and 1-2 coding challenges, or a Codility-style task (45-minute scenario implementation); older Mumbai / Pune campus drives use aptitude, psychometric (PI), written and coding tests

Manager conversation focused on your resume and experience, then technical rounds: data structures, linked lists, graph traversal, space-optimised hashmaps, OOP (inheritance), Java or C++ topics, logic puzzles (two eggs and 100 floors); a software-engineer offer candidate described rising LeetCode-style difficulty and a final call with two interviewers; another had a super day of five back-to-back interviews
Final interview (India campus: a personal technical interview and a round with the India MD), then decision

intercontinental-exchange.name: Intercontinental Exchange
intercontinental-exchange.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports and guides:
intercontinental-exchange.roles: Glassdoor report volume covers Analyst, Senior Software Engineer (about 16), Software Engineer (about 14), Senior Developer, Risk Analyst, Quantitative Analyst, Trainee Associate, QA Analyst / Senior QA and Test Automation Engineer, Business and Financial Analyst, IT Analyst and Client Support roles. Sites include Atlanta GA, New York, Pune, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Tel Aviv, Chicago, Overland Park KS. A frontend engineer guide also exists. No official level ladder seen beyond Senior/Associate titles.
steps: Application online, via LinkedIn recruiter outreach (a 15-minute HR call about expectations and benefits), staffing agency or referral
Recruiter / HR screening call, then a technical screen online or by phone (older reports: HackerRank of 1.5 hours with 2 coding questions and 9 Java MCQs)

Technical interviews: Java fundamentals (collections, threading, LRU-style coding), security and performance topics, project walkthroughs; a Senior Software Engineer report from Atlanta (Feb 2026) lists a 1.5-hour coding interview twice, then onsite with a Senior Solutions Architect (45 min), a Principal Engineer (45 min) and a Senior Director (30 min)

Managerial / hiring-manager conversation; for trading-related roles a presentation on a new financial product, and for India walk-in drives a full-day process of multiple rounds (a Pune hiring-drive report calls it disorganized)

Offer. Timeline: Interview Query says about 2 months for software engineers; Dataford says 4-6 weeks over 5 rounds for frontend; reports range from 1 week to over a year, with several candidates ghosted after final interviews and slow gaps between rounds.

intersystems.name: Intersystems
intersystems.note: Software developer path per candidate reports: Timeline: reports vary a lot, from 4 days to 4 months (Boston referral case); Glassdoor shows about 30 days for software developers and 48 days company-wide.
intersystems.roles: Software Developer / Software Engineer (Boston MA and other sites), Software Developer Intern, Quality Development Engineer, Sales Engineer (largest Glassdoor volume), Technical Specialist, Support Advisor, Program Manager, plus roles like Distinguished Systems Developer (SQL Engine), AI Application Engineer and Cloud Security Architect seen in postings. No official level ladder seen.
steps: Application online, referral, email, or campus; the company sometimes initiates contact

Online tests before interviews: older reports describe 3 online quizzes (a personality/PI test, a hypothetical programming-language logic test of about 20 questions in 35 minutes, and a programming test); a Program Manager reviewer says the process begins with an online test too
Phone / recruiter interview, then a deep resume and past-experience review

Onsite or virtual panel: a November 2025 Boston report describes four rounds with interviewers from four different groups, mostly resume deep-dive with no LeetCode-style coding; some interviews ask you to read provided code and explain it
Decision: one reviewer warns that the final decision may rest with someone other than the interview panel

intuit.name: Intuit
intuit.roles: Software Engineer ladder per a candidate guide (unofficial): Software Engineer 1 (0-2 yrs), Software Engineer 2, Senior, Staff, Senior Staff, Principal. Glassdoor's most-reported roles are Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Software Engineer Intern and Tax Associate. Engineers work on products like TurboTax, QuickBooks and Mailchimp.
steps: Application, often with a short online assessment
Recruiter screen, then technical conversations / phone screen (LeetCode-medium style, e.g. sliding-window problems)

Intuit's 'Assess for Awesome' (A4A) interview of about an hour, plus a craft / project demonstration round (a ~2 hr take-home or repo-based task, one recent report says it involved AI use, followed by talking through the project)

Final interviews: behavioral, DS&A, OOP and discussion of 1-2 personal projects; AI-tool questions are common in 2026 reports. Overall about 2-4 weeks per one guide; Glassdoor reports range from about 3 weeks to a few months. Rounds counted as 3-5.

ixana.name: Ixana
ixana.note: Few reports (Glassdoor: 9 interviews across all titles, average 19 days). Candidate details:
ixana.roles: Ixana (body-internet / charging-free wearables platform; West Lafayette IN and Bengaluru, India). Embedded Software Engineer, Senior Embedded Software Engineer (3+ yrs, low-level software, bootloaders, drivers), Firmware Engineer, Hardware / Electrical Engineer, Embedded Software Engineer Intern (wearables and IoT), plus a Strategic Technical Proposals Associate role. Different companies with similar names (Ixis, Oxa, Xaana) in results were ignored.
steps: Online application

Technical interview(s) on embedded and firmware topics: debugging code, designing firmware for an IoT system optimized for throughput and memory footprint, hardware questions such as sampling rate and buffers (Software and Firmware Engineer interviews are rated hardest on Glassdoor)

Decision. Process took about 2 weeks in a Sept 2025 report, with a 'positive, difficult' experience and no offer; several embedded software candidates (Nov 2024, Jan 2026) report neutral experiences without offers. Ixana's own posting for a business role says candidates may complete a short practical exercise based on a technical brief. A 1Point3Acres post covers Ixana, Klaviyo and MathWorks intern interviews.

ixl-learning.name: IXL Learning
ixl-learning.roles: Software Engineer (including new grad), Senior Software Engineer, Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Software Developer team lead roles, engineers on IXL family brands such as Education.com and Teachers Pay Teachers. Glassdoor report counts: Software Engineer is the largest group, then Account Manager, Curriculum Designer and sales consultants. No official level codes seen.
steps: Application online (about 83 percent of new grad reporters applied online) or via campus
Online assessments (one 2026 report mentions 4 fairly easy OAs) and/or a phone screen
Technical interview (LeetCode medium / hard style, hash map and graph problems such as Course Scheduler II; one report adds a code review question and real IXL software problems)
Super day / onsite with several one-on-one interviews with developers (older report describes about 4 hours with four developers), plus resume and project discussion
Decision. Glassdoor shows about 15 days on average for software engineers, though some campus cases stretched to months (reports vary).

j-p-morgan.name: J.P. Morgan
j-p-morgan.note: About 3-5 weeks in many reports; graduate programs in some regions have run for months.
j-p-morgan.roles: Software Engineer, Associate Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Software Developer, Software Engineer interns / Summer Analyst, Code For Good program; plus very large volumes of Associate, Analyst, Vice President, Senior Associate and Project Manager reports across the bank.
steps: Application
Online assessment (HackerRank coding tasks, logic and problem-solving; some regions add HireVue recorded video questions)
Technical interview rounds (data structures, algorithms, OO design, language-specific questions such as C++ or Python, discussion of your resume and projects)
'Super Day' with several back-to-back technical and behavioral rounds (teamwork, leadership, why finance), then decision

jain-global.name: Jain Global
jain-global.note: Few reports, only a rough picture for the Data Engineer track:
jain-global.roles: Jain Global (multi-strategy hedge fund). Roles seen in sources: Data Engineer (full-time, with a take-home), quantitative / portfolio-manager-aligned roles; a guide notes strong Python and statistical-modeling skills are required for the quant track. I did not find a clear software-engineer-specific process. Other search results were for unrelated firms (Jain Software, Jade Global, SP Jain) and were ignored.
steps: Application and recruiter / HR contact
Take-home or technical screen: rolling calculation and data pipeline task focused on production-scale data handling
Three interview rounds covering data quality, user support, and a compliance modeling case (July 2026 report)
Decision. A quant guide says the interview culture is closely tied to PM-driven interviews; timeline not clearly reported.

jane-street.name: Jane Street
jane-street.roles: Software Engineer (full-time and intern; the firm works heavily in OCaml but does not require it in interviews), plus trading and quant-research tracks with different interview formats. Levels are not publicly structured.
steps: Application review and early recruiter screen (hands-on recruiter, fast turnaround, often within days)

Technical phone screen (~1 hr over video): one open-ended coding problem built up through follow-ups, worked collaboratively with an engineer; no standard algorithm-screening stage reported for SWE interns

Onsite / final interviews (about 3-5 sessions, ~5 hrs): problems that start simple and keep growing, implementation-heavy; some tracks mix in math or logic puzzles; using hints is part of the collaboration; a Q&A session; a separate behavioral round is not guaranteed
Decision. Typically about 2-4 weeks; recruiters are described as quick and responsive.

jefferies.name: Jefferies
jefferies.note: Software engineer / technology path per candidate reports and the techinterview.org guide (partly reconstructed):
jefferies.roles: Investment bank / financial services (Jefferies Financial Group; New York, Jersey City, other US cities and offices abroad). Glassdoor volume across Jefferies is broad; software-side reports cover Software Engineer (about 14 tagged reports plus many tech roles), Software Developer, Python Software Engineer (Strategic Investment Division hedge fund), IT Analyst / Information Technology Analyst, Technology Analyst, Summer Technology Intern and Software Developer Intern. Per techinterview.org, engineering follows bank titles: Analyst (new-grad / junior engineer, about $95-120k base), Associate (mid software engineer, about $120-160k) and above; Jefferies markets tech and strats work is New York, front-office-adjacent.
steps: Application online, recruiter, referral or university; an online assessment for interns and some analyst roles (a November 2025 intern reports a 100% score on the OA)

First round on site or by phone with the hiring manager (older reports; a 2020 New York developer met the hiring manager first on site); questions about your projects and basic technical topics every engineer should know (Java, SQL, whiteboarding with time and space complexity, duplicate rows and slow-query diagnosis, closures, production-incident handling, strengths and growth areas)

Further technical and behavioral rounds (a 2022 Jersey City report had a 3-week process); IT Analyst reports mention randomly structured interviews and slow HR replies, and one 2-month process in April 2026

Decision. Timeline: reports range from 1 day (referral) to 2-3 weeks for interns and a few weeks to 2 months for full-time; Glassdoor shows about 55 days across all job titles (6 reports). Reports are mixed: easy and positive for interns, negative or disorganised for some analyst candidates. Other divisions (investment banking, trading) were not researched here.

jerry-ai.name: Jerry.Ai
jerry-ai.roles: Software Engineer (largest report group, including associate SE with about 1 year of experience), Senior Software Engineer, AI Engineer, plus Product Manager, Data Scientist and operations roles. The sheet links getjerry.com (Jerry, the car insurance and personal finance app). No official level codes seen.
steps: Application online or via recruiter
Recruiter / HR screen (strengths and weaknesses, how often you ship a feature, process overview; a 2026 report also mentions a general-knowledge quiz style question)
Take-home coding assignment (described as manageable) and/or a short online assessment (a 2026 report: one string manipulation problem)
Technical rounds: coding interview with two software engineers (data structures, recursion vs iteration), SQL and JavaScript emphasis per a guide, then a technical interview with the CTO
Final interview with a VP / executive, then decision. Reports range from 5 days to about 3 months; several candidates mention a long process or lack of feedback after rejection (reports vary).

jump-trading.name: Jump Trading
jump-trading.note: One guide describes Jump's process as lean, fast and secretive, with no trading-game round for engineers. From candidate sources:
jump-trading.roles: Software Engineer / Core Developer (low-latency C++, systems, production engineering), Senior Software Engineer, Software Engineering Intern, Quantitative Researcher, Algorithmic / Quantitative Trader, Production Engineer, Business Development. Glassdoor's most-reported roles are Software Engineer (39), Quantitative Researcher (18) and Algorithmic Trader (9). Offices include Chicago, New York, London and Singapore.
steps: HR / recruiter call (30-45 min; resume and project discussion, introduction to Jump)

Online take-home test (HackerRank-style, described as very hard but fair) and/or technical phone screen with C++, OS and systems questions (e.g. virtual memory, semaphores and multithreading, probability and coding)
Live technical rounds of realistic implementation work done together with the interviewer, plus low-level and hardware-aware design questions
Final interviews and decision. Reports range from about 1 week to 2 months; some agency-sourced candidates report being ghosted, and Taro shows a low pass rate in London (about 0 of 6 in one sample).

karat.name: Karat
karat.note: Karat's own hiring loop (per Taro and Dataford): 1. Recruiter / HR call about tech stack and motivation, 2. a 15-minute multiple-choice 'Karat Qualify' test, 3. a 60-minute 'Karat Core' live video interview with a Karat Interview Engineer (CS theory such as Java and operating systems, live coding, sometimes system design), 4. a roughly 3-hour onsite loop with managers and engineers. Karat screen for other companies: a one-hour structured interview with an Interview Engineer, often a short introduction, a couple of conceptual questions and then 2-3 coding problems; some candidates describe it as scripted and strictly timed. Decision timelines were not consistently reported; Taro shows low pass rates in small samples.
karat.roles: Software Engineer, Software Developer, Frontend Engineer, Software Engineering Manager, Product Manager, plus Interview Engineers. Important: many 'Karat' interview reports are not for working at Karat but for Karat's technical screens run on behalf of other companies (Karat says it conducts live technical assessments as part of its clients' hiring), so the sheet's reports may describe that screen instead of Karat's own hiring loop.

kayak.name: Kayak
kayak.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports:
kayak.roles: Software Engineer (22 Glassdoor reports), Senior Software Engineer, Java Software Engineer, Front End Developer / Frontend Engineer, UI Developer, software engineering interns, plus account manager, campaign manager, product manager, QA and network roles. Locations: Cambridge / Concord MA, Boston, Berlin, Kaunas, New Delhi. No official level ladder seen.
steps: Application online or via recruiter
Recruiter / phone screen; some candidates get a take-home assignment to finish within about 5 business days

Technical rounds: OOP / object-oriented design questions (e.g. a duck class hierarchy with flying and quack modes), implementing an ArrayList without Java Collections, validating list items with changing rules, graph-based map architecture, a menu with price ranges, basic algorithms, plus behavioral questions such as resolving a team conflict
Panel or one-on-one final interviews (Glassdoor shows phone, group panel and one-on-one as common stages), some engineers describe a mix of backend and frontend topics

Decision. Guides say about four stages over 3-5 weeks; Glassdoor shows about 29 days company-wide; reports vary from 1-3 weeks. Several 2025-2026 candidates describe polite processes that ended with no reply or an unfair-feeling final test.

kickoff.name: Kickoff
kickoff.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports (2024-2025): Candidates on Glassdoor are mostly no-offer with mixed experiences (some positive, difficult, one negative); PracHub holds only 1 report. Treat this row as thin and low-confidence.
kickoff.roles: AMBIGUOUS COMPANY / POSSIBLE SPELLING: no company named 'Kickoff' with engineering interview reports turned up, so I researched Kikoff (kikoff.com, a San Francisco credit-building fintech), which is the closest match; please confirm or give the real company. Kikoff roles seen: Software Engineer (about 29 Glassdoor reports), Senior Software Engineer (Product Platform; Partnerships), Senior Backend Engineer (Grant Underwriting and Payment), Member of Technical Staff, Software Engineer Intern; posted senior bands about $244-292k. No numeric ladder seen.
steps: Application online or recruiter; recruiter screen

Coding rounds: one coding interview, then two more coding interviews, with an optional extra call; questions are LeetCode-style problems (Alien Dictionary, JSON parsing to extract key info; a PracHub guide notes a two-part log parsing and query screen); an intern process took about 4 weeks
Final rounds (reports are thin and not detailed), then decision

kikoff.name: Kikoff
kikoff.roles: Software Engineer (including New Grad), Senior Software Engineer (Product Platform, Partnerships), Senior Backend Engineer, Frontend Engineer, Software Engineer Intern, Member of Technical Staff. Kikoff is a credit-building fintech based in San Francisco. No official level codes seen.
steps: Application online or via recruiter
Recruiter screen

Coding rounds: reports describe one to three coding interviews on CoderPad (LeetCode-style problems such as Alien Dictionary variants, log parsing in two parts, parsing and validating JSON / input strings), starting with some behavioral questions
Onsite or video onsite for full-time SDE roles with coding and system design, and an optional extra call; interviewers are described as friendly
Decision. Reports say a few weeks, with an intern report taking about 4 weeks; some candidates mention communication gaps (reports vary).

klaviyo.name: Klaviyo
klaviyo.note: Candidate sources describe a practical, non-LeetCode-heavy loop, roughly 3-5 weeks (Interview Query: 4-7 rounds, about 30 days; one Glassdoor report 'under two weeks' with an offer in hand):
klaviyo.roles: Klaviyo (marketing automation, Boston, Waltham, San Francisco, New York, London). Software Engineer, Software Engineer II, Senior Software Engineer, Staff, Engineering Leader / Manager, Software Developer, interns. Levels in postings are I / II / Senior / Staff / Principal; no formal numbered ladder was seen.
steps: Recruiter screen (behavioral, process overview; questions about AI use at work in 2025-26 reports)
CodeSignal assessment: about 90 minutes, often a multi-stage 'build a practical application' task rather than classic algorithms (some candidates fail here and never reach later rounds)

Hiring-manager conversation (project deep dive), then a virtual 'superday': a pair-programming / live coding collaboration with Klaviyo developers (real-world scenarios), a more LeetCode-medium question written by Klaviyo, system design (you are given an existing design diagram and asked to improve it), and a leadership / behavioral round with an engineering leader

Decision. Taro shows a pass rate of about 21% across 19 Boston reports; Glassdoor sentiment is mostly positive, with some reports of delays or too many repetitive rounds (7-8 rounds for one 2022 senior candidate).

kneron.name: Kneron
kneron.roles: Software Engineer, Compiler Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, Deep Learning Engineer, AI Research Scientist, System Engineer Intern, firmware and computer vision engineers. Kneron is an edge-AI chip and software company with San Diego and Taipei bases. No official level codes seen.
steps: Application online, employee referral, staffing agency or by emailing a resume

Technical interview with an engineer: reported test of non-basic C++ programming plus a data structures and algorithms test with emphasis on graphs (rated not difficult in a 2022 Taipei report); other reports mention a coding test
Second interview (the Taipei report counts 2 interviews in total); ML roles get background-knowledge questions such as why ResNet uses shortcuts
Decision. Reports say about 3 weeks for a referral candidate and 3-5 weeks for research roles according to a guide; data is thin (reports vary).

labelbox.name: Labelbox
labelbox.roles: Software Engineer (largest group, 10 Glassdoor reports), Senior Software Engineer, Sr. Software Engineer, Full Stack Engineer, Backend Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Engineering Manager, plus Sales, Business Intelligence and Technical Writer roles. No official level codes seen.
steps: Application online or via recruiter
Recruiter screen (general experience, role fit and compensation expectations)

Technical interviews (one or more): coding and system design for software engineers, with MySQL schema-change questions seen in a guide; Forward Deployed Engineer candidates get a two-part technical assessment to design a reinforcement learning dataset from scratch

Onsite loop that a guide says features a top-grading interview (career walk-through, behavioral questions such as how you grade teams you worked with) plus dedicated mission and values rounds (for example what you made recently, for work or outside of work)

Decision. Reports range from 2 to 3 weeks for senior engineers and about 1 month for a Forward Deployed Engineer; a guide for ML engineers says 3-5 weeks, and some 2023 candidates call the process unprofessional (reports vary).

lambda.name: Lambda
lambda.note: Lambda publishes its own interview process page (lambda.ai/careers/process; only a snippet was visible). Candidate reports and guides (partly generic, some PracHub-synthesised) describe:
lambda.roles: Lambda (the Superintelligence Cloud; GPU cloud and AI infrastructure; San Francisco, San Jose, Bellevue and remote). Roles seen: Software Engineer (Compute, about $296-395k posted in San Francisco / San Jose / Bellevue), Senior Software Engineer (SDN and networking), Software Engineer Cluster Orchestration, Site Reliability Engineer, Data Engineer, Data Scientist / ML researcher, Infrastructure and Cloud Engineer, Product / Project Manager. Lambda Labs was its former name. No numeric ladder seen beyond Senior.
steps: Application online or recruiter outreach; recruiter / HR screen to align on background and scope (Software/Cloud vs Hardware/Data Center); one September 2025 candidate says the recruiter screen grilled them on Kubernetes, bare metal and fleet management (hard)
Technical phone screen on systems, networking, cloud fundamentals or coding

Multi-round virtual onsite: coding, Linux (process scheduling, memory management, filesystems and storage IO), Kubernetes and GPU cluster scheduling, system design for a multi-tenant GPU cloud, incident-response scenarios, and a team collaboration round; a behavioral round centres on customer obsession and ownership

Decision. Dataford says the loop is direct, thorough and practical; Lambda's careers page notes the sales team's loop includes a take-home project. Timelines were not clearly reported; confirm with the recruiter. Interview Query / PracHub list only a few first-hand reports.

langchain.name: LangChain
langchain.note: Exponent's candidate-driven guide says LangChain runs one of the most non-traditional software engineer loops in the AI startup space and may skip standard coding challenges. Reported structure (Nov 2026 lodely summary: 3-4 rounds, chat + work sample + design):
langchain.roles: LangChain (LLM application framework; LangSmith and LangGraph products; San Francisco and remote). Software Engineer (AI / Software Engineer, Senior / L5, Senior+), Software Engineer Applied AI (full-stack agent engineering, Python and TypeScript), JavaScript Engineer (Open Source), Deployed / Forward Deployed Engineer (Mid Level / L4), Machine Learning Engineer. A lodely page lists levels such as L1 AI / Software Engineer (unofficial). No formal internship program per one guide.
steps: Hiring-manager or founder chat (~30 min on background, product interest, team fit); a recruiter intro precedes it for some candidates

Coding work sample: implement a feature in an existing, sometimes poorly documented codebase (investigate the code, write tests, review your work), or a take-home on the real LangChain codebase (AI tools allowed per one guide); a June 2026 PracHub report describes a take-home optimization followed by three onsite rounds in one day
System design: critique the current architecture and propose a design for a new product

Possible panel, then offer. Reports say a few weeks (one senior candidate: about 1 month, offer); another report took 3 months with a negative outcome. Deployed Engineer loops add a 30-min screening call, a technical interview and a take-home project; ML engineers describe a LangSmith demo take-home then a LangGraph build-and-present round.

latent.name: Latent
latent.note: Per Latent's own Work at a Startup listing (only a snippet was visible, which says it is an early-stage team that keeps things simple and starts with a phone screen): the first listed step is a phone screen; later steps were not visible. No candidate reports (Glassdoor, Taro, Blind) were found for Latent, so durations and round counts are unknown. Treat this row as very thin and confirm the company and process with the recruiter.
latent.roles: AMBIGUOUS COMPANY: the sheet's 'Latent' has no website or identifier. Best guess is Latent (YC W23; builds medical language models to help hospitals authorize drugs quickly; San Francisco; a small early-stage team), because it publishes its own interview process. Roles seen: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack; TypeScript, Python, React; 6+ years; $100-200k; US citizen / visa only per the listing). Latent AI (an edge-AI company with an AI/ML Engineer posting in October 2026) is a different company; I did not use it. No level ladder seen.

latitudeai.name: Latitudeai
latitudeai.note: Very few first-hand reports. Glassdoor (filed under Latitude (PA), December 2024-January 2025): a Software Engineer candidate had five interviews, the first three coding challenges of easy to medium difficulty with a few tough questions, outcome no offer, and called the five interviews excessive; a Senior Software Engineer candidate (via recruiter) found the process too narrow in scope though everyone was pleasant. A 1point3acres thread covers a Senior Backend Software Engineer onsite touching embedded Linux, RTOS, networking and system design (details behind a login). Blind has threads asking about Latitude AI software and systems engineering interviews. A zerogtalent analysis notes no public source documents Latitude's interview stages or evaluation methods. Timeline not reported. Treat this row as thin and verify with the recruiter.
latitudeai.roles: Latitude AI (Ford's automated-driving subsidiary; offices in Pittsburgh, Palo Alto, Detroit, Dearborn). Roles seen: Software Engineer I and Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (including backend), Staff Software Engineer (radar sensors), Senior Software Engineering Manager (multi-object tracking and RTOS), Senior Staff Software Systems Engineer, systems engineers, hardware engineers (lidar) and cyber-security engineers. Posted comp bands are published (for example Software Engineer I $124,400-$198,000), but no interview-stage ladder. I did not use pages about Latitude (Salt Lake City) or Latitude Financial, which are different companies.

layerzero.name: Layerzero
layerzero.note: Backend engineer path per Glassdoor reports (2025-2026):
layerzero.roles: Sources are for LayerZero Labs (omnichain interoperability protocol; Vancouver BC, remote). Engineering roles seen: Backend Engineer (most Glassdoor reports), Web3 Systems Engineer, Engineering Manager, Engineering Operations Lead, blockchain / smart-contract engineers in North America, plus marketing roles. I did not use pages about LayerZero Power Systems, a different company (its internship page appears in results). No numeric ladder seen.
steps: Application online or via recruiter; pleasant recruiter screen

First interview online with a team member (described as interesting), then practical system-design rounds: candidates are handed system requirements and asked what decisions they would make (one candidate says the interview centered on practical system design, which they appreciated)
Further rounds where interviewer quality was inconsistent: some professional and well prepared, others less structured and engaged; one candidate wanted more structured communication and visual aids

Decision. A 1point3acres thread covers an HR call for blockchain / smart-contract roles in North America with pay, relocation and system design stages (details behind a login). Timeline: one June 2025 report says 3 weeks; others do not state it. Recent candidates are mostly no-offer with mixed or negative experiences. Treat this row as thin.

lead-bank.name: Lead Bank
lead-bank.note: Few reports, so only a rough picture:
lead-bank.roles: Lead Bank (Kansas City / Omaha based digital bank). Software Engineer / SDE full-time roles; other role titles not confirmed in sources I saw. Levels are not published. Several search results were for similarly named banks (U.S. Bank, Leader Bank, Allica Bank), which I ignored.
steps: Recruiter screen
Technical phone screen (practical task: CRUD operations and a binary-search implementation in an event-management context, including pagination)

Onsite / virtual rounds: two coding rounds plus a system design (a hotel reservation system is reported); one Glassdoor report describes a sequence of recruiter, hiring manager, team and director conversations of about 30 minutes each, scheduled back to back
Decision. Timeline not clearly reported.

league.name: League
