league.roles: Software Engineer (Backend in Go and MongoDB, Platform, Apps and Solutions), Senior Software Engineer (Backend, Frontend Web, iOS, Frontend Core Team), Software Engineer Android, Customer Data Engineer, Customer Business Intelligence Engineer. League is the Toronto health benefits platform; most roles are remote within Canada. Titles with II appear for some senior iOS roles; no other level codes seen.
steps: Application online; a recruiter reaches out if there is alignment and shares the team-specific process
HR / recruiter screen
Take-home project (reported in a 2025 candidate account) and/or hiring manager interview on experience, skills and motivations

Technical screen, then system design for senior roles (one 2025 report was rejected just before the system design round); data roles add a talent interview about culture and compensation expectations and a meet-the-data-team technical discussion
Decision. Guides say about 3-5 weeks over 4 rounds; the company says it commits to giving updates throughout the process (reports vary).

legora.name: Legora
legora.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack Engineer, Engineering Manager, Legal Engineer, Customer Success Engineer, Account Executive. Legal-AI company; most engineering reports are from Stockholm, with some from Chicago and elsewhere.
steps: Application online or via recruiter
Recruiter call on background and interest in the company
Call with a technical manager (reported as intense; past projects and how you fit the team)
Technical round: live coding, or a small test project for some senior cycles, with production-style and PostgreSQL / index questions
Onsite of about three rounds: system design (one report says almost no coding), coding and a case presentation
Decision. About 2 weeks in some reports. Taro stats show low pass rates (about 38% for SWE and 0% for Senior SWE in small samples), and several 2026 candidates describe the process as odd or abrupt.

lendingclub.name: LendingClub
lendingclub.note: Candidate sources describe a fairly conventional process (Taro: pass rate about 29% across 7 SF reports, so selective):
lendingclub.roles: Software Engineer (Java and general backend; San Francisco, Westborough MA and remote), Senior Software Engineer, Principal Software Engineer, Associate Software Engineer, Software Engineer Intern. Levels are not published. Many reports are older (2015-2021), plus some 2023-2026 reports.
steps: Recruiter phone call

One or two technical phone screens (a 2023 candidate says the first round is easy LeetCode, while onsite questions are medium to hard; a 2024 candidate reports LeetCode-medium plus many behavioral questions; older Java reports include OOP basics like abstract class vs interface)

Multi-round onsite or virtual onsite (an older principal-level report describes about 4 hours one-to-one with architects, a principal engineer and a manager; a 2018 intern report has four 45-min onsite interviews)

Decision. Timelines range from 1 week to about 2 months (7 weeks for a 2017 principal referral); one 2026 Dataford report describes the process as chaotic with job description mismatches, while a 2021 report calls it smooth and well organized.

liftoff.name: Liftoff
liftoff.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (San Jose and remote reports, including Terraform/infra-flavoured roles), machine learning engineer, mobile ads engineering, GenAI engineer, engineering manager, product manager. Sources are for Liftoff (including the merged Vungle business). Most Glassdoor reports for engineers are positive with accepted offers. No official level ladder seen.
steps: Application online or via employee referral
Recruiter screen
Technical phone screen (about 45-60 min): practical algorithmic coding with data parsing, such as matrix traversal / printing diagonals, graph shortest path, IP conversion and scheduler-style tasks

Onsite / virtual onsite: LeetCode-style questions, system design (for example a real-time view-counting or ad-event system) and a hands-on project-style coding challenge (e.g. a small console project); behavioral/team fit conversation

Offer. One referral report describes a 4-step process over about 4 weeks; Glassdoor shows about 14 days for software engineer roles and 18 days company-wide (based on few reports). Interviews are described as smooth and friendly.

lila.name: Lila
lila.note: No first-hand candidate reports for software engineers were found. Generic guides describe an initial recruiter call, technical deep dives and final technical assessments, about 5 rounds over roughly 4-6 weeks, with collaboration with research and engineering leads for research roles. Treat all of this as indicative only; one Dataford page is based on a single ML engineer report.
lila.roles: Assumed to be Lila Sciences (AI-driven autonomous science / lab company, Cambridge MA and San Francisco). Software roles on its job board: Software Engineer I and II, Senior Software Engineer (backend, frontend, ML infrastructure, simulation, instrument software, enterprise platform, full stack), Staff and Principal Software Engineer, Senior Principal Software Engineer, plus Research Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer and Technical Program Manager.

linkedin.name: LinkedIn
linkedin.roles: Software Engineer ladder per candidate guides (unofficial): Apprentice, Software Engineer, Senior (IC3), Staff (IC4), Senior Staff (IC5), Principal Staff (IC6), Distinguished, plus engineering manager tracks. Glassdoor also shows many Account Executive / Account Director interview reports.
steps: Resume, cover letter or referral
Recruiter call (15-30 min)
Technical phone screen (~1 hr, video with CoderPad-style tool), or an online coding round
Second recruiter call
Onsite / virtual loop (5-6 hours): LeetCode-style coding with follow-ups, system design, behavioral and a hiring-manager conversation about your projects
Team matching after the loop (process is centralized), then offer. About 4-8 weeks.

lowe-s.name: Lowe's
lowe-s.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports and guides: Timeline: TechPrep says about 2-4 weeks; Taro pass rates are about 31% for Charlotte software engineers across 13 reports; Bengaluru is described as easier. Experience ratings are mostly positive.
lowe-s.roles: Software Engineer (Charlotte NC, Bengaluru, Austin TX, remote), Senior Software Engineer (full stack, frontend, iOS, backend), Android engineer, Software Engineer Internship, Software Developer, store-inventory engineer. A prep site lists a career path of Senior, Staff, Principal, Engineering Manager, Director and VP (unofficial). Retail roles were not researched.
steps: Application online or recruiter outreach (a recruiter called for an Android flagship app role)
Recruiter / HR phone screen (campus and some roles start with an online test the same day)

Online technical assessment (guides) and technical interview(s) over Microsoft Teams: Java and OOP, Spring Boot, collections/threading/streams, Python/algorithms; Android-specific questions for mobile roles; you must know your resume well
Team interviews (reports: recruiter call plus two team interviews; Bengaluru three rounds), a managerial interview and an HR round; guides count 4-6 rounds
Offer

lucid-motors.name: Lucid Motors
lucid-motors.note: Candidate reports vary a lot by team (Taro: pass rate about 29% across 17 US reports; 80% across 5 Newark reports):
lucid-motors.roles: Lucid Motors (electric vehicles; Newark CA, San Francisco, Bay Area). Software Engineer (vehicle software, C++, sensors, infotainment), Embedded Software Engineer (device drivers, data structures), Senior Software Engineer, Staff, Senior Staff and Principal Software Engineer, platform validation and test engineers, DevOps engineers, interns. A third-party site labels engineer levels as Software Engineer 1, 2, Senior 1, Senior 2, Staff, Senior Staff, Principal (unofficial).
steps: Recruiter screen (about 30 min; often a LinkedIn approach), and sometimes a hiring-manager conversation
Technical screen: CoderPad coding (LeetCode-style, time complexity) and domain questions (C++, sensors, Nvidia SoCs, device drivers, functional safety for embedded roles)
Onsite / virtual loop of about 4 hours in a March 2026 report; older reports cite up to 9 rounds, and a software engineer lead technical interview followed by a second one for non-local candidates
Decision. Glassdoor timelines range from about 3-4 weeks to 2 months, with some reports of long recruiter delays and no closure.

luma.name: Luma
luma.roles: Staff Backend Engineer, Senior AI Engineer, Research Engineer, Product Engineer (frontend, enterprise platform), Enterprise Backend Engineer, Staff Design Engineer, Data Scientist. Sources are for Luma AI (generative video / 3D AI company), Palo Alto based with remote roles.
steps: Application online or via recruiter
Recruiter screen (reported as positive and quick; replies usually within 2-3 days, with flexible scheduling)

Take-home assessment: an open-ended build-something-end-to-end project (choose a problem such as reverse-engineering an undocumented API), estimated at 8-12 hours; recent cycles allow AI coding tools and ask for a deployable product, documentation, a video walkthrough and AI session history
Technical and behavioral interviews for those who pass; research engineer reports describe a typical mix of both
Decision. A fast-paced process, about 2 weeks in one report. Several 2026 candidates describe the unpaid full-day take-home and a template rejection with no feedback as negatives.

luma-ai.name: Luma AI
luma-ai.note: Candidate sources describe a fast, sequential, gated process (Glassdoor average about 25 days across roles; reports of 2-4 weeks):
luma-ai.roles: Luma AI (generative video / 3D, San Francisco and Palo Alto). Software Engineer (AI product engineering), Staff Software Engineer, Staff Backend Engineer, Research Engineer (II), Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer, Product Manager, Recruiter. Glassdoor notes Staff SWE and Research Engineer interviews were rated hardest. Levels are not published.
steps: Recruiter screen

Online assessment: two unproctored CodeSignal OAs are reported for software engineers (one candidate ran out of time both times); staff-level candidates report a take-home assessment after the recruiter screen
Take-home review, a chat with the CTO, and system design (a build-Uber style problem is reported) in the AI product engineering loop; research engineers face harder technical rounds
Decision. Taro shows 0% pass rate in small staff-level samples with very negative experiences; one candidate says they were given no time to ask questions.

lumen.name: Lumen
lumen.roles: Software Engineer (largest group by far, 279 Glassdoor reports), Senior Software Engineer, Senior Lead Software Engineer / Developer, Principal Software Development Engineer, Software Developer, Java Developer, Site Reliability and DevOps engineers, plus many network, sales and project roles. Reports come from the US, Bengaluru and Noida campuses. Level names in listings include Senior Lead and Principal tiers; no other codes seen.
steps: Application online, campus or recruiter
Initial screen: a one-way video or AI-led interview (HireVue style; questions on screen and recorded answers) that is mostly introductory, and for some candidates an online assessment

Technical rounds: Java basics, OOP, threads, collections, Spring, Hibernate and DSA problems (India reports describe up to 3 technical rounds), or a recruiter-to-panel process that is resume-driven for US roles
Hackathon and presentation for some campus candidates, then a managerial round and an HR round

Decision. Glassdoor shows about 16 days for software engineers; individual reports range from 1 day to 7 months, and a guide says about a month with poor communication after interviews (reports vary).

lyft.name: Lyft
lyft.roles: Software Engineer (frontend, backend, pricing; levels L4/T3-T9 in candidate guides, unofficial, up to Staff and Principal), Associate Product Manager (APM), Operations Manager, and engineers on Lyft Urban Solutions.
steps: Recruiter screen (~30 min)
Technical phone screen (~1 hr with a Lyft engineer, algorithms)

Virtual onsite of ~4 rounds: system design (~60 min, large Lyft-relevant system drawn in a shared tool), CS fundamentals, a unique 90-min 'Laptop Programming Test' where you can use the internet and any language, and behavioral
Team matching: explanatory calls with managers of potential teams, then offer. About 4-6 weeks; recruiter communication can be slow.

marshall-wace.name: Marshall Wace
marshall-wace.note: Marshall Wace publishes its own Quant Associate process guide and Quant Intern application guide (cdn.mwam.com PDFs; only snippets visible). Per those and third-party guides (QuantVault says 7 stages, the firm says up to 5 stages after CV screening; roles vary): Timeline: reports vary a lot, from 2 weeks (Hong Kong) to 2-3 months; one candidate reports 6 steps and an assessment centre with a general rejection email after 3 weeks of silence. Glassdoor candidates call the process difficult but mostly positive.
marshall-wace.roles: Marshall Wace (London-based alternative investment manager; offices in London, Hong Kong, New York and others). Roles seen: Quant Researcher (Quant Associate programme / TOPS), Quant Developer (Quant Implementation / TOPS; Python, MATLAB, C++, Java, Linux, DevOps), Quantitative Software Developer, Quantitative Developer, Quant Research Intern and technology interns. No numeric ladder; entry routes are the Quant Associate programme and internships.
steps: CV screening, then an initial test: a roughly 2-2.5 hour in-person maths/statistics test at a Pearson test centre (current cycle; maths, probability, statistics, linear regression), or an online Codility test for technology internships
Human Capital screening call (15-30 min, Zoom)

Lab interview (about 1 hour, Zoom with a quant; some reports 2 hours): technical and brainteaser rounds (the firm says you solve two brainteasers and a forecasting interview on predictive modelling and quantitative finance); developer tracks add coding (Python data handling, JSON parsing, sliding windows)
Project presentation and assessment-day / London assessment centre with several interviews, then offer

mathworks.name: MathWorks
mathworks.note: Timeline: reports vary a lot, from about 1 day (campus) to 2 months; Glassdoor averages about 29 days for the company overall and longer for software engineer roles.
mathworks.roles: Software Engineer (largest share of Glassdoor reports), Associate Software Engineer, Senior and Principal Software Engineer, Software Engineer in Test / Quality Engineer, Applications Engineer, internships, and the Engineering Development Group (EDG) early-career program (C++/MATLAB/Simulink flavoured work). Third-party sites suggest a ladder from Software Engineer 1 up to Principal / Consultant plus M2/M3 management levels (unofficial, from a candidate-prep site).
steps: Online application, or campus/EDG application

Early screening gate: online assessment or video/phone screen (candidate guides mention a video round with questions about MathWorks and the EDG role; Glassdoor stats show phone interview and skills test as the most common first stages)
Technical interviews: C/C++ and data structures/algorithms, OOP, math-flavoured or string-handling problems, MATLAB/Simulink-related topics for some teams, and a project discussion or presentation
Further technical/architecture conversation for experienced hires, plus behavioral and cultural-fit conversations (guides describe a friendly, collaborative style, 4-6 rounds)
Offer, background check

maven-securities.name: Maven Securities
maven-securities.note: Trader and research path per candidate reports and guides (several guides say it runs 4 stages over about 4-8 weeks): Software/C++ developer path is shorter: Glassdoor shows C++ Developer and Software Engineer rated hardest, and Software Development Engineer quickest (about 14 days). Timeline: Glassdoor shows about 45 days across 7 reports (up to 90 days for graduate traders).
maven-securities.roles: Maven Securities is a London-headquartered, employee-owned options market maker (with offices including Amsterdam and Chicago). Roles seen: Graduate Trader / Quantitative Trader, Junior Quant Trader, Quantitative Researcher, Software Engineer, C++ Developer, Software Development Engineer, FPGA Engineer. Maven's published Emerging Talent process covers applications, role-dependent assessments, interviews and a possible assessment centre or final stage. No level ladder seen beyond graduate / junior.
steps: Application, then online assessments: timed mental maths (about 50 arithmetic questions in 5 minutes), number or letter sequences (about 30 in 6 minutes), a probability and problem-solving test, and for some cycles an Arctic Shores or coding test; formats differed between London and the U.S. in the 2027 cycle
Recorded video interview (about 20 minutes, on demand, no live interviewer, per Maven's graduate profile; not prescribed for every candidate)
HR + technical interview (about 15-40 minutes with a trader and HR): percentages, confidence interval estimates, comparing large numbers, a first market-making game, probability and combinatorics

Assessment day with senior traders: market-making and card games, estimation (Fermi) questions, repeat of the maths and probability tests in person, then individual interviews; later rounds include options/Greeks questions

mavenclinic.name: Mavenclinic
mavenclinic.roles: Software Engineer (backend, Python / Flask, React front end), Senior Software Engineer (Backend, Android, AI/ML), Staff and Principal Software Engineer, Senior Front-End Engineer, Data Engineer, Data Analyst, Product Manager, Product Analyst. Maven Clinic is a virtual women's and family health company based in New York with remote hubs.
steps: Application online or hiring-manager outreach (one reviewer says there is no traditional process and the hiring manager contacts you directly)
Initial HR / recruiter phone screen (one 2025 candidate describes the HR person as rude)
Hiring-manager interview
Technical assessment: web services / REST APIs, JSON processing, backend API design, requirements gathering, system design
Virtual onsite for some roles: coding, technical deep dive, design, leadership and behavioral rounds of about 30-45 min each
Decision. Reports vary: about 2-4 weeks per one guide; Glassdoor reports show 2 weeks to 2 months. Experiences are mixed and the evidence is thin.

mercor.name: Mercor
mercor.note: Timeline: reports vary, roughly 2-4 weeks; one aggregator quotes about 14 days average from Glassdoor.
mercor.roles: Two very different streams. (1) Mercor's own staff hires: software/backend/AI engineers, plus operations-type roles (a Glassdoor report mentions a recruiter screen, case study, onsite and a head-of-ops round). Levels not clearly given; one Exponent report tags an entry-level/L3 data scientist role (unofficial). (2) A large volume of reports is about the Mercor talent marketplace, where contractors such as AI trainers, coding analysts and domain experts apply for project work through the platform.
steps: Application on the Mercor platform: upload resume
AI-led interview (about 20 min per candidate reports), questions adapt to your resume and earlier answers; the company's own docs say a human interview cannot be requested instead
Job-specific assessment (for example a coding test or project-style task)
For staff engineering roles, candidates report a recruiter call, then a technical/coding round, a manager conversation, and one long final round (up to about five stages in one guide)
For ops-type roles, one report describes recruiter screen, case study, onsite, then head-of-ops interview

meta.name: Meta
meta.note: Total about 4-8 weeks, though some candidates report 3-4 months. Meta tells candidates the round types in advance.
meta.roles: Software Engineer is the main public title, covering roughly E3-E7 (E3 junior up to E8 principal+ for ICs). Other roles show up in candidate reports: Data Scientist, Data Engineer, Production Engineer, Product Manager, Program Manager, Technical Sourcer, plus internships.
steps: Recruiter call (walks through the process)
Technical screen: 1-2 coding problems in ~35 min (some regions report a ~90 min online assessment first)
Virtual onsite: 3-5 interviews - coding, system design, behavioral (E4 guide counts 5 rounds total)
Team matching after the loop, then offer

metropolis.name: Metropolis
metropolis.roles: Software Engineer (customer experience, backend, edge, Advanced Technologies), Senior Software Engineer, Staff Software Engineer, Virtual Performance Software Engineer, Data Scientist. Sources are for Metropolis Technologies (parking / computer-vision company); NVIDIA's 'Metropolis' platform and the retailer METRO also appeared and were ignored. Offices: New York, Seattle, Bengaluru.
steps: Application online or recruiter
Recruiter / hiring-manager screen (a 2026 report mentions an HM screen)
Tech phone screen: practical data tasks such as parsing a CSV and answering questions on the data, user categorization

Pair-programming round with an engineer on a real-world exercise (coding on a day-to-day basis, collaboration, code fluency, turning logic into code); a three-round loop is reported by one 1point3acres candidate, and a Bengaluru report describes three rounds ending in a resume and tech-stack deep dive
Decision. Reports vary: about 1-2 weeks, though a 2023 senior candidate reports 2 months. Metropolis states candidates must not use AI for live answers during interviews.

micro1.name: Micro1
micro1.roles: Software Engineer (largest group), Web Software Engineer, Software Developer, Senior Software Engineer, Frontend Engineer, Backend Engineer, QA Engineer, plus AI Training Expert, Data Annotation and independent contractor roles in Glassdoor counts. micro1 is an AI talent platform that places engineers and experts; no official level codes seen.
steps: Application online or via recruiter; automated invitation to an AI interview

AI-led screening interview (about 20-50 minutes, interactive chat or AI avatar video, sometimes live with an AI interviewer called Zara): behavioral and technical questions where candidates must keep speaking while thinking, covering JavaScript / TypeScript, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL and data structures
Practical coding exercise or live coding assessment (described as easy but not rewarding deeper experience)
Possible follow-up human or client round for placement

Decision. Glassdoor shows a very short process of about 1-2 days on average; Taro shows a low pass rate (about 11 percent among 44 software engineer experiences) and most reports ended without an offer (reports vary).

microsoft.name: Microsoft
microsoft.roles: Software Engineer / SDE ladder: SDE (L59-60, entry), SDE II (L61-62), Senior (L63-64), Principal (L65-67), Partner (L68+) per candidate guides (unofficial). Glassdoor also lists Program Manager, Senior Program Manager, Director, Project Manager and internships. Pay bands from guides vary widely.
steps: Resume screen via careers portal, referral or LinkedIn
Recruiter email or call
First round: online assessment (Codility reported) or 45-60 min phone/Teams screen with an engineer or hiring manager
Final loop, usually virtual: several coding and system design rounds (design weighted more at senior/principal), with more behavioral time than Google/Meta and a growth-mindset focus
Debrief, then offer. Typically about 4-8 weeks.

millennium.name: Millennium
millennium.note: Highly decentralized: rounds depend on whether you interview for a firm-wide platform team or a specific trading pod. Typical stages from candidate sources (about 5 stages, 3-6 weeks, 3-8 rounds counted):
millennium.roles: Millennium Management (multi-manager hedge fund, pod model). Software Engineer / Quant Developer (trading systems, data infrastructure, low-latency), Senior, Lead and Principal Software Engineer (per a candidate guide, unofficial), Software Engineer Intern, Data Engineer, Data Scientist, Quantitative Researcher / Analyst, Business Analyst, Financial Analyst.
steps: Application / recruiter or manager screen (~20-30 min)
Timed online assessment (HackerRank coding, SQL, sometimes ML; e.g. sliding-window and OOP problems)
Caliper personality test mentioned for some tracks
Several technical rounds: data structures, Java or Python internals, SQL, async/debugging problems, resume deep dive, system design for senior levels
Hiring manager / PM or pod-fit conversation, then offer.

mintlify.name: Mintlify
mintlify.note: Engineering path per candidate reports and job postings:
mintlify.roles: Product Engineer, Senior Product Engineer, Software Engineer (including recent grad), Backend AI Engineer / Senior AI Engineer (LLM fine-tuning, RAG, evals), Full Stack Engineer, Solutions Engineer and Engineering Manager; mostly San Francisco in-person with a small team. No official level ladder beyond job titles.
steps: Application online or in person; a culture interview (30-minute video call) appears in a job posting
Initial call with the CTO / founding team (about 30 min)
Take-home assessment
Debugging interview: debug issues in a realistic codebase

Onsite with the team (one September 2025 report: 4 rounds, CTO then take-home, debugging, onsite, about 3 weeks); Mintlify's own hiring page says every team hires a little differently, with a realistic process that feels like working there; postings also mention a flexible 'showcase' stage focused on your area of expertise
Offer. Reports describe the process as lengthy but meaningful and well tailored; Glassdoor volume is small.

mistral-ai.name: Mistral AI
mistral-ai.roles: Software Engineer (API platform, internal tooling, customer-facing products), AI Engineer, Applied AI Engineer, Applied Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer, Research Engineer, Forward-Deployed Engineer, Data Scientist, Data Engineer, Product Manager. Offices mentioned in reports: Paris and London. Dataford lists Software Engineer as the most reported role.
steps: Application, or outreach from a Mistral employee on LinkedIn
Recruiter / HR call (reports say it can already be fairly technical and covers past projects)
Technical rounds: coding, plus ML / generative-AI fundamentals for AI and ML roles, code review and project discussion
System design and AI-infrastructure discussion (distributed systems, performance, scalability) for software engineers
Culture / autonomy conversation and a team or stakeholder interview; some data roles add a challenge; offer and HR discussion at the end

Decision. Reports vary: 4 rounds in one Interview Query summary, 5-6 rounds in several others; no consistent timeline was reported. Sample sizes are small and a few candidates describe the experience as negative.

mithril.name: Mithril
mithril.note: For Mithril (a): the only evidence is a generic prep page describing a 30-min initial call and a 45-60 min technical interview, plus a PracHub page with a small set of software-engineer questions; no first-hand loop details were found, so treat as indicative only. For Mithril Security (b), from its own internship posting and Glassdoor: 1. HR chat, 2. take-home assignment of about 2-3 days (e.g. switch a platform's browser automation from Selenium to Playwright), 3. interview with a security engineer, 4. final interview with the CEO (in person in Paris). One Glassdoor report says the process took about 3 days and was negative with no offer.
mithril.roles: Name is ambiguous. Three companies appeared: (a) Mithril, an AI compute marketplace company (formerly Foundry), hiring Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack), Senior Product Engineer (Marketplace) and finance / ops roles, likely the best match for a software-engineering report set; (b) Mithril Security, a Paris cybersecurity / confidential-AI startup with internships; (c) IOG's Mithril blockchain project (Senior Software Engineer, Rust). Roles below are mostly for (a) and (b).

mixpanel.name: Mixpanel
mixpanel.note: Engineering path per candidate reports: Timeline: reports vary, about 3-4 weeks in the reports I saw. Support-engineer reports describe funnel-analysis questions and some poor communication after interviews.
mixpanel.roles: Software Engineer (largest share of Glassdoor reports), Software Development Engineer, senior engineers (one report mentions interviewing with a 'SE III' engineer, unofficial), software engineering managers, technical support / support engineers, solutions architect / sales engineer, plus account executives, sales, customer success and recruiting. A third-party prep site lists an L2-L6 engineer ladder (unofficial, from a candidate-prep site).
steps: Application online or via referral
Initial screening / recruiter call (about 30-45 min)
Technical interview with an engineer (live coding, graph traversal, recursion such as parsing nested JSON; senior reports add system design)
Take-home assignment for some candidates (one July 2025 report: screening, interview with a senior engineer, take-home, then further rounds)
Presentation or project discussion round (Glassdoor stats list presentation as the common stage for SDE) and behavioral/hiring-manager conversation
Decision

modal.name: Modal
modal.roles: Software Engineer (systems, backend, infrastructure), Forward Deployed Engineer (ML and systems), Infrastructure Security Engineer, Detection and Response Engineer, Developer Relations Engineer, Solutions Architect, plus product and design roles. Modal Labs is a serverless GPU compute company with most engineering roles in New York and some in Stockholm. No official level codes seen. A Glassdoor listing for a different company named Modal (Integration Engineer, SQL / HTML questions) was not used.
steps: Application online or recruiter outreach
Recruiter screen (about 30 min)

Technical screen / coding rounds (one to two in Python, Rust or Go, systems-flavored: concurrent worker pool, scheduling primitive, container-runtime interface, stream with backpressure; a guide also mentions reasoning about GPU process state during checkpointing)
Possible design task, then a final virtual or onsite loop including system design and a behavioral round checking for agency and customer empathy
Decision. Guides say 4-5 rounds and about 2-3 weeks; Modal does not publish an interview guide and public candidate reports are few (reports vary).

modular.name: Modular
modular.note: I did not find candidate-written interview reports for Modular, so the stage-by-stage process is not available. What Modular's own postings say: the Mojo Compiler Engineer posting notes that people who have read Pierce's 'Types and Programming Languages' and can present a proof can skip an interview, which hints that language-theory interviews are part of the compiler loop; postings also tell candidates to ask the recruiter for accommodations during the interview process. A Scoutify page advises asking the recruiter which skills each interview will cover and points to Mojo / kernel programming skills (Triton, TileLang, CuTe, AI-assisted kernel development) for performance roles.
modular.roles: Modular (Modular AI; Mojo language, MAX platform; US, Canada, remote; now described in postings as a Qualcomm company). Mojo Compiler Engineer (mid level, 3-5 yrs, MLIR), Mojo Compiler Engineering Manager, Mojo Libraries Engineer (Mojo standard library and kernel libraries; 5 yrs in one aggregator listing), Serving Libraries and APIs Engineer (3+ yrs, C++ / Python, async networking), Hardware Enablement Engineer and Principal Engineer, AI Performance Engineer (Mojo kernels, Triton / CuTe experience), Software Engineer postings with Mojo kernels. Levels appear as Mid / Senior / Principal / Manager.

moloco.name: Moloco
moloco.roles: Software Engineer (SWE I, SWE II, Senior, Staff, Senior Staff per third-party guides, unofficial), Backend Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, Data Engineer. Glassdoor report counts are led by Software Engineer, then Data Scientist, Growth Manager and Account Manager.
steps: Application online or via recruiter
Recruiter screen (visa sponsorship and logistics questions come up)
Online coding assessment on CodeSignal (one Seoul report describes about 70 minutes with 3 problems), then live coding
Further rounds: behavioral and culture conversations, system design (including adtech ML system design for ML roles), and in one account AI-assisted coding and a bar-raiser style round
Decision. Glassdoor shows about 1-6 weeks across reports (reports vary).

molocoads.name: Molocoads
molocoads.roles: Software Engineer (SWE I, SWE II, Senior, Staff, Senior Staff per third-party guides, unofficial), Backend Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, Data Engineer. Glassdoor report counts are led by Software Engineer, then Data Scientist, Growth Manager and Account Manager.
steps: Application online or via recruiter
Recruiter screen (visa sponsorship and logistics questions come up)
Online coding assessment on CodeSignal (one Seoul report describes about 70 minutes with 3 problems), then live coding
Further rounds: behavioral and culture conversations, system design (including adtech ML system design for ML roles), and in one account AI-assisted coding and a bar-raiser style round
Decision. Glassdoor shows about 1-6 weeks across reports (reports vary).

mongodb.name: MongoDB
mongodb.roles: Software Engineer (Associate SWE, SWE 2 / SE3 style titles, Senior, Staff, Senior Staff, Distinguished per candidate guides, unofficial), Software Engineering Intern, Solutions Architect, Consulting Engineer. Glassdoor report volume is dominated by sales roles: Enterprise Account Executive is the largest, followed by Software Engineer, Account Executive and Account Development Representative, then Senior Software Engineer and Solutions Architect.
steps: Application online, through a recruiter, or via university
Recruiter screen

Technical screen of about 60 min: live coding with an engineer, explaining reasoning aloud; concurrency (e.g. thread-safe sets, executors), database concepts, merging streams, rate limiter style problems

Hiring-manager round, and for many levels a virtual onsite of several rounds (one senior report mentions 5 onsite interviews): coding, API / system design, Java code review, past-project and behavioral questions
Decision. Reports vary: about 3-5 weeks in most guides; Glassdoor shows MongoDB overall at about 31 days, and one senior candidate says the process took a long time.

moody-s.name: Moody's
moody-s.roles: Software Engineer (incl. Backend, Senior, Principal), Assistant Software Engineer (ASE), Software Development Engineer, Software Developer. Moody's is a risk-analytics and ratings company; offices: New York, Charlotte, West Chester PA, Toronto, Bengaluru, Gurgaon. The sheet's reports may also cover non-engineering roles, which were not researched.
steps: Application online, recruiter, referral or university
HR / recruiter screening on background, experience and motivation

Technical rounds (2-3 typical): resume-driven technical questions, .NET, OOP, SQL and Angular for some teams, string and backtracking coding problems, memory and internals questions, a principal-engineer round, and for backend cycles a system design / HLD round with a staff engineer
Managerial / behavioral round on problem-solving approach and domain knowledge

Decision. Reports vary: about 1 day (campus) to 4-6 weeks for most, and up to 2-3 months in a few Bengaluru cases. Several candidates call the process well-structured and professional, while others find it long; one 2026 candidate was told the role was too junior.

morgan-stanley.name: Morgan Stanley
morgan-stanley.note: Technology Analyst / Summer Analyst path per candidate reports: Timeline: reports vary widely; Glassdoor shows about 31 days on average for Technology Analyst and about 40 days company-wide. Other divisions (investment banking, wealth management, operations) were not researched here.
morgan-stanley.roles: Very broad bank. Glassdoor interview-report volume is led by Associate, Vice President, Analyst, Manager, Director, intern/summer analyst, client service associate and software developer roles. The technology-side reports I saw focus on Technology Analyst (Technology Analyst Program, TAP, a graduate program), Technology Summer Analyst, and software developer roles; the business analyst function inside technology is also mentioned. Division-level levels (Analyst, Associate, VP, Director) are generic bank titles from the reports; no engineering level ladder seen.
steps: Application online, through campus, or via referral; campus events can fast-track you
Online assessment for some tracks (one report: 7 debugging, 10 aptitude and 3 easy-to-medium coding questions)
Phone or campus interview with an engineer or hiring manager: resume/project discussion, OOP, data structures, databases, Java fundamentals, easy LeetCode-style coding

Final round / Super Day: reported as about 2 technical interviews plus 1 behavioral (data structures, algorithms, CS fundamentals, 'why Morgan Stanley', technology-trend questions); one onsite had a panel with program alumni
Offer, background check

morningstar.name: Morningstar
morningstar.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports and guides: Timeline: Glassdoor shows about 13 days for software engineers (10 reports) and 18 days company-wide; reports range from 1 day to 4 weeks, with one 2015 report taking over 2 months. Interview Query lists about 3-4 rounds and says formats vary by team and level; Glassdoor rates difficulty 3/5 and about 50% positive.
morningstar.roles: Glassdoor interview volume is led by Data Research Analyst (about 462), Research Associate (181), Software Engineer (151), Analyst, Senior Software Engineer (102), Data Analyst, Product Manager, MDP Associate (58, the Morningstar Development Program) and Associate Software Engineer (36). Engineering sites: Chicago IL, Mumbai / Navi Mumbai, Toronto, London, Boston. Posted US bands include Software Engineer $90-131k and Senior $114-167k. No official numeric ladder seen.
steps: Application online, via recruiter, referral or campus (MDP / Associate Software Engineer drives in India)

Online test or take-home coding for some tracks (SQL, Java OOP, Python), or recruiter / phone screen; Glassdoor stage stats show one-on-one interview, group panel and phone screen as the common stages

Technical interviews: practical discussion over pure algorithm drilling per Interview Query; reports mention SQL and stock-price problems, AWS usage, reflection, DOM and tuples vs sets for associate roles, and a one-hour whiteboard system design; a 2022 Toronto report: first round with a senior engineer (straight to technical), second round a long panel with seven people covering behavioral, system design and frontend
Behavioral / HR round, then offer

motive.name: Motive
motive.roles: Software Engineer (backend), Senior Software Engineer, Frontend Engineer, Mobile / Android Engineer, Solutions Engineer. Reports come from San Francisco and Pakistan hubs (Lahore, Karachi). No official level codes seen. Sheet links gomotive.com (Motive Technologies, the fleet management company).
steps: Application online, via recruiter or campus
HR / recruiter screening (about 30 min)
Hiring manager interview (about 45 min) on experience
Technical interview and live coding (LeetCode-style, about 1 hour)
Interview loop of about 5 hours: two coding rounds, a system design round, a real-world challenge / API implementation round, plus manager and HR rounds; one candidate counted 7 interviews
Decision. Reports say each stage takes about a week, so about 3-8 weeks in total; several candidates call it long and drawn-out (reports vary).

moveworks.name: Moveworks
moveworks.note: Candidate sources describe a long, multi-stage process, about 4-6 weeks (up to 6 in Glassdoor reports):
moveworks.roles: Moveworks (enterprise conversational AI, Mountain View; Moveworks.ai). Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Staff Software Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer. Levels are not published.
steps: Recruiter / hiring-manager call (~30 min on your experience and the role)

1-hour technical interview with a senior engineer (LeetCode-style problems with corner cases, e.g. dynamic programming, string manipulation, Word Break variants; one report mentions a hangman-style problem)
Hiring-manager screen, then more technical rounds (including system design, e.g. a car-rental HLD, and SQL-style data manipulation for some roles)

Full virtual onsite loop (guides count several system design rounds, a presentation session and conversations with leadership), then decision. Several candidates call the process very long and say they received little feedback.

nash-ai.name: Nash AI
nash-ai.note: Per Nash's own listing on Work at a Startup (YC) for a Forward Deployed Engineer: 1) initial screen (alignment of your background to Nash's need), 2) Technical Interview #1, 3) Technical Interview #2; the posting was cut off after that, so later steps and timeline are not known. A 1point3acres thread describes a tech phone screen for an SDE at NashAI with a Minesweeper object-oriented design challenge (details behind a login). Timeline not reported; very few candidate reports exist.
nash-ai.roles: Nash (nash.ai, a YC S21 logistics / delivery infrastructure startup based in San Francisco) hires Forward Deployed Engineers (including Melbourne hybrid), software engineers and SDEs. I did not use pages about Nash Squared / Harvey Nash (a recruiter), Nash direct, or Nash Technologies Germany, which are different companies. No level ladder seen.

natoora.name: Natoora
natoora.note: Store / operations roles per candidate reports: Timeline: Indeed data say about a day or two for 70% of reporters and about a week for another 15%; Glassdoor shows ratings around 100% positive for few reports. Data / pricing analyst roles (Feb 2026): a technical phone screen focused on data infrastructure, ETL pipelines and LLM project claims; process details beyond the screen were not found.
natoora.roles: Natoora is a London-founded seasonal fresh-produce supplier (founded 2001) with operations in the UK, US (Miami, New York) and Australia. Roles seen: store assistant, barista / cafe staff, buyers (cheese, charcuterie, junior night buyer), sourcing lead, customer account manager, fulfillment manager, field service representative, and some data roles (price analyst / data analyst). Software engineering is rare; one Portuguese-language Glassdoor report is for a junior programming role. No level ladder seen.
steps: Application online or by email with CV and cover letter
Phone call or Zoom with HR / recruiter (background, why Natoora, situational questions), sometimes an online video stage
In-person or video chat with the team or store manager; reports call it informal, friendly and easy, with interest in sustainable food or prior cafe experience helping
Offer

natwest.name: NatWest
natwest.roles: Software Engineer (campus and experienced), Software Engineer (VP) / Vice President level, Software Engineer Android, Software Developer, QA Engineer, plus a huge non-engineering mix across the bank. Reports come from Gurgaon, Chennai, Bengaluru and UK sites. A VP level is mentioned in Glassdoor titles; no other level codes seen. The sheet links natwestgroup.com.
steps: Application online, campus, staffing agency or recruiter outreach on LinkedIn; some hiring is through drives organised for multiple roles
Online assessment and coding test (campus on-campus process reported as two rounds starting with an OA; others describe a straightforward test)
Video interview stage (guides say it carries significant weight), then a short technical discussion of about 30 minutes with two people

Technical round on DSA, Java, OOP, SQL and backend discussion (a linked-list code question was reported), followed by an HR round; a Virtual Assessment Centre (VAC) step is mentioned for some candidates
Decision. Reports range from 1-2 weeks (campus) to 3-5 weeks in guides, with some delays before the VAC invitation (reports vary).

navan.name: Navan
navan.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports: Timeline: guides say 4-5 rounds; reports range from 1 day to 3 weeks, with one 2019 Palo Alto case taking 3 months. Taro pass rate is about 6% across 18 reports; some candidates describe slow hiring or messy processes.
navan.roles: Navan (formerly TripActions) hires Software Engineer (backend, frontend, full-stack, SDE), Senior Software Engineer, Staff Software Engineer, new grad engineers, mobile engineers and AI roles. Offices: Palo Alto / San Francisco, Amsterdam, Berlin, India and remote. No official level ladder seen.
steps: Application online, via recruiter or campus
HR / recruiter screening call (behavioral, classic questions)
Online assessment: CodeSignal test or a HackerRank-style OA with two medium questions, sometimes locked to Java; frontend and new-grad backend variants exist
Technical phone screen: LeetCode-style problems such as LRU cache, linked-list addition, SetAll data structure, live coding on CoderPad

Onsite / virtual onsite: about four interviews in a full-stack role (coding, low-level design, high-level system design such as designing Google Flights, and behavioral) plus a one-hour manager round; final screen with an engineering manager

nclusion.name: Nclusion
nclusion.note: I found no candidate-written interview reports or published process for Nclusion, so the stages are unknown. Only postings (on-site or hybrid, Palo Alto) and a job-board prep page with generic product questions were seen. Treat the loop as unconfirmed.
nclusion.roles: Likely Nclusion (fintech for the unbanked: savings, investing, transfers; Palo Alto CA, 51-200 employees, growth stage) based on postings found on ZipRecruiter and Marketing Monk: Senior Software Engineer - Crypto Infrastructure (custody, transaction processing, key management, indexing, blockchain integrations), Backend Software Engineer, Backend Engineer, Frontend Engineer, Product Manager - Growth and Gaming. Other results (Inclusion Cloud, Nexient, Nuclein, Neodocto) were different companies and were ignored.

nebius.name: Nebius
nebius.note: Nebius publishes its own engineering interview pages (nebius.com/engineering-interviews and role pages for backend and frontend; only snippets visible). Per those and DesignGurus' summary: apply (Nebius says it responds within three business days); a recruiter conversation; a preliminary interview; technical and algorithm interviews; a system design section; final meetings; each interview lasts about one hour on Zoom, with feedback promised within a week; one of the final stages is a 90-minute Technical Deep Dive about one significant project you have worked on; the company asks you to think out loud. Candidate reports: a first round of an online test (four HackerRank coding tests; the Glassdoor FAQ says unlimited time but expected under 2 hours, HR replies within a week), then recruiter screen and tech screen (concurrency questions; Python allowed), coding round (LeetCode medium-to-hard), system design and a hiring-manager interview; a referral candidate was promised 4-5 stages with 3 technical but was withdrawn after the third tech interview; a C++ candidate (September 2026) says to read the project description before the technical round. Timeline: Glassdoor shows about 75 days for software engineers (5 reports) vs 47 days company-wide; reports vary from a quick process to months. Most Taro reports are no offer; some candidates say the outcome felt arbitrary or feedback was missing.
nebius.roles: Nebius (AI cloud / infrastructure; Amsterdam, Belgrade, other European sites, and a US presence). Roles seen: Software Engineer (backend, frontend, C++), Senior Software Engineer (including C++ teams), Lead Software Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, Product Manager (TractoAI), plus Glassdoor volume mostly Software Engineer and Senior Software Engineer from Amsterdam. No numeric level ladder seen.

netapp.name: Netapp
netapp.note: Reports vary by team and country; Glassdoor average is about 6 days for engineers and 11 days company-wide, while some candidates report a month for the full loop:
netapp.roles: Software Engineer (C/C++, Go, Java, Python, cloud / distributed systems, Kubernetes, embedded firmware, StorageGRID, Azure NetApp Files), Member of Technical Staff, Senior Software Engineer, Software Developer Engineer in Test, Technical Support Engineer, Software Engineer Intern (many in Bengaluru, Raleigh, San Jose, Cork). Glassdoor's most-reported roles: Software Engineer, Member of Technical Staff, Technical Support Engineer, Senior Software Engineer.
steps: Recruiter screen (basic profile and fit discussion)
Hiring manager round (heavier on behavioral questions)

Three to four technical rounds of about 45 min each, usually over Zoom: DSA (trees, arrays, stacks and queues, dynamic programming), writing pseudo-code, Python / pytest mocking questions, design questions and, in India, Kubernetes and Go concurrency discussion; some campus drives do all rounds on the same day
Decision; some candidates report a week or more of silence before a portal update.

netflix.name: Netflix
netflix.roles: Mostly senior engineers: Senior Software Engineer is the most common title, plus Software Engineer, Staff and Principal / Software Architect levels (job postings use numbered titles like Software Engineer 4 and Software Architect/Engineer 6). Glassdoor also shows Customer Service Representative, Production Assistant, Manager and Director reports.
steps: Initial recruiter / HR phone screen
Technical phone interview with an engineer or hiring manager (team-specific; coding plus technical depth)

Onsite or virtual panel: several interviews with engineers (LeetCode-style coding, software architecture / design), a hiring manager conversation, and a strong culture-memo ('freedom and responsibility') fit assessment
Decision. Team-specific and relatively fast: about 3-5 weeks, though one candidate report says a little over two months.

new-relic.name: New Relic
new-relic.roles: Software Engineer (largest report group), Senior Software Engineer, Associate Software Engineer (campus / early career, Bengaluru, Hyderabad), Principal Software Engineer, Lead Software Engineer, Engineering Manager, Frontend Engineer, plus Technical Support Engineer, Account Executive, Solutions Consultant and Sales Engineer in Glassdoor counts. No official level codes seen beyond title tiers.
steps: Application online, recruiter or employee referral
Recruiter screening call; for campus and India hiring an online assessment of CS fundamentals comes first

Technical interviews: live coding on data structures with system design trade-offs, problem solving rounds (two technical rounds reported for associates), project deep dives and role-specific questions (including recent AI topics for some associates)
Manager round and HR round; an older Portland report describes a 4-stage process with an onsite resume-fit conversation and a code challenge

Decision. Glassdoor shows about 15 days for the company overall, with individual reports from 2 days to 5 weeks; several senior candidates describe the process as unprofessional or poorly calibrated, and some Portland candidates report weeks of silence after the manager interview (reports vary).

newsbreak.name: NewsBreak
newsbreak.roles: Software Engineer, Software Engineer Intern, Frontend Engineer, iOS Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, Agentic AI Engineer, Data Engineer. NewsBreak is a local news app based in Mountain View, CA.
steps: Application online
Recruiter call on background and technical experience

Technical phone screen with an engineer: LeetCode-style problems (a number-of-islands style question, linked lists and DFS for ML-engineer reports, React coding and core front-end topics for front-end roles); one reviewer says the interviewer seemed disengaged
Onsite / panel rounds with multiple interviewers for ML and data roles (Interview Query suggests 3-5 weeks and notes possible take-homes)
Decision. Reports vary: about 1 week to a few weeks. All the Glassdoor software engineer reports seen (2025-2026) ended with no offer, so the sample leans negative.

nexon.name: Nexon
nexon.roles: Software Engineer, Software Developer (C++ / game), Senior Software Engineer, Web / Frontend Developer, Software Engineering Intern. Reports come from Seoul, Seongnam, Pangyo, Emeryville and Ho Chi Minh City. Nexon is the game company behind MapleStory; search results also showed an unrelated crypto company named Nexo, which was excluded. No official level codes seen.
steps: Application online, referral, staffing agency or in person
Online assessment: aptitude and/or coding round with basic data structures and algorithms (reports mention a 3-round process of aptitude, coding and HR)
Technical interview, often one-on-one: C++ and memory, data structures, Big O, STL containers, heap vs stack, plus code review and a hand-written database or specific-function coding question
Behavioral interview with an engineer (about 30 min on projects and teamwork) and an HR round, where at least one candidate was rejected
Decision. Reports range from about 1 week to 4 weeks (reports vary).

nextdoor.name: Nextdoor
nextdoor.roles: Software Engineer (backend, frontend, mobile), Senior and Staff Software Engineer, Analytics Engineer, Software Engineering Manager; a third-party guide shows L1 through L6 engineering levels (unofficial). Other families in Glassdoor reports: Product Manager, Account Manager, Sales, Designer, Intern. Software Engineer is the largest report group.
steps: Application online, via recruiter or employee referral
Recruiter outreach / phone call; the phone screen often turns into a live coding exercise
Coding screen (LeetCode-style; example reported tasks include linked list work and building a graph of users, posts and comments)
Full onsite or virtual loop, described as a long interview day of roughly 4-5 hours: coding, system design, behavioral, and some reports mention a PM / team-match discussion
Decision. Glassdoor stats give about 3 weeks on average; individual reports range from 2 to 4 weeks (reports vary).

ngrok.name: Ngrok
ngrok.note: ngrok's own Greenhouse postings do not list interview steps. Candidate reports (Glassdoor, May 2025) describe for an engineer:
ngrok.roles: ngrok (cloud networking / API gateway platform, San Francisco and remote). Postings use Software Engineer II / III, Senior Software Engineer, and Engineering Manager titles, across teams such as Agent, Admin Engineering, Developer Growth, Data Platform (Software Engineer III / Senior), Infra Platform and AI Gateway; stack is Go, Rust, C/C++, Java on AWS. Also Product Manager, Senior Developer Educator, Senior Product Designer. SE III roles ask 3+ years, Senior 5+ years.
steps: HR interview (standard meet-the-person call)
Manager meeting to gauge culture fit
A remote LeetCode-style coding challenge (a Wordle-clone style problem)
Systems design challenge: reviewing a system design question (e.g. handling connection metadata reliably)

A non-technical culture interview about how you solved organizational issues and conflict (e.g. a production issue you solved), then decision. A Developer Educator report from June 2025 lists an HR screen, hiring manager interview, a homework blog outline discussed with two peers, a CRO interview and a CEO interview, over about 4 weeks. Both reports are negative, so experiences may vary.

nielsen.name: Nielsen
nielsen.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports and guides: Timeline: Glassdoor shows about 13 days for software engineers (7 reports) and 26 days company-wide; Interview Query says 2-4 weeks; reports range from 1 day to 2 weeks. A January 2025 senior candidate called a three-round process disappointing, while a November 2024 Bengaluru candidate accepted.
nielsen.roles: Nielsen (audience measurement; engineering concentrated in Bengaluru, plus Chicago, Oldsmar FL and others). Glassdoor volume spans many non-engineering roles (research interviewer, analysts), while engineering reports cover Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (about 73; for example Full Stack Java + Angular, 7+ years), SDE / SDE-1 (campus), Software Engineer Mid Level, Lead and Principal Software Engineer, DevOps Engineer, Data Scientist, Engineering Manager. A third-party prep site lists Software Engineer (2-5 yrs), Senior (5-10), Lead (7-15), Principal and Senior Principal levels (unofficial, from a candidate-prep site).
steps: Application online, referral or campus; a campus SDE report (January 2025) had a one-day process
Online assessment: DSA and multiple-choice questions for campus and some experienced hires

Technical rounds: Interview Query's synthesis of 5 reports describes three rounds centred on coding, core CS, project discussion and (in one account) low-level and system design; another describes four rounds with two DSA rounds at easy-to-medium level; reports include 'design Uber' plus a binary search problem (Bengaluru, January 2026), easy/medium DP and DSA, and an older Chicago phone screen followed by a panel and a one-hour coding challenge (build a board game in the terminal)
Hiring-manager / behavioral conversation and stakeholder discussions, then decision

nike.name: Nike
nike.note: Formats vary by team and location; Interview Query puts it at 2-4 rounds over 3-8 weeks (Glassdoor average is about 23 days for Nike, 26 for lead engineers):
nike.roles: Software Engineer ladder per a third-party site (hw.glich.co, unofficial): Software Engineer I (L band), II (U band, about 2-5 years), III, Senior, Tech Lead, Principal Engineer (E band), Distinguished Engineer (S band), plus Software Engineering Manager and Senior Director. Lead Software Engineer (Bengaluru), Software Engineering Intern (Beaverton). Locations include Beaverton OR, Portland, Bengaluru.
steps: Recruiter / HR conversation, sometimes via a LinkedIn approach
HireVue recorded screen with one coding question and a resume question (interns and Bengaluru lead roles report two HireVue rounds)

Technical interviews: resume deep dive, Node.js / React / Java / SQL fundamentals, data modeling (e.g. shopping cart schema), whiteboard or system design discussion; one report says two technical rounds plus a managerial round

Back-to-back behavioral and culture-fit conversations (a 2025 report says the behavioral portion was the main part), then decision. Candidate experiences vary from respectful to ghosted after the first round.

ninjatrader.name: Ninjatrader
ninjatrader.note: Candidate sources (Glassdoor, Interview Query) describe a short, structured process that often involves leadership:
ninjatrader.roles: NinjaTrader (retail futures trading platform and brokerage; Chicago, remote or hybrid). Sr. Software Engineer I / II (Trading Platform in Java / Scala / C++, Backend NT Connect, Evaluation Services, Scala), Software Engineer in Test (Backoffice), Software Engineer Intern (Chicago, campus), Data Engineer, Data Analyst. Titles use Sr. Software Engineer I and II; no further ladder published.
steps: Recruiter screen or phone screening (constant, quick contact reported)

A technical stage: a quiz on data structures and optimization or a timed technical screen (a Sept 2026 PracHub report describes a hard technical screen coding a log parser and anomaly detector against Pytest tests in an IDE); interns report two LeetCode-medium linked-list questions

A three-round loop with managers and directors, or an in-person visit: an HR partner and then three people at varying levels in the department; questions about handling harsh feedback and how you think through problems related to the investing landscape
A final meeting with senior leadership, possibly including the CEO (Interview Query), then decision. Timelines range from a short process to 2-4 months for campus internship hiring.

nooks.name: Nooks
nooks.roles: Software Engineer (core product infrastructure, voice AI infrastructure, product), Senior Software Engineer (Voice AI), Staff Software Engineer, Software Engineer Intern, Engineering Manager, Customer Success Engineer. Glassdoor report volume is small and led by Account Executive (about 5), then Software Engineer (about 3), Sales and SDR. Nooks is an AI sales-assistant / dialer company in San Francisco and Seattle.
steps: Application online or via recruiter
Recruiter / phone screen
Technical screen: LeetCode-style graph question such as a web crawler with BFS, followed by optimizing it with parallelization
Onsite: a system design round (a Twitter-style design in one report) plus coding and a conversation about your past experience and why you want to change jobs

Decision. Reports vary: about 1-2 weeks; guides say 2-3 weeks. One 2025 candidate got a generic automated no-reply rejection a week after the final interview, and most reports seen ended with no offer, though one May 2026 candidate declined an offer. Dataford notes the process is generally organized and communicative.

nordstrom.name: Nordstrom
nordstrom.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports: Timeline: guides say about 3-5 weeks over 4-5 stages; Glassdoor shows about 12 days company-wide; individual reports vary from 6 days to 4 weeks, with one campus case taking 3 months.
nordstrom.roles: Software Engineer (Seattle WA, Chicago), Software Developer, Software Engineer I / Senior Software Engineer I and II / Senior Principal Software Engineer and Software Engineering Manager (level names as listed by a third-party prep site, unofficial), engineering manager, and interns/new grad hires. Retail-store and other corporate roles were not researched.
steps: Application online, via recruiter, or at a campus job fair
Online assessment and/or pre-recorded behavioral interview on an AI chat platform; or an HR screen (about 45-60 min: experience, role, salary expectations)
Hiring manager conversation and phone technical screen: project deep dive, OOP basics, one moderate (LeetCode-medium) coding question such as sorting/caching problems, a product you deployed

Virtual loop of back-to-back interviews: coding, system design (including database schema design in one report), behavioral and team fit; engineering manager loops add a director/senior director interview
Offer

notion.name: Notion
notion.roles: Software Engineer (new grad / early-career through senior; one candidate-guide site shows L1-L5 labels, unofficial), Software Engineer Intern (Winter / Summer 2025 cohort), data roles (a data-wrangling stage and a Head of Data interview are mentioned), plus other engineering and product roles.
steps: Application online; recruiters often send a prep guide
Recruiter intro call

Technical screen: either a live coding challenge where a Notion employee observes (about 50 min of problem-solving) or a product-specific tech screen; some cycles use a take-home or data-wrangling exercise

Onsite / virtual onsite of about 3 interviews: coding, system design, a pair-programming walkthrough that extends your own take-home code in some cycles, and a behavioral round; reports describe a practical, real-life style without heavy LeetCode
Leadership / hiring-leader conversation (for data roles, a Head of Data interview), then references and offer

Decision. Reports vary: about 2-5 weeks in most guides, and about 3-4 weeks in an expedited case; one summary notes tempo can be slow between stages. Taro stats (28 US SWE reports) show roughly a 32% pass rate.

nubank.name: Nubank
nubank.note: Software engineer path per Nubank's own blog and candidate reports:
nubank.roles: Software Engineer (about 236 Glassdoor reports), Senior Software Engineer (about 238), Lead / Tech Lead Software Engineer, Staff and Principal Software Engineer (Toronto, Palo Alto, Miami, São Paulo, Bogotá, Mexico), plus business analyst, customer experience analyst and product manager roles. One Glassdoor report labels a Senior Software Engineer role as IC5, so Nubank uses IC-style level numbers; the full ladder is not shown.
steps: Application online, via recruiter, or at campus; first phase screens applicants
Remote interview with a recruiter or a fellow software engineer (the company blog says people approved in the first phase get this call)

Technical interviews: coding tests you must run to pass, multi-level OOP-style questions of increasing difficulty, in-memory database tasks, general object-oriented design; guides add functional-programming themes
Further rounds including system design for senior roles, a presentation or project discussion, and a conversation with the manager on culture alignment; one São Paulo report lists 5 steps

Offer. Timeline: reports vary from 1 week to 4 months; most are about 4 weeks to 2 months; Taro pass rate is about 21% across 102 software engineer reports. Candidates mention being given step-by-step guidance before each round but find the whole process long.

nuro.name: Nuro
nuro.roles: Software Engineer (levels L3-L6 per a candidate guide, unofficial; embedded, controls and SWE II tracks exist), Software Engineering Manager (L3-L5 in the same guide), Software Engineering Intern, with an office in the Netherlands as well as Mountain View.
steps: Recruiter call or recruiter outreach (background, interest, availability)
Technical screen: HackerRank and/or a ~45 min technical phone interview with an engineer or manager (coding, data structures)

Onsite / virtual loop of about 3-4 rounds, mostly technical (coding, system design of ~60 min, a behavioral / managerial fit round); interns report an HR call, then 3 technical rounds, then team matching
Decision. Timelines reported from about 1-2 weeks up to roughly two months; one guide says the process moves at a reasonable pace once it starts and varies by team.

nutanix.name: Nutanix
nutanix.note: Software engineer / MTS path per candidate reports and Interview Query: Timeline: Interview Query says 4-6 rounds and about 3-4 weeks; Glassdoor shows about 12 days for interns and 4 days average hiring for some intern reports, while company-wide it is longer; reports range from 1 week to 2 months and one older campus case took 3 months. Glassdoor rates difficulty 3.6/5 with about 80% positive for software engineer internships.
nutanix.roles: Glassdoor report volume: Member of Technical Staff (MTS, about 153 plus MTS-2 / MTS-3 / MTS-4 variants), Systems Reliability Engineer / SRE (about 78 / 65), Senior Systems Engineer (58), Software Engineer (55), Sales, interns (about 26 plus a separate Software Engineer Internship track). Nutanix uses numbered MTS levels (MTS-2, MTS-3, MTS-4) visible in titles. Sites: San Jose CA, Durham NC, Bengaluru, Pune, Toronto, UK, Singapore.
steps: Application online, referral or campus; recruiter or hiring-lead conversation (about 30 min)
Online coding test: 4-hour online assignment (3 algorithmic tasks) in some processes, or a 1-hour MCQ technical test for interns

Technical interviews: two online interviews of 45-60 minutes each with engineers (LeetCode-medium problems such as top-K elements and swapping nodes in pairs, project discussion, concurrency, OS and systems fundamentals); full-time MTS loops add an onsite of about four interviews plus a lunch interview (San Jose, 2019) or five 1:1s (Durham, 2019)
Design discussion for senior levels and a closing hiring-manager or team-lead conversation on fit, project deep dives and behavioral questions

nvidia.name: NVIDIA
nvidia.roles: Software Engineer, Systems Software Engineer (largest group), Senior Systems Software Engineer, CUDA / TensorRT / GPU profiling and AI platform engineers, ASIC / hardware / verification / physical design engineers, Solutions Architect, interns and new college grads. Candidate guides label SWE levels IC1-IC8 (unofficial).
steps: Recruiter call
Technical phone screens (often 1-2; hiring manager and a senior engineer; C/C++, OS concepts, threads vs processes, coding and team-specific topics like embedded, drivers, GPUs, AI/ML)
Hiring manager call
Onsite / virtual loop of ~4-6 rounds (up to 8 rounds over ~3 months reported for CUDA team): coding, system design, performance and optimization focus, behavioral
Decision. Highly team-specific; Glassdoor average about 2-3 weeks, guides say several weeks, some reports up to 2-3 months.

okta.name: Okta
okta.roles: Software Engineer (largest share of Glassdoor reports), Senior Software Engineer, Staff Software Engineer, software engineering interns, plus Architect-level roles; locations in reports include San Francisco, Seattle/Bellevue, Toronto and Bengaluru, and postings mention full-stack, Android and Java roles. A third-party prep site lists a SWE 1 / 2 / Senior / Staff / Principal / Architect ladder (unofficial, from a candidate-prep site).
steps: Recruiter screening (often a recruiter reaching out via LinkedIn)
Hiring manager discussion

Online assessment (a Toronto staff-engineer report mentions a CodeSignal assessment) or a phone coding screen: data structures, string manipulation, a LeetCode-medium problem solvable in about 30 min, sometimes data/JSON handling
Technical discussion with two engineers, focused on the assignment or on design for senior and staff levels; older reports describe an onsite at the Seattle/Bellevue office

Decision. Reports say about 4-5 stages; timeline reports vary from about 1 week to 2 months, and Glassdoor shows about 18 days on average company-wide. Some candidates report being ghosted after the final round.

okx.name: Okx
okx.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports and Dataford (347 reports; 6 stages in its summary): Timeline: Dataford says about 3-5 weeks for backend; a March 2025 report took 4 weeks over three rounds; a December 2024 Android report took 2 months; third-party sites suggest about 14 days. Glassdoor results are mixed: accepted offers (2023-2024) and several no-offer reports from Singapore and Hong Kong in 2025.
okx.roles: OKX (crypto exchange and Web3 platform; Singapore, Hong Kong, Hangzhou, Dubai, Malta, US and remote). Glassdoor lists the company as OKG: Software Engineer (about 145 reports), Product Manager (70), Senior Software Engineer (36), Senior Associate (30), Senior Android Developer, Backend Engineer, Frontend Engineer, Software Engineering Manager. A third-party prep site lists OKX engineering levels P4, P5, P6.1, P6.2, P7.1, P7.2, P7.3 and manager / Director / Head of Engineering tracks (unofficial, from a candidate-prep site).
steps: Application online or recruiter; HR / recruiter screen (smooth and professional in a March 2025 report); initial assessment

Technical interviews: coding (sometimes LeetCode, sometimes business-scenario problems), backend questions across blockchain, databases, Java, middleware and design patterns (Hangzhou report), frontend rendering performance (frontend track), search or pathfinding algorithms, and system design for high-concurrency exchange systems
Discussion with management and team-lead / cross-team interviews (one candidate counts seven rounds in total, including two with the collaborating team and cross-interviews); offer discussion

omnissa.name: Omnissa
omnissa.roles: Software Engineer, Member of Technical Staff (MTS-2, Senior MTS), Senior Python Developer, DevOps Engineer, Data Analyst, Data Scientist, Account Executive. Formerly VMware's end-user computing business. Reports are mostly from Bengaluru, plus Atlanta.
steps: Application (campus, referral, recruiter or online)
HR / recruiter screening about experience and role expectations
Online assessment on HackerRank (e.g. a C# design-style problem) or a 45-60 min DSA round (trees, strings, three-sum)
Technical rounds (typically 2): DSA, low-level design, Golang / C# / Python depth, Docker and systems questions, resume and project discussion; senior roles have more rounds (5-6 reported)
Managerial round with a director or manager on behavioral topics
Decision. Reports vary: about 1-2 weeks for campus and MTS-2 reports, 4 weeks to 2 months for senior roles.

onemain-financial.name: OneMain Financial
onemain-financial.note: Branch / field roles (most common in reports): Corporate / analyst roles per guides: HR or recruiter screening, then about 3 rounds with hiring managers and cross-functional peers; case-based questions, SQL and financial analysis for analyst tracks, compliance/ethics themes. One senior engineer report mentions HR fit call plus a technical test (CS algorithms, SQL, IQ-style). Timeline: reports vary, from a few days for branch roles to about 3-5 weeks for corporate roles; Glassdoor shows about 17 days on average.
onemain-financial.roles: Reports are dominated by branch-based and corporate finance roles: branch manager, assistant manager / customer service or loan specialist roles, district-manager-led hiring, internships, plus corporate roles such as financial analyst, data analyst, operations manager, product manager and (less often) senior software engineer. No official or unofficial level ladder seen in the sources.
steps: Online or in-person application with resume
Short scripted phone screen or recruiter call

Interview with the branch manager, often followed by a second interview with the district manager; questions are mostly behavioral and about management style, and the final manager interview is described as the most important
Background check, then offer (sometimes within a day)

onepay.name: Onepay
onepay.note: OnePay's own job postings state a 'Standard Interview Process' (process varies by role): Postings do not give durations or coding formats; I did not find candidate reports describing the technical rounds in detail.
onepay.roles: OnePay (consumer fintech backed by Walmart and Ribbit Capital; banking, savings, credit cards, lending, investing). Software Engineer across teams: Banking (identity and onboarding, React Native mobile), Backend Engineer Banking, Senior Backend Engineer, Software Engineer Risk, Servicing, @Work (Instapay / employer benefits), Lending (full-stack), Product Facing, Platform / Infra Engineer; also hiring in Bengaluru. Levels are described by years of experience in postings (about 3-8+ years), not formal level names.
steps: AI-assisted initial screen (newer postings)
Initial interview with a Talent Partner
Technical or hiring-manager interview
Team interview
Executive interview
Offer

openai.name: OpenAI
openai.roles: Software Engineer (backend, infra, product), ML engineer, researcher, infrastructure and product roles. Candidate guides describe levels like L2-L6 (unofficial). OpenAI has a Residency program for people before graduation instead of traditional internships (per a university career blog).
steps: Application review
Recruiter or intro call (~30 min)
Technical phone screen (~1 hr, practical coding)
Second screen or skills assessment (coding or architecture/system design)
Final loop of ~4-6 rounds: coding, system design (~1 hr, scale-focused), behavioral and mission fit
Decision. Reports range from about a week up to 3-6 weeks (some say 6-8 rounds). Team-dependent.

opendoor.name: Opendoor
opendoor.note: Software engineer path per guides and candidate reports: Timeline: TechPrep says about 3-5 weeks; CleverPrep says about 20 days on average with 51% positive Glassdoor ratings and 2.92/5 difficulty; an L2 guide says about 7 days; reports vary.
opendoor.roles: Software Engineer (Seattle WA, San Francisco; hybrid 4 days onsite, listed as 'all levels'), Backend Engineer, Analytics Engineer (Agentic Analytics team), QA Engineer, Software Engineering Manager (M3-M5), plus other business roles. Per a third-party prep site: L2 Software Engineer 1, L3 Software Engineer 2, L5 Staff, L6 Senior Staff, L7 Principal and M3-M5 manager levels (unofficial, from a candidate-prep site). The company's own careers page lists the Seattle Software Engineer role (opendoor.com/careers).
steps: Online application on the careers portal, then a recruiter screen (30 min: background and interest; the recruiter explains the process)
Hiring-manager conversation (30-45 min) and/or a technical phone screen (coding, e.g. a reverse Polish calculator)
Take-home coding assignment or case study (React-focused per one guide)

Virtual onsite of about 4 rounds (5-6 hours of interview time per TechPrep): coding, system design (a design for real estate applications), a hiring-manager discussion and behavioral questions; a Dataford/PracHub report mentions three surprise technical rounds after HR went dark, with only the tech lead round going well
Panel deliberation, then decision within about a week; offers include RSUs

oppo.name: OPPO
oppo.roles: Software Engineer (India, Hyderabad, Bengaluru and other sites), Software Test Engineer, SQA Engineer, Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, Software Trainee Intern, plus many non-software roles (Assistant Engineer, Production Engineer, Process Engineer, Sales Executive) that dominate review counts. No official level codes seen. OPPO is a large smartphone maker, so reports span several countries.
steps: Application online, referral or campus; resume shortlisting
Online test or aptitude test: one reported format has 12 questions (10 MCQs on OS, data structures and DBMS plus 2 coding questions)

Coding / technical round (about 1 hour): LeetCode easy-medium problems on trees and strings, OS, DBMS and OOP questions, data structures and algorithms; test roles ask about STLC and mobile software features
HR round, sometimes a managerial or one-on-one round
Decision. Reports say 2-3 rounds in total and usually under 2 weeks, with one software engineer report giving 2-4 weeks (reports vary; data is thin).

optiver.name: Optiver
optiver.roles: Software Engineer (graduate and experienced; C++ and low-latency trading systems), Software Developer, interns, plus Trader, Quantitative Trader, Derivatives Trader and Quant Trading Intern (the most-reported roles on Glassdoor). Offices include Amsterdam, Sydney, Chicago and others.
steps: Application (CV and motivation letter in some regions)
Long online assessment, up to ~4 hours: HackerRank-style coding, multiple-choice CS questions (computer architecture, networking), and sometimes mini-games
Recruiter / behavioral conversation
Technical rounds: data structures, OOP/OOD, trading-style system design, low-level fundamentals, C++ and quantitative reasoning (design-heavy rather than pure LeetCode)
Final interviews and decision. Typically 2-4 weeks, some reports up to 8 weeks. Pass rates reported as very low.

oracle.name: Oracle
oracle.roles: Software Engineer / Software Developer / Applications Developer, Senior and Principal Platform Software Engineer, Senior Member of Technical Staff (SMTS), Systems Software Engineer, OCI (Oracle Cloud Infrastructure) engineers, interns; also Associate Consultant, Senior Consultant and Business Development Consultant (many Glassdoor reports). Candidate guides label engineer levels IC1-IC7 and managers M2-M5 (unofficial).
steps: Resume screen
Recruiter call / HR call
Technical phone screen or online test (mostly easy-to-medium DSA; Java, SQL and database basics come up)
About 4-6 rounds depending on team: coding, system design (more for OCI and senior roles), resume / project deep dive, behavioral or managerial round
Decision. Highly team-dependent: OCI loops are more rigorous like big tech; other divisions are more traditional. Glassdoor average is short (about 8-15 days); guides say a few weeks.

oscar.name: Oscar
