oscar.roles: Software Engineer, Software Engineer New Grad, Software Engineer Apprentice, Senior and Staff Software Engineer (claims and payment processing systems), Site Reliability Engineer, Business Analyst. The sheet links hioscar.com, so this is Oscar Health; no official level codes seen beyond title tiers.
steps: Application online, referral or recruiter outreach on LinkedIn
Recruiter / HR screen (quick, basic Q&A)
Online assessment: CodeSignal or HackerRank (older reports: 2-3 problems, roughly LeetCode medium), or a paired-programming LeetCode-style technical screen

Further rounds reported: a longer LeetCode session (about 2 hours), system design (healthcare-flavored, for example a telehealth queue) and a manager / behavioral round; older onsite reports describe 2 phone interviews and about 5 onsite rounds; Oscar publishes AI guidelines for use of AI during interviews
Decision. Guides say about a month; individual reports range from 1 week to 5 weeks, and some mention silence after coding (reports vary).

otter-ai.name: Otter.Ai
otter-ai.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer and Staff/Senior-Staff backend, frontend (web and desktop), iOS and search/recommendation engineers, research scientists and research engineers (speech recognition, speaker identification, model inference), machine learning, data engineers, and some go-to-market roles. Sources are for Otter.ai (AI meeting transcription); I skipped pages about a different company named Otter (restaurant software). No official level ladder seen.
steps: Application online
Recruiter call
Timed coding screen / technical phone screen (about 45-60 min): graph, stack, array and similar algorithm problems, or a key-value cache design in Java with transactions in one report

Second tech screen for some senior candidates, then an onsite/virtual loop of about 3 interviews: coding (e.g. a grid-style BFS problem), system design (e.g. a meeting-bot service) and behavioral/hiring-manager conversations; one senior report described two tech screens plus three onsites
Decision. Guides say about 2-5 rounds; Interview Query's four reports ended without an offer, so treat success rates as low. Process length was not reported in the sources I saw.

palantir.name: Palantir
palantir.roles: Software Engineer (backend, frontend / full-stack, infrastructure), Forward Deployed Software Engineer, Data Engineer, Security Engineer, Product Designer, Account Executive, plus internships. No official level codes seen in sources. Software Engineer is the most reported role.
steps: Application online or recruiter outreach on LinkedIn
Recruiter call (about 30 min)
Online assessment or HackerRank / Karat style coding, then a technical phone screen (about 1 hour, LeetCode-style plus some unusual questions)

Onsite / virtual loop with distinctive formats per guides: decomposition (scoping a messy problem), learning interview (solving alongside an engineer who is graded on how you learn), re-engineering / debugging, coding and system design; some reports include a short informal chat with a current engineer
Hiring manager conversation, then decision. Reports mention about 2 weeks to a few weeks; pass rates in candidate data are low (reports vary).

palo-alto-networks.name: Palo Alto Networks
palo-alto-networks.roles: Software Engineer (intern, SWE, Staff, Senior Staff, Principal, Senior Principal, Distinguished per candidate guides, unofficial), plus security, networking and systems-software engineers; one report mentions deep Linux and C++ topics. Mostly Santa Clara / Bay Area reports.
steps: Application online or through a recruiter
Online assessments: Codility coding test and a HireVue video round in some cycles (2 OAs reported for a senior staff candidate)
Recruiter screen (behavioral and logistics) and a hiring-manager tech screen of about 45 min
Onsite / virtual loop: about 3 back-to-back technical rounds (data structures and algorithms, systems / networking, debugging, system design for senior levels) plus behavioral
Decision. Reports vary a lot: 2 weeks to about 6 weeks in most guides, but Interview Query mentions 2-6 months for some candidates. Taro stats (40 US SWE reports) show a low pass rate of roughly 18%.

paradromics.name: Paradromics
paradromics.note: Only one candidate report and company job postings were found, so the rest of the loop, timeline and outcomes are unknown.
paradromics.roles: Software Engineer (clinical BCI software, mid level), Senior Software Engineer (frontend and backend), Full-Stack Software Engineer, Embedded Software Engineer (Austin), Research Engineer. Paradromics is a brain-computer-interface company (Connexus BCI) in Oakland, CA and Austin, TX; stack mentions C++, Rust, Python, TypeScript.
steps: Application through the company's job board (JazzHR)

Technical manager phone interview of about 1 hour, per one 1point3acres report: system design, Docker, Python optimization, real-time systems and a LeetCode-style implementation (details behind a login)
Further interviews with engineers and scientists, likely including a software exercise and team conversations; no first-hand reports for these stages were found

parafin.name: Parafin
parafin.note: Engineering path per candidate reports and guides: Timeline: guides say about 2-5 weeks (4 rounds); candidate reports are mixed, with several negative senior reports from 2022-2026 and a declined offer in March 2026; Dataford shows a difficulty of 5.2/10 across 13 reports.
parafin.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Staff Software Engineer (Lending Products), SDE and software engineering interns (San Francisco and Canada), data engineer / data analytics engineer, data scientist, account executive (platform partnerships). Parafin is an embedded-finance startup in San Francisco.
steps: Resume screen / application (or referral / recruiter)
Recruiter or behavioral phone call; intern candidates start with a short behavioral phone call

Technical screen: practical, company-specific problems rather than pure LeetCode tricks (a March 2026 senior candidate calls the process fantastic and not trick-based); backend system design and scalable infrastructure topics for underwriting and decisioning

Onsite / virtual onsite of about 4-5 rounds covering coding tasks, system design, cross-functional collaboration and a team-integration discussion; one candidate felt interviewers should be matched to the domain of the problem
Offer

paramount-commerce.name: Paramount Commerce
paramount-commerce.note: Reports for Paramount Commerce are old and sparse (2018-2020 Glassdoor). A 2020 candidate describes a 5-stage process with progressing difficulty: screening, a fairly simple development round, architecture, a deep dive and a conversation with the CTO (2 weeks, no offer despite good feedback). Others mention a technical meeting with a staff developer, a hiring manager interview and phone screenings; one 2018 candidate had a phone screen and a second HR call covering salary and in-depth questions. Paramount Commerce's current postings say it uses technology-assisted tools (including AI) for parts of recruitment such as resume screening, note taking and scheduling. A PracHub page lists a behavioral and leadership technical screen question for the Software Engineer role.
paramount-commerce.roles: Paramount Commerce (Canadian payments fintech, Toronto, Burnaby, Ottawa, remote). Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (Payment Experience, merchant platform, Risk Engineering; 7-8+ years asked in postings), Android Software Engineer, QA / test engineers, Senior Software Engineer in AI. Stack in postings: Java, Go, React, Kubernetes, Postgres, Redis. Note: search results also mix in the media company Paramount (a different employer), which I separated out.

patreon.name: Patreon
patreon.note: Candidate sources describe about 3-4 weeks end to end (Glassdoor reports 2-3 weeks) and a coding-heavy start:
patreon.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (L5 in a Taro report; a candidate guide labels engineer levels L3-L8 and manager tracks IC1-IC6, unofficial), Senior Software Engineer iOS, Site Reliability Engineer, Software Engineer interns.
steps: Recruiter screen (15-30 min)
Timed HackerRank-style coding screen, or an online live coding interview with an engineer (~1 hr), e.g. implementing JavaScript array reduce
Onsite / virtual loop: more coding, system design (e.g. a grocery cart system) and a behavioral / hiring-manager conversation; in one report the interviewer signalled early that they had not passed
Decision. Taro shows a low pass rate for interns and SWEs in samples; some senior reports are positive.

paxos.name: Paxos
paxos.note: Per Paxos's own engineering blog (older, may have changed): phone interview, take-home test, in-person interview, then offer, with work product described as the most important thing tested. Candidate reports describe: recruiter call and hiring manager screen; a coding interview (LeetCode medium style such as mergesort, 2D matrix problems, graph construction with precision handling); a virtual onsite with coding, system design (for example a market surveillance platform) and behavioral rounds; and in 2025-2026 an AI interview step (Ribbon AI) before several team conversations. Decision. Reports range from 2 weeks to 5 weeks; several 2025-2026 candidates call the process lengthy, repetitive or disrespectful of their time (reports vary).
paxos.roles: Software Engineer (blockchain, onboarding and platform teams), Senior Software Engineer (Go, distributed systems), Senior Backend Engineer, SRE / DevOps Engineer, Software Developer Engineer in Test, Technical Support Engineer. Paxos is the New York blockchain infrastructure and fintech company. No official level codes seen. Reports come from New York, Salt Lake City and remote.

paypal.name: PayPal
paypal.roles: Software Engineer (web platforms, payments, reporting; Senior Software Engineer titles), full-stack and React engineers, engineering managers. Candidate guides label levels CL5-CL10 and manager tracks T27-T28 (unofficial).
steps: Early screen: HackerRank online assessment (2-3 easy-to-medium DSA problems), a Karat coding challenge, recruiter call or video application
Live technical screen (45-60 min, Karat or a PayPal engineer, working code with reasoning out loud)
Onsite / virtual loop: 1-2 coding or pair-programming rounds (some teams add React live coding), system design with a payments accent for experienced hires, and a behavioral / managerial round
Decision. About 4-6 stages over a few weeks; Glassdoor reports range from 1 week to 4 weeks.

perceptyx.name: Perceptyx
perceptyx.note: Perceptyx's own postings include an 'Interview Process & AI Transparency' section: AI is used to help summarize interview data but all final hiring decisions are made by Perceptyx employees; candidates are asked to confirm that they will not use AI or large language models to generate or refine their interview responses unless a step explicitly allows it; and interviewers are expected to be fully engaged in the conversation. Candidate reports (older Glassdoor plus an August 2026 PracHub report) describe: a phone interview on career interests and technologies, an in-person interview going deeper, a technical screen that was largely a project demo / project deep dive (a next-day rejection in Aug 2026), and for the former CultureIQ a mix of conversational and technical questions with long gaps between final interview and offer (3 weeks) in some reports. A 2019 Python developer report took 7 months end to end.
perceptyx.roles: Perceptyx (employee experience and survey platform; includes the former CultureIQ, Toronto, Montevideo, US remote). Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (Platform team, AI-driven development), Software Developer (Infrastructure Platforms, Data Engineering), Software Engineer - Front End, Senior Software Engineer / Developer - Perl (Toronto, Montevideo), Python Developer. Levels appear as Software Developer / Software Engineer / Senior in postings.

peregrine.name: Peregrine
peregrine.roles: Software Engineer (including Product Experiences), Engineering Team Lead, Software Engineer interns, plus Product Manager, Data Scientist and Account Executive roles in report counts. The sheet had only search links for this name, and the name is crowded (a UK defense contractor, Peregrine Semiconductor and others exist), so the match assumed here is Peregrine Technologies, the San Francisco public-safety data platform, which has the most software engineer reports. No official level codes seen.
steps: Application online, recruiter outreach or other source
HR / recruiter screen (about 30 min on background, role and logistics)
Take-home project (reported as a build-a-system assignment with an expected time budget)

Virtual or in-person onsite with practical coding rounds, behavioral and algorithm questions; one 2025 report describes a grueling practical-coding onsite and a rejection over coding notes; some data roles add a decomposition round, deep dive and division lead interview
Decision. Reports say the process can run about 3 weeks, with 2-3 business days between rounds in a fast case (reports vary).

perplexity.name: Perplexity
perplexity.roles: Software Engineer (including infrastructure, and Berlin and San Francisco reports), Senior and Staff engineer levels per a candidate guide (unofficial), product manager, and technical, product and growth roles generally. Perplexity runs its own technical interviewing portal, so engineering candidates get an official orientation to the process.
steps: Application or referral
Recruiter / intro call (about 30-45 min per an aggregator guide)
Technical screen or coding challenge: candidates mention an online-assessment-style problem and a multi-part practical coding task (a 4-part 'todo list for AI' style round in one 2026 report)
Further technical interviews, including system design on improving an existing system, and a hiring-manager technical interview
Spike round for some roles: a project-style round, with project proposals, described on Perplexity's own interview portal (only a snippet was visible)
Decision. Guides give about 2-6 rounds; timeline reports vary from about 1-3 weeks (fast) to about 4 weeks.

persistence.name: Persistence
persistence.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports and guides (applies only if 'Persistence' means Persistent Systems): Timeline: Glassdoor's report ratings for software engineers are mostly positive with accepted offers (2025-2026); most processes run about 2-4 weeks, with campus drives taking a day or two; Dataford rates difficulty 5.2/10 across 493 reports.
persistence.roles: AMBIGUOUS COMPANY: the sheet's 'Persistence' has no website or identifier. Search results for the name point to Persistent Systems (Pune-based IT services firm), which has by far the most interview reports, so I researched that as a best guess; please confirm or tell me the real company (for example Persistence Labs or Persistence AI). Persistent Systems roles seen on Glassdoor: Software Engineer (about 1,700 reports across title variants), Senior Software Engineer (1,090), Lead Software Engineer (573), Engineering Lead (466), Project Lead (381), Module Lead (358), Team Lead, Software Developer, Architect, Salesforce Developer, interns. Sites: Pune, Nagpur, Indore, Goa, Bengaluru, Hyderabad and others, plus a US presence. Levels use titles such as Associate Software Engineer, Software Engineer, Senior, Module Lead, Lead and Architect.
steps: Application online, referral or campus; resume screening and an initial HR call
Online assessment for freshers and some experienced hires (aptitude, coding and SQL; the process is described as covering technical, problem-solving and cultural alignment)

Technical rounds: Java / Spring Boot / SQL / AWS, OOP, DBMS, OS and computer networks basics, one coding question and one SQL query, easy-to-medium DSA, project discussion from your resume; some teams add Salesforce or MuleSoft topics; some processes add a coding or system-design task
Second technical round with another technical leader, a project manager or managerial interview, then a final HR round for offer and salary negotiation

persona.name: Persona
persona.note: Persona's own job postings state: 'As part of our interview process, all candidates will be asked to verify their identity with Persona' (used only to confirm identity and with no impact on hiring decisions). Other details are partly generic: Lodely lists 5-6 rounds (a recruiter screen, an exercise, and a technical loop covering coding, product judgment, identity-platform tradeoffs, APIs, sensitive data, reliability and false-positive tradeoffs, plus behavioral topics) and says reported loops vary by team and level, so confirm whether your role uses a take-home, a live exercise, or an early-career assessment; Scoutify's generic loop is a 30-minute intro call and a 45-60 minute technical interview. No first-hand candidate reports (Glassdoor, Taro) were found in this search, and timelines were not reported. Treat this row as thin.
persona.roles: Persona (identity verification and fraud-prevention platform; San Francisco hybrid, five-day week, Series D, about 26 open roles in July 2026). Roles seen on Ashby and job boards: Software Engineer (product, Edge, Resilience 7+ yrs, Compute, Data Products, Security; $130-220k and higher), Senior Software Engineer (Security, Compute), Product Security Engineer ($150-220k) and Senior Product Security Engineer ($200-280k), Software Engineering Residency (Infrastructure), Solutions Engineer. A 2026 compensation report on a prep site lists L2 and L3 software engineer levels (unofficial, from a candidate-prep site); Persona's postings say 'Great Place to Work 2025'. I did not use pages about unrelated companies named Persona.

physical-intelligence.name: Physical Intelligence
physical-intelligence.note: The company does not publish its process and public reports are rare (DesignGurus and techinterview.org both say so), so this is the likely shape, not confirmed by the company: Timeline not reported. PracHub lists 6 interview experiences for the company. Treat all round counts and durations here as indicative.
physical-intelligence.roles: Physical Intelligence (San Francisco, Mission District; founded 2024; general-purpose foundation models for robots). Roles seen on Ashby and mirror sites: Software Engineer, Runtime Software Engineer (low-latency inference and control), Deployments Software Engineer, Robotics Software Engineer, Robotics Research Engineer, robot integration / fleet and test engineers, research scientists, project managers. Per techinterview.org, the loop splits into research and engineering tracks. No level ladder seen.
steps: Application via the company's careers page, then a recruiter screen

A split by track: runtime / robotics software engineers get real-time systems, C++ and Python, concurrency and profiling questions (a signature question is bridging a 200 ms model to a 20 ms control loop); integration and fleet engineers get hardware-debugging-under-uncertainty rounds
One first-hand September 2026 report (PracHub, in progress, hard): a technical screen where you hand-code a cache, then a 90-minute mini project running 4-5 AI agents
Later rounds, likely including a deeper technical/design round and a team or culture conversation (guides, unconfirmed)

pika.name: Pika
pika.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (Backend, Agent), Front End Engineer, Full-Stack Engineer, Backend Engineer, Video Generation and Editing Model Engineer, Engineering Manager / lead roles. The sheet links pika.art (Pika Labs, the AI video generation company in Palo Alto, working on-site five days a week). No official level codes seen.
steps: Application by emailing hr@pika.art with the job title, a personal statement, links and a resume, or through the company's job postings (a third-party guide mentions a portfolio review for some roles)
Phone screen with a recruiter

Technical interview with an engineer: practical coding and infrastructure problems tied to serving models at scale, with Python problem solving, AI inference and video generation topics emphasized in guides
Hiring manager round and team-fit round; ML research candidates get a research deep dive
Decision. Guides say about 3-5 weeks and 4-5 rounds; sources are mostly third-party guides and job-board summaries with little first-hand candidate detail (reports vary).

pilot.name: Pilot
pilot.note: I did not find candidate-written interview reports or an official description of Pilot's interview stages; results were almost entirely job postings. Postings (Greenhouse, Index Ventures, Dice, Built In) describe level expectations (SWE, Senior, Staff) and team work but no steps. Treat the loop as unknown; a typical startup sequence would be a recruiter call, hiring-manager call, technical rounds and a team or founder conversation, but none of that was confirmed here.
pilot.roles: Pilot (pilot.com, tech-enabled bookkeeping, tax and CFO services for startups; San Francisco and remote; not the Pilot flight / training companies). Software Engineer (3+ yrs, Bookkeeping Automation, Product), Senior Software Engineer (4-5+ yrs; Bookkeeping Automation, Enterprise team building the Meridian AI accounting platform), Staff Software Engineer (7+ yrs, Takeoff team on core accounting and revenue recognition systems). Stack: Python, TypeScript, Vue, AWS, Terraform, Postgres.

pinduoduo.name: Pinduoduo
pinduoduo.note: Timeline: reports vary from about 2 days to 10 days for some Shanghai reports, while a guide quotes 3-6 weeks for a six-round backend process. Sources are for PDD Holdings (Pinduoduo/Temu) generally; reports are mostly small in number.
pinduoduo.roles: Software Engineer / backend developer (Shanghai and other China offices), data engineer, and Temu-related engineering roles (several reports filed under Pinduoduo are actually Temu or PDD Holdings loops, including senior engineer). No official level ladder seen; one report mentions a senior-level process.
steps: Online application / resume submission
Recruiter or HR phone screen (one report: a 45-minute phone screen scheduled the next day with a backend engineer)

Technical coding rounds, algorithm-heavy and LeetCode medium-to-hard style (for example LRU-style cache design, spiral matrix, sliding window); one senior report describes a second round of about 2.5 hours

Behavioral / project and team-ownership discussion (about 40% of the question bank on one prep site is behavioral), possibly a manager or director round for senior roles (a guide lists 6 rounds for backend)
Decision

pinterest.name: Pinterest
pinterest.roles: Software Engineer (IC13 / Software Engineer I entry, Software Engineer II, Senior, Principal per candidate guides, unofficial), Machine Learning Engineer, Data Scientist, plus interns. Glassdoor also shows Account Manager, Partner Manager, Product Designer and Program Manager reports.
steps: Resume screen
Recruiter phone screen (checks minimum requirements)
Technical phone screen (~45-60 min) or timed online assessment
Loop of about 4-5 interviews: algorithms/coding, system design (level dependent), behavioral and a manager conversation
Team matching, then offer. Reports range 2-8 weeks, some say 2-3 months.

pitchbook.name: Pitchbook
pitchbook.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports and guides (mostly generic):
pitchbook.roles: PitchBook (Morningstar-owned financial data platform; Seattle, Chicago, London, Bengaluru and an outsourced Ukraine team via SPD Technology). Roles seen: Software Engineer, Staff Software Engineer, Senior Software Development Engineer (Back-End), ML Engineer, Senior ML Operations Engineer, Data Operations Associate, Product Manager, Client Development Associate. Glassdoor engineering volume is small; many reports are for data and client roles. No official numeric ladder seen beyond Senior/Staff.
steps: Application online, via recruiter (LinkedIn) or employee referral; recruiter call of about 30 minutes
Phone / video screen with the hiring manager (30-45 minutes), more rigorous than the first screen

Technical rounds: one 2024 report lists three rounds and a take-home test before the final round; Interview Query lists a recruiter phone screen, a hiring-manager interview and a panel interview, with Python and algorithms questions ranked as high-frequency

For the Ukraine team posting (SPD Technology for PitchBook), a stated process is: 30-45 minute recruiter pre-interview, 45 minute short tech screening, 45 minute manager interview, and a client interview with live coding up to 1.5 hours

Offer. Timeline: reports range from 2 to 3 weeks (September 2024) to 4 weeks (referral, August 2024) and 2 months (recruiter, 2023); a staff-level candidate called the process poorly run. Glassdoor engineering reports are few and mixed; treat details as indicative.

plaid.name: Plaid
plaid.note: Candidate guides describe about three to seven steps depending on era and team, with a practical, fintech-focused style over puzzles: Total about 2.5-3 weeks per one guide. Taro reports a low pass rate in the US, and some candidates describe the process as dated.
plaid.roles: Software Engineer (backend, API integrations, distributed systems, fintech infrastructure), Backend Engineer, Solutions Engineer (enterprise sales engineer). Offices include San Francisco, New York and Salt Lake City. Levels are not publicly structured.
steps: Recruiter / HR phone screen
Online assessment or coding challenge, in older reports a take-home challenge
Virtual technical interview (~90 min of live coding with many follow-ups; practical tasks such as scraping events, ingesting data and sending notifications appear in system design reports)
Virtual final onsite (a three-hour block reported in January 2026): technical rounds, project deep dive, behavioral / leadership conversations

playstation.name: Playstation
playstation.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Staff Software Engineer (including Cloud Engineering in the Future Technologies Group), Software Engineer (Mid to Senior, backend), Software Developer, DevOps and Systems Engineers. PlayStation is part of Sony Interactive Entertainment; reports come from San Mateo, San Diego, Aliso Viejo, Los Angeles, London, Dublin and Waterloo. No official level codes seen.
steps: Application online, referral or recruiter outreach
Recruiter screen

Hiring manager conversation (about 45 minutes, conversational on background and fit), then technical interviews: LeetCode-style coding (max subsequence sums, kth largest item), Java questions, a Java build-a-webstore exercise in one report, and project deep dives where your own project is picked apart

System design interview (deep follow-ups of 15-20 question threads in system-heavy roles), cross-functional panel and a behavioral interview on collaboration, conflict resolution, leadership and project impact
Decision. Guides say about 3-5 weeks over 2-5 rounds; reports range from under 2 weeks to 3 months, and some candidates describe slow feedback or being ghosted after the process (reports vary).

plymouth-rock-assurance-corporation.name: Plymouth Rock Assurance Corporation
plymouth-rock-assurance-corporation.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports and guides (public reports are mostly Glassdoor and Dataford / Interview Query guides, partly generic): Timeline: reports range from 1 week to 2 months; Interview Query says its guide is generic for the role and the company is described as Agile; treat details as indicative.
plymouth-rock-assurance-corporation.roles: Plymouth Rock Assurance (property and casualty insurer; Boston MA and Woodbridge NJ). Roles seen: Software Engineer (eBusiness applications; Java, AWS, SQL), Senior Java Software Engineer / Senior Java Developer, QA Engineer, Solutions Architect, AI Engineer, data scientists / modelers (statistical modelling and coding), business and product analysts. No numeric ladder seen beyond Senior.
steps: Application online, via recruiter, staffing agency or employee referral; phone screen

First round onsite or video at the Boston office with one or more engineers: reports describe four technical interviews of about 30 minutes each, covering standard Java questions, SQL joins, problems you faced and 'proud of something' questions, plus a discussion of your current project; guides say each interview lasts 30-45 minutes and covers system design, APIs and best practices
Data-science / modelling roles: technical questions on statistical modelling and applying it to code under pressure, one-week process (Woodbridge NJ, August 2022)
Decision. One Boston candidate had a director call two days after the onsite (about 2 weeks via a staffing agency, 3 weeks via recruiter); a Woodbridge referral case took 2 months (June 2024).

point72.name: Point72
point72.roles: Software Engineer (data, macro quant analytics, risk, treasury, controllers and equities middle-office technology), Quantitative Software Developer intern, Machine Learning / AI / NLP Engineer, SDLC and DevOps Engineer; Glassdoor is dominated by Analyst, Research Analyst, Quantitative Researcher and Associate reports.
steps: Application / recruiter contact
HackerRank online assessment (reported for many SWE candidates)
Technical interviews: SQL (T-SQL, joins, optimization), Java / C++ / OOP and architecture, algorithms, project and resume deep dives
Hiring manager and senior team member rounds, in some cases a 'Super Day' of back-to-back interviews; an HR round
Decision. Roughly 3-6 weeks, with Glassdoor reports ranging from days to 3 months; some candidates describe the process as disorganized.

posthog.name: Posthog
posthog.note: PostHog publishes its engineering hiring handbook page (see official sources) and its job postings spell out the stages: 1) a short intro call with a Talent Partner (20-30 min, the 'culture interview'); 2) a technical interview of 45-60 min with an engineer (described as having no live coding, often system design or an architecture session such as designing a product analytics app) plus a 15-30 min chat with the CEO or CTO; 3) the PostHog SuperDay, a paid full day of real work arranged around your schedule (the support hiring page states it pays 1,000 USD). One posting says 2-3 short interviews across 2-3 weeks, then the SuperDay. The handbook adds that interviewers may be shadowed by another PostHog team member and that Talent Partners handle all scheduling. Candidate reports (Taro) are mixed: about a 25% pass rate across 4 US reports, praise for transparency but complaints about disengaged interviewers, ordering of the process and unclear rejections.
posthog.roles: PostHog (open-source product analytics and observability platform, remote-first across US and EU; YC W20). Product Engineer (mid level, 3+ yrs; Growth, AI Product Engineer), Backend Engineer (Data Warehouse, APM / observability team), Full Stack Engineer, Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Technical Support Engineer, Developer Relations. Levels are not formally published; postings use Product Engineer / Backend Engineer titles.

postman.name: Postman
postman.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports, TechPrep (5-6 rounds, 'Applied Engineering': real working code and API-centric thinking) and Dataford (4 stages, 575 reports): Timeline: a May 2022 Software Engineer II candidate took 4 weeks over 5 rounds; Glassdoor shows about 60 days for software engineers (2 reports) vs 38 days company-wide; campus processes took 2 days. Taro shows a 29% pass rate across 21 India reports with positive experience ratings (83% positive for Bengaluru), while a 2022 Salt Lake City report was negative; one frontend candidate says HR ghosted after good interviews. Glassdoor rates difficulty 2.9/5 with 72% positive.
postman.roles: Postman (API platform; Bengaluru main engineering base, San Francisco, Salt Lake City, remote). Glassdoor volume: Software Engineer (about 62), Senior Software Engineer (about 15), Software Engineer II, Frontend Software Engineer, Software Engineer Internship / Intern, Account Executive, Solutions Engineer (5), Forward Deployed Engineer (5), Product Designer. Titles used in reports; no numeric ladder seen.
steps: Application online, referral or campus; resume screening and a screening round

Culture-fit round and technical rounds: DSA and practical coding, building a service and database schema, and a system design (for example a commenting application, general infra / DB / product questions); frontend roles have two technical rounds; a July 2025 Bengaluru report counts 5 rounds starting with a screening round
System design round (senior), hiring-manager and HR conversations, then offer or background check

profound.name: Profound
profound.note: Very few first-hand reports (PracHub lists 6; techinterview.org says no candidate report existed as of September 2026 and reconstructs the loop from comparable AI startups, so treat its loop as unconfirmed). A PracHub April 2026 report (easy): an HR/recruiter screen followed by a technical screen with an AI-assisted coding exercise. Scoutify's generic loop: a 30-minute intro call and a 45-60 minute technical interview. Techinterview.org's reconstructed loop emphasizes practical engineering rounds, measurement/evaluation of third-party model outputs, and a product-oriented conversation. Timeline not reported. Confirm stages with the recruiter.
profound.roles: Profound (tryprofound.com; AI answer-engine optimization and marketing platform; New York and San Francisco, in-office). Roles seen: Software Engineer (backend, full-stack), Software Engineer New Grad ($120-170k), Agent Engineer, Talent Engineer ($130-200k), AI Strategist, Account Management, Product Manager. I did not use pages about Profound Logic (IBM i modernization) or Profound Medical, which are different companies; the company says all official recruiter email comes from @tryprofound.com. No numeric ladder seen.

purestorage.name: Purestorage
purestorage.roles: Software Engineer on a Member of Technical Staff ladder (MTS2, MTS3, MTS4, MTS5 per a third-party guide, plus LS1 to LS3 levels there; unofficial), Software Engineer (MTS) in Mountain View, Santa Clara, Prague and Bengaluru, Software Development Engineer (SDE), interns.
steps: Recruiter contact (some older reports mention an online quiz first)
Phone / video screen with an engineer (coding, medium difficulty)

Virtual or onsite loop; reports describe three stages of two technical interviews plus a manager interview, or 2 technical rounds and 1 HR round for SDE roles in India; topics include data structures and algorithms, concurrency and object design, system design and, per one guide, Kubernetes and cloud / networking knowledge
Candidates sign an NDA before interviewing in some regions
Decision. A third-party guide gives about 7-14 days for the process; Taro stats show a low pass rate in a large US sample, and reports vary strongly by location and year.

pylon-lending.name: Pylon Lending
pylon-lending.roles: Generalist Software Engineer, Software Engineer New Grad, Junior Generalist Engineer, Newgrad Generalist Engineer, Backend Engineer (Underwriting), Senior Product Engineer, Senior Design Engineer. Pylon is the mortgage-lending-as-a-service company (TypeScript, GraphQL, PostgreSQL), a small team with in-office roles in New York, Palo Alto and Menlo Park. The sheet had only search links for this name; this match is clear from sources. No official level codes seen.
steps: Application online or recruiter outreach
Short recruiter / behavioral screen (a new grad candidate reports a basic behavioral interview and then a rejection before advancing)

Technical rounds reported only lightly: a generalist engineer reported a process that took about 1 week, with the team communicating each step clearly from the start; the interview-process details on the main career listings are not public
Decision. Glassdoor shows about 7 days on average from a very small sample (reports vary; data is very thin).

qualcomm.name: Qualcomm
qualcomm.roles: Software Engineer (largest report group), Engineer, Senior Engineer, Staff Engineer, Senior Staff Engineer, Embedded Software Engineer, Associate Engineer (campus hire), Staff Software Engineer, Systems / Verification / Hardware Engineer, internships. Qualcomm uses a title ladder (Associate Engineer through Senior Staff and above); numeric levels in third-party guides are unofficial.
steps: Application online, campus hire or referral
Phone screen and/or online skills test (some reports describe a written or coding test)

Technical interview rounds: C / C++ fundamentals, data structures (linked lists, trees, circular buffer), OS concepts (mutex, semaphores, scheduling), shell scripting, projects and past experience; LeetCode-style DSA in some teams
Hiring manager round and a panel of several interviews (a 2026 San Diego report describes one hiring manager round then four panel interviews; some candidates meet a director), then HR round
Decision. Glassdoor shows about 8 days on average for software engineers, but individual reports range from 1 day to several months (reports vary).

qualified-health.name: Qualified Health
qualified-health.note: These three steps and an estimated 3-5 week timeline come from a single guide page that reads as generic, so treat them as indicative only; no first-hand candidate reports for this company were found. Similarly named firms (Qualis Health, Qualitas Health) showed up in results and were ignored.
qualified-health.roles: Software Engineer is the only role seen in sources. Qualified Health is described by a guide site as a company building a generative-AI SaaS platform for health systems; the sheet's reports may be about this company, but that match is not confirmed. Interview-report volume is very small.
steps: Initial screening
Technical assessment
Behavioral / culture-fit interview

quantbot-technologies.name: Quantbot Technologies
quantbot-technologies.note: Very few candidate details. Glassdoor (2025-2026): Quantitative Researcher reports from Hong Kong and London (no offer, positive experience, average difficulty), and a Data Analyst report from New York where the process took 3 weeks and a Python/pandas merge-on-index question was asked. A 1point3acres thread covers a Quant Research round-2 interview (details behind a login). Internship postings describe embedding in a PM team and working with a developer and researcher. Generic quant-firm processes (not specific to Quantbot) run 4-6 stages over a month or more: CV and recruiter screen, online coding or probability/statistics assessment, technical interviews on probability, statistics, ML and coding, then a final round; confirm the actual stages with the recruiter. Timeline specific to Quantbot not reported.
quantbot-technologies.roles: Quantbot Technologies is a global systematic quantitative investment firm (New York, London, Hong Kong; 51-200 employees per a jobs site). Roles seen: Quantitative Researcher (full-time and Summer 2027 internships, London and New York), Quantitative Developer (including 2027 internship embedded in a PM team), Machine Learning Research Engineer internship, Data Analyst. A summer 2027 New York researcher internship posts pay of about $84-96 per hour. No level ladder seen.

qube-research-and-technologies.name: Qube Research & Technologies
qube-research-and-technologies.note: Timeline: reports vary, about 1 week to 3 months; internship processes average about 5 weeks per one guide, and developer processes 1-2 months.
qube-research-and-technologies.roles: Quantitative Researcher / quant trader (internship, graduate, PhD and postdoc tracks), Quantitative Developer and Software Engineer (internship, graduate and experienced), including C++ and low-latency roles. Offices reported: London, Paris, Zurich, Geneva, Hong Kong, Singapore, Dubai, Mumbai and others. Candidates apply to a location and get matched to a team during the process. No level ladder seen.
steps: Online application (rolling review)
HR / recruiter call (motivation, background, basic coding and statistics)

Online assessment: HackerRank-style test; for developers LeetCode easy-to-medium problems plus multiple-choice on language features and CS; for researchers a statistics-and-coding test (one guide says 90 min); some candidates report no online test

Technical interviews by Zoom: probability, statistics, linear algebra, Python/pandas, data structures, dynamic programming and C++ for developers; often with a junior then a senior researcher or team managers
Superday / assessment centre, on-site or online, with several interviewers of about 1 hour each, sometimes a relaxed chat with a senior director
Offer

quora.name: Quora
quora.note: Candidate sources describe a fast, hands-on loop (Taro: pass rate about 11% across 54 US reports, so extremely selective; older Quora-challenge reports exist):
quora.roles: Software Engineer (also Mountain View, New York and India), Software Engineer - Machine Learning, Software Engineer Tools and Platform, Mobile Engineer, Security Engineer (Senior Infrastructure Security), Software Engineer Intern, SDE (Mumbai). A third-party site labels engineer levels L3-L7 (unofficial). The company also builds the Poe AI platform.
steps: Automated timed coding assessment (older route: solve a few Quora challenges and a recruiter emails to schedule a screen)
Phone / video screen with an engineer or hiring manager (algorithms, about 45 min; examples reported include tree depth lists, matrix rotation, array and string problems)

Onsite / virtual loop of about 3-4 rounds: more algorithm rounds, a practical section where you hack on an existing Java or Python codebase, system design for senior levels, and a behavioral / culture round; ML roles add questions such as how to build the Quora feed with ML
Decision, often within about 1-2 weeks per one site; Glassdoor reports range from 2 to 4 weeks.

ramp.name: Ramp
ramp.roles: Software Engineer, Senior and Staff Software Engineer (e.g. iOS), Frontend Software Engineer, software engineering interns; Glassdoor volume is dominated by Sales Development Representative, Account Manager and Customer Success roles.
steps: Recruiter screen (background and motivation, ~30 min)
Automated coding assessment (CodeSignal-style) and/or a ~60 min technical phone screen

Practical live rounds: collaborative pair-programming style builds (React/DOM for frontend, spreadsheet-style implementation, no tricks), light system design, project deep dive, behavioral; an AI-assisted coding round is reported as emerging
Decision. Usually 4-6 rounds over about 2-4 weeks; some candidates report slow follow-ups. Reports describe practical engineering judgment valued over LeetCode grinding.

rbcroyalbank.name: Rbcroyalbank
rbcroyalbank.note: Varies by role and team; Glassdoor average is about 18 days for software engineers (22 days company-wide), with some candidates reporting 2+ months:
rbcroyalbank.roles: Royal Bank of Canada (RBC) and RBC Capital Markets. Software Engineer / Software Developer, Senior and Staff Software Engineer, Lead Software Engineer, Machine Learning Software Engineer, Software Engineer Intern (Toronto, Montreal, Edmonton, Calgary, Vancouver, Jersey City and others). A candidate guide labels engineering levels PL05-PL10 (unofficial). Glassdoor reports also cover Financial Analyst, Account Manager and many other bank roles.
steps: Resume screen, then a recruiter or quick hiring-manager screening call (~30 min, behavioral and situational questions)
Online coding assessment (CodeSignal reported, about 4 hard questions; LeetCode-style problems)

Technical interview(s) over video with screen sharing, covering coding, stack vs list type concepts, project deep dive; some teams add a take-home exercise with a presentation during the onsite, and senior levels add system design
Behavioral / culture-fit interview, then offer. Some candidates report waiting a month without closure.

read-ai.name: Read.Ai
read-ai.note: Very thin data. One Senior Software Engineer candidate (recruiter-sourced, Nov 2025, no offer, rated an average interview and a negative experience) reported a phone interview with practical coding-style questions (return the average image size from Wikipedia; calculate the number of days between two dates). No other stages, round counts or timeline were found in search results.
read-ai.roles: Senior Software Engineer (Backend Media Capture, Backend Data, Frontend, Fullstack, Growth Fullstack) per Glassdoor job listings, all based in Seattle. Read AI is the meeting intelligence company at read.ai. Only a single candidate report was found, so nothing is known about other levels.

reddit.name: Reddit
reddit.roles: Software Engineer (IC1 / SWE I through IC2, IC3, IC4 Senior, IC5 Staff, up to IC7 Principal per candidate guides, unofficial), plus backend, ads and ML-flavored engineering teams. Reports in the sheet are most likely for software engineering roles.
steps: Application online or via recruiter outreach
Recruiter call
Technical phone screen (LeetCode-style coding, often backend-focused)
Virtual onsite of roughly 4-6 rounds: coding, system design (heavier for senior levels), behavioral / project deep-dive
Decision. Candidate guides put the total at about 2.5-4 weeks, though individual reports range from 2 weeks to 2 months (reports vary).

reevo.name: Reevo
reevo.roles: Software Engineer / 'Builder - AI Engineer' (Junior, Senior, Staff, Senior Staff, AI/LLM-focused, onsite in Santa Clara), Front-End Software Engineer, Forward-Deployed Engineer, Account Executive, and 'Builder' roles in marketing, customer success and recruiting. Sources are for Reevo (reevo.ai, an AI revenue / go-to-market software company); similarly named firms (Evolution AI, Evolv AI, REVEL) also showed up and were ignored.
steps: Application online or via recruiter
Short recruiter / team-member conversation (30 min)

Practical work sample: a custom project where you explain your approach and reasoning; a Blind post says the engineering loop includes a problem-solving round that encourages an AI-assisted IDE, an open-ended system design round, and a product-sense round focused on customer empathy
Final virtual-onsite style round(s) with upper management / founders

Decision. A Glassdoor candidate describes a fast, straightforward process of about 2 rounds. Evidence is thin (about 5 reports on Dataford and a few comments on Glassdoor and Blind), so treat as indicative only.

remitly.name: Remitly
remitly.roles: Software Engineer / Software Development Engineer (SDE I, II, Senior, Staff, Principal; a candidate guide labels L1-L5 plus engineering manager EM III-IV, unofficial), Software Engineer Intern. Offices include Seattle, Burnaby / Vancouver (Canada) and other global hubs.
steps: Recruiter screen / call (sometimes with a scheduling delay of several weeks)
Phone or CoderPad screen: one coding round (a coding problem that must pass test cases, not a classic LeetCode question; streaming-style problems also reported)

Onsite / virtual loop: about 3 interviews - two coding rounds plus one behavioral and design round; each interview often starts with behavioral questions, then a data-structures coding challenge; senior levels add a 60-min system design
Hiring manager conversation, then decision. Overall about 2-4 weeks, with Glassdoor reports of up to 4 weeks and varying by account.

render.name: Render
render.roles: Software Engineer (Product, Growth, Billing, Dev Velocity), Senior Software Engineer (Product), Backend Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, UX Engineer, Engineering Manager, Developer Advocate, UX/UI Designer. Render is a cloud hosting platform (render.com); mostly remote US plus San Francisco.
steps: Application online
Recruiter screen on background and role fit
Hiring-manager conversation (the key early stage for management and design tracks)

Technical round(s) tailored to the role: a practical technical challenge or deep-dive session (reported for backend and developer-advocate roles), a simple ops task plus open-ended process and systems-design questions for SRE, live coding such as traffic analysis and rate limiting for software engineers; reports say no LeetCode-style gotchas for some roles
Further stages for software engineers per a guide: system design and a behavioral / cross-functional round (4-5 stages total)

Decision. Reports vary: about 1 week to 5 weeks; Glassdoor puts Render's hiring at about 15 days. Render says its process is unique to each role, and a 2024 backend candidate was unhappy with the unclear technical deep-dive; Render's recruiting team replied that it would explain that session better.

replit.name: Replit
replit.note: A DesignGurus guide says Replit publishes a four-stage process (I did not find the official URL): recruiter interview, hiring manager interview, technical interview (a live exercise or a take-home, depending on the role), and a panel interview; Replit says its exercises are real challenges like its daily work with no trick questions. Candidate reports match this and add: Timelines: about 2 weeks on average for software engineers per DesignGurus, 3-4 weeks in Glassdoor reports (Jan 2025, May 2026). Taro shows a very low pass rate (0 of 5 US reports) and several negative experiences, including a May 2026 candidate who felt the loop was not well calibrated to the role.
replit.roles: Replit (AI-native software creation platform, Foster City CA). Software Engineer (Compute Platform, Enterprise, Growth, Developer Experience), Staff Software Engineer (e.g. Money), Product Engineer (Product Platform), Frontend Engineer, DevOps / SRE, Solutions Engineer, Engineering Manager, Software Engineering Intern (Summer 2026). Levels are not published.
steps: Recruiter screen, then a hiring-manager chat

Technical interview: practical coding such as an operational-transformation problem (build insert / skip / delete from append, right and backspace operations), basic API calls with data manipulation, or designing and building a simple app using Replit itself
Panel / final interviews, then decision

resolve-ai.name: Resolve.Ai
resolve-ai.note: I did not find candidate-written reports specific to Resolve AI's engineering loop. Scoutify's company page says the process includes screening interviews and technical assessments but gives no round counts, and its question list is inferred from job postings rather than from real candidates. Treat the stages as unconfirmed; the process is described as a standard software engineering loop for an early-stage startup.
resolve-ai.roles: Resolve AI (autonomous 'AI Production Engineer' for incident investigation and production troubleshooting; San Francisco HQ, applications via Ashby). Software Engineer, Enterprise Solutions Engineer, Enterprise Account Executive, Technical Recruiter; Scoutify counts about 19 open roles. Levels are not published. Several search results were for unrelated companies named Resolve (Resolve Systems, Resolver, involve.ai, Solve Intelligence) and were ignored.

retell.name: Retell
retell.note: Engineering path per Retell's job postings (hosted by third-party job boards that source them from Retell's careers page) and candidate reports:
retell.roles: Software Engineer (backend, full-stack, GTM and 'Founders Initiatives' internal AI systems), Senior and Founding Senior Software Engineer, Staff Engineer (platform/systems), Founding Forward Deployed AI Engineer, Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (Mandarin), Internal Deployed Engineer. Offices: San Carlos / Redwood City / San Francisco Bay Area, on-site. Exponent tags one report as Mid Level / L4 (unofficial). Retell's own job postings state that offers depend on interview performance, not experience or past salary.
steps: Intro call with the recruiter / talent team (15-20 min)
Online assessment for some roles: HackerRank, 2 coding questions in 25-30 min (7 days to complete)
First technical phone interview (45 min): system design and project deep dive, or CoderPad algorithms for backend roles
Second tech screen (30-45 min): tools and automation, or full-stack JS/TS/React/Node; staff roles get a design-only round with no coding

Final interview: a 90-minute coding and technical round (sometimes on an existing codebase), a 30-minute cross-functional interview and a 30-minute past project deep dive; candidate reports describe phone screen plus four onsite rounds, with one founder interviewer who muted himself
Decision. Offers are tied to interview performance per the postings; timelines were not clearly reported. Some reports are rejections after the technical screen.

retell-ai.name: Retell AI
retell-ai.note: Engineering path per Retell's job postings (hosted by third-party job boards that source them from Retell's careers page) and candidate reports:
retell-ai.roles: Software Engineer (backend, full-stack, GTM and 'Founders Initiatives' internal AI systems), Senior and Founding Senior Software Engineer, Staff Engineer (platform/systems), Founding Forward Deployed AI Engineer, Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (Mandarin), Internal Deployed Engineer. Offices: San Carlos / Redwood City / San Francisco Bay Area, on-site. Exponent tags one report as Mid Level / L4 (unofficial). Retell's own job postings state that offers depend on interview performance, not experience or past salary.
steps: Intro call with the recruiter / talent team (15-20 min)
Online assessment for some roles: HackerRank, 2 coding questions in 25-30 min (7 days to complete)
First technical phone interview (45 min): system design and project deep dive, or CoderPad algorithms for backend roles
Second tech screen (30-45 min): tools and automation, or full-stack JS/TS/React/Node; staff roles get a design-only round with no coding

Final interview: a 90-minute coding and technical round (sometimes on an existing codebase), a 30-minute cross-functional interview and a 30-minute past project deep dive; candidate reports describe phone screen plus four onsite rounds, with one founder interviewer who muted himself
Decision. Offers are tied to interview performance per the postings; timelines were not clearly reported. Some reports are rejections after the technical screen.

retool.name: Retool
retool.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports, Taro and a 2022 Medium post (company says on Glassdoor it is re-evaluating its interview structure, so details may have changed):
retool.roles: Software Engineer (26 Glassdoor reports; San Francisco), with team-specific postings such as Software Engineer Observability, AI Product Engineer, Core Services, Cloud Platform, Apps Builder Experience, Resources, Enterprise Expansion and Governance (posted bands about $164-306k). Also sales engineer, support engineer, technical account manager and solutions engineer. No numeric level ladder seen.
steps: Application online, referral or recruiter; recruiter call (brief introduction, background, role fit, logistics)
Technical coding screen of about 1 hour online: LeetCode-medium on arrays, or practical tasks such as building a form in React and implementing Wordle's algorithm in a language of choice

Onsite of one day: reports mention two 1-hour pair-programming rounds, a system design round, and practical, iterative questions (for example writing a SQL evaluator in any language; a mix of frontend-specific and general programming) rather than LeetCode puzzles; behavioral questions on team challenges

Offer. Timeline: Glassdoor reports range from 1 week to 4 weeks (4 weeks via referral or recruiter; one report shows 90 days for a single software engineer), company-wide average about 49 days. Taro shows a 27% pass rate across 22 reports with 59% positive experiences; candidates say the process is well organised and practical, with a few finding it difficult (4/5).

reuters.name: Reuters
reuters.roles: Software Engineer (largest group), Senior Software Engineer, Lead Software Engineer, Staff Software Engineer, Software Engineer AI / Machine Learning (including CoCounsel), Intern, Software Developer. Thomson Reuters uses TR-numbered levels (TR3 Principal to TR7 Associate per a third-party guide, unofficial). The sheet notes this row as a duplicate / alias of Thomson Reuters, and Glassdoor counts also include many non-engineering roles (Correspondent, Content Specialist, Account Manager).
steps: Application online, recruiter, referral, university or staffing agency
Online technical screening (HackerRank assessment is common; one candidate did not know it was a technical assessment)
Technical interviews: programming round, SQL and project / resume deep dive (guides say the process is built around your own work more than hard puzzles), system design round for senior roles
Manager round, then HR round; one Washington DC senior report lists online screening, programming, system design, then leadership and behavioral round over about a month

Decision. Glassdoor shows about 7 days for software engineers and about 19 days for senior ones, though reports range from 2 days to 4 weeks and some candidates say HR stops replying after consideration (reports vary).

revolut.name: Revolut
revolut.note: Revolut's own blog 'How to ace your Java interview at Revolut' (March 2025) covers its Java engineer process, and eFinancialCareers reported on Revolut revealing a five-stage engineering process. Candidate sources describe 4-6 stages over 3-6 weeks, and a production-focused style:
revolut.roles: Software Engineer (Java, Python, frontend, backend; graduate and internship programmes for 2027), Senior Software Engineer, Lead and engineering manager tracks (candidate guide labels Junior / Middle / Senior / Lead, unofficial), Applied AI Engineer. Glassdoor volume is dominated by Account Executive, Customer Support, Operations Manager, Recruiter and Data Analyst reports.
steps: Screening call with a recruiter, with some basic technical questions
Live coding (about 1 hr) on a practical problem judged on code quality and test coverage (e.g. implement a simple load balancer in Java, a thread-safe URL shortener)
Technical interviews on concurrency and multithreading, locking (pessimistic vs optimistic), SQL and banking-style problems; system design (e.g. a booking system) for senior roles
Team fit and values conversation, then decision. Taro shows a low pass rate (about 13% across 138 reports).

rillet.name: Rillet
rillet.note: Public data is thin, but a few sources agree: a June 2026 Glassdoor report says the first step was a 30-minute introduction with a recruiter and the second a 30-minute behavioral interview with the hiring manager (interviewers described as kind and engaged; one candidate calls it a refreshing contrast to cold interviewers elsewhere); a February 2026 report via recruiter took 2 weeks and was very positive; techinterview.org (updated July 2026) describes the engineering loop as a recruiter screen, a hiring-manager conversation, a practical take-home exercise, and a technical interview with collaborative coding plus backend system design (ledger-style design), not LeetCode-heavy, and says to expect two to three weeks from recruiter screen to offer if the take-home is turned around quickly; two 2026 backend phone-screen reports are on 1Point3Acres. ZeroG Talent says Rillet has no public hiring playbook and that its founder-led approach weights core accounting-domain expertise. Glassdoor shows about 7 days hiring time across 8 reports. A PracHub senior SWE technical-screen report (October 2026) calls the experience strange.
rillet.roles: Rillet (AI-native ERP and accounting software for finance teams; San Francisco and New York, remote-friendly; founder-led, small). Roles seen on Lever and job boards: Software Engineer (SF / NYC; late-2025 posting $160-200k base plus equity for 2+ years; Zero G Talent shows $170-270k bands), Software Engineer (Platform), Senior Software Engineer (5+ years; backend-focused fullstack in Kotlin / Java / JVM, TypeScript a plus), Staff Software Engineer, Applied AI Engineer, Engineering Manager (Platform; Product Engineering), plus Account Executive, Solutions Consultant and Deployment Lead - Accounting Solutions. Titles are flat; the company is too small for a levels page.

riotgames.name: Riotgames
riotgames.roles: Software Engineer (Associate Software Engineer P1, P2, Senior P3, Staff P4, Principal P5, Senior Principal P6 per third-party guides, unofficial), Senior / Lead Software Engineer, Software Engineering Manager, game tech and platform engineers across LA, Dublin, New York and other hubs.
steps: Application online, referral or recruiter
Recruiter screen
Separate early conversations in some cases: a values / personality chat with the team's producer or hiring manager, then a technical conversation with a team programmer
Take-home or online coding assessment (reports include an easy LeetCode-style problem with a long window and a take-home C++ exercise later discussed in a technical follow-up)

Final loop split into several interviews (one Dublin report describes a final round broken into 4 separate interviews, 8 rounds in total): coding, systems design / architecture (for example a password reset system), a craft round (for example data modeling and SQL), and values alignment
Decision. Guides say 4-8 weeks, with some reports of 2-3 months and 7 rounds (reports vary).

ripple.name: Ripple
ripple.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports and guides:
ripple.roles: Ripple (crypto / cross-border payments; Chicago, San Francisco, New York, London, Toronto, Dublin, remote). Glassdoor engineering volume: Software Engineer (about 40 reports), Senior Software Engineer (12), Staff Software Engineer (3), Software Engineer II, Staff Full-Stack Software Engineer, Staff DevOps Engineer, Senior Software Engineer in Risk / Banking Connectivity / Cash Forecasting, and interns. A third-party prep site lists Software Engineer I (0-2 yrs), II (2-5), Senior (5-10), Staff (8-15), Senior Staff and Principal levels (unofficial, from a candidate-prep site).
steps: Application online or via recruiter; recruiter call and phone screening

Technical screen: a recruiter schedules a technical interview (Toronto SWE II report); questions include stock-change and statistics-of-data problems, decomposing a monolith into microservices (staff level), and a March 2026 report describes passing a phone screen and then three 45-minute interviews the next week (1 technical, 2 behavioral) that felt conversational

Onsite / virtual loop: TechPrep says system design is a dedicated onsite round and one of the more differentiating stages, with the full process about four weeks; hw.glich.co lists 3-4 rounds depending on level

Decision. Timeline: Glassdoor shows about 29 days company-wide and about 8 days for staff engineers (3 reports); reports range from 1 week to 2 weeks (a 2022 staff report took 2 weeks). Taro shows a 0% pass rate across 11 Senior SWE reports with mixed experiences (45% positive, 45% negative); a 2014 report mentions a language-barrier technical screen.

rippling.name: Rippling
rippling.roles: Software Engineer / Software Development Engineer (levels L5-L10 in candidate guides, unofficial: SWE, Software Engineer II, Senior, Staff, Senior Staff, Principal), interns, and campus SDE hiring in India.
steps: Recruiter call (15-30 min); an online assessment for interns/new grads in some cases
Technical phone screen (~1 hr, often LeetCode-style or a build-up problem where one class grows more complex each step)
Hiring manager screen
Onsite / virtual loop: coding, system design (used for leveling), project discussion and behavioral, with team members and leadership
Decision. Decentralized: you interview for a specific team. About 4-6 weeks; some reports as short as 1-2 weeks.

rivian.name: Rivian
rivian.roles: Software Engineer (Software Engineer I), Software Engineer II, Senior Software Engineer, Staff Software Engineer, Principal Software Engineer, Backend Engineer, embedded and robotics software engineers, plus Program Managers and QA Engineers in report counts. A third-party guide maps levels to RIV-3 (SE I), RIV-4 (SE II), RIV-5 (Senior), RIV-6 (Staff), RIV-7 (Senior Staff), RIV-8 (Principal) and RIV-9 (Distinguished); this mapping is unofficial. Reports come from Irvine, Palo Alto and other sites.
steps: Application online or recruiter outreach
Recruiter / HR phone screen (logistics, background and an overview of the process)

Hiring manager call (about 30 minutes) on day-to-day work, then a technical screen or live coding round (data structures and algorithms; C++ memory management and pointers for embedded-leaning teams; a laid-back resume and project-focused screen for some)

Loop of panel interviews, which can include system design, a cross-functional interview, a project presentation and domain topics such as robotics debugging or high-voltage experience; a guide describes about 5 rounds

Decision. Guides say about 2-6 weeks; individual reports range from 2 weeks to nearly a month waiting for feedback, and Taro shows a low US pass rate (about 8 percent among 25 reports) (reports vary).

ro-co.name: Ro.Co
ro-co.note: Ro's careers page warns about recruiter impersonation scams and says real recruiters use @ro.co emails, but does not publish the interview steps. Candidate sources describe a practical, healthcare-focused loop of about 4-6 rounds over 4-5 weeks (TechPrep):
ro-co.roles: Ro (Ro.co; direct-to-patient telehealth, pharmacy and lab services; New York HQ, hybrid). Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (Backend, Frontend, Care Platform Operations, Clinical Workflows), Staff Software Engineer (Backend, Identity and Privacy, Patient Experience / Tech Lead), Principal Software Engineer, Engineering Manager (Core Infrastructure), Senior Applied AI Engineer. Ro's careers page lists exactly these titles; stack mentions Python, Django, FastAPI. A third-party page labels engineering levels L1-L5+ (unofficial).
steps: Recruiter screen (30-45 min)

Technical phone screen (about 60 min coding with an engineer) or a coding assessment followed by a follow-up discussion; one Sept 2026 report for a Senior Applied AI Engineer describes an HR screen, then a one-hour take-home online assessment, with a rejection the next day

Onsite or virtual rounds with different team members and cross-functional partners (Glassdoor 2020 senior report: recruiter call, hiring manager call, take-home, onsite with team and cross-functional members, then a meeting with the CTO and co-founders); behavioral questions about patient impact and trade-offs

Decision. Glassdoor reports are mostly older (2019-2022) and mixed, with one calling it the best interview process the candidate had been through, and a PracHub post noting there are almost no recent reports.

robinhood.name: Robinhood
robinhood.roles: Software Engineer (backend, infrastructure, product; internal levels IC3-IC8 in candidate guides, unofficial), Senior Software Engineer, Quality Engineer, interns, Product Manager; Glassdoor also shows many Customer Experience Representative, Customer Service and Brokerage Representative reports.
steps: Recruiter call
Technical phone screen: HackerRank challenge or a LeetCode-style live coding round
Additional recruiter call
Onsite / virtual rounds (3-5): coding, system design (trading app, job scheduler, order handling themes; Kafka/Redis style messaging), deep dive into a past project, behavioral
Team matching, then offer. About 4-6 weeks per one guide; Glassdoor average about 3 weeks; scheduling can be slow.

roblox.name: Roblox
roblox.roles: Software Engineer (early career, Software Engineer, Senior, Principal; candidate guides use IC1-IC6, unofficial), Game Developer, interns, engineering managers, plus Content Moderator and Product Designer per Glassdoor.
steps: Online assessment on Roblox's own platform: game-style tasks (e.g. car and factory games) plus LeetCode-style questions
Recruiter call (~30 min)
Technical phone screen (60-90 min, LeetCode-style)
Onsite of ~4-7 hrs: coding, system design, and a task about making structure out of ambiguity; short behavioral round
Bar raiser interview (~1 hr) and team matching, then offer. Process is decentralized and varies by role; about 4-6 weeks overall.

rogo.name: Rogo
rogo.note: Very few candidate reports (Exponent says it does not know much about Rogo yet). Per a techinterview.org guide (updated July 2026, unconfirmed): recruiter/intro conversation, a coding round at medium level that parses, transforms and processes structured financial data with follow-ups on complexity and edge cases, then technical/product-engineering rounds, and a founder or hiring-manager conversation that closes things out (behavioral stories about ownership). A 1point3acres thread covers an onsite for a data science full-time role (applied AI, coding, project deep dive, behavioral rounds; details behind a login). Timeline per the guide: about two to four weeks from first contact to offer, and it can compress or stretch with founder scheduling. Treat the details as indicative only.
rogo.roles: Rogo is a generative-AI platform for financial services (New York, with a London office). Engineering roles seen on investor job boards: Software Engineer (Product), Software Engineer (AI), Software Engineer: Fullstack (5+ years), Staff Software Engineer: Backend, Forward Deployed Engineer, Entry-Level Engineer, Design Engineer, Software Engineer: Internal Automation, Cloud Engineer (Azure), enterprise and application security engineers; also data science. Mostly in-office or hybrid in New York. No numeric level ladder seen.

rokos-capital-management.name: Rokos Capital Management
rokos-capital-management.note: Quant developer / graduate path per candidate reports (2018-2025; 'a lot of different rounds' and a PDF describing about 5 rounds):
rokos-capital-management.roles: Rokos Capital Management (London-based global macro and multi-strategy hedge fund founded by Chris Rokos, formerly Brevan Howard; also an office in Newcastle upon Tyne). Roles seen in Glassdoor reports: Quantitative Developer (most reports), Graduate Developer, software engineers, plus accountants, financial controllers and trading-support roles. No numeric ladder; entry routes are graduate programmes and experienced hires.
steps: Application online, through a recruiter or an agency; first an automated stage: two separate online assessments, overseen by recruiter Dartmouth Partners in some cycles: a coding test (one 2025 report: three LeetCode-hard problems in 2 hours as a take-home) plus a mental maths and reasoning test, an IQ-style / Elenchus test (30 questions in 10 minutes in 2019), or a maths assessment on probability and financial maths (a logic test and a core A-level maths test)

Competency-based interview with the HR team (and a 30-minute video interview with Dartmouth in some cycles), then a hiring-manager or team video interview (algorithm and data-structure problems, university grades and A-level scores asked in some reports)

Half-day assessment centre in person with a general interview and a technical interview (a 2024 report: coding test + IQ test, then a whole half day of interviews), including a lot of technical questions on financial concepts for some roles

Decision. Timeline: reports range from 1-2 weeks to 4 weeks (Sep 2022 and Dec 2024) and up to 3 months (January 2024, five rounds). Glassdoor shows mostly no-offer reports with negative experiences for developers; one candidate calls the process bulky and robotic with no human contact until the fourth round.

rokt.name: Rokt
rokt.roles: Software Engineer (largest group), Senior Software Engineer, Junior Software Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, plus Account Manager, Digital Account Coordinator and Accelerator roles in Glassdoor counts. A third-party guide shows level codes such as L2, L4A, L4B, L5A, L5C, L6A and L6C (unofficial). Reports come from Sydney, New York, Seattle and other offices.
steps: Application online or employee referral

Timed aptitude and personality assessments (Criteria Cognitive Aptitude Test and Employee Personality Profile); a one-way AI video interview follows for some candidates, and some reports mention math, statistics and geometry questions
Take-home technical exercise (implement a functional API in any language with a written explanation, or a larger build such as a Google Analytics clone)

Live coding round (for example ReactJS plus ExpressJS, or LeetCode-style problems), then an onsite or virtual onsite with coding, system design and leadership rounds; a senior report counts three major rounds starting with the hiring manager

Decision. Interview Query says 5-6 stages over about 3-5 weeks; Glassdoor shows about 31 days for senior engineers; pass rates look very low in Taro data (about 8 percent for Sydney software engineers) and many candidates call the process assessment-heavy (reports vary).

roku.name: Roku
roku.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (largest report group), Principal Software Engineer, firmware / backend / frontend / mobile engineers, QA Engineer, Data Scientist, Engineering Manager and above. Other families in Glassdoor reports: Account Manager, Product Manager, Senior Recruiter. No official level codes seen.
steps: Application online or via recruiter
Recruiter phone screen (tech stack, experience)
Online assessment (HackerRank-style) and/or a technical call / Zoom with a senior engineer
Hiring manager Zoom interview
Final onsite panel, reported as about 3 rounds: algorithms, system design, behavioral
Decision. Guides say about 3-4 weeks; Glassdoor shows about 17 days for senior engineers on average, and some candidates mention being ghosted (reports vary).

rubrik.name: Rubrik
rubrik.note: Dataford (426 candidate reports) shows 4 stages; guides give 2-5 rounds over about 2-5 weeks (a third-party level page puts it around 14 days):
rubrik.roles: Rubrik (data security and cyber resilience; Palo Alto, San Francisco, Bengaluru, Pune). Software Engineer (backend, frontend, distributed systems), Senior and Staff Software Engineers, Software Engineer Intern, Software Engineering Manager, Solutions Engineer. A third-party site labels engineer levels L3 (SWE I), L4 (SWE II), L5 (SWE III), L6 (G8), L7 (G9), L8 (G10) and managers L3-L7 (unofficial).
steps: Recruiter screen (a LinkedIn approach or a long wait after applying are both reported; one 2025 candidate heard back six months after applying)
Live coding screen (one report: a snapshot-array style problem), sometimes a phone screen on data structures and algorithms

Onsite / virtual loop: data structures and algorithms (45 min), distributed-systems and backend design, behavioral and project discussion; frontend candidates report 9 interviews across experiences, including performance questions for large React data sets
Decision. Taro reports a pass rate of about 25% for SF software engineers and a very selective process overall, with a mix of positive and negative candidate experiences.

runway.name: Runway
runway.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports and guides (public data is thin and partly historical):
runway.roles: Sources are for Runway (Runway ML; generative AI video; New York NYC hybrid, plus California reports). Roles seen: Software Engineer (about $161-250k per a guide), Staff / Senior Product Engineer, AI Full Stack Engineer, Backend Engineer (API), Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, Research Scientist, Engineering Manager, Platform Engineer. I did not use pages that describe runway.com (the financial-planning company) such as a scoutify listing for a Forward Deployed Finance Partner. No numeric ladder seen.
steps: Application online or recruiter (a recruiter screen over video, mostly introductory: background, interest in Runway, fit)

Technical round(s): a 60-minute technical phone screen with an engineer on a practical problem (guides mention graphs, sliding window and intervals; code review of a sample pull request in a September 2022 SWE report); Runway is described as less of an algorithm gauntlet and more about practical engineering in a fast product environment

Hiring-manager round, a take-home assignment (a lengthy one, per Interview Query) and a final panel; ML engineers report two phone screens and ML system design (an August 2025 report was rejected there)

Decision. Timeline: TechPrep says about 4-5 weeks, Interview Query 3-6 weeks (5 rounds), Orbyt 2-4 weeks; Glassdoor 'Runway (NYC)' ML reports are 1 to 3 weeks. PracHub notes it could not verify two independent accounts of a 2026 SWE cycle, so treat round details as indicative.

salesforce.name: Salesforce
salesforce.note: Salesforce's own Trailhead module says engineering interviews start with a recruiter conversation, run through five milestones (it names Milestone 1 Recruiter Connect and Milestone 2 Hiring Manager Connect; I only saw those two names) and end with a final on-site at a Salesforce office, even for remote roles, with travel paid by Salesforce. Assessment covers technical skills plus behavioral qualities tied to Salesforce values (STAR-style answers). From candidate reports: online coding assessment (a genuine filter, camera on, ~60 min), technical coding screen, system design for experienced roles, behavioral/values round. About 3-5 weeks overall.
salesforce.roles: Software Engineer titled as Associate Member of Technical Staff (AMTS), Member of Technical Staff (MTS), Senior MTS (SMTS), Lead, Principal, Distinguished Engineer; also Technical Support Engineer, Solution Engineer, interns. Glassdoor is dominated by sales reports (Account Executive, BDR, Senior Account Executive).

samsara.name: Samsara
samsara.note: Candidate sources describe 4-5 rounds over about 3-5 weeks (some Glassdoor reports show 2 weeks):
samsara.roles: Samsara (connected operations cloud, IoT and fleet). Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (I, II), Staff and Senior Staff Software Engineer, Software Engineering Manager, Data Engineer, Solutions Engineer. A candidate guide labels SWE I-IV and L2-L8 style levels (unofficial).
steps: Recruiter screen (45 min for staff level)
Online coding assessment on CoderPad or HackerRank before live interviews, for many candidates
Live coding (practical problems such as Markdown parsing, debugging), practical system design, and a hiring-manager discussion; senior roles add questions about mentoring and technical decisions
Behavioral follow-ups, then decision. A 2026 report with an offer describes the process as built around a lot of rounds, including level 2 and level 3 rounds.

samsung.name: Samsung
samsung.roles: Software Engineer (L2 Engineer I through L7 Principal per third-party guides, unofficial), Senior Software Engineer, Staff Engineer, Lead Engineer, firmware, design verification and QA engineers. Samsung is a large group, so reports span Samsung Electronics (India, US, UK, Korea), Samsung Electronics America, Samsung Semiconductor and Samsung Austin Semiconductor; the sheet links samsung.com.
steps: Application online, campus hire or recruiter outreach on LinkedIn
Online coding assessment: campus hiring uses a coding round (Samsung's Software Competency Test is called the biggest filter in one guide); other reports mention HackerRank-style medium-hard problems
Technical interview: data structures and algorithms (graph traversal BFS / DFS), core CS fundamentals, project discussion
Behavioral / HR conversation (teamwork, why Samsung); US reports sometimes include an NDA and a hiring manager call; some teams add a panel
