Decision. Guides say 3-5 rounds; Glassdoor shows about 28 days on average for software engineers, and campus hiring can finish in one day (reports vary).

sap.name: SAP
sap.note: Software developer path per candidate reports and TechPrep:
sap.roles: Very broad enterprise-software company. Glassdoor engineering volume is led by Software Engineer (about 270 reports), Software Developer (232), Intern (229), Software Engineer Internship (70), Developer (86), Associate Developer (64), Senior Software Engineer (51), Developer Associate (39), Working Student (60), Scholar (44), plus Support Engineer, Consultant, Account Executive and Data Scientist. SAP uses numbered developer levels such as T1 Associate Developer, Developer, Senior Developer, Development Architect, per a third-party prep site (unofficial, from a candidate-prep site). Sites: Walldorf, Bengaluru, Montreal, Sofia, Seoul and many others.
steps: Application online, via university/campus, recruiter or referral

Recruiter or HR call (about 30 minutes: background, interest in enterprise software, 'Why SAP?'); campus drives and some regions start with an online assessment (one September 2025 report: 15 multiple-choice questions, one medium DSA problem and one SQL query)

Technical interview(s): two technical rounds covering data structures, OOP, SQL, C/C++/Java, operating systems and computer networks, plus project discussion and design-pattern and database-optimization questions; senior roles have up to six rounds in Bengaluru (two technical with senior developers, one with an architect, one cross-team)
Hiring-manager / managerial round and HR round; some recruiter-driven processes add a take-home

Offer. Timeline: Glassdoor shows about 34 days company-wide; reports range from 1 day (campus) to 4+ months; TechPrep says about 4-6 weeks. Glassdoor rates developer difficulty around 2/5 with high positive ratings.

scale-ai.name: Scale AI
scale-ai.roles: Software Engineer (new grad L3 up through L4-L8 per candidate guides, unofficial), Machine Learning Engineer, Applied AI Engineer / AI Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer (held to the same bar as SWE per Exponent), engineering manager (L6 per candidate guides, unofficial).
steps: Application

Online coding assessment, often HackerRank, about 1 hour with 1-2 medium-to-hard scenario-style problems (a card-game style question is frequently reported); for new grad the automated assessment can come before any recruiter conversation
Recruiter call (non-technical, resume focus; FDE candidates are also asked about FDE vs SWE preference)
Technical screen or hiring-manager interview: practical coding such as intervals and JSON processing, multi-part
Final / virtual onsite rounds: coding, debugging, system design for experienced levels, behavioral; Applied AI / ML roles add LLM and ML concept discussion, and some ML roles have a take-home
Decision. Reports vary: about 3 weeks to a month for SWE, about 4 weeks for 7-round AI Engineer loops, up to about 2 months and 10 interactions for FDE.

schneider-electric.name: Schneider Electric
schneider-electric.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Junior / Associate Software Engineer, Software Developer, Software Developer Co-op, plus industrial and energy-management software roles. Offices mentioned: Bengaluru, Galway (Ireland), Lund (Sweden), Athens, North America. The sheet's reports may also cover non-software roles at this large industrial company, which were not researched.
steps: Application online, university, recruiter or referral
HR / recruiter screen, or a HireVue interview with the recruiter and hiring manager (co-op cycles)

Technical interview of about 1 hour: language fundamentals (e.g. how a Java HashMap works), multithreading, object-oriented design, Azure experience, resume-led questions; difficulty reported as hard for senior roles
Final panel or manager interview, for example with a director and principal engineer on culture fit and alignment with company values; some reports mention a panel of two managers and HR
Decision. Reports vary: 1 day to about 3 months. Several senior candidates complain about long gaps between stages and poor communication; some reports describe a positive, open discussion.

schonfeld.name: Schonfeld
schonfeld.note: Per Interview Query, Dataford and candidate reports (generic structure, small first-hand sample):
schonfeld.roles: Schonfeld Strategic Advisors is a New York multi-manager, multi-strategy fund with a large quant arm (QIS). Roles seen: Software Engineer / Senior Software Engineer (trading, treasury, post-trade and securities-lending technology, C++ and Java, low-latency market data), Quantitative Developer (New York), Quantitative Researcher (New York, Summit NJ, Dubai, offices abroad), Quantitative Analyst, Data Scientist, Data Engineer (ETL pipelines), Data Analyst, Trading Assistant and CIO-office strategist roles. No level ladder seen.
steps: Application online or via staffing agency (two Glassdoor reviewers warned of agency-sourced roles that were not actively hiring), then a recruiter conversation about motivation, culture and fit

Technical assessment or screen: for software engineers, coding with modern stacks (Java, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes), distributed systems and data-pipeline design, low-latency/electronic-trading questions; for quant researchers, statistics and ML (deriving multivariate OLS, avoiding overfitting, dimensionality reduction for factor analysis)
Further technical interviews with team members, then a behavioral interview and meetings with the desk or portfolio-manager team

Decision. Timeline: Interview Query says about 3-5 weeks (4 rounds per Dataford for data scientists); Glassdoor reports range from 2 to 4 weeks. A March 2024 Summit NJ researcher reported an accepted offer after 4 weeks.

schwab.name: Schwab
schwab.roles: Software Engineer I, Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Staff Software Applications Engineer (Java), Senior Staff Software Engineer, Software Development Engineer, Software Engineer Intern. Reports come from Austin, Phoenix, New York, Arlington and other sites. Schwab also hires heavily in non-engineering roles. No official level codes seen beyond title tiers.
steps: Application online, campus or employee referral
Recruiter phone screen, then a series of phone interviews of about 30-60 minutes

Technical interview(s): Java / OOP and C# / .NET Core fundamentals, REST API, Angular state management for some teams, a simple coding question (for example a hashmap frequency count), project descriptions and scaling questions such as growing a product from 700 users to 1,000,000
Virtual onsite or panel with team members and a hiring manager, plus behavioral STAR questions (why Schwab, conflict with a teammate); one report counts five interviews in total
Background check and decision. Guides say 3-5 weeks over 3-4 stages; individual reports range from 2 weeks to 5 months, with some candidates describing the interviewers as unprepared (reports vary).

scribd.name: Scribd
scribd.roles: Software Engineer (including a mid-level content-understanding team report from 2026), Software Engineer II - Frontend, Backend-focused Software Engineer / Backend Engineer (Python), DevOps engineer, data engineer, data analyst / scientist, product growth analyst, product manager and QA engineer. Offices in reports: San Francisco, New York, Toronto / Mississauga and remote. No official level ladder seen.
steps: Application online or recruiter outreach
Recruiter phone screen

Technical screen with an engineer: coding (CoderPad session such as list operations), plus general topics for infra roles (traceroute, DB replication, snapshots); frontend guides mention pair programming

Hiring-manager interview, or a virtual onsite of about three rounds in guides: coding, system design (heavily weighted at senior level, e.g. dependency cycle detection across microservices), and behavioral/team fit; a September 2026 report from the content-understanding team says the onsite coding round was lost over missing metrics

Decision. Guides say about 3-5 weeks over 3 rounds; Glassdoor shows about 42 days; reports vary from 1 day to 3 weeks in older ones, and several candidates describe the process as disorganized or poorly communicated. Reviewer sentiment on Glassdoor is mostly negative for engineers.

serval.name: Serval
serval.note: Very few reports. One 1Point3Acres post (early 2026) describes a full-time Software Engineer tech phone screen with coding on a 'motion intensity stream' style problem and database schema design. Other aggregator pages (Scoutify, Dataford) have only generic or Account Executive content. No staged process or timeline was found for engineers; treat the loop as unknown beyond a technical phone screen with coding plus design.
serval.roles: Serval (AI-native IT service-management automation platform competing with ServiceNow; San Francisco, in-person). Software Engineer (backend, full-time), Senior Software Engineer, Backend; Forward Deployed Software Engineer (2+ years, customer pilots), Design Engineer (first design-focused frontend hire), Applied AI Engineer, Account Executive. Small team (11-50). Levels are not published.

shein.name: Shein
shein.note: Varies by office; Glassdoor shows an average of about 19 days company-wide and as little as 3 days for one engineer report, while a database engineer describes about a month:
shein.roles: SHEIN (global fast-fashion e-commerce; engineering hubs in Nanjing, Singapore, Dublin, Sydney, US). Software Engineer / SDE (backend, C++ and Java), SRE / DevOps Engineer, Database Engineer, Data Engineer, Data Analyst, UX/UI Designer, Product Manager, Business Analyst, Marketing Analytics Specialist, Account Executive, Project Manager. Dataford reports 173 SHEIN interview reports and positions the process as efficient but varied by role and office.
steps: Resume screening, then an online coding test (Nanjing SDE reports)
1-2 technical interviews on algorithms and coding, with language-specific internals such as memory management and concurrency in C++ or Java for engineers
A team / manager interview about projects and communication, and an HR interview (about 30 min in Sydney: self-introduction and career planning)

In the US, one database engineer report describes a hiring manager interview, a technical interview and a virtual onsite of three back-to-back sessions (2 behavioral and 1 technical) in about a month. Decision follows; sentiment on Dataford is 45% positive and the offer rate is reported around 41%.

shield-ai.name: Shield Ai
shield-ai.roles: Software Engineer (SWE I, mid-level; Planning and Controls and other teams), Senior Software Engineer, Staff Engineer, Software Engineer Intern, Software Applications Engineer, plus Electrical Engineer, Recruiter and AVO roles in Glassdoor volume. Offices: San Diego, Dallas / Frisco TX, Arlington VA, Washington DC, Amsterdam.
steps: Application online, university or recruiter
Recruiter Zoom call, then a hiring-manager interview
Take-home coding round (reported in the Arlington cycle) and/or a LeetCode-style technical interview

Onsite / virtual loop of about 4 hours (4 rounds over about 3 weeks in one Dallas report): coding, systems / engineering discussion, and values-based behavioral questions; candidates are asked which of Shield AI's three values or leadership principles stand out and are advised to give specific stories

Decision. Reports vary: about 3-6 weeks (4-5 weeks typical). Taro stats show a roughly 38% pass rate across 16 reports; reviews are mixed, with several describing a fair and thorough process and a 2026 candidate who declined an offer describing disorganized interviewers.

shopify.name: Shopify
shopify.roles: Software Developer / Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Tech Lead, interns, Data Scientist, Solutions Engineer, plus many non-engineering roles in Glassdoor (Support Advisor, Customer Success Guru, Account Executive, Merchant Success Manager, Team Lead). Levels are not clearly published.
steps: Application and short recruiter call (~30 min; some reports mention an IQ-test-style initial assessment)
Technical phone screen (~40 min) or a 60-75 min pair-programming session on a practical problem (AI use was encouraged in at least one 2026 report)
'Life Story' interview (~1 hr): a deep conversation about your background and motivations, weighted heavily for culture fit
Onsite / virtual rounds (3-4 hrs): pair programming, system design or a deep dive for senior roles, a take-home style build from a Google Doc spec in some cases
Decision. Decentralized - you interview for a specific team. About 3-5 weeks.

siemens.name: Siemens
siemens.roles: Software Engineer (T7 through T12 per third-party guides, unofficial), Senior Software Engineer, Graduate Engineer Trainee, Software Developer, interns, Project Engineer, Field Service Engineer. Siemens is a large group, so reports span units such as Siemens Digital Industries Software (EDA), Siemens Energy and Siemens Mobility; Glassdoor counts are led by Software Engineer, Intern and Software Developer.
steps: Application online, campus, recruiter or referral
HR screening call (about 45 min) and/or aptitude / online assessment (DSA-focused online tests reported)
Technical interview(s): OOP and language fundamentals (C++ for Siemens DI Software), coding problems, resume and project deep dive, role-specific stack questions, testing questions
Managerial or hiring manager conversation, then HR round; guides list 3-4 rounds, up to 5 for Siemens DI Software
Decision. Glassdoor shows about 18 days on average for software engineers; some reports stretch to about 3 months or end with automated rejections (reports vary).

sierra.name: Sierra
sierra.note: Sierra's own blog post 'The AI-native interview' (sierra.ai/blog/the-ai-native-interview; only snippets visible) says its engineering interview had been fairly standard (two coding interviews, algorithms, system design, culture fit, reference checks) and was redesigned from the ground up: the phone screen was replaced by a system design interview, and an AI-native onsite now tests product sense and building 0-to-1 with AI coding agents, supplemented by a round for taking a feature from 1-to-N in an existing messy codebase; the company notes the format is open-ended and harder to standardise, and links to sierra.ai/careers. Third-party guides (Final Round AI, techinterview.org, ZeroG Talent; partly reconstructed): recruiter screen (a video call that covers background, motivation, interest in AI agents, salary expectations and in-office expectations), the design interview, a Plan / Build / Review style AI-native onsite, then reference checks; Final Round AI says the process takes about 19 days on average, while ZeroG says four rounds over three to five weeks (a take-home to build a customer-service agent in one description) and Forward Deployed Engineer roles can run six or seven rounds over five weeks. Any guide dated before the company's April 2026 post describes the older process.
sierra.roles: Sierra (enterprise AI agent platform founded by Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor; San Francisco, onsite, plus other offices). Roles seen on Ashby and job boards: Software Engineer (Agent, Agent Architecture, Agent Builder, Agent Data Platform, Insights), Software Engineer Intern (Agent, Winter 2027), Forward Deployed Engineer, Research Engineer, product manager, Principal level ($700k-$950k+ per techinterview.org). Postings ask for 4-7+ years for Software Engineer roles; no numeric ladder seen.

sig.name: Sig
sig.note: Timelines vary from about 2 weeks to 2-3 months; some candidates describe slow communication after final rounds.
sig.roles: Susquehanna International Group (SIG), a trading and technology firm. Software Engineer (associate, software engineer, senior, technical lead per a candidate guide, unofficial), graduate software developer (Sydney, Dublin, Philadelphia / Bala Cynwyd), plus Quantitative Trader, Trading and Quantitative Research tracks with case-study and probability-style rounds.
steps: Online application (campus, Discovery Day or referral)
Timed online assessment on CodeSignal or HackerRank (about four coding questions in ~70 min, increasing difficulty; quant roles get quantitative / logic tests)
Recruiter screen (resume walk-through, 'why SIG')
Technical phone / live coding interviews with C++ depth, code optimization, OOP design, concurrency and memory topics; some graduate tracks add a behavioural interview and a case study
Final round or multi-hour 'Superday' (in person or virtual): coding, low-level design, probability and logic for some roles, behavioral with senior managers; team-matching conversations

sig-susquehanna.name: SIG (Susquehanna)
sig-susquehanna.note: Timelines vary from about 2 weeks to 2-3 months; some candidates describe slow communication after final rounds.
sig-susquehanna.roles: Susquehanna International Group (SIG), a trading and technology firm. Software Engineer (associate, software engineer, senior, technical lead per a candidate guide, unofficial), graduate software developer (Sydney, Dublin, Philadelphia / Bala Cynwyd), plus Quantitative Trader, Trading and Quantitative Research tracks with case-study and probability-style rounds.
steps: Online application (campus, Discovery Day or referral)
Timed online assessment on CodeSignal or HackerRank (about four coding questions in ~70 min, increasing difficulty; quant roles get quantitative / logic tests)
Recruiter screen (resume walk-through, 'why SIG')
Technical phone / live coding interviews with C++ depth, code optimization, OOP design, concurrency and memory topics; some graduate tracks add a behavioural interview and a case study
Final round or multi-hour 'Superday' (in person or virtual): coding, low-level design, probability and logic for some roles, behavioral with senior managers; team-matching conversations

sigmacomputing.name: Sigmacomputing
sigmacomputing.roles: Software Engineer (about 25 Glassdoor reports), Senior Software Engineer (full-stack, backend), Staff Software Engineer (frontend), software engineering interns, plus solutions engineer, account executive, marketing, product designer and sales roles. Offices: San Francisco and New York. No official level ladder beyond job titles.
steps: Application online or recruiter outreach (a 15-minute recruiter chat, then mostly automated emails and scheduling links in one 2023 report)

Online assessment or take-home coding challenge (Python friendly; some include an LLD / system design question such as designing a file system with constraints, or simulating basic SQL lookups with a hashmap), often done days before the first interview
Technical review / code-review of the assessment with an engineer plus behavioral questions (one report calls it a 'BQ round' on your most recent project)

Final technical round or virtual onsite of up to 4 rounds: 45-minute technical screen, two coding rounds, one system design round, and behavioral questions; one 2022 report describes a non-LeetCode technical screen

Decision. Reports say about 2-4 weeks; Glassdoor shows about 27 days company-wide; Taro shows a 14% pass rate across 29 software-engineer reports, and several candidates note they received no feedback.

snapchat.name: Snapchat
snapchat.note: About 3-6 weeks; some cases longer. Not fully standardized across teams.
snapchat.roles: Searched under Snap Inc (Snapchat's parent). Software Engineer (levels L3-L9 per candidate guides, unofficial; C++ and frontend tracks exist), Machine Learning Engineer, Data Scientist, Product Manager, Security Engineer, Account Manager/Executive, Content Analyst, Designer, interns and research interns.
steps: Recruiter call (30-60 min)
Technical phone screen (~1 hr, medium-level coding)
Onsite of several back-to-back interviews (up to ~6 hrs): coding, design for senior levels, C++ or frontend topics by team, behavioral
Centralized process - team matching happens at the end with calls to interested hiring managers, then offer

snorkel.name: Snorkel
snorkel.roles: Software Engineer, Senior / Staff Software Engineer (Product, backend-focused), Senior / Staff AI/ML Software Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, AI Researcher (Pretraining infra, L4 mentioned on one report), Technical Delivery Manager, Data Scientist. The sheet links snorkel.ai (Snorkel AI), with offices in San Francisco and Redwood City. A mid-level L4 label appears in one Exponent report; no other level codes seen.
steps: Application online, recruiter or other source
Recruiter screen by phone, then a Zoom call with a principal software engineer for some candidates
Technical screen: DSA (hash maps, stacks, heaps, queues) and basic system design with a coding problem such as implementing a SnapshotMap in a 2026 report

Loop of about 3-4 rounds, reported as a project deep dive, a systems and coding round and an AI round; a guide describes one onsite with a vague format given upfront and says platform engineers follow the most conventional track
Decision. Guides say about 2-3 weeks; one AI researcher report took 2 months and several candidates call the interviews tricky or mutually unbeneficial (reports vary).

snowflake.name: Snowflake
snowflake.roles: Software Engineer (levels IC1-IC6 per postings and guides: Software Engineer through Staff, Principal I/II), Senior Software Engineer, Distinguished (IC7), interns, ML engineer, data scientist/engineer, plus a large number of Sales roles (SDR, Account Executive, Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect) in Glassdoor reports.
steps: Recruiter call (~30 min)
Often an online assessment, then CoderPad coding rounds with follow-ups (one guide says Snowflake bans AI assistants in coding interviews and holds one coding interview in person)
5-8 rounds in total for engineers: coding, system design, database internals / distributed systems depth, behavioral with ownership focus, and a hiring-manager conversation
Debrief and decision, usually within a few days. Glassdoor average about 3-4 weeks.

socure.name: Socure
socure.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports and guides:
socure.roles: Socure is an identity-verification / fraud-prevention company (New York, Chennai, Bengaluru and remote). Glassdoor volume is led by Data Scientist (about 10), Software Engineer (about 6), Senior Data Scientist, Senior Software Engineer (about 5), AI Engineer, Software Developer, SDET, Android engineer, Senior DevOps engineer, plus solutions engineers and consultants. Levels shown only as Software Engineer / Senior; no numeric ladder seen.
steps: Application online, via recruiter or staffing agency; an initial HR call that walks you through the process

Technical interviews: DSA (e.g. lowest common ancestor in a binary tree) and low-level design; an older New York report had a quick HR call then a 2.5-hour programming challenge; a recent report lists one HR call, a phone interview with a VP, two technical interviews with a senior SWE and a staff engineer, and a final 30-minute project deep dive
Hiring-manager round that may test judgment under pushback (Interview Query's software engineer report: two technical conversations plus a hiring manager round)

Offer or rejection. Timeline: Interview Query says about 2-4 weeks over 3 rounds; Dataford says 3-4 weeks for AI engineers; reports vary from 1 day to 2 months, and older India/SDET reports mention up to 7 rounds and 3 written tests. A May 2026 candidate describes a month-long scheduling delay and a poor experience.

sofi.name: SoFi
sofi.roles: Software Engineer (SWE 1 / 2, Senior, Staff, Senior Staff, Principal, Senior Principal per candidate guides, unofficial), New Grad software engineer, engineering manager / director. Glassdoor report volume also includes non-engineering roles: Director, Mortgage Loan Officer and Customer Service Representative show up near the top alongside Software Engineer and Senior Software Engineer.
steps: Application online; recruiters often reach out quickly
Recruiter call (SoFi history, mission, why you want to join)
Technical screen: a coding round with an engineer from the team (DSA, sometimes SQL), or a HackerRank-style assessment
Hiring-manager conversation (behavioral plus some light technical / business context)

Virtual onsite of several rounds: coding with staff engineers (about 1 hour each), system design for regulated fintech, behavioral rounds; new-grad reports mention a director round at the end; some backend teams ask Java / Kotlin questions
Decision. Reports vary by team: about 2 to 5 weeks, with Glassdoor averaging around 24 days to hire.

sonatus.name: Sonatus
sonatus.roles: Senior Software Engineer (Dublin and US), Software Engineer, Cloud Backend Engineer (San Jose), Staff AI Engineer, AI Engineer, DevOps Engineer, QA / Senior Cloud QA Test Engineer. Sonatus is a software-defined vehicle platform company with San Jose and Dublin offices. No official level codes seen beyond title tiers.
steps: Application online or via recruiter
HR / recruiter screening call (about 30 min; process, team and role overview)
One-hour technical coding interview; a 2026 Dublin report describes only an HR call and then a 1-hour technical interview, taking 6 days
Further loop reported as about 3-4 coding rounds (mostly not traditional LeetCode-style) and 2 behavioral rounds, with deep dives into backend and embedded-adjacent systems for some roles
Decision. Guides say about 3-5 weeks; individual reports range from 6 days to 2 months, and several 2025-2026 candidates ended without an offer (reports vary).

soti.name: Soti
soti.note: GeeksforGeeks (Dec 2023) describes SOTI selection as two main rounds, a coding round and an interview round. Candidate reports add:
soti.roles: SOTI (enterprise mobility management; Mississauga ON, Cochin, Gurgaon, New Delhi). Software Developer 1 (SOTI posts these), Associate Software Engineer, Software Engineer I and II, Senior Software Engineer I and II, Principal Software Engineer, Software Development Manager, Senior Android Developer, SDET, Software Developer Intern, Full Stack Developer. A third-party page labels levels by experience (0-2 yrs Associate / SE I, 2-5 yrs SE II, 5-8 yrs Senior I, 5-10 yrs Senior II, 8-15 yrs Principal); unofficial.
steps: Recruiter call or LinkedIn outreach, sometimes a screening call with brainteasers and math problems

Coding test, often timed and hard: Glassdoor says a 3-hour technical assessment with 2 questions for associate engineers; campus reports say 1 hour with 3 easy-to-medium LeetCode problems, or 3 hours with 3 questions, or 4 very difficult questions

Panel or technical interviews with brainteasers and technical or design questions without code (for managers, system design such as capturing pictures at traffic intersections); an in-person or Zoom round, group discussion in some campus drives (for example guessing a clock with three hands and no numbers)
Decision. Glassdoor and third-party pages put the process at about 1-4 weeks (about 14 days typical), and 2-3 or up to 5 rounds depending on level. Experiences range from smooth to disappointing.

spacex.name: Spacex
spacex.note: Candidate guides say the process is intense (about 7-9 rounds over 5-8 weeks per one guide; Glassdoor shows an average around 56 days for software engineers). Typical steps:
spacex.roles: Software Engineer (Starlink network, simulation / C++, backend, flight and ground software; Hawthorne, Sunnyvale, Redmond, Bastrop), New Graduate Engineer - Software, Senior Software Engineer, Software Engineering Intern / Co-op. Glassdoor volume is dominated by hardware roles (Mechanical, Propulsion, Manufacturing, Structures Engineer, Technician).
steps: Recruiter call (~20 min on background and interest in SpaceX), sometimes a phone screen first
Online coding assessment (about 3 LeetCode-style questions, or a take-home / application-building task; Starlink-flavoured problems such as assigning satellites to users appear)
Technical phone / video screens (data structures, hash tables in memory, network concepts, resume depth)

Onsite or virtual technical interviews (2-4 rounds): system design (including Starlink network architecture questions), deep coding, project deep dives and a 'why SpaceX' conversation; one Starlink candidate reports 8 rounds
Decision. Taro reports a low pass rate (about 10-13% in samples).

speak.name: Speak
speak.note: Very few public reports, so only a rough picture:
speak.roles: Speak (AI-powered conversation-first language tutor). Software Engineer / SDE roles, Product Manager (a Nora AI guide describes a senior product lead role spanning multiple pods). Levels are not published. Other search results were for different companies (Speechify, Babbel, Asapp, TSMC) and were ignored.
steps: Recruiter / background conversation
Technical phone screen: background discussion plus a challenging coding problem (SDE report)

Onsite for an early-stage language-learning app: coding plus a product sense and team-fit interview (why language learning and an early-stage startup, how to decide which speaking scenarios to build next, which success signals to track, project deep dive)
Decision. A guide for the Speak PM role notes that Speak has not published its exact process, and Exponent says it has little information on Speak.

splunk.name: Splunk
splunk.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports and guides:
splunk.roles: Software Engineer (about 120-134 Glassdoor reports), Senior Software Engineer (about 41-47), Principal Software Engineer, Software Engineering Interns (about 28), plus sales engineer, technical support engineer, solutions engineer and sales roles. Locations include San Francisco, Kraków, London, Bengaluru, Maryland Heights MO. A third-party prep site lists P2 / P3 (Software Engineer), P4 (Senior), P5 (Principal), P6 (Senior Principal) and Technical Fellow levels (unofficial, from a candidate-prep site and not confirmed).
steps: Application online or recruiter outreach
Recruiter / HR phone screen (Glassdoor shows phone interview as the most common stage)

Early screening step: a Karat- or HireVue-style timed assessment or a technical phone screen (a candidate calls the Karat interview the real gatekeeper with almost no feedback); some principal-level candidates got a 3-day take-home project

Technical rounds: data structures and algorithms (duplicate detection, frequencies, rate limiting), Java/JavaScript basics, Unix/Linux, performance and scalability, system design for senior and above, and behavioral rounds with engineers and managers

Decision. TechPrep says about 3-5 weeks; Glassdoor shows about 27 days for software engineers and 29 days company-wide; reports vary from 1 week to 3 months. Many negative reviews cite disorganization or silent rejections.

spokeo.name: Spokeo
spokeo.roles: Software Engineer (backend, full-stack), Senior Software Engineer, Senior JavaScript / UI Developer, Data Engineer, DevOps Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Product Manager. Glassdoor report counts are led by Customer Care / Customer Service Representative and Software Engineer. No official level codes seen.
steps: Application online or via recruiter
HR / recruiter intro call (background and what you want next)
Online assessment or take-home coding, reported as a timed or up to about 3-hour exercise covering coding and database basics (examples: Figma-to-HTML/CSS and a React image slider for frontend)

Technical interview with a developer or manager, then further rounds with the hiring manager and leadership; Solutions Engineer report describes four rounds including recruiter, hiring manager and senior operations leaders
Decision. Reports typically give about 1-3 weeks, and several candidates describe the experience negatively (reports vary).

spotify.name: Spotify
spotify.roles: Software Engineer (Associate Engineer, Engineer I / II, Senior, Staff, Senior Staff, Principal per a candidate-guide ladder, unofficial), Senior Software Engineer (frontend and backend), Machine Learning Engineer, Data Scientist. Glassdoor report volume also includes Product Manager, Manager, Campaign Manager and Client Partner, so the company hires broadly beyond engineering. Offices: Stockholm, Amsterdam, London, New York, Toronto and others.
steps: Application online
Recruiter call (about 30 min)
Technical phone screen of about 75 min (some junior cycles use a 45-minute coding challenge); LeetCode-style and object-oriented questions

Onsite / virtual loop of about 4 hours: coding, system design (including applying algorithms to Spotify features), a debugging exercise with logs and Linux commands, and values / behavioral conversations; Spotify's process is centralized, so interviewers are often from other teams, and you usually meet the hiring manager and one team engineer

Decision. Reports vary a lot: about 2-5 weeks per guides, with Interview Query noting 3-12 weeks and one Glassdoor reviewer describing 2.5 months with delays. Taro stats (43 US SWE reports) show a pass rate of roughly 19%.

sprinter-health.name: Sprinter Health
sprinter-health.note: Sprinter Health's own postings (hosted on startup.jobs, Peerlist and its own board text) state the process aims to finish in 2-3 weeks and usually consists of: Candidate reports (Glassdoor, April 2026) match this: HR phone screen 30 min, online coding 30 min with 2 easy-to-medium list-style questions, hiring-manager screen, then an onsite with system design (45-60 min), a behavioral round, and lunch. Glassdoor shows an average of about 21 days for engineers; sentiment is mixed (about 20% positive across 5 reports).
sprinter-health.roles: Sprinter Health (in-home healthcare delivery, San Francisco / Menlo Park, hybrid). Software Engineer (Early Career / Mid-Level, 2+ years in some Growth postings), Software Engineer Mid-Level (Data Services, Growth, Engagement Platform), Senior Software Engineer (Product Engineering, AI Automation, 5+ years), Staff Software Engineer (AI Automation). Glassdoor volume is dominated by Patient Engagement Specialist and phlebotomist roles. Levels appear as Early Career / Mid-Level / Senior / Staff in the postings.
steps: Recruiter screen (30 min)
Technical assessment (45 min)
Hiring manager introduction (30 min)
Onsite interview: systems design plus a behavioral interview plus lunch with the team (about 3 hours; growth-focused design for the Growth team)
References, then offer.

square.name: Square
square.roles: Software Engineer (new grad, SWE, Senior; one guide labels senior as L6, unofficial), Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Software Engineering Intern. Glassdoor report volume for Block is dominated by Software Engineer (about 257) and Senior Software Engineer (about 93). Block is the parent of Square, Cash App and others; offices: San Francisco, New York, Seattle, Atlanta, Melbourne.
steps: Application online, referral or campus recruiting
Recruiter screen (about 30 min)
Technical phone screen of about 1 hour, with a hiring-manager conversation for some levels (practical coding rather than pure LeetCode in several reports)

Virtual onsite of 4-5 rounds (about 4-5 hours): coding, design (e.g. hotel booking system, end-to-end banking system), a practical build-something task, past-experience and values conversations; committee review follows

Team matching, then decision. Reports vary: about 3-4 weeks in many cases, up to 2-4 months for some new-grad and referral cycles; Glassdoor puts Block overall at about 25 days. Taro stats show a roughly 42% pass rate for SWE in San Francisco (12 reports).

squarepoint.name: Squarepoint
squarepoint.roles: Software Engineer / Software Developer (including graduate and intern), Data Engineer, Platform Engineer, Senior Rust Developer. Interview-report volume on Glassdoor is dominated by Quantitative Researcher (largest), then Software Engineer / Developer, Desk Quantitative Analyst, Quantitative Developer, plus some Analyst and Support Analyst roles.
steps: Application (online or via recruiter)
Online coding test, often HackerRank (about 2 questions in an hour; reports say fairly simple), or a take-home assessment for some teams
Phone call with HR / recruiter about role and logistics

Live coding round with an engineer watching (some reports mention building a small front-end task); Python-heavy fundamentals, practical build tasks, quick-fire OS/git questions, LeetCode-style string and DP problems
Further technical rounds plus a resume / past-projects deep dive and a conversation with a head of department; one data-engineer report describes 5 stages
Decision. Reports vary widely: about 2 weeks to 2 months; a Glassdoor summary puts overall hiring at about 28 days. Reports also say candidates often get no feedback.

squarespace.name: Squarespace
squarespace.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports and guides:
squarespace.roles: Squarespace (website builder; New York, Dublin, Portland, Seattle). Roles seen: Software Engineer, Java Software Engineer (Dublin), Frontend Engineer, Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, Software Engineering Manager. A third-party prep site (hw.glich.co) lists numbered levels L1 Software Engineer 1 (0-2 yrs) through L2, L3 (4-7 yrs), L4 Senior 1, L5 Senior 2, L6 Staff 1 (8-15 yrs), L7 Staff 2, L8 Principal and manager levels L1-L8; these level numbers are unofficial, from a candidate-prep site.
steps: Application online; recruiter call (early recruiter coordination; one candidate says scheduling broke down)
Coding screen (about 1 hour; DSA, practical problems such as string palindromes, merging sorted lists)

Virtual or onsite loop of about four interviews (often back-to-back in one day): data structures and algorithms, system design (about 60 minutes), a distinctive object-oriented design and code-review / bug-finding round (TechPrep calls it one of the more distinctive parts, emphasising code quality and craftsmanship), and a behavioral interview; Dublin Java reports describe a final interview with the hiring manager

Decision. Timeline: TechPrep says about 4-5 weeks; Interview Query says 1-2 months over 5-6 rounds; Dataford says about 3-5 weeks over 3 rounds for frontend; prep sites suggest about 7-21 days by level. Some candidates report being ghosted after a verbal offer or a negative Dublin experience, while others describe supportive interviewers.

stackadapt.name: StackAdapt
stackadapt.roles: Software Engineer, Senior and Staff Software Engineer, Frontend Engineer, Data Scientist, Data Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, Quality / Platform Ad Quality Analyst, Technical Solutions Specialist. Glassdoor report volume is led by Account Executive and Account Manager (sales), with Software Engineer, Data Scientist and Senior Software Engineer close behind. No official level codes seen.
steps: Application online, via recruiter on LinkedIn or other sources
Recruiter or hiring manager check-in
Online technical test (HackerRank mentioned in an older report) or first technical interview

Technical rounds: live coding (LeetCode-style, some described as hard), system design in a shared document, React / JavaScript questions for frontend roles; one 2026 employee report describes an HR interview, a manager / culture interview and three technical rounds

Decision. Reports range from about 1 week to about 2 months; several candidates call the process somewhat disorganized, and the order of rounds sometimes differs from what was announced (reports vary).

startups-com.name: Startups.Com
startups-com.note: Not enough data for a reliable process. From the single Glassdoor report (Dec 2024): applied online, phone conversation, then an in-person interview, after which the candidate heard nothing further. The 1point3acres thread describes a Principal Engineer tech phone screen with a demanding process and unpaid terms, but the body was not visible. Timeline not reported. Treat this row as unverified and look for the company's own job posting before relying on it.
startups-com.roles: Very little public data. The only role-specific reports I found are a Glassdoor entry for an 'Unsure Honestly' (unspecified role) at Startups.com in Schaumburg IL, and a 1point3acres tech phone screen thread for a Principal Engineer role that mentions unpaid terms (details are behind a login). Startups.com also runs the Clarity expert marketplace and startup-education platform. I did not use pages about Hello Alice (helloalice.com), which came up in results but is a different company. No level ladder seen.

strava.name: Strava
strava.note: Strava publishes its own engineering interviewing post on Medium (Engineering Interviewing at Strava; only a snippet was visible): the goal is to find out whether you will succeed at Strava; interviews are tailored to everyday situations and not intelligence tests or brainteasers. Candidate reports: Timeline: Glassdoor shows about 14 days for internship software engineers and 24 days company-wide; one senior candidate took about 10 days end to end; reports range from 2 days to 2-6 weeks. Experiences are mostly positive (75%) with a few unprofessional comments about hiring managers.
strava.roles: Strava (fitness and activity tracking platform; San Francisco, Denver, Bristol / London, Dublin, remote). Glassdoor volume: Software Engineer (about 17), Senior Software Engineer (4), Software Engineer Internship, Engineering Manager (2), Machine Learning Engineer (2), Android and iOS engineers, Data Scientist (Lead Data Scientist, Experimentation Platform) and finance / business roles. Open roles include Senior Staff Full Stack Engineer ($300-330k as employer-provided Glassdoor bands). Titles used in reports; no numeric ladder seen.
steps: Application online or recruiter outreach; recruiter / phone screen

Technical interview of a practical kind: a basic frontend layout in React or an API fetch-and-display exercise; Android SDK lifecycle and architectural standards (MVVM) for Android; Java or Kotlin live coding on a small Android feature; internship processes are about two rounds (a technical round and a managerial or behavioral round)

For full-time and senior roles, an on-site or virtual loop (Dataford: about 5 rounds over about 4-6 weeks, including system design reasoning and a final technical round; a 2018 Android candidate had a phone screen, a shared-screen coding interview and an all-day on-site)

stripe.name: Stripe
stripe.roles: Software Engineer (backend, frontend/UI, full-stack tracks), Engineering Manager, Product Manager. Levels are not clearly published; guides cite levels.fyi style bands only.
steps: Recruiter phone screen (30-45 min)
Online coding assessment and/or ~60 min pair-programming screen (algorithm or UI problem by track)
Virtual onsite, about 4-5 rounds: coding, bug squash / debugging, refactoring, integration (calling APIs), API and system design (~1 hr), plus behavioral / manager conversation
Team matching, then offer. Interviews are practical and scenario-driven rather than pure LeetCode; you can generally search the web. Roughly 3-5 weeks (range 2-8).

stubhub.name: StubHub
stubhub.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports:
stubhub.roles: Glassdoor volume is led by customer service representatives, then software engineers; engineering reports cover Software Engineer II, Senior Software Engineer (one report says a senior title requires 6+ years of experience), Staff Software Engineer, site reliability engineer, frontend engineer and the 'Open Distribution' team. These level names come from candidate reports, not an official ladder.
steps: Application online, referral, or recruiter outreach via LinkedIn
Recruiter / HR behavioral screen
Online assessment (CodeSignal or Codility mentioned) or a technical chat/resume-based screen

Live technical rounds: a roughly 75-minute pair-programming round, a project deep dive with an engineer, OOP questions, and system design (e.g. an A/B experimentation or checkout-resilience style design); one July 2026 report mentions a final presentation

Decision. Guides say about 3-5 rounds; candidate reports mention slow, uneven scheduling and missed calls from recruiters in 2026, and process length was not clearly reported (one report says 3 weeks). Customer-service hiring was not researched.

suno.name: Suno
suno.note: There are no published first-hand reports; the process below is from Dataford's prep guides (not candidate-confirmed) and a recruiting-site outline, and Suno's own postings say the team will work with you during the process to find the best mutual-fit team.
suno.roles: Suno (AI music creation; Cambridge/Boston MA, New York, remote-limited). Roles seen: Staff / Senior Software Engineer (Product Teams, $228-363k in NYC; Platform Teams, $220-280k in Boston), Staff Software Engineer Infrastructure, Senior/Staff Android and iOS Software Engineers, Frontend Engineer, Software Engineer Trust & Safety, Machine Learning Engineer, Software Engineering Intern (Summer 2027 per Extern guide; 3.7 GPA bar), plus product, marketing and recruiting. Levels are Senior/Staff in titles; no numeric ladder seen.
steps: Application (careers page) and recruiter / phone screen

Technical assessment or screening: Dataford's software engineer loop shows 3 rounds over about 3-5 weeks (recruiter screen, technical assessment, final round), with likely topics such as retention analysis over session events, database schema design for user accounts, subscriptions and credits, and clean API design; its frontend guide shows about 2 rounds over 2-4 weeks, and the ML guide an initial screen then research-heavy rounds
Final loop: another outline lists phone screen, technical interview, hiring manager and team fit stages

Decision. Timeline for the process is described as lean and efficient, roughly 2-5 weeks depending on role; the company is described as less rigid than large tech firms. Treat this row as indicative only.

supio.name: Supio
supio.note: Very few reports. A PracHub report (February 2026, easy) describes a technical screen of about one hour live-debugging Supio's AI chat codebase; PracHub lists 6 Supio experiences in total. A 1point3acres thread covers a tech phone screen for an AI legal-tech startup (details behind a login). Glassdoor (5 ratings, mostly Customer Success and other non-engineering roles, 20% positive, difficulty 3/5): an initial screen followed by a leadership interview, or a three-round process with a responsive recruiter ending in an offer; one candidate criticised inconsistent communication. Per Supio's postings, the assessment weighs technical depth, ownership, system thinking and impact. Timeline: about 30 days on average (Glassdoor, 5 reports). Treat this row as thin.
supio.roles: Supio is an AI platform for personal-injury law firms (Seattle and San Francisco, in office). Engineering roles seen on a Sapphire Ventures job board: Software Engineer (backend, AI workflows), Software Engineer Core Product (Mid-Senior+), Senior Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer Full Stack, Senior/Staff Software Engineer Full Stack (frontend leaning), Senior Applied AI Engineer, Senior Site Reliability Engineer, plus customer success and recruiting roles. The company's own postings say final leveling and compensation are determined by demonstrated ability and experience in the interview process. I did not use pages about Sapio or Sapio Sciences, which are different companies.

sybill.name: Sybill
sybill.note: Sybill's own job postings include an 'Interview Process' section; the visible part says that after your resume is shortlisted you receive a link to a 1-hour take-home assignment (the rest of the steps was not visible to me). From other sources: a Glassdoor ML engineer report (May 2024) calls the process well organized and thorough and ended in an accepted offer. A JobMentis page mentions an onsite loop of about 4 rounds for non-engineering roles but gives no engineering-specific detail. No detailed candidate write-ups of Sybill's technical rounds were found.
sybill.roles: Sybill (AI sales assistant / revenue intelligence, San Francisco and India). Software Engineer, Software Engineer - Full-Stack Support (blends engineering with customer technical support; Python/FastAPI, JavaScript, MongoDB, AWS), ML Engineer, Product Manager, and sales and marketing roles. Postings ask for about 4+ years of experience for the full-stack support role; no formal level names.

talroo.name: Talroo
talroo.roles: Software Engineer, Associate Software Engineer (largest recent group, new grad / junior, Austin), Software Developer, Principal Software Engineer, plus Account Executive and sales roles that dominate report counts. Talroo is an Austin, Texas recruitment marketing company with an engineering presence in Charlottesville, Virginia. No official level codes seen beyond Associate / Principal titles.
steps: Application online, via recruiter or campus career fairs

Math-first assessment: candidates report a math and stats screen of about three problems (probability, areas, perimeter, prime factorization counting) led by the CEO or a founder before any coding, which surprised many who expected coding problems

Online assessment (OA) and then technical interviews that candidates describe as aptitude-style; the company's own listing says its interview process focuses on problem-solving ability and engineering fundamentals rather than specific technology expertise
Value alignment interview (about 45 minutes, behavioral with an HR director) and a final onsite in Austin (reported as 4 rounds, a superday style)
Decision. Reports range from about 1 week to 4 weeks, and most reports in sources ended without an offer (reports vary).

target.name: Target
target.roles: Software Engineer (SE-I / Associate through Lead / Principal; one guide uses L4-L8 levels, unofficial), Senior Software Engineer (SE-II), Software Engineer in Technology Leadership Program, Software Engineering Manager. Target is a large US retailer; offices: Minneapolis, Bengaluru, Istanbul, Ann Arbor. The sheet's reports may include non-engineering roles, which were not researched.
steps: Application online, university or referral; resume shortlisting
Recruiter screen, then an online assessment focused on coding (e.g. edit-distance style tasks) in some cycles

Technical interviews: basics of programming and OOP (overloading vs overriding), strings and recursion questions, a pair-programming exercise, explaining your approach to a task, and system design for experienced levels (e.g. design Uber; a chat wait-time estimate in an older report)
Behavioral / hiring-manager evaluation and 'why Target' questions
Decision. Reports vary: about 2-4 weeks per guides (3-5 rounds); Glassdoor puts SWE hiring at about 12 days and Target overall at 18 days. Most 2026 Minneapolis reports seen ended without an offer.

tcs.name: TCS
tcs.roles: Assistant Systems Engineer (ASE), Associate Software Engineer, Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (large report volume), Software Developer, Systems Engineer. Campus hiring splits into hiring programs such as NQT, Ninja, Digital and Prime. Reports come from India (Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata and others), the UK and elsewhere. TCS uses its own grade bands; no official level codes seen.
steps: Application online, campus drive or referral

Online test: TCS NQT (National Qualifier Test) with aptitude, reasoning and verbal sections plus two DSA coding questions for campus hires; some candidates enter through coding contests such as TCS CodeVita

Technical interview (face to face or virtual): resume and project walk-through, OOP, DBMS and SQL, programming fundamentals, simple coding such as finding the middle node of a linked list, stacks and queues

Managerial round in some processes, then HR round (communication, strengths, career goals, availability, location preference); some Hyderabad panels combine technical, managerial and HR in one sitting
Decision. Glassdoor shows about 10 days for software engineers and 12-21 days for the company; reports range from 2 weeks to 2 months (reports vary).

tekion.name: Tekion
tekion.roles: Associate Software Engineer (campus, L1), Software Engineer (L2), Senior Software Engineer (L3), Staff Software Engineer (L4), Lead Software Engineer (L5) per a third-party guide (unofficial), plus Frontend Engineer, DevOps Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, SDET. Tekion is an automotive retail cloud company with large Bengaluru and US presence.
steps: Application online, campus drive, or third-party recruiter outreach (for example via Instahyre)
Online / coding round (campus reports: coding round with about 4 problems)

Technical interview(s): about 60 minutes each, virtual; data structures and algorithms, React / JavaScript and practical coding for frontend roles; design questions such as vending machine or elevator system for experienced candidates
System design round for L3 and above, then managerial / behavioral round and HR round
Decision. A third-party guide shows about 7 days for most levels and 14 for L4-L5; one Bengaluru SDET report says the process took 3 days, while some guides say 4-6 weeks for ML roles (reports vary).

temu.name: Temu
temu.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports (2024-2026):
temu.roles: Software Engineer (North America team, Seattle, Boston, Shanghai), Senior Software Engineer, and specialised engineering roles such as Software Engineer (Ads) and Software Engineer (Data Privacy) on job boards. Temu is part of PDD Holdings (the Pinduoduo group), so some reports are filed under Pinduoduo. Several reports say every role is interviewed under the title 'software engineer' and the package is negotiated afterwards based on the interview; one candidate said Temu can only make an offer based on your current level.
steps: Application on LinkedIn or through a recruiter / other source
Recruiter contact; a one-hour HR interview appears later in the process
Technical phone screen: LeetCode-medium style coding in a restricted language (Java or C++), for example spiral matrix, sliding window, a Twitter-feed min-heap problem

Further rounds: a February 2026 North America report lists 3 coding rounds, one behavioral round with a director/VP and one HRBP round, and describes the loop as light on coding and heavy on cross-checking; a September 2026 report says the technical round was skipped and the final round was only HR and salary talk; a Senior SWE second round lasted about 2.5 hours

Offer. Timeline: Indeed says the process is about a day or two with difficulty 8/10 on fewer than 10 reports; reports vary a lot. Several candidates describe disorganised offer or compensation handling.

tencent.name: Tencent
tencent.note: Highly team-dependent; candidates describe 4-7 rounds, usually over 2-4 weeks (Glassdoor average is about 18 days for developers and 32 days company-wide):
tencent.roles: Software Engineer / Software Developer (backend, client, games, cloud, WeChat / WXG teams such as the Mini-program team), Senior Software Engineer, Software Engineering Manager. A candidate guide lists levels T4-T17 for engineers and T7-T13 for managers (unofficial). Hiring is team-driven by Business Group.
steps: Resume screen, sometimes a skills test or online assessment and a phone screen

Technical rounds (often 3-5, conducted over Tencent Meeting): live LeetCode-style coding, project deep dives, OS fundamentals, networking, databases (indexing and optimization), OOP and thread-safety patterns, and system design scoped to Tencent-scale products
Conversations with department leaders from the hiring team, in some offices in Chinese (a Kuala Lumpur report)
HR / behavioral interview on culture fit and experience (framed around the mission 'Value for Users, Tech for Good'), then decision.

tesla.name: Tesla
tesla.roles: Software Engineer (infotainment, factory software, controls, automated diagnostics, backend), Senior and Staff engineers, interns, Manufacturing and Mechanical Design Engineers; Glassdoor volume is dominated by Production Associate, Sales Advisor and Intern reports.
steps: Online application
Recruiter phone screen
Online assessment (Codility) and/or a technical phone interview with an engineer; some teams give a ~4 hr take-home coding challenge

Onsite / virtual rounds, often several back-to-back with different team members: resume and project deep dives, live coding (LeetCode-style data structures), design problem relevant to the team, behavioral
Decision. Fast and team-dependent: guides say about 2-5 weeks, Glassdoor average about 34 days, some reports up to 16 weeks.

testgorilla.name: TestGorilla
testgorilla.note: Candidate sources (Glassdoor 2022-2025) describe a heavily automated, assessment-first process (Glassdoor reports range from 1 week to 7 weeks):
testgorilla.roles: TestGorilla (online talent assessment platform; remote-first, Amsterdam / Europe roots). Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Senior Frontend Engineer, Engineering Manager, Product Manager; Glassdoor volume also includes sales and customer roles. Levels are not published beyond Senior / Manager.
steps: Application online, then an invitation to take a test on TestGorilla's own platform (logic, coding and problem solving; one 2025 candidate says the test also included a short video recording and extra fields and wondered if the purpose was partly to have applicants test the software)
Technical interview(s) and a deep-dive interview with product or engineering stakeholders (for product roles, how you define priorities for a proposed feature)

Culture / values and hiring-manager conversations, then offer. A Senior Frontend Engineer report from July 2023 took about 4 weeks and ended in an accepted offer; several 2025 senior engineer and engineering manager reports are negative, rated difficult, with no offer. The company responds publicly on Glassdoor, noting its aim is a well-rounded assessment of skills as well as critical thinking.

the-new-york-times.name: The New York Times
the-new-york-times.note: Candidate sources (Taro, 2019-2025) describe a long, multi-step process:
the-new-york-times.roles: The New York Times (nytco.com careers; New York, remote). Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Web Engineer, Software Developer, Software Engineer Intern, Software Engineering Manager / management roles. Levels are not published; many reports describe teams on a Ruby / JavaScript stack. Taro tracks 48 US reports for Software Engineer (about 15% pass rate), so it is selective.
steps: Recruiter screen / intro call (30 min; the recruiter explains the steps; some applicants wait a month or more to hear back)
Hiring-manager call, sometimes a combined call with a manager and a staff engineer
Live coding or a code challenge (a CoderPad / video coding session or a take-home that should match the team's stack; 2025 reports mention a code review round)

Virtual onsite / 4-part panel: a technical interview, a system design interview, and two culture-fit interviews (older onsite days ran about 5 hours with a PM, senior engineers, an executive director and a manager). Roughly 60% behavioral and 40% technical in one senior report

Decision. Reports often mention long waits, slow feedback and rejections after weeks of silence, and a few mention down-leveled offers; interns report a faster 'phone, hiring manager, technical' sequence with heavy emphasis on values and past experiences.

the-trade-desk.name: The Trade Desk
the-trade-desk.roles: Software Engineer I, II, Senior, Staff, Principal, Distinguished / Fellow and Senior Fellow ladder per third-party guides (unofficial), Frontend Engineer, Forward-Deployed Engineer. Locations seen in reports include US, Sydney, Singapore and London. Reports in the sheet are most likely for software engineering.
steps: Application online or via recruiter
Recruiter screen (about 30 min on resume, experience, interest)
Online assessment on HackerRank (coding)
Technical rounds: algorithm interview (about 60 min, roughly LeetCode medium, two questions) and further technical / design rounds; some reports mention an N-way cache style problem
Hiring manager interview combining system design and behavioral, plus an HR / behavioral round based on the resume; Sydney report describes an online assessment, recruiter call and 4 onsite rounds
Decision. Reports vary from about 3 weeks to 2 months; several senior candidates call the process lengthy and demanding.

thomson-reuters.name: Thomson Reuters
thomson-reuters.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports and guides (Interview Query: built around your resume and project work more than hard algorithm puzzles; 20 reports): Timeline: Glassdoor shows about 19 days for senior software engineers (12 reports), about 7 days for software engineers (3 reports) and 15-22 days company-wide; reports range from 2 days to 4 weeks (a Gdańsk referral took 4 weeks); one DC candidate says HR was responsive until being considered and then stopped replying. Glassdoor rates software engineer difficulty about 2.8/5 with 80% positive.
thomson-reuters.roles: Large information-services and AI-products company (Toronto, Eagan MN, Minneapolis, New York, Washington DC, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Gdańsk, London). Glassdoor volume across all roles is led by Software Engineer (about 583), Senior Software Engineer (491), Manager (198), Account Manager, Project Manager, Analyst, Account Executive, Director, Product Manager, Business Analyst, Lead Software Engineer (119), Intern, Content Specialist and Correspondent. Engineering postings include Staff Software Engineer, Lead Software Engineer AI, Senior Software Engineer AI (Materia AI, CoCounsel). Thomson Reuters uses numbered TR levels (TR7 Associate, TR6, TR5, TR4, TR3 Principal and manager equivalents), as listed by a third-party prep site (unofficial, from a candidate-prep site).
steps: Application online, referral or recruiter; HR / recruiter screen (about 45 min in a prep site's TR3 outline); some roles start with an online technical screening or HackerRank assessment

Technical rounds: two technical rounds followed by a manager round and then HR (Hyderabad, 2026); a Washington DC senior candidate (July 2026) describes an online technical screening, then a programming round, a system design round and finally a leadership and behavioral round over about a month; questions include SQL join internals, project deep dives, how to explain a technical challenge to leadership and get agreement
Manager / HR round, then offer

thumbtack.name: Thumbtack
thumbtack.roles: Software Engineer (backend, full-stack, mobile), Senior Software Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer. No formal level codes seen in sources. Reports in the sheet are most likely for software engineering.
steps: Application online, via recruiter or campus career fair
Recruiter call; the company's own prep post says candidates get a link to book a prep call with a recruiter before the technical phone interview
Technical phone interview with a Thumbtack engineer (about 1 hour of live coding; some candidates report a HackerRank challenge first, and questions described as LeetCode medium-to-hard)
Onsite or virtual loop: coding, system design / build-a-feature style questions, and behavioral rounds; some reports mention a short lesson on a topic of choice or a lunch chat
Decision. Reports vary from under 2 weeks to about 3-5 weeks, with some older reports mentioning slow follow-up and a hiring freeze.

tiktok.name: TikTok
tiktok.roles: Software Engineer, ML engineer, data scientist, product manager and other guides exist; TikTok Shop and other teams hire separately. Levels are team-dependent and not clearly published.
steps: Application (career site, LinkedIn or referral)
Recruiter phone screen (~30 min) or an email questionnaire
Online assessment (HackerRank-style) in many cases
2-3 technical rounds (LeetCode-style coding plus a deep dive into your resume; design, SQL or frontend depending on team), done virtually, passed one at a time rather than one onsite day
Behavioral / HR round (~1 hr), then decision. About 3-5 weeks. Process is decentralized and varies by team, and you can often interview for more than one team.

tinder.name: Tinder
tinder.roles: Software Engineer (largest group, about 21-28 Glassdoor reports), Senior Software Engineer, iOS Engineer (Swift), Android Engineer, Backend Engineer, Security Engineer, Data Engineer, ML Engineer, Software Engineer Intern, plus Product Manager, Product Designer, Data Scientist and Campus Ambassador. Tinder is part of Match Group; offices: Los Angeles, Palo Alto, San Francisco, Dallas, others.
steps: Application online, university or employee referral
Recruiter / intro call (a 15-minute intro for some mobile roles)
Technical screen of about 1 hour on a video call: a medium HackerRank-style question, plus language-specific and general development topics (Swift for iOS, JavaScript for web)
Take-home or timed app-building exercise for mobile roles (an app prompt completed in a couple of hours, then a group review with about 4 engineers)

Onsite or virtual loop of 3-4 interviews: coding, algorithms and data structures, system design for experienced candidates, behavioral and team fit; one security-engineer report describes an 8-hour loop
Decision. Reports vary: about 1-2 weeks for some, about 4-5 weeks for iOS roles, up to 2 months. Reports are mostly positive, with comments about feedback communication.

tml.name: Tml
tml.note: The lab does not publish its process, and public candidate reports are very few (DesignGurus found one, finished in about three weeks). From PracHub's software engineer guide and techinterview.org (both partly reconstructed, so treat as indicative): 1) an initial screen, sometimes a recorded video interview with three foundational questions, where a motivation answer is asked early; 2) practical coding and a design exercise (for example making run creation safe when the client retries, retry and failure handling); 3) system design questions about training and serving infrastructure, job queues and distributed training basics; 4) a panel interview ending in a culture-fit conversation. Techinterview.org says the loop flexes per candidate and team and hires for spikes, not checklists; DesignGurus says to expect days, not weeks, between rounds once in the loop. Confirm stages with the recruiter.
tml.roles: Tml is Thinking Machines Lab (thinkingmachines.ai, the AI research lab in San Francisco, per your sheet's website). Roles seen on its Greenhouse board and in guides: research and engineering roles (training and serving infrastructure, software engineer), recruiting coordinator and recruiting operations roles. The company sponsors visas. I did not use Glassdoor, Taro or Interview Query pages for Thinking Machines Data Science (Taguig, Bangkok), a different company, even though they appear first in search. No level ladder seen.

toast.name: Toast
toast.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports, Interview Query (21 reports) and Taro: Timeline: Interview Query says 4-6 rounds and about 2-3 weeks; TechPrep says about 3-4 weeks; Glassdoor shows about 17 days company-wide; reports range from 2 to 4 weeks. Taro shows a very low pass rate (7% across 30 U.S. software engineer reports) though half of candidates feel positive; Interview Query says most difficulty comes from follow-up questions.
toast.roles: Sources are for Toast, Inc. (restaurant point-of-sale and software platform; Boston, Dublin, Toronto, Bengaluru, Chicago). Glassdoor volume is led by Account Executive (about 195), Software Engineer (58), Territory Account Executive, Sales Associate, Senior Software Engineer (34), Onboarding Consultant, Software Engineer Internship (13) and Field Implementation Engineer. Engineering roles also include Staff Software Engineer (a staff engineer interviews candidates). No official numeric ladder seen.
steps: Application online, LinkedIn, referral or campus; brief recruiter call (background, role, sometimes compensation expectations)
Online coding assessment for some tracks (CodeSignal, easy; or two HackerRank list-manipulation questions in a 2022 Dublin report) or a phone interview

Technical interviews: first round with an engineer on a LeetCode-medium problem (arrays, recursion, string manipulation, a stock-profit or nested-structure problem, a restaurant-domain design) plus questions about Toast and the interviewer's projects; a later round with a tech lead and another engineer, or a technical coding interview with a staff software engineer; the Toronto 2026 report describes a 4-5 hour process starting with a recruiter intro call
Behavioral and manager conversations, then offer; one Boston intern was told of an offer a day after the final interview

together.name: Together
together.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports and guides (public data is thin: Dataford has 4 reports, Glassdoor 2 research-engineer reports in 2026):
together.roles: Sources are for Together AI (together.ai), the AI acceleration cloud (San Francisco, on-site). Roles seen: Software Engineer (Together Cloud Platform / Cloud Infrastructure; Go, distributed systems, GPU virtualization), Senior Software Engineer - Together Cloud Infrastructure, Backend Software Engineer (Data Platform & AI Data Products), Research Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, Data Engineer, Senior Network Engineer, Customer Support / Customer Success Engineer, Solutions Architect, Account Executive, Technical Program Manager, DevOps. No numeric level ladder seen beyond Mid Level and Senior labels.
steps: Application online, then recruiter screen

Technical phone screen(s): coding plus systems topics (Go concurrency, GPU inference / virtualization, distributed scheduling, state and consensus with etcd-style tools, fault tolerance and checkpointing)

Virtual or on-site loop of about 6-7 touchpoints per TechPrep: coding, distributed-systems / system design (for example architecting a global management plane across data centers), production trade-offs and a STAR-format behavioral component; techinterview.org says the company screens for people who can operate without a thick layer of process

Decision. Timeline: DesignGurus says about 2-4 weeks; TechPrep says 6-7 touchpoints; Orbyt says 3-5 rounds. Glassdoor's two research-engineer reports from March-April 2026 were no-offer with neutral to negative experiences. Treat counts and durations as indicative.

together-ai.name: Together AI
together-ai.roles: Software Engineer (Together Cloud Platform / Cloud Infrastructure, AI Acceleration Cloud), Backend Software Engineer (Data Platform), Senior Software Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, Research Engineer, Data Engineer, DevOps Engineer, Customer Success Engineer, Solutions Architect, Account Executive, Technical Program Manager. Offices: San Francisco, Amsterdam and others.
steps: Application online
Recruiter / intro screen
Technical screens: coding and practical systems questions rather than textbook algorithms

Virtual onsite with heavy emphasis on distributed systems, ML-systems and infrastructure design (e.g. managing state across data centers, fault tolerance for training jobs), low-level coding, and developer-experience discussion
Behavioral round (STAR style) that screens for people who can work without much process

Decision. Guides say 6-7 touchpoints over about 2-4 weeks; one Glassdoor report (Amsterdam, Dec 2025) says 3 weeks. Several 2026 research-engineer reports are neutral or negative with no offer. Evidence is thin, with only a handful of candidate reports.

toma.name: Toma
toma.note: Per Toma's own listings on YC's Work at a Startup and candidate-facing postings: Timeline was not stated; no independent candidate reports on Glassdoor or Taro were found, so this is the company's description of its process.
toma.roles: Toma is a YC W24 AI voice-agent startup for automotive dealerships (a16z-backed, San Francisco). Roles: Software Engineer (AI Products), Software Engineer (Forward-Deployed), Founding Engineer, Founding Platform Engineer, Senior / Staff Software Engineer (the level is decided by experience, scope and technical leadership shown during the interview), Senior and Staff Founding Engineer, Software Engineer Intern / New Grad (Founding Junior Technical Staff Member). Company-defined levels are visible only in job titles.
steps: Intro screen (a general screen with the CTO/CEO, or an initial meeting with the CTO)

Technical screen: 45-minute technical screen for AI Products engineers, or a 1.5-hour virtual screener on problem-solving and system design for the founding platform engineer role; new-grad listing instead lists a take-home assignment
Onsite: a 6-hour virtual or in-person onsite (new-grad listing: virtual or in-person on-site assessment)
Flexible work trial for some roles, then an offer decision

tools-for-humanity.name: Tools For Humanity
tools-for-humanity.roles: Software Engineer, Mobile Engineer, Security Engineer (cryptography and threat modeling heavy), plus other engineering roles around World ID and the World ecosystem. Tools for Humanity is based in San Francisco (the sheet links toolsforhumanity.com). No official level codes seen.
steps: Application online or via recruiter
Recruiter / intro call
A few rounds with current team members; one 2026 Glassdoor report describes a take-home assessment and a presentation, followed by meetings with executive-level people for fit
Technical rounds with emphasis on cryptography and threat modeling for security roles (a guide shows these as the most frequent topics)
Decision. Candidate reports call the process long, unstructured or unclear in places; no firm timeline was found (reports vary; data is thin).

tower.name: Tower
tower.roles: Software Engineer / Software Developer, Core Developer (C++), Senior Software Developer (Montreal), Quant Developer, plus Quant Trader, Quant Researcher and Data Scientist tracks. The sheet links tower-research.com (Tower Research Capital, the trading firm). A third-party guide shows 5-6 stages depending on track; there is no single stable loop and teams run their own process. No official level codes seen.
steps: Application online, campus or recruiter
Online assessment: for developers a 75-minute, 4-problem coding test (parsing, difference arrays, heaps, stacks) or a HackerRank DP set
Recruiter / team-matching phone call (behavioral and team fit)
Technical phone screens: coding plus C++ internals (virtual destructors, const correctness, memory model), Python and Linux commands for some teams
Onsite day with several back-to-back interviews; one Montreal senior report describes the panel experience negatively
Decision. Guides say about 1-2 weeks for some engineering tracks and 3-5 weeks overall; one older Gurgaon report took 4 weeks; offer rate from one aggregator is about 26 percent (reports vary).

tradedesk.name: Tradedesk
tradedesk.roles: Software Engineer (SWE I, II, Senior, Staff, Principal, Fellow per a candidate-guide ladder, unofficial), Senior Software Engineer, Frontend Engineer, Forward-Deployed Engineer. Sources are for The Trade Desk (ad-tech demand-side platform). Offices: Ventura / Irvine, San Francisco, London, Sydney, Singapore and others.
steps: Application online or recruiter
HackerRank-style online assessment (a short coding challenge in several reports)
Recruiter / HR screen (30-45 min, behavioral questions from your resume, salary expectations)
Technical screen of about 60 min: two LeetCode-medium algorithm questions, or software design and data structures (e.g. N-way set-associative cache)
Onsite / virtual loop of about 4 rounds: system design, coding, behavioral, and a hiring-manager interview (system design plus behavioral for seniors)

Decision. Reports vary: about 3-4 weeks in several reports, up to about 2 months in one 2025 case. Reviews describe the loop as lengthy and rigorous, and some senior candidates say it is not well tailored to experienced engineers.

transunion.name: Transunion
transunion.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer / Sr. Software Engineer, Lead Software Engineer, Software Developer / Associate Developer, Developer, Senior Developer Platform Engineering, plus huge non-engineering volume (Senior Consultant, Director, Advisor, Customer Service Representative, Product Manager, Sales). Reports come from US (Chicago), India (Chennai, Pune), Costa Rica and Hong Kong. No official level codes seen beyond title tiers.
steps: Application online, through a recruiter, staffing agency, university or referral
Recruiter / HR phone screen (checks job requirements, availability and relocation)
Written / coding round for some candidates (Java, SQL and data structures mix in older India reports)
Technical interview(s): OOP, threads, frameworks and tools from your resume, project deep dive, and DSA-heavy coding; senior candidates report higher-level design questions

Managerial round (process-focused), then HR round with salary discussion. Guides say 3-5 rounds over about 1-3 weeks, with Glassdoor showing about 8 days on average for software engineers; some reports mention a 5-week process, scheduling mix-ups, long follow-ups and visa-sponsorship rejections (reports vary).

travelers-insurance.name: Travelers Insurance
travelers-insurance.roles: Software Engineer I (SE1), Software Engineer II, Senior Software Engineer, Software Developer, GenAI Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, plus a large non-technical mix (Account Executive, Claims, Customer Service). Software Engineer is the largest tech group (96 Glassdoor reports in one view). Reports come from Hartford CT, Atlanta GA, Saint Paul MN, Charlotte NC and New York. SE I and II levels appear in titles; no other level codes seen.
steps: Application online, referral or Indeed; an online assessment about two days after applying in some reports
Recruiter call or HR call (a 15-minute call in a 2021 report, scheduled within a week of applying in 2025)

First video technical interview with a director and a senior engineer (about one hour): scenario-based questions, personal projects, Java, Azure, Guidewire, AWS, Git, Spring Boot design patterns, tracing merge sort, and for senior roles .NET garbage collection and design patterns; a small pull-request review exercise was reported for an SE II
Second round with the team or panel and a behavioral interview (strengths and weaknesses, how you learn something new, why you want to leave your current team)
Decision. Reports range from 2 weeks to 2 months, and several 2024-2026 candidates call the process streamlined and positive (reports vary).

trexquant.name: Trexquant
trexquant.roles: Software Engineer (C++ heavy), C++ Developer, Data Engineer, DevOps Engineer, Data Scientist, Quantitative Researcher, LLM / machine learning roles, and quant internships. Trexquant Investment is a quant fund with offices including Stamford and Greenwich CT, New York and Gurgaon. No official level codes seen.
steps: Application online, recruiter or campus
HR / recruiter outreach (resume, sponsorship, why Trexquant)

Online test or take-home: examples reported include a Hangman project that needs better than 50 percent accuracy, a C++ / string parsing / DSA coding test and an assessment on parsing Nasdaq ITCH 5.0 tick data
Technical phone screen (LeetCode-style, for example a median-finding problem, C++ fundamentals, in-depth resume review)
Onsite / superday with several coding rounds (C++ only for software engineers) and a call with the CEO or senior leadership reported as influential
Decision. Reports range from about 3 weeks to 2 months (reports vary).

tripadvisor.name: Tripadvisor
tripadvisor.note: Interview Query counts 4-7 rounds and calls the process friendly but broader than a typical coding screen; Dataford says roughly 2-3 weeks. Candidate reports describe:
