tripadvisor.roles: Tripadvisor (Needham / Newton MA, Oxford UK, Lisbon, Krakow, remote). Software Engineer I, II (Android, backend), Senior Software Engineer, Principal Software Engineer (PSE1), Senior Principal and Principal Architect (levels SE1, SE2, SSE, PSE1, SPSE per a third-party site, unofficial), Software Engineer Internship, plus Account Manager, Product Manager and sales roles (Glassdoor: Software Engineer about 93 reports, Account Manager 51).
steps: Application and recruiter screen

A project or coding challenge (an older US report lists a pre-interview, a project, a technical interview and an on-site; interns get a skills test, a phone interview and string-reversal style problems)

Technical interview(s): algorithms, data sources, complexity, databases, OOP and API / networking questions, with system design for senior roles (a May 2026 Krakow senior report was asked to design a system similar to Ticketmaster); one 2021 Oxford report describes seven stages with several senior engineers, deep technical and system design rounds, and no follow-up afterwards

Hiring-manager and team conversations, then decision. Glassdoor average is about 14 days for Software Engineer II and 29 days company-wide; Taro shows a low US pass rate (about 13% across 168 reports) with mixed experiences.

tripstack.name: TripStack
tripstack.note: Reports differ between the Pune and Toronto teams, with most processes finishing in about 1-2 weeks:
tripstack.roles: TripStack (travel technology / flight-itinerary platform; Toronto and Pune). Software Engineer I and II (SE-2 / SDE 1 labels on Glassdoor), Senior Software Engineer, Software Developer, Junior Web Developer, QA Engineer, Engineering Manager, Team Lead, Product Owner, Product Analyst. Stack mentions C#, Go, OOP and databases. Levels follow the SE I / SE II / Senior pattern in reports.
steps: HR screening call (about 15 min)

Online or coding assessment (aptitude test or a coding assessment on a hosted platform; a Sept 2025 report describes an online assessment then a Go-heavy technical screen with a 'notepad' coding round)

Two or three technical interviews (introduction and experience, OOP, databases, C#, stacks, queues and arrays, string and array LeetCode-medium questions), then a culture-fit / HR round for Pune hiring

Decision. Pune reports cite 4 rounds (aptitude, two technical rounds, a final round) in about 5 days to 2 weeks with offers; Toronto senior reports (2023-2026) are mixed, with a 4-day to 2-week timeline, a declined offer in April 2026 and a 'neutral / negative' experience, including a note on slow communication in February 2025.

truefoundry.name: Truefoundry
truefoundry.note: A TrueFoundry job posting on Wellfound (company-written text) says the whole interview process is completed within 1 week: an intro call that is not an interview, one DSA + JavaScript round, two machine coding rounds, and a cultural fit round. Candidate reports add:
truefoundry.roles: TrueFoundry (cloud-native ML / LLM deployment platform on Kubernetes, Bengaluru and USA). Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (Core Engineering, 4+ yrs for frontend), Senior Frontend Engineer, Senior+ Software Engineer, SDET / QA Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, Senior Product Manager. A similarly named company, Foundry, was ignored.
steps: Technical screen: DSA, LLD and HLD rounds reported on Glassdoor (medium DSA on lexicographic ordering and matrix prefix sum; LLD on database schema design and API implementation)
A 2026 PracHub report for a Senior+ Software Engineer lists a technical screen then an onsite with problems like a VersionedArray, interview-scheduling APIs, and a behavioral round with the chief

Decision. Glassdoor reports range from a positive, difficult senior-engineer process ending in an accepted offer (Mar 2025) to a Bengaluru candidate in Mar 2026 complaining of an unresponsive contact and long delays between steps.

tubi.name: Tubi
tubi.note: Reports vary (2-5 stages) and the process is often quick, around 1-2 weeks:
tubi.roles: Software Engineer (backend with Elixir applications, frontend, iOS, full stack), Senior Software Engineer (San Francisco and Toronto, hybrid), a Builder's Program Software Engineer entry track mentioned in one report, plus DevOps, QA, Machine Learning and Data engineers. Levels are not publicly structured.
steps: Recruiter or sourcer call

Technical screen(s): coding with practical tasks (e.g. write a runnable program to parse a large log file and extract metrics; a React component build for frontend) and one report counts a 'screening -> technical -> manager/panel' sequence
System design interview and a panel / manager conversation covering behavioral topics and sometimes a product or project round
Decision. Some candidates mention remote interviews and mixed communication quality.

tudor.name: Tudor
tudor.note: Per Glassdoor, 1point3acres and Dataford (partly generic): Timeline: a New York application took 3 weeks (September 2024); London reports range from 1 week (2021) to 6 weeks (April 2025); Dataford says about 3-5 weeks over 4 rounds; one candidate (via recruiter) says the process took months with no feedback and communication simply stopped. Glassdoor shows mostly no-offer reports for junior quant developers with mixed or negative experiences.
tudor.roles: Sources are for Tudor Investment Corporation / The Tudor Group (New York, Stamford, London; discretionary and systematic macro, quantitative global macro, equity strategies). Roles seen on its Greenhouse board and in reports: Quantitative Developer (C++ on Linux, low-latency position tracking), Medium Frequency Quantitative Developer Intern (Pipeline team, New York; about $15-18k per month in a posting), Junior Quant Developer (London), Quantitative Software Engineer (New York / Stamford), Low Latency Quantitative Researcher, Medium Frequency Quantitative Researcher, Software Engineer, DevOps and Frontend Engineer (older HN posting) and a Summer Internship for 2026. No numeric ladder; entry routes are internships and junior roles.
steps: Application online or through a recruiter; a first phone or video screen with a quantitative researcher (a September 2024 New York report: video interview with a quantitative researcher, then a take-home data science assignment, then a super day if you pass both)

Technical phone call with a QR / engineer (a 2026 quant researcher first-round tech phone screen is described on 1point3acres); questions on Python fundamentals, algorithms and probability (Junior Quant Developer, London, 2021-2022); take-home assignment for quant roles; coding assessments and system-design discussions per Dataford's software engineer guide
Super day with technical and behavioral interviews (a full-day on-site in New York), then offer

turing.name: Turing
turing.note: Per Turing's own blog post by one of its technical interviewers (only a snippet was visible) and candidate reports: Timeline: Glassdoor shows about 31 days for software engineers (53 reports) and 29 days company-wide; reports range from 1-2 days to 3 months, and one Cameroon candidate waited 9 months. Glassdoor rates difficulty 3/5 with only 43% positive; several candidates complain of unclear rules and long waits after the online tests.
turing.roles: Sources are for Turing.com (remote developer marketplace and AI-training data company; Palo Alto CA, remote worldwide). Glassdoor engineering roles: Software Engineer (largest share, 53 reports in stage stats), Senior Software Engineer, Remote Software Engineer (Python/TypeScript at $170-200/hr), Software Engineer C++ ($200-300/hr) project roles, Lead Software Engineer. A third-party prep site lists Software Engineer, Senior and Lead tracks (unofficial). Turing's own blog says it typically looks for engineers with at least three years of experience.
steps: Register on Turing.com and build a developer profile (about three or more years of experience preferred); applications online, via staffing agency or referral
Automated tests on the platform: coding challenges (LeetCode / HackerRank style) and tech-stack tests; hiring companies can see your scores

Turing interview assessing technical knowledge, communication and English proficiency (one report: a non-technical English and communication assessment; another: describing your stack and recent project tasks); coding challenges such as flattening a deeply nested JavaScript object, sum of an array and its square root, and heavy SQL with data-structure programming for senior roles
Matching with a client company and further client interviews

turo.name: Turo
turo.roles: Glassdoor engineering reports cover Software Engineer (about 40), Senior Software Engineer (about 26) and Staff Software Engineer, in San Francisco, Los Angeles and remote; non-engineering volume includes claims associates/adjusters, managers and hosts. A third-party site lists a P1 (Associate) to P7 (Distinguished) engineer ladder (unofficial, from a candidate-prep site).
steps: Application online, referral, recruiter or agency
HR / recruiter sync
Phone / technical screen (45-60 min coding; some reports mention a skills test or online assessment)

Virtual onsite, focused on coding and system design (for example designing a booking system) plus platform questions (Kubernetes, data modeling for senior roles, mobile topics for Android roles) and a behavioral round; staff reports mention a panel interview and background check

Offer. A third-party guide calls it a three-stage pipeline of about three weeks. Glassdoor shows about 23 days company-wide and about 42 days for staff engineers; reports vary from 1 week to 6 weeks, and some candidates mention long gaps and ghosting.

twitch.name: Twitch
twitch.roles: Software Engineer / Software Development Engineer (SDE I, L4 through L8 numbering per third-party guides, unofficial; Twitch is an Amazon subsidiary), Senior Software Engineer, Software Engineering Manager, safety, memberships and discovery team engineers.
steps: Application online or hiring manager outreach
Recruiter prescreen (general view of the role and process)
Hiring manager conversation and/or online or timed coding assessment (design-and-debug style tasks reported; some medium / hard LeetCode-style questions)

Technical screen, then a final loop of about four to five interviews: coding, system design (for example parking garage system), behavioral questions that guides say resemble Amazon-style leadership principles
Team call and decision. Guides say 2-8 weeks; some reports describe a light two-interview loop in about a week (reports vary).

two-sigma.name: Two Sigma
two-sigma.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Quantitative Software Engineer, Quantitative Researcher, Quantitative Analyst, Data Scientist, interns (SWE and QR), Vice President and Associate titles. Candidate guides label engineer levels L1-L8 (unofficial).
steps: Application and recruiter contact (sometimes begins with an email expressing interest, then a scheduling call)
Online assessment, usually HackerRank (up to ~2 hrs coding)
Technical phone / live interview(s) where algorithm difficulty is the main filter (BFS/DFS, binary search, implementing a DB class, Java debugging with tests; quant SWE roles also get ML basics)
Virtual onsite of ~4-6 rounds total: coding, design and resume questions
Decision. Slow in some reports (Glassdoor average about 26-46 days; one 2015 report took over 6 months to reach onsite). Pass rates reported as low.

uber.name: Uber
uber.roles: Software Engineer (SWE I, II, Senior, Staff, Senior Staff levels per candidate guides, unofficial), ML engineer, data engineer, technical program manager and other engineering roles.
steps: Application
Recruiter conversation
Online coding assessment or live technical screen (45-60 min, 1-2 algorithm problems; HackerRank/CodeSignal style is common)
Interview loop of ~4-6 interviews: coding, software architecture / system design, behavioral
Optional take-home or assessment for some teams, then decision. Typically 2-6 weeks.

uber-freight.name: Uber Freight
uber-freight.note: Uber Freight reports are few, so this combines them with the Uber-wide process (see the Uber row for Uber's own engineering interview blog, which was also found in results):
uber-freight.roles: Uber Freight (Uber's logistics and freight marketplace; Glassdoor files its reports under Uber). Software Engineer (platform team, full stack), Software Engineer interns (e.g. Summer 2026, Chicago), Senior Software Engineer. Uber-wide titles include Software Engineer I/II (SDE-1, SDE-2), Staff and Engineering Manager, but Freight levels are not separately published.
steps: Recruiter call (and sometimes an online assessment)
Technical phone screen (45-60 min coding; a full stack candidate reports a pure JavaScript phone screen)

Onsite rounds reported for Freight in 2026: DSA (e.g. a car and N riders with constraints), low-level design (a file system), system design (a URL shortener, a real-time analytics dashboard with high throughput and caching), plus frontend coding for full stack roles, a hiring manager round and a behavioral interview on culture fit
Decision. Timelines vary (one Uber report says 4 weeks).

ubs.name: Ubs
ubs.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports and guides: Timeline: Glassdoor shows about 9 days for software engineers (67 reports) and 19 days company-wide; reports range from 1 day (campus) to 2-4 weeks. Glassdoor rates difficulty about 3/5 with 49% positive for software engineers (company average 62%). Other divisions (investment banking, wealth management) were not researched here.
ubs.roles: Very broad bank. Glassdoor volume across UBS is led by Associate Director (about 1,157), Director (833), Analyst (578), Intern (538), Software Engineer (about 440) and Authorized Officer (409), plus Wealth Management, Investment Banking Analyst, Summer Analyst, Business Analyst and Executive Director roles. UBS engineering uses its banking grades: Employee (about 1-5 yrs), Authorized Officer (4-7 yrs), Associate Director (8-15 yrs), Director, Executive Director and Managing Director (as listed by a third-party prep site; the Glassdoor role counts show the same grade names). Sites: Pune, Hyderabad, Wrocław, Krakow, Singapore, Hong Kong, London, New York, Weehawken NJ.
steps: Application online, recruiter, campus drive or referral; recruiter / HR screen (motivation to join, background)
Online or skills test for some tracks (campus drives in India add aptitude / IQ tests; Glassdoor stage stats show one-on-one interview 23%, skills test 17%, presentation 14%, IQ test 10%)

Technical rounds: a pure technical first interview where you code live in a shared environment (Java, automation, data structures; for example how a map container is implemented), two rounds in total in one Interview Query report, design of an inventory system, designing a streaming pipeline that avoids throttling (2026 reports), and a group-panel interview in older reports

Managerial / HR round and final decision, then background check. A 3-4 round loop is typical per prep sites (Employee and Authorized Officer levels 3 rounds, Associate Director 4); TechPrep says a 4-5 stage pipeline

uipath.name: UiPath
uipath.roles: Software Engineer (Software Engineer II, Senior, Principal, Senior Principal, Distinguished Engineer; L-level numbers from third-party guides are unofficial), RPA Developer, AI Engineer, QA Engineer, Frontend Engineer, Engineering Manager, Solutions / Sales / Pre-Sales Engineer, Customer Success Manager. Glassdoor report volume mixes engineering with sales and customer-facing roles.
steps: Application online, via recruiter or employee referral
Recruiter screen (background and behavioral)
Online assessment for some candidates
Technical interview (about 60 min virtual, live coding on HackerRank-style tool; data structures such as graphs / BFS and tries, string and list problems)
Further technical rounds and/or hiring manager conversation; senior roles can add system / cloud deployment design questions. Guides say about 3-7 rounds depending on region and seniority.
Decision. Reports vary from about 2-3 weeks to longer; several senior reports describe the process negatively (reports vary).

uniswap.name: Uniswap
uniswap.roles: Software Engineer, Web3 Software Engineer, Senior Backend Engineer (Platform), Senior Smart Contract Engineer, Application Security Engineer, Senior Application Security Engineer, Engineering Manager. The sheet links uniswap.org; hiring is through Uniswap Labs (New York or US remote). A listing for the senior backend role asks for 6+ years of experience, and no other level codes were seen.
steps: Application online, referral or recruiter outreach
Initial recruiter call (about 30 minutes on background, role and logistics)
Technical interview and coding exercises; a third-party guide describes an intensive, hands-on process of 5-6 stages over about 45-60 days with emphasis on thinking in systems, ownership and security

Onsite or final loop: coding, system design and unusual HR questions about Uniswap's global impact (an onsite report); the company's own job posting says that if any part of the process allows or encourages AI usage, candidates are told ahead of time

Decision. Guides give about 3-5 weeks for some roles and 45-60 days for software engineers, and one 2024 Glassdoor candidate with an employee referral rated it a difficult interview and got no offer (reports vary).

upstart.name: Upstart
upstart.roles: Software Engineer (verifications platform, mobile, Upstart Bank; Senior, Principal levels L3-L7 in candidate guides, unofficial), Site Reliability Engineer, Analytics Engineer, engineering managers; Glassdoor's most-reported role is Credit Analyst.
steps: Recruiter phone screen (behavioral, why Upstart)
Timed coding assessment (CodeSignal-style with strict time limits) or live coding / technical + behavioral interview with a senior engineer
Onsite / virtual loop: system design, a hands-on project round, hiring manager conversations; an exec / VP chat after the onsite is reported
Decision. Roughly 2-4 weeks; round counts vary by report.

valon.name: Valon
valon.note: Candidate reports (mostly Taro and Glassdoor) describe a practical, non-LeetCode style: Taro shows a very low pass rate (0 of 11 in one US sample) and several candidates describe the process as disorganized.
valon.roles: Valon (mortgage / loan servicing technology). Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Staff Software Engineer, Lead Software Engineer, New Grad Software Engineer (Python-heavy); Glassdoor also shows Manager and Loan Officer reports.
steps: Recruiter chat
Behavioral interview with an engineering manager, sometimes combined with a first coding session

Coding block: about 1 hr of pair programming plus 1 hr of solo programming, then ~30 min of code review / walkthrough (build and iterate on provided documentation; a ledger bank service is one reported task); some reports describe a 2.5-hour coding project in a two-part onsite

System design relating to Valon's product, plus further behavioral rounds, then decision. Total interview time of 5-6 hours is reported; Glassdoor average is about 14 days, though some candidates report up to 6 weeks and delays between rounds.

vanta.name: Vanta
vanta.note: Candidate guides count about 2-4 stages over roughly 2-5 weeks, and Vanta is described as moving fast (sometimes contacting applicants within hours):
vanta.roles: Software Engineer (backend, frontend, full-stack; early-career program in San Francisco and New York), Senior Software Engineer (also Vancouver, Toronto), plus go-to-market roles whose interviews mix technical and GTM scenarios. Levels are not publicly structured.
steps: Recruiter screen / engagement (the recruiter shares documents outlining the process and what each interview covers)
Online assessment or timed screen (arrays, strings, hash maps, basic graph/tree traversal) and/or a ~60 min live technical with two Vanta engineers via video; OOP-style edge-case questions are common

Onsite / virtual loop (about 3-4 rounds): a practical ~90 min live feature build (building a CLI is mentioned), a LeetCode-medium style round, system design for senior roles, behavioral and past-experience discussion
Decision. Taro reports a low pass rate for senior roles (about 13% in one sample), and some candidates call the prep demanding.

veeva-systems.name: Veeva Systems
veeva-systems.note: Interview Query summarises candidate reports as a behavioral screen, a Java-leaning coding assessment, live technical rounds and often a team day, with reported coding difficulty mostly easy to medium. Other sources add:
veeva-systems.roles: Veeva Systems (life-sciences cloud software; Pleasanton CA, Toronto, Boston, remote, India). Software Engineer, Associate Software Engineer / New Grad, Senior Software Engineer (Python, Ostro, Java), Principal and Senior Principal Software Engineer, Software Engineer - Test Automation / Infra, QA Engineer, Software Engineer Intern, plus Consultant, Associate Consultant, Data Steward and Data Curator roles that dominate Glassdoor counts (Consultant 131, Software Engineer 108, Data Steward 94). A third-party site labels levels Associate / Software Engineer / Senior / Principal / Senior Principal (unofficial).
steps: Application, then a first-round personality and behavioral interview (motivation: why Veeva, why this major or team) and sometimes a personality test; new grad and intern routes include phone interviews and a skills test

Coding assessment and technical interview (45 min coding on data structures and algorithms, e.g. two-sum on a sorted list, constructing a tree from a string, simple calendar algorithm in Java); some senior reports are mostly about your work experience plus basic technical questions

Live technical rounds and a managerial or team day, then background check and offer. Glassdoor shows an average of about 5 days for software engineers (2 reports) and 30 days company-wide; third-party pages put the process at about 14 days over 3-4 rounds. A recruiter referral for an internal Tech Services role took 2 months in a May 2024 report.

vercel.name: Vercel
vercel.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (frontend-focused, infrastructure and platform), machine learning engineer, forward-deployed engineer, solutions architect, product manager. Locations in reports: San Francisco, Vancouver, UK/Manchester, Amsterdam and remote. One third-party guide lists Software Engineer and Senior Software Engineer pay bands but no official ladder.
steps: Application online, referral or recruiter
Recruiter screen
Hiring manager screen (one report: fails if you cannot show you understand Vercel's product)

Technical interview: practical coding such as a rate limiter or a hit counter with time-window queries (some reports say DSA tests), plus real-life scenario questions on parallel programming, scaling and caching

Further rounds: a frontend-focused interview, system design, and a take-home/code-review or practical build for some roles (one guide describes a practical coding build and an engineer code review); candidates are often asked to use or critique v0

Decision. Guides say about 5 stages over 3-5 weeks (a March 2025 Senior SWE report lists 5 rounds over 3 weeks); Taro shows an 11% pass rate across 9 reports. Several 2025-2026 candidates describe a disorganized or unprofessional recruiting process.

verkada.name: Verkada
verkada.roles: Software Engineer (new grad, SWE, Senior, plus L2-L7 style level numbers from one candidate-guide site, unofficial), Backend Engineer, Solutions Engineer, engineering manager. Reports are mainly for software engineering in San Mateo, Seattle and other US locations, plus Canada.
steps: Application online or via recruiter
Recruiter call (some candidates also report an early hiring-manager chat)
First technical interview / phone screen with an engineer (about 60 min, LeetCode medium style: arrays, graphs, algorithms plus thought process)
Final round, about 3.5 hours of 4 back-to-back interviews: coding, system / API design for experienced levels (e.g. design and implement APIs), domain knowledge, behavioral
Decision. Reports vary: about 3 to 4 weeks overall. Taro stats (27 US SWE reports) show a low pass rate of roughly 11%, and a few candidates describe the process as disorganized.

versemedical.name: Versemedical
versemedical.note: Per Verse's own job posting (text reproduced on Built In) and candidate reports (all 2026): One January 2026 candidate describes 2 technical rounds, the second followed by behavioral/system design with the hiring manager. Timeline: one candidate says 2 weeks; reports mention communications getting lost in email and recruiting that felt poorly screened. Most Glassdoor reports are no offer.
versemedical.roles: Verse Medical (hospital-quality care at home; New York and San Francisco hybrid; Series C). Roles seen: Software Engineer, Full Stack (including Emerging Talent / early-career at $130-140k and junior or senior variants), Senior Full Stack Software Engineer, backend engineers; the stack is Python, TypeScript, Flask, React, Apollo GraphQL, Postgres, Airflow, AWS and GCP. No numeric level ladder seen.
steps: Introductory call (30 min) with a Talent Partner: background, interests and the role

Technical interview (90 min): live session with a Verse engineer; candidates describe an API-focused coding task (call a weather API and iterate over the data), React/Python or Flask/Express backend work and SQL queries, plus behavioral questions
Final technical interview or onsite (4 hours): an in-depth pair-programming exercise (about 3 hours of coding plus a behavioral portion) with Verse's Head of Engineering / engineering leadership
Conversation with the CEO (45 min) on vision, values and long-term impact (per one posting)

virtu.name: Virtu
virtu.note: Candidate guides describe about 4 stages over 3-6 weeks, more structured than most prop shops:
virtu.roles: Virtu Financial. Software Engineer (low-latency C++ hot-path trading systems, Python for platform and analytics, full-stack with JavaScript tasks), Software Engineer - Trading Strategies, FPGA Engineer, DevOps Engineer, Software Engineer / Developer Interns (New York, Austin), plus Quantitative Trader, Quantitative Analyst / Researcher, Operations Analyst and Sales and Trading Analyst roles.
steps: Online assessment: for software engineers two HackerRank-style algorithm problems in about 90 min (interns report five easy Codility-style problems; quant roles get probability and mental-maths tests)
Recruiter conversation about the process and your background

Virtual technical interview with an engineer: combined data-structures and low-level design problems, with heavy emphasis on low-latency design and C++ (a JavaScript task appears for full-stack roles); prior-work discussion
Additional interviews / final rounds, then decision. Reports range from days to 2 months.

virtu-financial.name: Virtu Financial
virtu-financial.roles: Software Engineer (including Trading Strategies, full-stack, C++ low-latency), Software Developer / Software Engineer Intern, DevOps Engineer, FPGA Engineer, Quantitative Analyst / Researcher, Trader, Trading Operations. No official level codes seen. The sheet notes this row as a duplicate / alias of Virtu.
steps: Application via careers page, recruiter or campus
Online assessment (HackerRank / Codility style; one guide says two algorithmic problems in 90 minutes, an intern report mentions 5 easy problems)
Recruiter conversation about the process, then a virtual technical interview with an engineer (combined DSA and low-level design problem reported)
Further interviews if you pass: C++ and low-latency design emphasis for hot-path systems, JavaScript task for full-stack roles, behavioral / HR round (Austin HR screen reported)
Decision. Guides say four stages over about 3-6 weeks; some campus cases take up to 2 months (reports vary).

visa.name: Visa
visa.roles: Software Engineer / Software Development Engineer (Associate SWE, SWE, Senior, Staff, Senior Staff, Lead, Chief, Distinguished per candidate guides, with L4-L9 style numbers, all unofficial), software engineering manager (VP / SVP). Reports are mostly from India (Bengaluru), US and Europe; Glassdoor reports for Visa also include non-engineering roles that were not detailed in the results seen.
steps: Application (career fair / university route also reported)
Timed online assessment on HackerRank or CodeSignal (e.g. a CodeSignal general coding assessment with 4 questions), focused on data structures and algorithms
Introductory conversation with recruiter or hiring manager; resume and project deep-dive
Live technical screens: easy-to-medium coding, some SQL / database design questions, two-pointer and sliding-window style problems
System design panel for experienced levels, plus behavioral / hiring-manager round on past projects, deadlines, and culture fit
Decision. Reports vary: roughly 3 to 5 weeks per most guides, up to about 8 weeks in one; some candidates report slow feedback.

voleon.name: Voleon
voleon.note: Software Engineer path as candidates describe it (about 4-7 rounds, around 4 weeks): Final-round content is NDA-covered, so reports are sparse. Many candidates describe it as hard, with rejections given without feedback.
voleon.roles: The Voleon Group (machine-learning-driven hedge fund). Software Engineer (new grad, Senior/Staff; data engineering and data infrastructure teams), Software Engineer Intern (summer 2027 postings open from September 2026), Member of Research Staff / Researcher, Data Scientist, Data Engineer, DevOps and Site Reliability Engineers, FinOps and Operations, Quantitative Researcher and Trader (Voleon Securities, experienced hires). On Glassdoor, Member of Research Staff and Software Engineer tie as the most-reported roles.
steps: Short recruiter / HR-style screen
Online assessment or take-home coding task (~1-1.5 hr)
Technical phone screen (45-60 min, LeetCode medium-to-hard style, HackerRank-type environment)

Virtual onsite of ~4 parts: hard algorithm problems, simulation-style implementation tasks, object-oriented design, resume deep dive, open-ended design work (an order-matching engine design problem is mentioned)
Culture / intro discussion, then references and a background check

walmart-labs.name: Walmart Labs
walmart-labs.roles: Software Engineer (Walmart Global Tech, formerly Walmart Labs): Software Engineer II, III, Senior, Staff and Principal Software Engineer per a candidate guide (unofficial); full stack, backend and information security engineers in Sunnyvale, Bentonville and India; also Walmart Connect roles. Glassdoor's Walmart page is mostly store roles (Personal Shopper, Team Lead, Manager).
steps: Recruiter screen (background, role, team, timeline, compensation range)
Online assessment (reported) and/or one or two phone screens (45-60 min live coding, LeetCode-style, plus technical background; one report mentions a 3-4 hr homework to present in a live round)
Virtual onsite of 3-4 rounds: coding (data structures, graphs), system design (caching strategy, regional fallback, write conflicts across distribution centers), behavioral
Decision. Usually about 3-5 weeks (Glassdoor reports from 8 days to 4 weeks). Moves faster than most big tech.

warner-bros-discovery.name: Warner Bros Discovery
warner-bros-discovery.roles: Software Engineer, Software Developer, Senior Software Engineer, Software Engineer Intern / Co-op, early career developers. Reports come from Burbank, New York, Seattle, Atlanta, Ottawa, Toronto, London, Bengaluru and Hyderabad. The sheet links wbd.com. No official level codes seen.
steps: Application online, campus or recruiter outreach; recruiter introductory call (about the role and company, not technical)
Online assessment or technical phone screen (campus: MCQs plus a short AI-bot introduction; others: coding test, easy LeetCode-style problems, debugging)

Technical interviews, often a loop of several 1-hour sessions: algorithms and data structures (3 Sum, linked list reversal, Langton's Ant), system design (for example a messaging app), project architecture deep dive and behavioral questions; some US teams add a take-home or hands-on task
Hiring manager and director / stakeholder conversations

Decision. Reports range from 3 days to about 4 weeks; several candidates mention disorganized scheduling or a lack of follow-up, and some Bengaluru candidates withdrew over interviewer behavior (reports vary).

warp.name: Warp
warp.note: Warp publishes its own detailed engineering hiring guide ('How We Hire Engineers at Warp' on Notion; only snippets visible) plus a Console.dev profile. Per those: Candidate reports: a Glassdoor Applied AI Engineer report describes several rounds of phone screens and technical interviews with coding and system design plus a final product interview, with check-in calls, pre-work and week-long scheduling gaps, six weeks overall, and a dealbreaker mixed feedback on the product interview; other Glassdoor reports are positive and friendly (a screening call, hiring-manager meeting and technical interview; one 1-week process in New York). Glassdoor shows 100% positive ratings at difficulty 3/5 across few reports.
warp.roles: Warp (Rust-based terminal that became an agentic development environment, with Oz and Warp Factories; New York and remote within the US and Canada; small engineering team). Roles seen on Greenhouse and job boards: Software Engineer, Software Engineer (Enterprise Security; 5+ years), Forward Deployed Engineer (goes through the standard software engineering loop), Applied AI Engineer, plus GTM roles. Titles are flat; no numeric ladder seen. I did not use pages about the unrelated payroll and compliance startup also named Warp (warp.co).
steps: Application, with an optional programming challenge (Warp's Greenhouse posting links Part 1 and Part 2 of an optional programming challenge); first conversation / recruiter or hiring-manager call
A 1-hour standard technical screen, or a second phone call with an engineer that includes a short coding exercise, time to discuss working at Warp and a live demo of the product
A roughly 2-3 hour technical session (Console.dev's older description: 2 hours with three sections, coding, algorithms and runtime analysis, and system design, to assess your level)
A roughly 2-hour final round with a product session and a chat with an engineering manager
A couple of reference checks, an optional conversation with an investor, then offer

wayfair.name: Wayfair
wayfair.roles: Software Engineer (SWE I, II, III, Senior, Staff, Principal; one guide uses L1-L6 labels, unofficial), engineering manager / associate director. Glassdoor report volume is broad and not mostly engineering: Customer Service Representative is the largest, then Software Engineer, Manager, Senior Manager, Senior Analyst, Recruiter and Business Analyst.
steps: Application online, referral, or university route
Recruiter screen: overview of Wayfair and the technology team
Online / technical assessment: typically two HackerRank-style data structure and algorithm problems (older reports: a coding challenge or take-home project)
Phone interview with an engineer (level-dependent): practical problems such as top-N scores from a scoreboard
Onsite panel (virtual): coding, system design for senior levels, a data-pipeline optimization style discussion, then a fit / cultural discussion with the hiring manager

Decision. Reports vary: about 2-5 weeks, and Interview Query summarizes it as about a month end to end. Wayfair's own tech blog says it aims for real problems without tricks and an evidence-based, bias-aware process.

waymo.name: Waymo
waymo.roles: Software Engineer (L3-L9 per candidate guides, unofficial; teams like perception evaluation, planner evaluation, fleet monitoring, quantitative evaluations), Machine Learning Engineer, Software Reliability Engineer, Technical Program Manager, plus Software Quality Operations Associate, Vehicle Operator and Operations roles per Glassdoor.
steps: Recruiter screen (background, interest, process overview)
Technical coding screen (medium-hard LeetCode difficulty, often graph or grid traversal; frontloaded and hard even for ML roles)

Final loop (about 4 rounds): coding rounds (language chosen by team, e.g. Java, JavaScript/UI), system design (and ML or autonomous-driving topics for ML roles), hiring manager conversation, behavioral
Decision. Alphabet-style structured process; roughly 2-4+ weeks in reports.

wayve.name: Wayve
wayve.note: Wayve's own job postings (hosted on ev.careers) carry an 'Interview Process' section that opens by saying the process is clear and respectful of your time, but the steps themselves were not visible in my results. TechPrep describes a fast four-stage pipeline, about two weeks from first contact to offer. Candidate reports add:
wayve.roles: Wayve (embodied AI for autonomous driving; London, Sunnyvale, Detroit, Tokyo, Germany). Software Engineer (Product, AI Portal; Platform Integration), Senior Software Engineer, Embedded Automotive Platforms and Application Software Engineers (C++), Machine Learning Engineer, Applied Scientist, Research Engineer, Platform / Cloud SRE, Principal Engineer, Tech Lead / Manager, plus Autonomous Vehicle Safety Driver and People / Product roles. Levels shown as Software Engineer / Senior / Principal / Staff in postings.
steps: Recruiter conversation (often a LinkedIn approach; the recruiter explains requirements and timeline and can accelerate for candidates with other offers)

Technical screen: easy-to-medium LeetCode-style array problems and system design questions (Jul 2025 report), or a Python function exercise; platform candidates report YAML file reading and editing tasks

Panel or on-site style interviews (Glassdoor: group panel, one-on-one, presentation and skills-test stages); a Germany-based engineer reports 5 interviews including a case study over 4 weeks with a smooth, friendly experience
Offer or rejection. Glassdoor average is about 21 days for software engineers (24 days company-wide), with a mix of positive and ghosting experiences.

weiss-asset-management.name: Weiss Asset Management
weiss-asset-management.note: Per WAM's own internship posting (company-described, only a snippet was visible): two interview tracks, quantitative and fundamental; the quantitative process emphasizes coding, statistics and game theory. Candidate reports (Glassdoor, PracHub, Dataford; mostly interns, analysts and data roles, so engineering detail is thin):
weiss-asset-management.roles: Weiss Asset Management (WAM; Boston-based multi-strategy investment firm, about $3.8B, with a New York presence). Roles seen on its Greenhouse board and job boards: Quantitative Developer (3+ years in finance), Python Software Engineer, Risk Developer (C#, 5-10 years), Quantitative Analyst Internship and Investment Analyst Internship (Summer 2026 / 2027, quantitative and fundamental tracks), Data Scientist, Financial / Business / Operations Analyst. WAM offers two interview tracks: quantitative (coding, statistics, game theory) and fundamental (research skills and analysis). No numeric ladder seen.
steps: Application online or via university; short screening questions about your finance background can affect the process
Online assessment: about 6 probability questions plus one coding challenge (one October 2024 report), or an online quiz and take-home assessments

Behavioral interview of about 60 minutes (why Weiss, why you), then multi-step live assessments: brainteasers, probability, game theory and a small programming exercise; one data-science candidate got a one-hour power-trading forecast case study with two documents to read

Further rounds, then offer. Timeline: Glassdoor shows about 5 days across 3 reports, while other candidates report 1 to 3 weeks and a campus process of 2 months; Dataford says about 3-5 weeks over 4 rounds for analysts. Developer-specific rounds were not found; confirm with the recruiter.

wells-fargo.name: Wells Fargo
wells-fargo.roles: Software Engineer (L1 Associate through L2, L3 Senior, L4 Lead, L5 Principal, L6 Distinguished per candidate guides, unofficial), Software Engineer internships, plus huge non-engineering volume. Glassdoor reports are dominated by Teller, Personal Banker, Bank Teller and Customer Service roles; Senior Software Engineer and Software Engineer are the top tech groups.
steps: Application online (many tech reports are from India hubs such as Hyderabad, plus US sites)
Online assessment / coding test for many engineering candidates
Technical interview(s): Java / C++ fundamentals, data structures, SQL, resume project discussion
Hiring manager / managerial round on past projects and behavioral questions
HR round, then decision. Some reports finish all rounds in one day; Glassdoor shows about 30 days overall for the company (reports vary).

weride.name: WeRide
weride.note: WeRide's own job postings say the interview process aims to learn about your skills, experience and motivators, that it may use AI tools to support parts of hiring (e.g. reviewing applications) without replacing human judgment, and that it cannot give individual feedback because of application volume. Detailed steps come from candidate reports:
weride.roles: WeRide (Level 4 autonomous driving, offices in San Jose CA and China). Software Engineer / General Software Engineer (real-time systems, cloud services for AV fleets, data frameworks), Software Engineer - Algorithm, Perception / Computer Vision / Deep Learning engineers, Software Development Engineer (SDE), New Grad (2025-2027 cohorts) and Summer Intern Software Engineer postings. Levels are not published in the postings.
steps: Application online, short HR call (~15 min on experience, computer networks, OS and full-stack basics)

Online assessments / coding interviews on HackerRank or live (reports mention about 3 sessions of 1 hr each, with LeetCode medium and one hard problem, token-bucket style design question; C/C++ preferred for some roles)
Virtual onsite of about 3 rounds with different team members and a ~15 min resume deep dive
Decision. About 2 weeks per one Glassdoor report; Glassdoor shows an average of 18 days across the company. Algorithm and SDE roles are described as demanding on data structures and algorithms.

wex.name: Wex
wex.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports:
wex.roles: Sources are for WEX Inc. (fleet, travel and health payments; South Portland ME, Portland ME, Bengaluru, Melbourne, São Paulo and remote). Glassdoor volume: Customer Service Representative (about 60), Software Engineer (47), Senior Software Engineer (29), Software QA Engineer (20), DevOps Engineer (14), Software Engineer II (11), Data Engineer (10), plus Lead Software Engineer and Software Development Engineer (SDE 3 in Bengaluru), junior full-stack engineers and interns. No official numeric ladder seen.
steps: Application online, referral, university or staffing agency (one April 2026 candidate met a third-party recruiter); recruiter phone screen covering pay, the job and the process

Take-home assignment for some processes (a Lead / Senior candidate had a 5-day production-ready application assignment on top of a full-time job, and called it very challenging); other processes use a group-panel interview or a case interview

Technical and manager interviews: a phone interview, then an interview with the manager and an interview with the larger team (older three-stage process); a recent lead process had a design-problem round, then a more conversational technical interview and a third interview, spread over about 2 weeks; Bengaluru SDE: phone screening, hiring manager, team member; questions cover tech stack, RESTful concepts, basic algorithms and team environments

Decision. Timeline: Glassdoor shows about 22 days company-wide and about 14 days for interns; reports range from 1-2 days (campus) to 4 weeks, with one referral taking 8 weeks and another candidate describing constant status chasing. Dataford calls the process straightforward and efficient (about 3-5 weeks over 4 rounds for DevOps).

whatnot.name: Whatnot
whatnot.roles: Software Engineer (backend, full-stack, mobile) and Data Engineer. One candidate report says HR described only two software levels, Software Engineer and Principal Software Engineer; a third-party guide instead lists L3 through L8 (unofficial, reports conflict). Product-minded engineering is stressed in reports.
steps: Application online, via recruiter or referral
Recruiter / hiring manager call (about 30 min) covering background, process and expectations
Technical screen or coding interview (about 1 hour; algorithms / data structures, sometimes 2 coding tasks or 1 with a twist)

Further rounds, reported as: system design (about 1 hour), product sense interview (for example how to onboard new customers, thinking like a PM), then a final behavioral conversation with a leadership team member that may include questions about using the Whatnot product
Decision. Reports vary from about 4 weeks to 2 months; total rounds reported as 3-4 or more.

whoop.name: Whoop
whoop.roles: Software Engineer (11 Glassdoor reports), Senior Software Engineer, Backend Engineer, Mobile Engineer, Embedded Software Engineer, Software Engineer Co-Op, plus a large Membership Services / customer support group in report counts. Whoop is the Boston wearables company. No official level codes seen beyond Senior and Co-Op titles.
steps: Application online or employee referral; the company's engineering site invites candidates to write a personal statement about challenges overcome and their path into engineering rather than rehashing a resume
Initial call from HR / recruiter

Technical rounds that mimic on-the-job work (one candidate says Whoop put thought into a short engineering process): for senior engineers reported as four rounds covering coding / pseudocode, system design, refactoring legacy code and a behavioral interview; topics include writing APIs, structuring data models, Kubernetes and improving a loading experience
Final panel; co-op candidates met four engineers over about four hours
Decision. Guides say about 2-4 weeks; reports show about 3 weeks, though Taro shows a low pass rate (about 17 percent among 6 senior reports) (reports vary).

workday.name: Workday
workday.roles: Software Engineer (P1 through P6 levels per a candidate-guide ladder, unofficial), Senior Software Engineer, Software Development Engineer, Software Applications Engineer, Associate Applications Developer, Associate Software Engineer, QA Engineer, Software Engineer Intern. Glassdoor report volume also includes Account Executive (about 232), Product Manager, Consultant, Manager, Director and Sales, so the company's reports are not all engineering. Offices: Pleasanton, San Mateo, Atlanta, Dublin, Chennai and others.
steps: Application online, referral or campus
Recruiter / HR screen: mostly non-technical, past experience and scenario-style questions
Phone / technical screen of about 30-60 min with an engineer, or an online skills test (some reports mention a take-home); coding and project-based questions such as the hardest project you worked on
Virtual onsite of 4-5 rounds: coding, engineering / system design, hiring-manager conversation and behavioral rounds; formats vary by team
Decision. Reports vary: about 2-4 weeks per guides, with Glassdoor putting software engineer hiring at about 18 days and the company overall at 31 days. Some reports mention up to 6 weeks.

worldquant.name: Worldquant
worldquant.roles: Glassdoor report volume is dominated by non-engineering roles: Research Consultant (largest, about 111 reports), Quantitative Researcher (about 97), then Software Engineer (about 26), Consultant, Researcher, BRAIN Research Consultant, Portfolio Manager, Quant Research Intern, Quantitative Analyst, Senior Software Engineer. Engineering-side roles include Quantitative Developer, C++ Software Engineer (Data Platform), Senior C++ Software Engineer, Software Engineering Lead (MetaTech). Offices mentioned: New York, Singapore, London, Tel Aviv, Ho Chi Minh City, Beijing.
steps: Application online, university, recruiter or referral
Online assessments: logic, probability and programming tests, sometimes a 90-minute exam; quant tracks may also add an IQ-style and personality test

Phone / video technical interview: for software and quant developer roles, self-description, C++ and OOP basics (linked lists, inheritance, #define vs const), LeetCode-style problems (edit distance, stock problem, square root, design); for quant researcher roles, probability, expectation and reasoning questions

Onsite or final interviews: about six people met in one older report, mixing algorithms, language, software engineering and behavioral questions; quant researcher loops are described as multi-round and challenging
Decision. Reports vary: about 5 days to about 2 months. Glassdoor puts overall hiring at about 33 days.

xai.name: xAI
xai.note: Process varies by team, entry path and month; each round is scheduled only after you clear the previous one. Direct application path: online application, then a 15-30 min engineer call (instead of a recruiter call) on background and interest, then a technical phone screen (applied coding on a shared platform or CodeSignal with camera, mic, screen sharing and government ID), then two or three technical rounds (applied coding / OOP class design, systems-flavored implementation, deep dive into past projects; no dedicated behavioral round), then team matching call. New grad path: short screen, ~4 hr take-home assessment, then one in-person coding round. Some reports say xAI publishes its full process; I did not open an official xAI page, so the above is from candidate guides.
xai.roles: Software Engineer (also titled Software Engineer Specialist on Glassdoor), new grad Software Engineer, 'Exceptional Software Engineer', ML engineers, safety engineers, data engineers, DevOps engineers, AI engineers, product leads. Most roles are in Palo Alto with hubs in San Francisco, Los Angeles, Washington DC and Memphis, many in person.

xiaohongshu.name: Xiaohongshu
xiaohongshu.note: Public detail is thin (Dataford aggregates 18 interview reports as medium difficulty, with the full text behind a paywall). One Glassdoor report (Shanghai) describes an urgent recruitment call for a mentor interview at work; Glassdoor ratings are 100% positive with difficulty 2/5 across very few reports. PracHub lists Xiaohongshu coding and algorithms questions for Software Engineer and Backend Engineer roles. A Chinese campus-recruiting guide (Autumn 2024) covers the campus tech interview, salary and tips. Typical Chinese big-tech pattern, not confirmed for Xiaohongshu: resume screen, online assessment or written test, 2-3 technical rounds (algorithms, system/backend design, project deep dive), then a manager/HR round and offer; timeline not reported. Treat this row as low-confidence and use the company's careers page or a recruiter to confirm.
xiaohongshu.roles: Xiaohongshu (rednote / Little Red Book) engineering roles seen: Software Engineer, Backend Engineer, AI Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, Data Engineer, rednote Product Engineer Intern (campus posting); main offices in Shanghai and other Chinese cities. Dataford has role guides only for AI Engineer, Data Engineer and Machine Learning Engineer. I did not use pages about Red.Digital, NESTMii, Binance, OKX, Flow, TikTok or ByteDance that appeared in results, because they are different companies. No level ladder seen.

xometry.name: Xometry
xometry.roles: Software Engineer, Mid-level Software Engineer, Entry Level / Junior Software Developer, Staff Software Engineer (Core Platform), Senior Machine Learning Engineer, GenAI Engineer, Software Engineer Intern, plus QA, Security and Solutions Engineer roles. Reports come from North Bethesda MD, Austin TX and remote. No official level codes seen beyond title tiers.
steps: Application online or employee referral
Recruiter phone call
Hiring manager interview over Zoom, then a technical interview with the team over Zoom (reports say a standard software engineer interview; older loops included a coding test)
Longer final session in one older report: about 3.5 hours with a coding test, a position-specific interview, a social-type interview and a last half hour with the SVP of software engineering
Decision. Reports range from 3 days to about 3 weeks; a few candidates mention being ghosted after the final interview (reports vary; most reports are older than 2023).

xpeng.name: XPeng
xpeng.roles: Software Engineer (platform, big-data and autonomous-driving software, tools and infrastructure, motion control, perception), Machine Learning Engineer (deep learning, distributed training, vision-language models), Data Engineer, Data Analyst, and some account executive roles. Locations include Santa Clara CA and Chinese offices such as Shenzhen. Sources are for XPeng Motors / XPENG. No official or unofficial level ladder seen.
steps: Application and resume review
Recruiter call
Technical phone screen (candidate reports: LRU-cache style coding for data engineers; transformers and vision-language-model questions for ML engineers)
Technical/onsite rounds on distributed systems, backend, ML infrastructure or data-pipeline design, possibly clustered into one day or spread over several days; behavioral/culture conversation

Offer. Guides say about 3-5 weeks overall, with about a week between stages; one Dataford page cites an offer rate of about 36% from 59 reports. One April 2026 report describes the recruiter going silent after a technical screen.

yahoo.name: Yahoo
yahoo.roles: Software Engineer (Associate, SWE, Senior, Principal, Senior Principal, Distinguished per candidate guides, with IC2-IC9 style labels that are unofficial), Front End Engineer, Software Development Engineer, intern roles. Glassdoor report volume is dominated by Software Engineer and Senior Software Engineer, with smaller counts for Intern, Product Manager, Account Manager and Director. Sources are for Yahoo (the sheet's website points to Yahoo Inc's corporate site).
steps: Application online, referral or university route
Recruiter / HR phone screen; some cycles begin with an online assessment or skills test

Technical phone round: LeetCode easy-to-medium coding (one report mentions 7 easy/medium problems plus a brain teaser), Java and OOP basics such as interface vs abstract class, merge sort style questions, Unix command questions
Onsite / virtual loop, often two main rounds: coding, deep dive into projects from your resume, system design for senior levels, behavioral questions about a challenging project
Decision. Reports vary a lot by team: about 1-3 weeks in many reports, but one 2023 candidate reports 3 months. Taro stats (296 US SWE reports) show a pass rate of roughly 22%.

yelp.name: Yelp
yelp.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports:
yelp.roles: Glassdoor interview volume is dominated by sales roles (account executive is the top role with well over a thousand reports, plus senior AE, account manager, inside sales, elite account director). Engineering reports cover Software Engineer (about 375), Senior Software Engineer, Software Engineer Intern and New Grad, backend and infrastructure engineers, product manager, plus recent Toronto and Mexico City hiring. A third-party site lists an IC3 level engineer (unofficial).
steps: Application online, referral, or campus
Online coding assessment (often HackerRank) and/or recruiter call that explains the process
Technical phone screen: algorithms and data structures (recursion, arrays, hash maps, prefix/top-k problems), sometimes object design
Behavioral / project conversation with a team member or lead engineer about a past project and obstacles
Virtual onsite of about four rounds: coding, system design (for example a Yelp-takeout style data export design), past-project deep dive and behavioral

Decision. Glassdoor shows about 19 days for software engineers and about 35 days company-wide; reports vary from 1-2 weeks to 2 months, and one candidate was told the role had been filled before the final interview.

zest-ai.name: Zest AI
zest-ai.roles: Software Engineer, Software Developer, Machine Learning Engineer, DevOps Engineer. Zest AI is a fintech company applying machine learning to credit underwriting (Burbank / Los Angeles, CA). A similarly named company, ZestyAI (property-risk AI), also appeared in results and was ignored. Glassdoor reports for Zest AI are old (2016-2022) and few.
steps: Application online or university
Recruiter phone screen with a short background chat
Tech screen with a manager: basic data structures (make a stack without built-in functions, what is a linked list)
Video call, then a 'super day' (3 rounds in total in the 2017 report) with algorithms and optimizations, a language-agnostic take-home assignment and paired programming

Decision. Reports vary: about 2-3 weeks in the Glassdoor reports; Interview Query guesses 3-5 weeks for ML engineers. One 2022 developer candidate reports a negative experience. Evidence is thin and dated.

zillow.name: Zillow
zillow.roles: Software Development Engineer / Software Engineer (P2 new grad, P3, P4 Senior, P5 Principal, P6 Senior Principal, P7 per third-party guides, unofficial), Backend Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, AI-native product engineer. Glassdoor report volume is dominated by non-engineering roles: Sales Executive (largest), Account Executive, Inside Sales Consultant, Mortgage Loan Officer, Client Engagement Specialist.
steps: Application online, campus or employee referral
Recruiter / HR screen
Online coding challenge for many candidates, then technical phone screen
Virtual or onsite loop (about 4 hours in older reports; guides say 6-8 rounds for some teams): practical applied coding, a code refactoring round, system design, behavioral
Decision. Guides say about 4-6 weeks, Interview Query says 1-3 months for some teams, with slow scheduling and limited feedback reported (reports vary).

ziphq.name: ZipHQ
ziphq.roles: Software Engineer (backend-leaning, in San Francisco and Toronto per reports), plus solutions engineer, and other business roles listed on prep sites. Reports are mostly Software Engineer; no official or unofficial level ladder seen. I left out pages for Zip Co (a different company) and ZipRecruiter.
steps: Application online or via recruiter
Recruiter screen (about 15 min: basic fit and sponsorship checks)
Online assessment for some candidates (a CodeSignal assessment is mentioned, including some object-oriented design questions)
Technical screen of about 1 hour: medium-to-hard LeetCode-style DSA (graph, tree DP and file-system style problems reported) or a backend practical task such as a questionnaire evaluator

Hiring-manager round and onsite/virtual onsite: practical coding on a realistic codebase (one September 2026 report mentions an AI-assisted coding round on an expense-reimbursement codebase with about three small problems), possibly a system-design discussion
Decision. Process length was not clearly stated in the sources; candidate reports are mixed and few, with several rejections after the technical rounds.

zipline.name: Zipline
zipline.note: A techinterview.org guide notes Zipline has not published its engineering interview loop, so it is pieced together from candidate reports. Reports describe a long, project-heavy process, about 4-6 weeks (one candidate reports more than three months):
zipline.roles: Zipline (autonomous drone delivery, South San Francisco; not the Python backtesting library). Software Engineer (including manufacturing / test, enterprise systems and automation teams), Flight Software Engineer, Autonomy / Robotics Engineer, embedded and electrical engineers, plus mechanical, aeroelasticity, operations and product roles; internships such as Enterprise Systems Software Engineer Intern (Fall 2026). Levels are not published.
steps: Recruiter call (pleasant but sometimes probes manufacturing / hardware-adjacent experience)
Technical interview with a senior team member (project deep dive and technical discussion)
Large take-home project (a defining component), then a 1-hour review of your solution and design considerations with an engineer

Onsite of about 4-7 rounds (4x45 min in one report): project presentation, algorithm / LeetCode-style problem, system design, bug review, behavioral interviews with people from manufacturing and other teams
Decision. Taro shows a pass rate of about 14% across 21 reports, and some candidates describe long gaps or no response.

ziprecruiter.name: Ziprecruiter
ziprecruiter.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports:
ziprecruiter.roles: Software Engineer (largest share), Software Development Engineer (SDE), full-stack engineer, entry-level engineer; locations include Los Angeles / Santa Monica, San Francisco and remote. A third-party prep site lists a ladder of Software Engineer I, II, III, Senior I/II, Staff, Senior Staff, Principal I/II and Distinguished (unofficial, from a candidate-prep site).
steps: Application online or via employee referral
Timed online coding assessment, commonly four questions of easy-to-medium difficulty, focused on algorithms, data structures and speed; many candidates are rejected quickly after this stage

Recruiter screen and two engineering screens: LeetCode-easy-style problems with follow-ups on optimization, time/memory complexity, scaling and pitfalls; tasks such as implementing a banking or restaurant system
Technical rounds for some candidates: system design, database and frontend coding (a May 2025 full-stack report), then a behavioral round

Final offer. A May 2026 accepted candidate describes recruiter screen, 2 engineering screens, behavioral, final offer; prep sites estimate about 1-3 weeks per level; Glassdoor reports range from 1 week to 4 weeks, and candidates note communication gaps.

zoox.name: Zoox
zoox.roles: Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer (a candidate guide labels L1-L8, unofficial), Software Engineer intern (Perception intern, Foster City, San Diego, Boulder), Machine Learning Engineer, ML Platform Engineer, DevOps / SRE, Data Scientist, Test Engineer, Software QA Engineer, Technical Program Manager, UX Designer, Autonomous Vehicle Operator.
steps: Recruiter screen / talent-acquisition conversation (~30 min)
Technical screen: language-specific round (C++ is commonly mentioned), coding, debugging or low-level design

Onsite / virtual panel (several interviews): coding, system design, a hallmark math-and-science reasoning round that includes brain-teaser style problems, domain problem solving (e.g. diagnostics, databases, lane-changing style C++ questions), and a behavioral round with the hiring manager
Decision. About 2-5 weeks per guides; Glassdoor reports range from 2 weeks to 6 months, with one candidate describing very poor communication over a months-long process.

zscaler.name: Zscaler
zscaler.note: Software engineer path per candidate reports and guides:
zscaler.roles: Software Engineer (about 130 Glassdoor reports), Senior Software Engineer (about 68), Associate Software Engineer (about 37), Staff Software Engineer (about 31), Principal and Senior Staff engineers (C / networking / dataplane, React/TypeScript, service platform and orchestration), plus a large volume of sales engineer, regional sales manager, customer success and technical account manager reports. Locations: San Jose / Santa Clara / Sunnyvale / Fremont CA, New York, Bengaluru, Gurgaon, Hyderabad, Ireland. A third-party prep site lists Software Engineer I, Senior II, Staff I and Principal tracks (unofficial).
steps: Application online, referral, recruiter, or campus drive (campus reports include an online assessment and a group discussion)
Recruiter screen; online assessment / skills test for many candidates (Glassdoor shows one-on-one interviews, skills tests and phone interviews as the common stages)

Technical interviews: medium-level DSA (for example move zeros to the end, threading-related coding), operating-systems, networking (IPv4, round-robin scheduling), OOP, DBMS, C/C++/Python fundamentals; one report asked for a query layer that exposes insert-only storage as if it supported delete and update

Senior / staff loops: system design and in-depth design rounds (a March 2024 staff report had six interviews including the hiring manager), STAR-style behavioral and scenario rounds, then hiring manager / HR conversation

Offer. Timeline: TechPrep says about 3-5 weeks; Glassdoor shows about 23 days for software engineers; reports vary from 1 day to 2 months. Dataford counts 6 stages across 534 candidate reports. Several 2025-2026 candidates describe unfriendly interviewers.
